pmid-3186538.summary_en: A case report describes a massive benign intrapericardial teratoma in an infant who presented at two weeks of age with severe respiratory distress. Fetal echocardiography at 20 weeks had shown normal intracardiac anatomy and no pericardial mass or effusion. The authors conclude that the tumor grew spontaneously sometime between 20 and 40 weeks of gestation. The report highlights the possibility of rapid prenatal tumor development after a normal fetal scan.

pmid-3191342.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の予後に陰嚢汚染が与える影響を評価した研究である。初回治療中または治療前に陰嚢汚染があった精巣がん患者35例を、汚染のない70例と比較した。生存曲線、無病期間、2年生存率に有意差はなかった。このため、著者らは汚染例に対して陰嚢や浅鼠径リンパ節への追加の積極的手術は推奨しないと結論づけた。
pmid-3191342.summary_en: A comparison of 35 testicular cancer patients who had scrotal contamination during or before primary treatment with 70 patients who underwent radical inguinal orchiectomy without contamination. Survival curves, disease-free intervals, and 2-year survival rates did not differ significantly between groups. The authors therefore do not recommend additional aggressive surgery of the scrotum and superficial inguinal lymph nodes for these patients.

pmid-3192036.summary_ja: 1988年の症例報告で、高リスクの妊娠性絨毛癌を有する27歳女性が、多剤併用化学療法の開始後8時間以内に死亡した。子宮静脈壁の壊死に由来する腫瘍栓による肺動脈閉塞が原因と考えられた。大きな骨盤内腫瘍量を有する患者は死亡・耐性のリスクが高いとし、β-hCGによる反応評価を行いながら、比較的穏やかな初回治療を検討すべきと提言している。
pmid-3192036.summary_en: This 1988 case report describes a 27-year-old woman with high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma (Goldstein-Berkowitz score 11) who died within eight hours of starting multidrug chemotherapy. Massive pulmonary obstruction by tumor plugs, likely from necrosis of uterine venous walls, was considered the cause. The authors discuss that patients with large pelvic tumor burden face high risks of death and resistance, and suggest that milder initial treatment, guided by beta-hCG monitoring, may be preferable before escalating to combination chemotherapy.

pmid-3192478.summary_ja: 1988年の獣医学症例報告で、断続的な腹部不快感と腸閉塞様症状を呈した5歳の雌馬の症例である。直腸検査で左子宮角の腫瘤、剖検で腹腔内の多葉状腫瘤と肺結節が見つかり、腫大した左卵巣には軟骨と毛様物質が含まれていた。卵巣奇形癌と診断され、肺転移を伴う胚細胞腫瘍である。
pmid-3192478.summary_en: A 1988 veterinary case report describes a 5-year-old Appaloosa mare with intermittent abdominal discomfort and signs suggesting intestinal obstruction. Rectal palpation revealed a large mass on the left uterine horn with smaller extensions constricting the rectum. Necropsy showed multilobulated abdominal masses and pulmonary nodules, and the enlarged left ovary contained cartilage and hair-like material. Histology of all masses was similar, confirming a diagnosis of ovarian teratocarcinoma. This is an oncologic germ cell tumor in an animal with metastatic spread to the lungs.

pmid-3192730.summary_ja: 1988年の報告で、正常な妊娠後期の胎盤内に発生した絨毛癌2例を記述している。腫瘍に隣接する絨毛の被覆が腫瘍性栄養膜組織から成ることから、絨毛栄養膜由来の起源が支持された。病変は妊娠中に母体および胎児へ転移しうるほか、正期産後の絨毛癌の起源となる可能性も示唆された。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発生機序に関する論文である。
pmid-3192730.summary_en: This 1988 report describes two cases of intraplacental choriocarcinoma arising in otherwise normal third-trimester placentas. Both tumors were small, and the villi adjacent to them were partly or wholly covered by neoplastic trophoblast, supporting an origin from villous trophoblast. The authors note that these lesions can metastasize to both mother and fetus during pregnancy and may also seed choriocarcinomas that develop after a term pregnancy. The paper addresses gestational trophoblastic disease pathogenesis and is directly relevant to this site's scope.

pmid-3194870.summary_ja: 1988年の短い報告で、気管支閉塞を呈した患者の気管支内腫瘍が、当初は原発性気管支癌と考えられた。妊娠性絨毛癌という正しい診断が遅れ、有効な治療も遅延した。早期に認識されていれば救命できた可能性があると著者は述べている。絨毛癌が肺・気道病変として出現しうることを示す症例である。
pmid-3194870.summary_en: This brief 1988 report describes a patient presenting with bronchial obstruction from an endobronchial tumour that was initially mistaken for primary bronchial carcinoma. The true diagnosis of gestational choriocarcinoma was not recognized promptly, delaying effective treatment. The authors suggest earlier recognition might have been lifesaving. The case highlights that choriocarcinoma can present as a lung or airway lesion and should be considered in the differential diagnosis, particularly where a prior pregnancy is relevant.

pmid-3195412.summary_ja: 1988年の泌尿器科症例報告で、左精巣の純粋絨毛癌を有する25歳男性を記述する。無痛性の陰嚢内腫脹と多発肺結節で受診し、入院時に小脳転移が判明した。左高位精巣摘除術で診断が確定した。脳転移の摘出や併用化学療法を行ったが、入院79日目に死亡した。精巣純粋絨毛癌は稀で、1987年までの文献報告は46例のみとされる。
pmid-3195412.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 25-year-old man with pure choriocarcinoma of the left testis, presenting with a painless scrotal swelling and multiple pulmonary nodules. Cerebellar metastasis was found at admission. Left high orchiectomy confirmed the diagnosis. Despite surgical removal of the brain metastasis and combination chemotherapy, the patient died on hospital day 79. The authors note that pure testicular choriocarcinoma is rare, with only 46 cases reported before 1987.

pmid-3195722.summary_ja: 1988年の研究で、精細管内セミノーマ細胞またはCISパターンを示す男性不妊症患者15例の精巣を検討した。2例では活性化マクロファージが管内の腫瘍細胞を溶解しており、侵襲性増殖を抑える宿主免疫反応と解釈された。精巣容積の減少は、マクロファージ活動の終末像である精細管陰影で説明された。炎症の強さは腫瘍進展リスクとは相関しなかった。
pmid-3195722.summary_en: This 1988 study examined testes from 15 subfertile men who underwent orchidectomy for intratubular seminoma cells or carcinoma-in-situ (CIS) patterns. Activated macrophages were found lysing tumor cells within seminiferous tubules in two cases, which the authors interpret as a host immune response that may prevent invasive growth. Testicular volume was reduced in most cases, attributed to tubular shadows representing the end stage of macrophage activity. However, inflammation intensity did not correlate with low or high risk of tumor progression.

pmid-3197321.summary_ja: 1988年の症例報告で、横紋筋肉腫様成分が顕著な転移性未熟奇形腫の37歳男性を記述する。血清CK-MBが著明に上昇したが、心電図・剖検で心筋病変は認められなかった。腫瘍組織にもMBアイソザイム活性が多く含まれ、上昇の由来は腫瘍と考えられた。総CK活性に比して不釣り合いなCK-MB上昇は、心筋外起源を示唆する可能性がある。
pmid-3197321.summary_en: This 1988 case report describes a 37-year-old man with metastatic immature (malignant) teratoma with prominent rhabdomyosarcomatous elements and markedly elevated serum creatine kinase-MB. No cardiac infarction, ischemia, or tumor invasion of the heart was found at autopsy. Most creatine kinase activity in tumor homogenate was MB isoenzyme, suggesting the MB elevation derived from the tumor rather than myocardium. The authors propose that disproportionately high CK-MB may indicate a nonmyocardial source.

pmid-3199168.summary_ja: 1968〜1985年に初回放射線療法を受けた病期2の精巣セミノーマ49例の連続症例を検討している。3年無病生存率は82%で、横隔膜下の腫瘍量10 cm以上が有意な予後不良因子であった。予防的縦隔照射は再発率・生存率を変えなかった。10 cm未満では放射線療法、大きな腫瘍または放射線後再発ではシスプラチン併用化学療法の積極的使用を推奨している。
pmid-3199168.summary_en: This 1988 study reports 49 consecutive patients with stage 2 testicular seminoma treated with primary radiotherapy between 1968 and 1985. Three-year disease-free survival was 82%. Infradiaphragmatic bulk of 10 cm or more was a significant prognostic factor, with 3-year DFS falling from 89% in stage 2A/2B to 64% in 2C. Prophylactic mediastinal irradiation did not change relapse or survival. The authors recommend radiotherapy for masses under 10 cm and aggressive cisplatin-based chemotherapy for larger masses or relapse after radiotherapy.

pmid-3204007.summary_ja: 1978〜1986年にHadassah大学病院で治療された純粋型精巣セミノーマ22例の後方視的研究である。70%が病期Iで提示された。中央値4年の観察後、死亡したのは病期IVで播種性セミノーマを発症した1例のみであった。残る19例は無病生存しており、再発に対し放射線療法を受けた3例を含む。治療前のβ-hCG高値は不良な転帰を予測しなかった。
pmid-3204007.summary_en: A retrospective review of 22 patients with pure testicular seminoma treated at Hadassah University Hospital from 1978 to 1986. Most presented at Stage I (70%), with 18% at Stage II and smaller numbers at Stages III and IV. After a median follow-up of 4 years, only the Stage IV patient died of disseminated seminoma. The remaining 19 patients were alive and disease free, including three treated with radiotherapy for recurrence. Elevated pretreatment beta-hCG did not predict an unfavorable outcome, and the results were comparable to those of larger centers.

pmid-3204101.summary_ja: 3種のヒト胎児性癌細胞株(H 12.7、2102 EP、1428 A)の増殖条件を検討した。インスリン、トランスフェリン、リポタンパク質を添加した基礎培地で良好に増殖した。無血清条件では多くの増殖因子の効果は乏しく、MSAはH 12.7と2102 EPを、EGFはH 12.7を刺激した。3株とも増殖因子を分泌し、抗EGF抗体による阻害から2102 EPではオートクリン的なEGF様因子が示唆された。
pmid-3204101.summary_en: This study examined the growth requirements of three human embryonal carcinoma cell lines (H 12.7, 2102 EP, and 1428 A). A basal medium supplemented with insulin, transferrin, and lipoproteins supported substantial multiplication, and fibronectin or collagen I served as attachment factors. In serum-free conditions most growth factors had minimal effects, but MSA stimulated H 12.7 and 2102 EP and EGF stimulated H 12.7. All three lines secreted growth factors, and anti-EGF antibody suggested autocrine EGF-like signaling in 2102 EP. Insulin-like growth factors were not part of the growth-promoting activity.

pmid-3207201.summary_ja: 不妊患者の精巣生検で見つかった管内セミノーマ細胞を含む組織について、CISの検出に対する固定法の影響を検討した。4%ホルムアルデヒドで固定した標本では見落とされ、ブアン液では診断が不確実であった。グルタールアルデヒドで固定し半薄切片で観察した標本では診断が明確に確定した。生検における固定液の選択はCISの検出に不可欠である。
pmid-3207201.summary_en: This study examined how fixation methods affect detection of carcinoma-in-situ in testicular tissue containing intratubular seminoma cells from a subfertile patient. Tissue fixed in 4% formaldehyde was overlooked, and Bouin's solution gave a doubtful diagnosis. Semithin sections of glutaraldehyde-fixed material established the diagnosis unequivocally. The authors conclude that fixative choice is essential for detecting CIS patterns in testicular biopsies, since inadequate fixation can lead to missed diagnoses.

pmid-3207664.summary_ja: 精巣がんが眼瞼への転移巣として発症した症例を報告する。眼瞼転移巣と、その後発見された原発巣の両方が、悪性奇形腫・トロホブラスト型(MTT)と診断される組織像を示した。著者らは精巣腫瘍について考察し、眼および眼付属器に生じた転移についても文献的に検討している。眼付属器の病変が精巣腫瘍の初発症状となる場合があることを示す症例である。
pmid-3207664.summary_en: A case report describes testicular cancer that presented as a metastatic deposit in the eyelid. Both the eyelid metastasis and the subsequently detected primary testicular tumor showed histology diagnostic of malignant teratoma trophoblastic (MTT). The authors discuss the testicular tumor and review metastases occurring in the eye and adnexa. The case shows that ocular adnexal involvement can be the presenting feature of a testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-3208237.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍40例の腹部CTを、原発側の情報を踏まえて再検討した研究。右側原発では1.5〜2.0cmの転移性リンパ節の見落としが多く、大動脈・下大静脈周囲のリンパ節の軽度の腫大を検出しにくかった。右側病変では同領域の評価を強化し、偽陰性率を下げるべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-3208237.summary_en: This 1988 study reviewed abdominal CT scans of 40 patients with non-seminomatous testicular tumors, with knowledge of the side of the primary tumor. Metastatic nodes measuring 1.5 to 2.0 cm were missed more often in right-sided primaries, because mildly enlarged aortocaval and paracaval nodes, the most common metastatic sites from right-sided lesions, were harder to detect than left para-aortic nodes. The authors conclude that the aortocaval region needs closer scrutiny on CT in right-sided disease to reduce the surprisingly high false-negative rate.

pmid-3208283.summary_ja: 未分化の奇形癌幹細胞の分化を、導入した外来性デルタクリスタリン遺伝子の発現により評価する実験系を構築した研究。未分化細胞では両遺伝子とも発現しなかった。レチノイン酸による原始内胚葉への分化ではデルタ遺伝子のみが発現し、さらにジブチリルcAMPを加えるとMo delta遺伝子も発現した。エンハンサー配列を介した制御の違いが示唆される。
pmid-3208283.summary_en: This 1988 study developed an experimental system to probe differentiation of teratocarcinoma stem cells using stably introduced chicken delta-crystallin gene and a Moloney murine leukemia virus LTR-driven derivative. Neither gene was expressed in undifferentiated cells. Retinoic acid induced primitive endoderm differentiation with expression of delta but not Mo delta. Further differentiation with retinoic acid plus dibutyryl cAMP also activated Mo delta, suggesting differential regulation through enhancer elements.

pmid-3209363.summary_ja: 鼻咽頭奇形腫が側頭骨に進展し、喘鳴に加えて顔面神経麻痺と伝音難聴を来した症例の報告。生後早期に経口的に部分切除して喘鳴は軽快し、14か月時に側頭下・翼突下窩アプローチで完全摘除した。顔面神経は腓腹神経移植で再建し、欠損部は遊離腹直筋皮弁で充填した。30か月時点で再発はなく、顔面神経機能は良好である。
pmid-3209363.summary_en: This report describes a nasopharyngeal teratoma in a child that extended into the temporal bone, causing facial paralysis and conductive hearing loss in addition to stridor. Stridor was relieved by partial transoral excision shortly after birth, and complete removal via a subtemporal and infratemporal fossa approach was performed at 14 months. Facial nerve reconstruction used a sural nerve graft, and the defect was filled with a free rectus abdominis flap. At 30 months the patient had no recurrence and good facial function.

pmid-3209587.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1が、生物学的活性でFGFとして振る舞う熱不安定性のヘパリン結合性増殖因子を産生することを示した研究。ヘパリンからの溶出、熱安定性、転写産物サイズはウシFGFbや肝細胞癌株SK-HEP-1のFGFbと一致し、同一または近縁と考えられた。またPDGF A鎖のプローブと交差する転写産物も発現していた。
pmid-3209587.summary_en: This 1988 study showed that the human embryonal carcinoma cell line NT2/D1 produces a heat-labile heparin-binding growth factor that behaves like FGF in a bioassay. Its heparin elution, thermal stability, and transcript size matched bovine FGFb and FGFb from SK-HEP-1 hepatoma cells, suggesting it is closely related or identical to FGFb. NT2/D1 also expressed transcripts hybridizing with a human PDGF A-chain probe. The findings suggest growth factor production patterns are evolutionarily conserved between human and mouse EC cells.

pmid-3209938.summary_ja: 新生児の乳様突起部に生じた稀な奇形腫の症例報告。頭頸部奇形腫は報告が約150例と限られる。診断法と治療法を検討し、文献的考察を加えている。奇形腫は多能性細胞から生じ、通常は3胚葉すべての組織を含む先天性腫瘍である。
pmid-3209938.summary_en: This report describes a rare teratoma of the mastoid region in a newborn, one of only about 150 head and neck teratomas reported. The paper discusses diagnostic methods and treatment for this lesion and reviews the literature. Teratomas are congenital tumours arising from pluripotent cells and usually contain tissues from all three embryonic germ layers. The focus is on clinical presentation, diagnosis, and management at this uncommon site.

pmid-3211142.summary_ja: P19胎児性癌細胞へのエンハンサートラップ法により、胎児性癌幹細胞で特異的に活性な染色体領域を機能的にクローニングした研究。得られたDNAのうち015と052は未分化細胞で活性を示し、分化後は不活性だった。いずれも細胞由来のプロモーターとエンハンサーを含み、胎児性癌幹細胞に特異的な制御配列である。
pmid-3211142.summary_en: This 1988 study cloned mouse chromosomal loci specifically active in embryonal carcinoma stem cells, using functional selection in the P19 pluripotent cell line. Enhancer-trapped neo transformants retained pluripotency. Of the cloned DNAs, two (015 and 052) were active in undifferentiated P19 cells but inactive after differentiation, and both contain cellular promoter and enhancer elements. These fragments therefore carry regulatory DNA elements specifically active in embryonal carcinoma stem cells.

pmid-3215206.summary_ja: セミノーマに対して左精巣摘除術と放射線療法を受けた46歳男性の症例報告。放射線照射の3か月後に、照射部位であるD10までの分節性ミオクロニーが出現した。これはD10-D11の放射線脊髄症に起因するとされた。この症状は睡眠中・覚醒中を通じて持続し、レム睡眠により選択的に抑制された。このパターンは文献上報告がなかった。カルバマゼピンにより2年間の経過観察中、部分的に制御された。
pmid-3215206.summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old man who developed segmental myoclonus three months after radiotherapy following left orchiectomy for seminoma. The myoclonus involved skeletal muscles up to D10, the irradiated area, and was attributed to radiation myelopathy at D10-D11. It was continuous during sleep and wakefulness and selectively inhibited by REM sleep, a pattern not previously described in the literature. Carbamazepine partially controlled it over two years of follow-up.

pmid-3215241.summary_ja: 1980～1985年にアイルランドで診断された非セミノーマ性胚細胞精巣がん131例を解析した研究である。全国的な治療プロトコルが存在しない時期であった。3年生存率は病期I 95%、病期II 54%、病期IIIおよびIV 24%であった。専門施設に比べ成績が劣り、全国的な治療戦略の策定が必要であると示された。
pmid-3215241.summary_en: This study analyzed all 131 cases of non-seminomatous germ cell testis cancer in Ireland diagnosed between 1980 and 1985, a period without national management protocols. Three-year survival was 95% for stage I, 54% for stage II, and 24% for stages III and IV. Outcomes at general hospitals lagged behind those of specialist centers, supporting development of a national strategy to improve disease control and identify the most suitable treatment approaches.

pmid-3215251.summary_ja: 1980年から1986年にかけて、陰嚢内腫瘤に対する鼠径部探索術を345例で実施し、良性精巣腫瘍47例を同定した。32例(68%)は精巣温存手術が可能であった。残る15例は、凍結切片で良性か否かが不確実であったことなどから、高位半精巣摘除術を受けた。1～7年の追跡で再発や転移は認められなかった。著者らは、白膜の切開と凍結切片による肉眼的・組織学的基準の適用により、精巣喪失率を最大80%から約30%へ低減できると提案している。
pmid-3215251.summary_en: Between 1980 and 1986, 345 inguinal explorations for intrascrotal masses were performed, and 47 benign testicular tumors were identified. In 32 of these (68%), testis-sparing excision or enucleation was possible, while 15 underwent high semicastration, mostly due to doubtful benignity on frozen section (Leydig cell tumors, dermoid cysts, and epidermoid cysts). No recurrence or metastasis occurred during 1-7 years of follow-up. The authors propose that incising the tunica and applying macroscopic and histological criteria on frozen section can reduce testicular loss from up to 80% to about 30%.

pmid-3215396.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌幹細胞株Tera-2 clone 13を対象とした研究である。レチノイン酸による分化誘導中に、PDGF関連ポリペプチドとTGF-βの産生が変化することを示した。外因性の増殖因子がなくても細胞は増殖した。PDGF A鎖mRNAは分化とともに減少し、TGF-β mRNAは増加した。初期胚および奇形癌における増殖と分化の制御に関する示唆が議論されている。
pmid-3215396.summary_en: This study examines the human teratocarcinoma stem cell line Tera-2 clone 13, which differentiates into endodermal or neuroectodermal lineages when induced by retinoic acid. Without added growth factors, these cells proliferate normally. Serum-free conditioned medium contains a PDGF-related polypeptide and TGF-beta, but not TGF-alpha. PDGF A-chain mRNA declines during differentiation, whereas TGF-beta mRNA increases. The findings are discussed in relation to growth regulation in early embryos and human teratocarcinomas.

pmid-3222224.summary_ja: フコシル化・シアル化された血液型前駆体糖鎖に対するモノクローナル抗体を用い、正常絨毛、胞状奇胎、妊娠性絨毛癌を免疫組織学的に検討した。シアリルLexは絨毛外栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞に局在した。合胞体栄養膜細胞ではLeaが検出され、絨毛栄養膜は染色されなかった。絨毛と浸潤性絨毛外栄養膜の分化の違いが示され、腫瘍細胞との類似性が考察されている。
pmid-3222224.summary_en: Using monoclonal antibodies against fucosylated and sialylated blood group precursor carbohydrates, the authors immunohistologically examined normal trophoblast, hydatidiform moles, and gestational choriocarcinoma. Sialyl-Lex was found in extravillous trophoblast and choriocarcinoma tumor cells, and Lex appeared after neuraminidase treatment. Lea was detected in syncytiotrophoblast, while villous trophoblast showed no staining. The results highlight divergent differentiation of villous and invasive extravillous trophoblast, and the authors discuss this in relation to tumor cells.

pmid-3224081.summary_ja: 精巣および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の転移患者297例で骨病変を検討した。初診時3%、再発例9%に骨病変があり、いずれも全身転移を伴い、腰椎が最も多く侵された。脊髄圧迫や椎体崩壊も生じた。孤立性の骨病変は生検すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-3224081.summary_en: This study of 297 patients with metastatic testicular and extragonadal germ cell tumours examined bone involvement. Bone disease was found in 3% at first presentation and 9% at relapse, always alongside widespread systemic metastases, most often in the lumbar spine. Some patients developed spinal cord compression or progressive vertebral collapse. Survival among patients with bone disease was similar to the whole cohort. The authors conclude that solitary bone lesions in germ cell tumour patients should be biopsied.

pmid-3229020.summary_ja: 低酸素と心雑音を呈した新生児に、右心室と肺動脈弁輪を占める巨大腫瘍が認められた。外科的切除に成功し、病理で良性奇形腫と診断された。34か月の追跡で再発はない。心臓内奇形腫の報告は11例目で、切除成功は4例目である。
pmid-3229020.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with hypoxia and a heart murmur, in whom echocardiography revealed a large tumour filling the right ventricle and pulmonary annulus. Prostaglandin E1 maintained pulmonary blood flow by keeping the ductus arteriosus patent. Surgical resection was successful, and pathology showed a benign teratoma. The patient remained asymptomatic with no recurrence over 34 months of follow-up. The authors note this is only the eleventh reported intracardiac teratoma and the fourth successfully resected.

pmid-3229546.summary_ja: 良性卵巣類皮嚢腫の構成成分が悪性転化した24例を報告した。扁平上皮癌が最も多かった。被膜内にとどまる症例は約85%が生存し、被膜外に進展した症例は80%超が2年以内に死亡した。子宮全摘と両側付属器切除が治療の第一選択である。
pmid-3229546.summary_en: This report describes 24 cases of benign ovarian dermoid cysts (cystic teratomas) in which a component underwent malignant transformation. Squamous cell carcinoma was the most common histology, and most patients were over 50. When the tumour remained within its capsule, about 85% survived disease-free after follow-up of 4 months to 9 years. When it extended beyond the capsule, over 80% died within two years. Hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy is the preferred treatment, and adjuvant cytostatics or radiation appeared to have little effect on prognosis.

pmid-3235287.summary_ja: 新生児2例における、鼻咽頭から発生した良性奇形腫の症例について報告している。著者らは、評価中に気道を温存することの重要性を強調している。画像検査と麻酔下の診察の後、スネアによる摘出を行い、通常は合併症なく経過したが、出血の報告もある。完全摘出により気道の問題は解消し、これらの病変の分類と病因のレビューも含まれている。
pmid-3235287.summary_en: This study describes two neonates with benign teratomas arising in the nasopharynx, presenting with breathing difficulty. The authors emphasise preserving the airway during assessment. Radiology and examination under anaesthesia preceded snare removal, which was usually uncomplicated although bleeding has been reported. Complete removal resolved the airway problem, and follow-up was generally uneventful. A review of the classification and aetiology of these lesions is included.

pmid-3236167.summary_ja: 両側に巨大な卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫を有する思春期女性を報告した。卵巣門付近で剥離面を作って嚢胞を破綻なく摘出し、卵巣を温存した。術後に月経が速やかに再開しホルモン値も正常化した。両側例では生殖機能とホルモン機能の温存が重要である。
pmid-3236167.summary_en: This report describes a teenager with huge bilateral ovarian cystic teratomas, managed by excising the cysts intact without spillage to avoid castration from bilateral oophorectomy. A dissection plane near each ovarian hilum allowed preservation of ovarian tissue. Menstruation resumed promptly after surgery as hormone levels normalised. The authors conclude that benign cystic teratomas can be excised without oophorectomy, which is particularly valuable in bilateral disease where reproductive and hormonal function should be preserved.

pmid-3238342.summary_ja: 23歳男性の精巣に生じた類表皮嚢胞の症例報告です。分化した奇形腫の良性単一胚葉性発生と考えられ、精巣腫瘍の1%未満を占めます。白膜内に見つかった病変は、術中の病理診断で良性と確認されたため、精巣摘除術を回避して局所切除されました。
pmid-3238342.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old man with an epidermoid cyst of the testis, considered a benign monodermal form of differentiated teratoma, which accounts for under 1% of testicular tumors. The cyst was found within the tunica albuginea. Because peroperative histology confirmed a benign lesion, the cyst was removed locally rather than performing orchiectomy, preserving the testis.

pmid-3242364.summary_ja: ヌードマウスに移植したヒト精巣がん4種を用い、各種抗がん剤の感受性を検討した研究です。シスプラチン、カルボプラチン、CHIPで腫瘍が有意に縮小し、併用療法でも縮小が見られました。腫瘍壊死因子(TNF)は腫瘍内投与の方が効果的で、奇形腫成分は抵抗性でした。臨床での化学療法成績と比較されています。
pmid-3242364.summary_en: This study tested anticancer drugs against four human testicular cancers grown as xenografts in nude mice. Cisplatin, carboplatin (CBDCA), and CHIP significantly shrank the tumors, and combinations of cisplatin and bleomycin with vinca alkaloids or etoposide also produced regression. Intratumoral tumor necrosis factor was more effective than intravenous. Teratoma components were resistant to TNF. Results were compared with clinical chemotherapy outcomes, and limitations of xenograft drug sensitivity testing were discussed.

pmid-3243339.summary_ja: 絨毛癌患者の尿から、分子量約14,000の低分子ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)様免疫反応性物質を単離し、性状を解析した研究です。ゲル濾過、免疫アフィニティ精製、モノクローナル抗体を用いて、hCG、hCG-β、LHと共通のエピトープを持つことを示しました。レクチン非結合性であり、絨毛癌患者ではこの成分が尿中に排泄されることが示唆されます。
pmid-3243339.summary_en: This study isolated a low-molecular-weight immunoreactive hCG-like substance (about 14 kDa) from the urine of a patient with choriocarcinoma. Using gel filtration, immunoaffinity purification, and monoclonal antibodies, the component was shown to react with hCG, hCG-beta, and LH epitopes but not hCG-alpha. It did not bind lectin, indicating it is a distinct urinary molecule. The findings suggest choriocarcinoma patients excrete a small hCG-related component that could affect hCG-based tumor marker assays.

pmid-3243384.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞と卵黄嚢腫瘍の系譜関係を明らかにするため、胎児性癌細胞の細胞骨格および表面抗原に対するモノクローナル抗体を作製した研究です。GCTM-4は胎児性癌細胞のみで発現する69kDa抗原を認識し、両細胞型の鑑別を可能にしました。一方で、両者が近縁であることも示されています。抗体パネルは、ヒト胎児性癌と卵黄嚢癌の区別に有用です。
pmid-3243384.summary_en: This study generated monoclonal antibodies against cytoskeletal and surface antigens of human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells to clarify the lineage relationship between EC and yolk sac carcinoma. Antibody GCTM-2 recognized a 200 kDa keratan sulphate proteoglycan on EC cell surfaces, GCTM-3 bound a 57 kDa cytoskeletal protein, and GCTM-4 recognized a 69 kDa lysosome-associated antigen expressed only in EC cells. The panel distinguishes EC from yolk sac carcinoma while confirming their close relationship.

pmid-3244094.summary_ja: 巨大な仙尾部奇形腫の切除術中に生じる大量出血を制御する簡便な方法を報告しています。大動脈鉗子を用いて緊急止血と持続的な出血制御を行いました。体重1,700g、奇形腫の重さ1,300gの新生児に対して、本法により手術に成功しています。小児の大型奇形腫を扱う外科医にとって実用的な方法です。
pmid-3244094.summary_en: This technical report describes a method for controlling intraoperative hemorrhage during resection of a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma. An aortic snare was used to achieve emergency hemostasis and continuous control of bleeding. The technique was successfully applied to a neonate weighing 1,700 g carrying a 1,300 g sacrococcygeal teratoma. The approach offers a simple, practical option for surgeons managing large pediatric teratomas with significant vascular supply.

pmid-3245353.summary_ja: 肺の器官様組織と気管支系を含む良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の、5例目の症例報告です。卵巣奇形腫内での肺分化はきわめてまれです。良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の大規模症例集積を解析し、内胚葉由来組織の出現頻度に影響する因子を検討しています。成熟卵巣奇形腫の形態学的多様性を示す報告です。
pmid-3245353.summary_en: This paper reports a fifth documented case of a benign cystic ovarian teratoma containing organoid adult-type lung tissue with a bronchiolar system. Such lung differentiation within ovarian teratomas is extremely rare. The authors analyzed the largest published series of benign cystic ovarian teratomas and discussed factors influencing the frequency of endoderm-derived tissues within these tumors. The report adds to the morphological spectrum of mature ovarian teratoma.

pmid-3247837.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎後に絨毛性腫瘍を発症した36例のうち24例が子宮内膜搔爬を受けたスウェーデンの研究です。組織学的に絨毛癌が証明されたのは1例のみで、他の3例では悪性を否定できませんでした。子宮内膜搔爬は胞状奇胎後の悪性疾患の証明にまれにしか有用でなく、フォローアップでの日常的な実施の妥当性が問われています。
pmid-3247837.summary_en: This study reviews Swedish patients with trophoblastic neoplasia after hydatidiform mole who underwent endometrial curettage. Of 36 patients who developed trophoblastic neoplasia, 24 had one or more curettages, usually to confirm malignancy. Histological proof of choriocarcinoma was obtained in only one patient, and malignancy could not be excluded in three others. The authors conclude that endometrial curettage rarely proves malignancy after molar pregnancy, questioning its routine use in follow-up.

pmid-3247838.summary_ja: 心膜内奇形腫が原因で胎児水腫を来した症例報告。子宮内での水腫の病因を確立することの重要性を述べ、積極的な新生児管理で予後改善が期待されるものの、死亡率は依然極めて高いと指摘している。心臓周囲の腫瘤に対する出生前評価の必要性も示している。
pmid-3247838.summary_en: This case report describes hydrops fetalis caused by an intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed in utero. The authors emphasize that establishing the etiology of a hydropic state in utero is essential, since active neonatal care may improve outcomes. Despite such care, mortality remains very high. The report underscores the rarity of pericardial teratomas as a cause of fetal hydrops and the need for prompt prenatal evaluation of cardiac masses.

pmid-3253030.summary_ja: XY染色体を持つ女性表現型の純粋性性腺形成不全症例。索状性腺に性腺芽細胞腫とディスジャーミノーマを認めた。術前内分泌検査で高ゴナドトロピン・低エストラジオールを示し、性腺のステロイド酵素活性は精巣より卵巣に類似していた。
pmid-3253030.summary_en: This report describes a 46,XY woman with pure gonadal dysgenesis whose streak gonads harbored gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma. Pre-operative endocrine testing showed high gonadotropins and low estradiol. Estradiol benzoate produced biphasic LH responses without changes in endogenous sex steroids, and hCG failed to stimulate steroid secretion. In vitro, dysgenetic gonadal steroidogenic enzyme activities resembled ovarian rather than testicular tissue, with higher aromatase activity, while genital skin fibroblasts showed low 5-alpha-reductase activity.

pmid-3253292.summary_ja: ヒト奇形腫由来細胞株Tera-2を無血清培地で培養し、IGF-IおよびIGF-IIの増殖への影響を検討。両因子は細胞増殖を促進し、標識指数はほぼ不変であったことから、主に細胞生存率の上昇を介すると考えられた。I型・II型IGF受容体の発現も確認された。
pmid-3253292.summary_en: Tera-2, a human teratoma-derived cell line, was cultured in serum-free medium to examine the effects of insulin-like growth factors on proliferation. IGF-I and IGF-II both maximally stimulated population growth at 10 ng/ml when added daily. The factors did not substantially alter the labelling index, suggesting that their effect was mediated mainly by enhanced cell survival. Membranes from these cells expressed both type 1 and type 2 IGF receptors.

pmid-3256810.summary_ja: 体重減少と肝腫大を呈した34歳女性。肝生検で予期せず転移性絨毛癌と判明したが、重篤な出血と開腹後の合併症で死亡した。妊娠可能年齢の女性の肝転移では絨毛癌を考慮し、出血リスクから診断が除外されるまで生検を避けるべきと警告している。
pmid-3256810.summary_en: A 34-year-old woman presented with weight loss and hepatomegaly. Liver biopsy unexpectedly revealed metastatic choriocarcinoma. Severe haemorrhage followed, and she died from complications after laparotomy. The authors highlight that choriocarcinoma should be considered in women of reproductive age presenting with liver metastases, and that biopsy should be avoided until this diagnosis is excluded because of bleeding risk.

pmid-3258274.summary_ja: 胎児性癌(EC)細胞F9が一部のマウス系統で拒絶される機序を検討。生体内ではクラスI抗原の発現が認められ、EC細胞と他の腫瘍細胞に共通する、MHC非拘束性に認識される抗原の存在も示された。古典的なMHC提示以外の免疫認識機構の関与が示唆される。
pmid-3258274.summary_en: This paper investigates why embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, such as F9, are rejected by some mouse strains despite lacking H-2 class I antigens in vitro. The authors examined T-cell cytotoxicity and found evidence for class I expression in vivo. They also identified an additional antigen shared by EC and other tumour cells that is recognized by T cells in a non-MHC-restricted manner. Findings suggest immune recognition of EC tumours involves mechanisms beyond classical MHC presentation.

pmid-3264254.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌JEG-3細胞を用い、コレラ毒素、TPA、EGF、IGF-Iによるプロゲステロンおよびエストラジオール分泌の調節を検討。CT・TPA・EGFはプロゲステロン産生を濃度依存的に増加させ、IGF-Iはエストラジオール産生を抑制した。絨毛癌細胞のステロイド産生のシグナル制御を示す基礎研究である。
pmid-3264254.summary_en: JEG-3 human choriocarcinoma cells were used to study how cholera toxin, TPA, EGF and IGF-I regulate progesterone and estradiol secretion. CT, TPA and EGF raised progesterone production in a concentration-dependent manner, while IGF-I had no effect. CT and TPA synergistically stimulated progesterone output, and IGF-I inhibited basal and CT-stimulated estradiol production. The study elucidates signaling control of steroidogenesis in choriocarcinoma cells.

pmid-3265633.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト絨毛癌に対する二段階の抗体指向性酵素プロドラッグ療法を検討した。hCGのβサブユニットに対する抗体断片にカルボキシペプチダーゼG2を結合させ、hCG産生性のCC3異種移植ヌードマウスに投与した。結合体が血中から消失した後、グルタミン酸誘導体のマスタード前駆体を投与すると、腫瘍部位で安息香酸マスタードが生成した。単回投与で従来の化学療法に抵抗性の異種移植腫瘍の増殖が著明に抑制され、選択的な治療の可能性が示された。
pmid-3265633.summary_en: This study tested a two-stage antibody-directed enzyme prodrug approach against human choriocarcinoma. Carboxypeptidase G2 was conjugated to an F(ab')2 fragment targeting the beta subunit of hCG and injected into nude mice bearing hCG-producing CC3 xenografts. After the conjugate cleared from blood, a glutamate-conjugated mustard prodrug was given, which CPG2 converted into an active benzoic acid mustard at tumor sites. A single treatment course markedly suppressed growth of this chemotherapy-resistant xenograft, suggesting that the approach can selectively activate alkylating agents and eradicate established human cancer xenografts.

pmid-3275031.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの治療進歩を概説する。かつての直交電圧放射線療法から、進行例での化学療法と、放射線単独で予後不良となる患者を識別する病期分類の導入へと進んだ。予後不良群はシスプラチン併用化学療法で改善している。限局例の80〜100%、進行例の60〜80%が長期生存者となる。hCG高値、性腺外原発、化学療法後の残存画像異常、化学療法後の再発への対応が今後の課題である。
pmid-3275031.summary_en: This review summarizes progress in treating testicular seminoma. Orthovoltage radiotherapy has given way to chemotherapy for advanced disease and to a staging system that identifies patients with poor outcomes after radiation alone. These high-risk patients benefit from cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Currently 80 to 100% of patients with limited disease and 60 to 80% with advanced disease become long-term survivors. Open questions include the significance of elevated hCG, extragonadal primaries, residual radiographic abnormalities after chemotherapy, and management of relapse after chemotherapy.

pmid-3276581.summary_ja: 卵巣の類皮嚢腫から発生した扁平上皮癌6例の臨床病理学的検討である。血清カルシウムを測定した5例中4例で高カルシウム血症を認め、腫瘍増大とともに上昇した。生存期間は3〜17か月と短かった。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる治療の効果は限定的であり、新たな治療法の必要性が示された。
pmid-3276581.summary_en: This clinicopathologic study describes six cases of squamous carcinoma arising in ovarian dermoid cysts. Four of five patients with measured serum calcium had hypercalcemia, which rose alongside tumor size, suggesting that hypercalcemia may signal this background in an ovarian mass. Survival was short, at 3 to 17 months. Five patients received cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin with little benefit, indicating that new treatments are needed to improve survival in all but a few stage I cases.

pmid-3279788.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫7例の報告と文献レビューである。診断時の腫瘍は多くが片側卵巣に限局し、約半数は20歳未満であった。5年生存率は病期Iで91%、病期II〜IVで65%だった。片側卵巣限局例では対側付属器切除や放射線療法の追加に利点はなかった。進行例では化学療法と放射線療法の生存率が同等であった。
pmid-3279788.summary_en: This report describes seven cases of ovarian dysgerminoma with a literature review. Most tumors were confined to one ovary at diagnosis, and nearly half of patients were under 20. The 5-year survival was 91% for stage I and 65% for stages II to IV. Adding contralateral adnexectomy, hysterectomy, or radiation did not help when disease was confined to one ovary, and advanced disease treated with chemotherapy fared comparably to radiation. Unilateral oophorectomy should be limited to unilateral disease without nodal metastasis.

pmid-3282036.summary_ja: 本総説は、臨床病期I精巣がんの診断と初期病期分類について扱う。腫瘍マーカーや画像診断法の正確性、感度、特異度を重点的に解説する。セミノーマと非セミノーマに対する放射線療法および後腹膜リンパ節郭清の治療成績と合併症を概説し、精巣摘除術後の注意深いフォローアップの重要性を強調する。再発に関する予後因子や、病期分類と治療介入の改善に向けた研究戦略も論じている。
pmid-3282036.summary_en: This review addresses diagnosis and initial clinical staging of stage I testicular cancer. It emphasizes tumor markers and the accuracy of imaging modalities. Treatment options for stage I seminoma and nonseminoma, including radiotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, are reviewed with their outcomes and complications. Orchiectomy followed by careful surveillance is highlighted, along with prognostic factors for relapse and strategies for improved staging and intervention.

pmid-3282091.summary_ja: 27歳男性の原発性縦隔セミノーマの症例報告である。組織学的には精巣セミノーマと同一である。血清ALPおよびACEが高値を示した。父親は精巣腫瘍に対して精巣摘除術と術後放射線療法を受けていた。放射線療法および化学療法後、胸部X線で腫瘤は完全に消失し、ALPおよびACEも正常範囲に低下した。日本の文献では本疾患の報告が51例あるとされる。
pmid-3282091.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with primary mediastinal seminoma, histologically identical to testicular seminoma. His father had undergone orchiectomy and radiotherapy for testicular tumor. Serum alkaline phosphatase and angiotensin converting enzyme were elevated. After radiation and chemotherapy, chest radiography showed complete regression and both markers normalized. The authors note that 51 such cases had been reported in the Japanese literature.

pmid-3282640.summary_ja: 本論文は、61歳男性が精巣セミノーマに対する腹部放射線療法の26年後に腹膜中皮腫を発症した症例を報告したものである。石綿曝露歴はなく、放射線照射が原因として考えられている。治療目的の腹部照射後に生じた腹膜中皮腫としては、本症例が文献上5例目にあたる。胚細胞腫瘍の生存者にみられる晩期の治療関連二次がんの一例である。
pmid-3282640.summary_en: This report describes a 61-year-old man who developed peritoneal mesothelioma 26 years after abdominal radiotherapy for testicular seminoma, without any asbestos exposure. Radiation was the likely cause. The authors note this is only the fifth documented case of peritoneal mesothelioma following therapeutic abdominal irradiation. The case highlights a late, treatment-related secondary malignancy in germ cell tumor survivors.

pmid-3283173.summary_ja: Ki-67モノクローナル抗体を用いて、セミノーマ20例の増殖活性を測定した研究。増殖分画は50～80%で、腫瘍サイズにかかわらず切片全体にほぼ均等に分布していた。病理組織学的病期が進んだ症例で増殖分画がやや高い傾向があったが、腫瘍サイズやリンパ球浸潤との相関はなかった。増殖活性の測定は全身治療と予後の判断に役立つため、日常の病理診断に含めるべきだと結論している。
pmid-3283173.summary_en: This study used the Ki-67 monoclonal antibody to measure proliferative activity in 20 seminomas. Growth fractions ranged from 50 to 80 percent and were distributed evenly across sections regardless of tumor size. Growth fraction showed a slight tendency to be higher in advanced histopathological stages, with no correlation to tumor size or lymphocytic infiltration. The authors conclude that proliferative activity should be included in routine histopathology for guiding systemic treatment and prognosis.

pmid-3287245.summary_ja: 本総説は、胞状奇胎後に設けられてきた避妊期間が現在も必要かを検討したものである。最近の細胞遺伝学的研究から、胞状奇胎と絨毛癌には因果関係がない可能性が示唆されている。早期妊娠診断法の進歩により、避妊期間はもはや不要かもしれないと論じている。フォローアップには連続的な超音波検査を推奨し、希望があれば自然妊娠を許容すべきとしている。
pmid-3287245.summary_en: This review examines whether postmolar contraception, the waiting period after hydatidiform mole, is still necessary. Recent cytogenetic studies suggest hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma may not be causally related. With improved early pregnancy diagnosis, the authors argue the waiting period may no longer be required. They recommend serial sonography for follow-up and allowing natural pregnancy if the patient desires.

pmid-3287252.summary_ja: 27.5週の胎児で、仙尾部奇形腫に伴う水腫とうっ血性心不全を発症した症例を報告している。二次元ドプラ心エコー検査で心室拡張、心嚢液貯留、弁逆流と高拍出性の血流が確認された。分娩時には腫瘤から活動性の出血があり、新生児のヘマトクリットは10%だった。著者らは子宮内出血による貧血が心不全の原因と考え、仙尾部奇形腫の胎児すべてにドプラ心エコー検査を行うことを提唱している。
pmid-3287252.summary_en: This case report describes a 27.5-week fetus with a large sacrococcygeal teratoma complicated by hydrops and congestive heart failure. Two-dimensional Doppler echocardiography revealed dilated ventricles, pericardial effusion, valvular regurgitation, and high-output flow. At delivery the tumor was actively bleeding, and the neonate had a hematocrit of 10%. The authors attribute the cardiac failure to anemia from intrauterine hemorrhage. They recommend Doppler echocardiography for all fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma so that heart failure can be detected early and treated in time.

pmid-3288367.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの進行局所病変に対する放射線療法とシスプラチン含有化学療法の役割を総説している。放射線療法は長年の標準治療だったが、化学療法で高い完全寛解率が報告され、後腹膜のバルキー病変への照射の妥当性が問われている。著者らは、バルキー病変を有する病期II患者27例に照射した未発表データで10年無病生存率70%を示した。病期IIセミノーマに対する両治療の前向きランダム化試験の必要性を提言している。
pmid-3288367.summary_en: This review examines the roles of radiotherapy and cisplatin-based chemotherapy in advanced locoregional testicular seminoma. Radiotherapy has long been the standard, but reports of high complete remission rates with chemotherapy have questioned irradiation for bulky retroperitoneal disease. The authors present unpublished data showing a 10-year disease-free survival of 70% in 27 bulky stage II patients treated with irradiation. They conclude that a prospective randomized trial comparing chemotherapy and radiotherapy in stage II seminoma is justified.

pmid-3288485.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で壁側内胚葉へ分化するF-9奇形癌幹細胞をモデルに、フィブロネクチンの蓄積と配列の変化を検討した基礎研究である。分化した細胞ではフィブロネクチンの蓄積が増え、フィブリル状の沈着が認められた。生化学的解析ではフィブロネクチンの構造に変化は見られず、沈着の調節は別の機構によると結論している。臨床ではなく培養細胞を用いた研究である。
pmid-3288485.summary_en: This basic study uses F-9 teratocarcinoma stem cells, which differentiate into parietal endoderm after retinoic acid treatment, as a model. Differentiated cells showed increased fibronectin accumulation and a fibrillar organization absent in undifferentiated cells. Biochemical comparison of fibronectin by gel electrophoresis and peptide mapping revealed no structural differences that could explain the change. The authors conclude that another mechanism regulates matrix deposition. The work is laboratory research on embryonal carcinoma-derived cells rather than clinical management.

pmid-3289501.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の治療成績の進歩を総説している。死亡率は1958年の100%から1983年には約10%へ低下した。メトトレキサートとアクチノマイシンDの併用療法や、肺・頭蓋内転移に対する手術や全脳照射を含む集学的治療が寄与している。転移例の死亡率は約20%で、転移巣の治療が完治への鍵とされる。
pmid-3289501.summary_en: This Japanese review summarizes advances in choriocarcinoma treatment. Mortality fell from 100% in 1958 to about 10% in 1983, mainly through combined methotrexate and actinomycin D and multidisciplinary intensive care, including surgery and whole-brain irradiation for pulmonary or intracranial metastases. Mortality was 0% in non-metastatic cases but about 20% in metastatic cases, so treating metastatic foci is key to achieving cure.

pmid-3290501.summary_ja: 泌尿生殖器癌の化学療法総説の第4部で、精巣がんを扱っている。病期Iおよび病期IIの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は、手術単独または化学療法の併用で治癒しうる。病理学的病期IIでは、白金製剤を基本とする2コースの補助化学療法で再発が予防できたと報告している。今後の治療の改良と研究により、精巣がんの問題は一層解決されると結論している。
pmid-3290501.summary_en: This is part 4 of a multi-part review on genitourinary cancer chemotherapy, focused on testicular cancer. Patients with stage I or II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors may be cured by surgery alone or with chemotherapy. For pathologic stage II disease, two courses of platinum-based adjuvant chemotherapy have successfully prevented relapse. The authors note that refinements in management and research could further reduce the problem of testicular cancer.

pmid-3291625.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性9例に生じた、絨毛癌に似た嚢胞性病変2型を報告している。奇形腫に伴うことが多く、9例中8例が切除前に化学療法を受けていた。非典型例の4例中3例ではhCG染色が陽性だったが、血清hCGは正常または軽度の上昇にとどまった。追加化学療法を受けずに完全切除された5例は平均1.9年のフォローアップで良好だった。
pmid-3291625.summary_en: This study of nine men with testicular germ cell tumors describes two histologically similar cystic lesions resembling choriocarcinoma. Five cases were teratomatous choriocarcinoma-like lesions, and four were cystic atypical choriocarcinoma. Most occurred with teratomas, and eight of nine patients had prior chemotherapy. hCG staining was positive in three of four atypical cases despite normal or minimally elevated serum hCG. Five patients with complete excision and no further chemotherapy remained well at follow-up. The authors urge separate recognition of these lesions.

pmid-3292037.summary_ja: 17歳から39歳の女性で、卵巣外の骨盤内卵黄嚢腫瘍4例を報告している。腫瘍は子宮内またはその近傍に発生し、卵巣は正常だった。術後のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は測定した3例すべてで上昇していた。全例が併用化学療法を受け、2例は術後14か月と24か月で死亡し、2例は6年と8.5年の時点で無病であった。
pmid-3292037.summary_en: This report describes four extraovarian pelvic yolk sac tumors in women aged 17 to 39, arising in or near the uterus with normal ovaries. Peritoneal metastases were present in some cases, and postoperative AFP was elevated in all three tested. Immunostaining showed AFP and alpha-1-antitrypsin positivity. All patients received combination chemotherapy; two died of disease at 14 and 24 months, and two remained disease-free at 6 and 8.5 years.

pmid-3292241.summary_ja: 卵巣皮様嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)189例の超音波所見をまとめた報告である。診断の鍵となる特徴的な「真珠灰色」のエコー像を示し、早期の超音波診断により小腫瘤での不要な手術の回避、切開法の選択、保存的手術の検討に役立つと述べている。
pmid-3292241.summary_en: This retrospective ultrasonography study describes the echo patterns of 189 ovarian dermoid tumors (mature teratomas). The authors identify a characteristic pearly-gray echo appearance as the key sonographic feature for diagnosis. They argue that early ultrasound diagnosis can help avoid surgery for small masses, guide the choice of a Pfannenstiel incision, and support conservative surgical approaches. The paper is a concise clinical imaging report focused on benign ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-3293377.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫23例の超音波所見とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を比較し、腫瘍内部の組成が超音波像にどう影響するかを検討した研究である。ダーモイドプラグの大きさ、石灰化の有無、脂肪成分の組織像が超音波所見を大きく左右すると結論づけている。
pmid-3293377.summary_en: This imaging study compares the sonographic and CT appearances of 23 ovarian teratomas to explain how internal composition shapes ultrasound features. Most lesions had mixed echotexture, and fat intermixed with hair appeared echogenic with acoustic shadowing. Dermoid plugs were a key finding, and their size, calcifications, and fatty histology determined the overall sonographic appearance. The authors conclude that dermoid plug size, calcified elements and fat composition are the main determinants of how teratomas look on ultrasound.

pmid-3293662.summary_ja: 若年男性に多い奇形癌と、そこから樹立された胎児性癌(EC)幹細胞株についての総説である。TERA-2株の性質やレチノイン酸とHMBAによる分化誘導を紹介し、ヒト初期胚のモデルとしての有用性を論じている。
pmid-3293662.summary_en: This review describes human teratocarcinomas, a common cancer in young men, and the embryonal carcinoma (EC) stem cell lines derived from them. The authors describe properties of human EC cells, including the TERA-2 line that can differentiate into neural and glandular elements in nude mice. They also outline differentiation induced by retinoic acid and HMBA, and discuss the value of these cells as models of early human embryogenesis and of teratogenic agents such as cytomegalovirus.

pmid-3334976.summary_ja: 精巣に生じた精母細胞性セミノーマに肉腫成分を伴った2例の報告である。ラブドミオサルコーマと原始間葉系紡錘形細胞肉腫が認められ、転移は肉腫成分のみに生じた。手術と多剤化学療法を行ったが、いずれも発症後14か月以内に死亡しており、予後不良な稀な組み合わせであることを示している。
pmid-3334976.summary_en: This report describes two patients with testicular spermatocytic seminoma that contained a sarcomatous component, one with rhabdomyosarcoma and one with primitive mesenchymal spindle cell sarcoma. Only the sarcoma component metastasized, to lung, lymph nodes or liver. Both patients received combined surgery and multiagent chemotherapy, yet one died within a year and the other at 14 months. The paper highlights the rare combination and its poor prognosis.

pmid-3335536.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌の患者尿から精製したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の糖鎖構造を正常妊娠と比較した生化学研究である。絨毛癌由来のhCGでは四糖コア含有糖鎖の割合が約60%と著明に増加し、侵入奇胎でも中等度の増加がみられた。
pmid-3335536.summary_en: This biochemistry study compares mucin-type sugar chains of hCG purified from urine of patients with trophoblastic disease and of healthy pregnant women. Normal and hydatidiform mole hCG showed about 10% of oligosaccharides with the tetrasaccharide core, while choriocarcinoma hCG had about 60%. Invasive mole hCG showed an intermediate increase. The findings suggest that hCG glycosylation patterns differ across gestational trophoblastic disease and may serve as diagnostic markers.

pmid-3336113.summary_ja: 生後6か月の男児に発生した左精巣傍部の類皮嚢腫の症例報告。稀な良性奇形腫としては報告された中で最年少の症例であり、組織学的基準に基づき核出術による治療が推奨されている。精巣傍奇形腫が乳児期に発症しうること、核出術が妥当な治療法となりうることを示した。
pmid-3336113.summary_en: This report describes a 6-month-old boy with a dermoid cyst arising in the left paratesticular region. The authors note that it is the youngest patient reported with this rare benign teratoma. They recommend enucleation as the treatment for this type of lesion, based on histopathological criteria from the literature. The case shows that paratesticular teratomas can present in infancy and that enucleation is a reasonable surgical approach.

pmid-3336815.summary_ja: 1963年から1985年に中国で診断された原発性縦隔腫瘍・嚢胞4,357例を解析した。北部では奇形腫様腫瘍が最も多く、南部では胸腺腫と神経原性腫瘍が多かった。病歴と胸部X線写真から組織診断を80%予測でき、針生検の併用で91.4%に向上した。最適な治療は完全な外科的切除とされ、局在分類と手術手技が示された。
pmid-3336815.summary_en: This large Chinese review analyzes 4,357 primary mediastinal tumors and cysts diagnosed from 1963 to 1985, including 307 from the authors' institution. Teratoid tumors predominated in northern China, whereas thymomas and neurogenic tumors were more common in the south. Preoperative histologic prediction was 80% accurate using history and chest radiographs, rising to 91.4% with needle biopsy added. The authors present a localization scheme and operative approach, concluding that complete surgical resection is the optimal therapy.

pmid-3336932.summary_ja: 68歳男性がエストロゲン療法を11か月間受けた後に、両側性の同時性原発胚細胞腫瘍を発症した症例を報告。マウスやヒトでエストロゲン投与によりライディッヒ細胞腫瘍が生じるとの報告はあるが、胚細胞腫瘍との関連を示した文献は見当たらなかった。単一症例のため因果関係は証明されていないが、関連の可能性を示唆する。
pmid-3336932.summary_en: This report describes a 68-year-old man who developed bilateral synchronous primary germ cell tumors after eleven months of estrogen therapy. The authors note prior reports of Leydig cell tumors in mice and men receiving estrogens. However, they found no previously published connection between germ cell tumors and estrogen medication. Because this is a single case, causality is not established, but the report raises the possibility of an association between estrogen exposure and germ cell tumor development.

pmid-3336933.summary_ja: Klinefelter症候群の患者に発生した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。Klinefelter症候群では縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍が多いことが知られているが、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の報告は稀である。本症例から、両者の関連は従来の報告より多い可能性があると著者らは示唆している。
pmid-3336933.summary_en: This report describes a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis in a patient with Klinefelter syndrome. The authors note that mediastinal germ cell tumors are known to occur more frequently in Klinefelter patients, whereas testicular tumors in this population are rarely reported. Based on this case, they suggest that the association between Klinefelter syndrome and testicular germ cell tumors may be more frequent than previously reported.

pmid-3338071.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の女性75例と、年齢・妊娠時期・居住地を一致させた対照群を用いた多施設症例対照研究。BMIの上昇と定期的な運動は低リスク、月経量の少なさ、初経12歳以降、性交頻度の低さは高リスクと関連した。著者らは、低エストロゲン状態が排卵を乱し、絨毛癌の素因となる可能性を提唱している。
pmid-3338071.summary_en: A multicenter case-control study of 75 women with gestational choriocarcinoma and matched controls examined reproductive, fertility, and lifestyle risk factors. Higher body mass index and regular exercise were associated with lower risk, whereas light menstrual flow, menarche after age 12, and infrequent intercourse were linked to elevated risk. Cases had more dizygotic twins in their families and were more likely to have married more than once. The authors propose that low estrogen levels may disrupt ovulation and predispose women to choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3338675.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫（Grade 3）の27歳女性に対し、片側卵管卵巣摘出術とVAC併用化学療法による補助化学療法を施行した症例報告。重度の骨髄毒性のため予定の12コースではなく6コースで中止となった。18か月後に妊娠し、正常児を出産した。VAC療法後の妊娠成功例としては2例目であり、治療後の妊孕性の可能性を示す。
pmid-3338675.summary_en: This report describes a 27-year-old woman with grade 3 immature ovarian teratoma treated with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and VAC combination chemotherapy. Six postoperative courses were given instead of the twelve originally planned, because of severe bone marrow toxicity. Eighteen months later she conceived and delivered a healthy child. The authors note this is only the second reported successful pregnancy after VAC chemotherapy for immature teratoma, supporting the possibility of fertility after treatment.

pmid-3338676.summary_ja: 54歳女性の右卵巣に発生した29ポンド（約13kg）の多嚢胞性腫瘍の症例報告。組織学的に、低悪性度の粘液性嚢胞腺癌と成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の2成分が認められた。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴う卵巣上皮性の低悪性度腺癌としては初の報告とされる。単一の卵巣腫瘍内で上皮性成分と胚細胞成分が共存する稀な例である。
pmid-3338676.summary_en: This case report describes a 54-year-old woman with a 29-pound multicystic tumor arising from the right ovary. Histology revealed two components: a mucinous cystadenocarcinoma of low malignant potential and a mature cystic teratoma. The authors describe this as the first reported case of an ovarian epithelial adenocarcinoma of low malignant potential associated with a mature cystic teratoma. The report documents a rare coexistence of epithelial and germ cell components within a single ovarian mass.

pmid-3338677.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎2回と絨毛癌を経験し、EMA-CO療法を受けた女性が、その後妊娠に成功した症例報告。エトポシド投与後の妊娠成功例としては初めての報告とされる。多剤化学療法を要した後も妊孕性が保たれうることを示している。
pmid-3338677.summary_en: This report describes a successful pregnancy in a woman who had two hydatidiform moles and a choriocarcinoma, treated with EMA-CO chemotherapy. The authors describe it as the first reported successful pregnancy after administration of etoposide. The case suggests that fertility may be preserved and a pregnancy achieved despite prior molar pregnancies and a choriocarcinoma requiring multiagent chemotherapy that included etoposide.

pmid-3338678.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫の切除から9年後に発症した腹膜神経膠腫症の症例報告です。典型的な症状のない外性子宮内膜症を併発していた稀な組み合わせを示しています。予後は原発腫瘍の組織学的悪性度や、播種病変における臓器転移や未熟成分の有無に依存すると述べ、両病変の病態を簡潔に考察しています。
pmid-3338678.summary_en: This case report describes gliomatosis peritonei arising nine years after removal of an immature ovarian teratoma, with an unusual coexistence of endometriosis externa that lacked the usual endometriosis symptoms. The authors note that prognosis depends on the histological grade of the primary tumor and on organ metastasis or immature elements within the implants. They briefly discuss the pathogenesis of both lesions. The report highlights the rare association of these two peritoneal lesions and the need for long-term surveillance after immature teratoma.

pmid-3338945.summary_ja: 1948〜1983年に治療された腹部病変を触知するセミノーマ33例の治療成績を検討した研究です。全体の5年・10年疾患特異的生存率は87%・81%でした。病期IIBでは腹部への放射線療法のみの群で再発が多かったものの、生存率に差はありませんでした。横隔膜上への進展や血行性転移がある場合は放射線療法単独では不十分と結論づけています。
pmid-3338945.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 33 seminoma patients with palpable abdominal disease, treated between 1948 and 1983, reports 5- and 10-year disease-specific survival of 87% and 81%. Stage IIB patients treated with abdominal radiation alone had more relapses than those who also received prophylactic mediastinal and supraclavicular radiation, though survival was unchanged. The authors conclude that radiation alone is inadequate when supradiaphragmatic lymphatic spread or hematogenous metastases are present.

pmid-3339730.summary_ja: 1960〜1982年に治療された精巣セミノーマ240例の後方視的解析です。全体の無病5年生存率は93.6%、病期I例では95.5%でした。腫瘍容積に関連する因子を中心に14の病理・臨床因子を検討しています。病期IまたはIIAには放射線療法、病期IIB以上には化学療法を推奨し、残存腫瘤には追加の放射線療法を行う方針を示しています。病期分類やフォローアップの指針も紹介しています。
pmid-3339730.summary_en: This M. D. Anderson series of 240 testicular seminoma patients treated from 1960 to 1982 reports a 5-year disease-free survival of 93.6% overall and 95.5% for stage I disease. Fourteen pathological and clinical factors were analyzed, most of which related to tumor volume. Based on this retrospective review, the authors recommend radiation therapy alone for stage I or IIA disease and chemotherapy for stage IIB or higher disease, with adjunctive radiotherapy for persistent masses. They also discuss staging evaluation and follow-up guidelines.

pmid-3339752.summary_ja: 精巣に異常のない後腹膜セミノーマに、前立腺病変が同時に認められた症例報告です。前立腺病変は後腹膜からの転移ではなく多中心性発生と判断されました。ビンクリスチン、ペプロマイシン、シスプラチンによる全身化学療法が後腹膜と前立腺の両病変に有効でした。精巣外に発生したセミノーマの稀な提示例です。
pmid-3339752.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with retroperitoneal seminoma and a simultaneous prostatic lesion, with normal testes on physical and ultrasound examination. The authors favor multicentric occurrence over metastasis from the retroperitoneum to the prostate. Systemic chemotherapy with vincristine, peplomycin and cisplatin was effective against both the prostatic and retroperitoneal lesions. The report illustrates an unusual extragonadal presentation of seminoma and the reasoning used to distinguish it from metastasis.

pmid-3341514.summary_ja: 肉腫様成分を伴う精巣の精母細胞性セミノーマ5例を報告しています。うち1例は横紋筋肉腫型でした。通常は予後良好な腫瘍が、肉腫様成分により高度悪性の腫瘍へ変化し、少なくとも2例が死亡しました。奇形腫様構造は認められませんでした。肉腫様成分は非セミノーマ性胚細胞成分ではなく未分化転化と解釈されています。
pmid-3341514.summary_en: This series reports five testicular spermatocytic seminomas with sarcomatous components, one of which was rhabdomyosarcomatous. The authors describe a rare aggressive transformation of a typically indolent tumor, and no teratomatous structures were identified. At least two patients died of disease. The authors favor interpreting the sarcomatous elements as anaplastic transformation rather than as a nonseminomatous germ cell component.

pmid-3343149.summary_ja: 1969〜1983年にPrince of Wales Hospitalで治療された卵巣未分化胚細胞腫14例を後方視的に検討しています。3例は初回手術後の再発または残存腫瘍を有して紹介されました。14例中10例（72%）が生存し、死亡例はすべて腹腔内腫瘍の再発が原因でした。奇形腫との混合型は除外されています。治療における放射線療法の役割を考察しています。
pmid-3343149.summary_en: This retrospective review of 14 patients with ovarian dysgerminoma treated at the Prince of Wales Hospital, Sydney, from 1969 to 1983 examines presenting symptoms, treatment and survival. Three patients had recurrent or residual tumor after primary surgery. Ten of 14 patients (72%) remained alive, and all four deaths resulted from recurrent intra-abdominal tumor, with or without distant metastases. Mixed ovarian germ cell tumors were excluded. The authors discuss the role of radiotherapy in treatment.

pmid-3345789.summary_ja: 本研究は卵巣奇形腫77例の病理組織学的レビューである。手術検体の検査方法、組織学的パターン、各種組織成分の頻度を解析し、腫瘍の組織発生に関する主要な考察も論じている。臨床転帰や治療ではなく形態学的特徴の記載が中心であり、卵巣奇形腫の組織構成と組織発生を整理した記述研究である。
pmid-3345789.summary_en: This histopathological review examined 77 ovarian teratomas, analyzing surgical specimens by examination method, histologic patterns, and the frequency of different tissue components. The authors also discussed the main histogenetic hypotheses for these tumors. The study is a descriptive series from the late 1980s, focused on morphologic characterization rather than clinical outcomes or treatment. Its value lies in documenting the tissue composition and histogenesis of ovarian teratomas.

pmid-3345955.summary_ja: 脳転移を伴う絨毛癌の2例を報告する。1例は胞状奇胎の除去後、もう1例は妊娠初期の自然流産後に神経症状で発症した。孤立性脳転移に対して開頭切除と化学療法を行い、術後5年および9年の生存を確認している。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の脳転移の治療を概説し、孤立性病変では手術と化学療法の併用により治癒もえられうると述べている。
pmid-3345955.summary_en: This report describes two women who presented with neurological symptoms due to metastatic cerebral choriocarcinoma, one after a molar pregnancy and one after a spontaneous abortion. Both underwent craniotomy with excision of solitary brain metastases followed by chemotherapy, and both remained alive and well 5 and 9 years later. The authors briefly review management of cerebral metastases in gestational trophoblastic disease. They note a generally poor prognosis but possible cure for solitary lesions treated with combined surgery and chemotherapy.

pmid-3346009.summary_ja: 2名の病理医が精巣セミノーマ45例を分類し、各症例30視野の核分裂数を評価した。核分裂率には観察者間で有意差があり、3例で分類が一致しなかった。高核分裂率と判定された4例はいずれも病期Iで発症し、追跡中に無病であった。著者らは「高核分裂率セミノーマ」という分類の意義に疑問を呈し、ポアソン分布モデルで誤分類確率と診断閾値を推定している。
pmid-3346009.summary_en: Two pathologists classified 45 testicular seminomas and evaluated mitotic counts across 30 high-power fields per case. Interobserver differences in mitotic rate led to disagreement in three tumors. All four high-mitotic-rate cases presented at stage I and remained disease-free during follow-up. The authors question the value of the 'high-mitotic-rate seminoma' designation. Using a Poisson model, they estimate the probability of misclassification and diagnostic mitotic-rate thresholds.

pmid-3346101.summary_ja: 本研究は170の組織・細胞検体におけるヒト内在性レトロウイルスERV3のRNA発現を調べた。ERV3は正常胎盤絨毛で最も高発現したが、絨毛癌細胞株と侵入奇胎の生検組織ではほぼ消失していた。この消失はゲノムの欠失や再配列によるものではなく、DNAメチル化による説明もつかず、5-アザシチジンでも誘導されなかった。著者らは、ERV3発現の喪失が絨毛癌の発生しやすさと関連すると提唱している。
pmid-3346101.summary_en: This study examined ERV3 endogenous retrovirus RNA expression across 170 human tissues and cell specimens. ERV3 was highest in normal placental chorionic villi but nearly absent in choriocarcinoma cell lines and an invasive hydatidiform mole biopsy. The loss was not due to genomic deletion or rearrangement, and it was not explained by methylation or reversed by 5-azacytidine. The authors propose that loss of ERV3 expression is associated with susceptibility to choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3347977.summary_ja: 後腹膜セミノーマを切除してから18年後に精巣セミノーマで発症した症例を報告する。精巣の組織所見は当初の後腹膜腫瘍の病理と一致し、潜在していた精巣原発セミノーマの再発と考えられた。後腹膜原発と思われた症例でも、潜在性の精巣原発が長期間を経て出現しうることを示している。
pmid-3347977.summary_en: This case report describes a patient who presented with testicular seminoma 18 years after resection of a retroperitoneal seminoma. Histology of the testis matched the original retroperitoneal pathology, suggesting that the testicular tumor represented recurrence of an occult primary testicular seminoma. The report highlights that an occult testicular primary can present years after an apparently retroperitoneal primary.

pmid-3348314.summary_ja: 1959年から1980年に絨毛癌または侵入奇胎で化学療法のみを受け、子宮摘出を行わなかった265例の長期フォローアップ研究である。その後妊娠した205例で355回の妊娠があり、303名が生児を得た。子どもの発育・発達は正常で、胎児損失、奇形、多胎、乳児死亡の頻度は増加しなかった。94名の染色体検査でも異常の増加はなかった。再発率は子宮摘出例と同程度であり、化学療法のみでの妊孕性温存を支持する。
pmid-3348314.summary_en: This long-term follow-up study reports pregnancy outcomes in 265 women with choriocarcinoma or invasive mole treated with chemotherapy alone, without hysterectomy, between 1959 and 1980. Of 205 women who later conceived, 355 pregnancies yielded 303 livebirths. Children showed normal growth and development, and fetal wastage, malformations, twinning, and infant mortality were not increased. Chromosomal analysis of 94 children showed no increase in aberrations. Recurrence rates were comparable to those after hysterectomy, supporting fertility preservation with chemotherapy alone.

pmid-3348356.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸で分化誘導し、実験的転移アッセイで臓器への定着パターンを比較した。未処理細胞は肝臓に、処理細胞は肺に定着した。両群の腫瘍は組織学的に分化の所見を欠く胎児性癌であった。ラミニンやIV型コラーゲンの発現は分化を示す一方、未分化マーカーSSEA-1は処理細胞由来の肺結節でのみ消失しており、in vitroで分化誘導に反応した細胞がin vivoで脱分化したと著者らは考察している。
pmid-3348356.summary_en: This study used F9 embryonal carcinoma cells to test whether retinoic acid-induced differentiation alters organ colonization. Untreated cells colonized the liver, whereas retinoic acid-treated cells colonized the lungs, a pattern seen with both spontaneous death and micrometastasis assessment. Tumors from both groups remained histologically undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma. Laminin and collagen IV expression was consistent with this, but SSEA-1 was absent only in lung-colonizing tumors, suggesting that cells responded to induction in vitro and dedifferentiated in vivo.

pmid-3348910.summary_ja: 20歳男性の前縦隔腫瘤は当初非ホジキンリンパ腫と診断され、CHOP療法は無効であった。免疫染色ではαフェトプロテイン(AFP)や絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は陰性であったが、精巣セミノーマを認識する単クローン抗体に強陽性を示し、縦隔セミノーマと確定された。若年男性の縦隔腫瘤の鑑別における本抗体の有用性を示す症例である。
pmid-3348910.summary_en: A 20-year-old man presented with a large anterior mediastinal mass initially suspected as non-Hodgkin lymphoma; CHOP chemotherapy was ineffective. Immunohistochemistry was negative for AFP, hCG and other markers, but the tumor strongly reacted with a monoclonal antibody that recognizes testicular seminomas. The authors conclude that this antibody is valuable for confirming mediastinal seminoma when conventional markers fail. This case highlights the diagnostic pitfalls of mediastinal masses in young men.

pmid-3351047.summary_ja: 右下葉の転移(性)絨毛癌が、胸部X線写真および動的コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で動静脈奇形と誤認された。画像上、転移(性)絨毛癌が血管性病変に酷似しうることを示す症例である。血管様所見を示す肺病変の鑑別には、転移(性)絨毛癌も考慮すべきであると述べている。
pmid-3351047.summary_en: A metastatic choriocarcinoma in the right lower lobe of the lung was misinterpreted as an arteriovenous malformation on both chest radiography and dynamic CT. The case shows that metastatic choriocarcinoma can closely mimic vascular lesions on imaging. Clinicians and radiologists should therefore include metastatic choriocarcinoma in the differential diagnosis of pulmonary lesions with vascular-appearing features.

pmid-3352038.summary_ja: 患者とその弟に精巣腫瘍が発生した家系を報告している。ある患者の同一精巣にセミノーマと胎児性癌が併存し、両者に同一の異常染色体i(12p)と由来不明のマーカー染色体が認められた。弟も2年前にセミノーマで精巣摘除術を受けていた。精巣腫瘍の細胞起源と遺伝学的特徴の観点から考察している。
pmid-3352038.summary_en: The authors describe a family in which a patient and his younger brother both developed testicular germ cell tumors. In one patient, a single testis contained both a seminoma and an embryonal carcinoma, and both tumors shared an identical abnormal chromosome, i(12p), plus a marker chromosome of unknown origin. The younger brother had also undergone orchiectomy for seminomas in the left testis two years earlier. The findings are discussed in terms of the cellular origin of testicular tumors and their genetic characteristics.

pmid-3353348.summary_ja: 若年男性が反復する咳嗽と喀血で受診し、開胸術で肺実質内の良性嚢胞性奇形腫が判明した。奇形腫は縦隔では一般的だが、肺内発生は極めてまれで報告例は30例未満とされる。外科的切除後、患者は速やかに回復した。奇形腫の珍しい発生部位を示す症例報告である。
pmid-3353348.summary_en: A young man presented with recurrent cough and hemoptysis and was found at thoracotomy to have a benign cystic teratoma within the lung parenchyma. Although benign cystic teratomas are common in the mediastinum, they rarely arise intrapulmonary, with fewer than 30 cases reported. Some patients present with bronchiectasis, abscess, or pneumonia. The patient recovered rapidly after surgical excision. The report is a brief clinical description of an unusual site for teratoma.

pmid-3356751.summary_ja: 正常組織と悪性腫瘍の計170検体で、ヒト内在性プロウイルスERV3のmRNA発現を検討した。胎盤絨毛では高発現で、他の多くの組織も胎盤の2～30%程度の発現を示した。一方、絨毛癌細胞株では発現が認められず、ERV3の発現消失が絨毛癌の発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-3356751.summary_en: This study measured mRNA expression of the human endogenous provirus ERV3 across 170 normal and malignant human tissue and cell samples. ERV3 was highly expressed in first-trimester and term placental chorionic villi and at lower levels in most other tissues, but was absent in choriocarcinoma cell lines. The authors suggest ERV3 may have been co-opted for a biological function in the placenta, and that loss of its expression may contribute to choriocarcinoma development.

pmid-3357146.summary_ja: ターナー様の特徴を示した生後15か月の表現型女児が、核型解析で46XY性腺異形成症と診断された。膀胱尿管逆流症に対する両側尿管再移植術の際に行った性腺摘出で性腺芽腫が見つかった。乳児期にすでに悪性化していたことから、診断時点での早期性腺摘出が必要であると結論づけられている。
pmid-3357146.summary_en: A 15-month-old phenotypic female with Turner-like features was diagnosed with 46XY gonadal dysgenesis by karyotyping. Gonadectomy performed during bilateral ureteral reimplantation for vesicoureteral reflux revealed gonadoblastoma. Malignancy was already present at 15 months of age, leading the authors to recommend early gonadectomy at the time of diagnosis in 46XY gonadal dysgenesis. The report highlights that gonadoblastoma can develop in infancy and supports timely surgical management of dysgenetic gonads.

pmid-3358365.summary_ja: 1956～1983年にUCLAで治療された精巣セミノーマ103例を後方視的に検討した。病期Iの10年疾患特異的生存率は93％、病期IIは70％であった。病期IIIの多くは放射線療法と化学療法の併用で長期無病生存を得た。骨盤手術歴のある患者では骨盤照射による制御改善はなく、hCG上昇を伴わない女性化乳房は性腺機能不全に起因すると考えられた。
pmid-3358365.summary_en: This retrospective review of 103 patients with stage I to III testicular seminoma treated at UCLA between 1956 and 1983 examined histology, treatment protocols, survival, and subsequent primary malignancies. Ten-year cause-specific survival was 93% for stage I and 70% for stage II. Most stage III patients achieved long-term disease-free survival with combined irradiation and chemotherapy. Pelvic irradiation did not improve control in patients with prior pelvic surgery, and gynecomastia without elevated hCG was attributed to gonadal failure.

pmid-3358367.summary_ja: 水腫様胎盤31例にフローサイトメトリーによるDNA倍数性解析を行い、胞状奇胎の診断補助として検討した。完全胞状奇胎はすべて二倍体、組織学的部分胞状奇胎の多くは三倍体で、対照胎盤はすべて二倍体であった。核型解析とも一致し、組織学的評価を補完する迅速・正確で費用対効果の高い方法と結論された。
pmid-3358367.summary_en: Flow cytometric DNA ploidy analysis was applied to 31 placentas, 19 of which appeared hydropic on ultrasonography or gross examination, to aid the diagnosis of hydatidiform moles. Complete moles were uniformly diploid, most histologically classified partial moles were triploid, and all control placentas were diploid. Ploidy results matched karyotyping where it was performed. The authors conclude that flow cytometry is a rapid, accurate, and cost-effective supplement to histologic evaluation of hydropic placentas.

pmid-3358908.summary_ja: 1981～1985年にスコットランド西部で治療された非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍122例を検討した。精巣原発の2年生存率は91％、性腺外原発は25％であった。精巣腫瘍では非常に大容量の転移で生存率が著しく低かった。病期I患者でフォローアップのみとした症例の23％が再発したが、全例が化学療法で治療された。
pmid-3358908.summary_en: This study reviewed 122 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours treated at a West of Scotland referral centre from 1981 to 1985, 98 of whom received cisplatin-based chemotherapy for metastatic disease. Two-year survival was 91% for testicular and 25% for extragonadal tumours. Among testicular patients, very large volume metastases were associated with markedly worse survival. Of 31 stage I patients, seven managed by surveillance relapsed, all of whom were successfully treated with chemotherapy.

pmid-3362327.summary_ja: 35歳女性の仙骨前奇形腫に悪性カルチノイド成分が含まれ、前仙骨髄膜瘤を併存していた症例である。臨床・画像・病理所見を報告し、仙骨前髄膜瘤および遺伝性仙骨前奇形腫症候群について文献的に考察している。稀な併存例として、仙骨前腫瘍の診断と治療上の留意点を示している。
pmid-3362327.summary_en: A 35-year-old woman presented with a presacral teratoma containing a malignant carcinoid component, associated with an anterior sacral meningocele. The authors describe the clinical, radiographic, and pathological features of this rare combination. They also review presacral meningoceles and the hereditary presacral teratoma syndrome. The case highlights diagnostic and therapeutic considerations for presacral tumors coexisting with meningocele.

pmid-3364197.summary_ja: 膀胱原発の絨毛癌の症例報告である。初回生検では絨毛癌と移行上皮癌が共存していたが、膀胱摘除標本と転移巣は絨毛癌のみであった。形態所見と、腫瘍組織および血清中のhCG検出により診断された。性腺外の絨毛癌が膀胱に生じうることを示す症例である。
pmid-3364197.summary_en: This case report describes primary choriocarcinoma of the urinary bladder in a patient whose initial biopsy showed coexisting choriocarcinoma and transitional cell carcinoma. The cystectomy specimen and metastatic lesions contained only choriocarcinoma. Diagnosis was confirmed morphologically and by demonstration of hCG in both tumor tissue and serum. The case shows that extragonadal choriocarcinoma can arise in the bladder and may be initially under-recognized on limited biopsy sampling.

pmid-3364839.summary_ja: 出産後の女性に生じる稀で侵襲性の高い妊娠性絨毛癌の2症例を報告する。消化管、呼吸器、泌尿生殖器、中枢神経系など通常とは異なる部位への転移が初発症状となった点が特徴である。原発巣が自然消退したように見える症例も示され、婦人科疾患が明らかでない場合でも本疾患を念頭に置く必要性が強調されている。
pmid-3364839.summary_en: This case report describes two women with metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma, a rare and aggressive cancer arising after pregnancy. The authors highlight unusual initial presentations involving the gastrointestinal, respiratory, genitourinary, or central nervous systems. In some patients, metastatic lesions were evident while the primary site appeared to resolve spontaneously. The report emphasizes that clinicians should consider gestational choriocarcinoma in women presenting with multisystem metastatic symptoms, even when a gynecological problem is not obvious.

pmid-3365662.summary_ja: 米国の集中がん患者データを用い、精巣の胎児性癌479例と卵黄嚢腫瘍33例の予後を検討した。胎児性癌の多くは15〜34歳で、約4分の3が診断時に転移性疾患を有していた。5年生存率は全体で88%で、限局例98%、領域例96%、遠隔転移例74%と進展度に相関した。卵黄嚢腫瘍は主に若年層に生じ、生存率はやや不良であった。早期発見と新規化学療法の進歩が成績向上に寄与したと結論づけられている。
pmid-3365662.summary_en: This large retrospective analysis from the Centralized Cancer Patient Data System examined 479 patients with testicular embryonal carcinoma and 33 with endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor. Most embryonal carcinoma patients were aged 15 to 34 years, and about three-quarters presented with metastatic disease. The overall 5-year survival was 88%, and survival correlated with disease extent: 98% for localized, 96% for regional, and 74% for distant disease. Endodermal sinus tumor occurred mainly in young patients and had slightly poorer survival. Improved detection and newer chemotherapy were credited for better outcomes.

pmid-3365676.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の消化管転移を6例（セミノーマ3例、非セミノーマ3例）で報告する。いずれも上部消化管に生じ、初診時または再発時に見つかった。無病期間は3か月から10年であった。転移経路は血行性または傍大動脈リンパ節からの直接進展と推定された。強い腹痛、腸閉塞、潰瘍、貧血などの症状がみられ、化学療法後に多くの患者が無病の状態となった。
pmid-3365676.summary_en: This report describes six cases of testicular germ cell tumor metastasizing to the gastrointestinal tract, three seminomas and three nonseminomatous tumors. All involved the upper gastrointestinal tract, either at presentation or at relapse, with disease-free intervals ranging from 3 months to 10 years. Spread occurred hematogenously or by direct extension from paraaortic nodes. Symptoms included severe abdominal pain, obstruction, ulceration, and anemia. Most patients treated with chemotherapy became disease-free, highlighting that GI involvement should be considered in relapsing testicular cancer.

pmid-3366446.summary_ja: 膀胱の移行上皮癌内に生じた絨毛性の化生から発生した絨毛癌の症例を報告する。このような栄養膜様成分は膀胱の尿路上皮腫瘍で時に生じることが示されている。生じた絨毛癌は典型的な上皮性膀胱癌とは異なる振る舞いを示す可能性があり、予後や治療方針に影響しうると指摘されている。抄録は簡潔で、患者背景や経過、治療に関する記載は限られており、稀な組織学的現象を記録したものである。
pmid-3366446.summary_en: This case report describes choriocarcinoma arising from trophoblastic metaplasia within a transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder. The authors note that such trophoblastic components occasionally develop in bladder urothelial tumors. They suggest that the resulting choriocarcinoma may behave differently from typical epithelial bladder cancers, which has implications for prognosis and treatment planning. The abstract is brief, offering limited details about patient demographics, clinical course, or therapy, so the report primarily documents a rare histologic phenomenon.

pmid-3367343.summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性奇形腫が自然に腹腔内破裂した症例を報告する。破裂は、拡張・排出法による妊娠中期の人工妊娠中絶後に生じた。このような破裂は稀であり、著者らは中期中絶に関連した初めての報告と述べている。産科的処置中に骨盤内腫瘤が存在する場合には、稀ではあるが起こりうる合併症として認識すべきであることが示された。抄録には治療経過や転帰の記載はない。
pmid-3367343.summary_en: This case report describes spontaneous intraperitoneal rupture of a benign cystic teratoma. The rupture occurred after a midtrimester pregnancy termination performed by dilatation and evacuation. Such rupture is considered unusual, and the authors state this is the first reported case associated with midtrimester abortion. The report highlights a potential, though rare, complication of benign teratomas that clinicians should recognize, especially when a pelvic mass is present during obstetric procedures. Management and outcome details are not included in the abstract.

pmid-3368170.summary_ja: ナッシュビルの5施設で、21歳以下の女性の卵巣腫大と卵巣腫瘍を後方視的に検討した。卵巣腫大137例中5.8%、卵巣腫瘍82例中9.8%が境界悪性または悪性であった。悪性腫瘍6例はすべて胚細胞由来で、境界悪性腫瘍は上皮性で10代後半に多かった。三次医療機関からの報告より悪性率は低いと結論づけられている。それでも若年女性の腹部骨盤内腫瘤は速やかな評価が必要である。
pmid-3368170.summary_en: This retrospective community-based review at five Nashville hospitals assessed ovarian enlargement and neoplasms in females aged 21 and younger. Borderline or malignant ovarian neoplasms were found in 5.8% of 137 patients with ovarian enlargement and 9.8% of 82 with ovarian neoplasms. All six malignant tumors were of germ-cell origin, while borderline tumors were epithelial and occurred in late teens. The authors conclude that malignancy rates are lower than suggested by tertiary-center series. Nevertheless, an abdominal-pelvic mass in young females warrants prompt, thorough evaluation.

pmid-3374921.summary_ja: 胎児の大型仙尾部奇形腫による不完全経膣分娩の2例を報告した。膣内と腹部からの併用操作により、骨盤位を通常と逆方向に娩出させたところ、良好な転帰が得られた。この手技は、閉塞分娩を防ぐには遅すぎた場合に限られる。早期の超音波診断と、陣痛進行前の帝王切開が閉塞分娩の予防に重要とされる。
pmid-3374921.summary_en: Two cases of incomplete vaginal delivery caused by large fetal sacrococcygeal teratomas are described. Recognition of the obstructed delivery led to combined vaginal and abdominal manipulation, with the breech extracted abdominally in a direction opposite to the usual one. Both mother and infant had favorable outcomes with minimal morbidity. The authors note the maneuver applies only when the fetal tumor is diagnosed too late to prevent obstruction. They emphasize that early ultrasonographic diagnosis and cesarean delivery before advanced labor can prevent obstructed delivery.

pmid-3375143.summary_ja: 前立腺癌と診断された29歳男性の根治的前立腺全摘術で、原発性の前立腺卵黄嚢腫瘍が判明した。シラー・デュバル様小体とAFP陽性の硝子様小体が認められた。尿道周囲導管、尿道、精嚢へ浸潤し、リンパ節転移を1個認めた。精巣超音波は陰性であった。積極的手術と化学療法にもかかわらず、診断後10か月で死亡した。
pmid-3375143.summary_en: A 29-year-old man with suspected prostatic adenocarcinoma underwent radical prostatectomy, revealing a primary endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor of the prostate. Histology showed tubular, papillary and solid patterns with Schiller-Duval-like bodies and alpha-fetoprotein-positive hyaline bodies. The tumor infiltrated periurethral ducts, urethra and seminal vesicles, with one lymph node metastasis. Testicular ultrasound was negative. Despite aggressive surgery and chemotherapy, the patient died 10 months after diagnosis. The authors note this is the third such case in the literature.

pmid-3376353.summary_ja: 母親と娘2人の卵巣類皮嚢腫の家系を対象に、染色体の検査を行った。家系内で異数性と染色体切断の頻度増加が認められ、染色体不安定性が示唆された。症例数は極めて少なく、因果関係は確立されていない。卵巣類皮嚢腫の遺伝的素因の可能性を示す短報である。
pmid-3376353.summary_en: A mother and two daughters with ovarian dermoid cysts were studied for chromosomal abnormalities. The family showed an increased frequency of aneuploidy and chromosomal breakage, indicating chromosomal instability. The report is a brief communication without detailed clinical description, cytogenetic methods or statistical analysis. The findings suggest a possible genetic predisposition to ovarian dermoid cysts within this family, although the sample is very small and no causal link is established.

pmid-3376363.summary_ja: 同側の精巣セミノーマと腎細胞がんが同時性に発生した1例を報告した。文献検索で類似症例は6例であった。2つの腫瘍の併存が偶然によるものかどうかを考察している。治療経過や転帰の詳細は抄録には記載されていない。症例報告と短い文献的考察からなる論文である。
pmid-3376363.summary_en: A case of synchronously arising seminoma of the testis and ipsilateral renal cell carcinoma is reported. The authors reviewed the literature and found six similar cases. They discuss whether the coexistence of these two tumors could be due to chance. The report is a brief case description with a short literature review, and the abstract gives no detail on treatment or outcome.

pmid-3378217.summary_ja: 7種類のマウス胎児性癌細胞株由来腫瘍に対する食事性レチノイドの効果を検討した。全トランスレチノイン酸を含む餌は多くの腫瘍の増殖を抑制し、分化を促進した。分化欠陥株の腫瘍はレチノイン酸に抵抗性を示した。レチノイン酸投与はマウスの体重増加を抑制する有害作用があった。分化促進以外の機序も関与すると結論づけられている。
pmid-3378217.summary_en: The effects of dietary retinoids on growth and differentiation of tumors derived from seven murine embryonal carcinoma cell lines were examined. Diets containing all-trans-retinoic acid suppressed growth of many tumors and increased differentiation, mostly quantitatively. Tumors from two differentiation-defective lines were resistant to retinoic acid. Changes in dietary retinyl palmitate had modest effects. Retinoic acid diets impaired weight gain in mice. The authors conclude retinoic acid reduces teratocarcinoma growth partly by promoting differentiation, but other mechanisms also contribute.

pmid-3379682.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌に対する化学療法後に、下大静脈内に奇形腫血栓が生じた1例を報告した。巨大な後腹膜病変の患者の約1%に下大静脈内転移が起こるとされる。奇形腫は局所進展のみでも致命的になりうる。手術時には下大静脈の確認と、化学療法後の残存腫瘤の完全切除が推奨されている。
pmid-3379682.summary_en: A case is reported of a teratoma thrombus within the inferior vena cava after chemotherapy for testicular embryonal carcinoma. The authors review literature showing intracaval metastases in about 1 percent of patients with bulky retroperitoneal disease. Seminoma and embryonal carcinoma have previously been found in the vena cava, and teratoma is now added. The case highlights the lethal potential of teratoma through local growth alone. They recommend inspecting the inferior vena cava at surgery for bulky disease and complete resection of residual masses after chemotherapy for testis cancer.

pmid-3383961.summary_ja: 実験的に誘発したラット卵黄嚢癌を、ヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍と形態学的・生物学的に比較した。多くの特徴が共通する一方、細胞起源は異なると考えられた。ヒトの卵黄嚢腫瘍は胚細胞由来とされるが、ラットの臓側卵黄嚢由来腫瘍は胚細胞由来ではないと筆者らは仮説を立てている。
pmid-3383961.summary_en: Experimentally induced rat yolk sac carcinomas were compared with human yolk sac tumors morphologically and biologically. The rat tumors share many features with their human counterparts, but the authors propose that their cellular origin differs. Human yolk sac tumors are considered germ cell derived, whereas rat visceral yolk sac-derived tumors are not. They hypothesize that rat tumors arise from multipotential cells displaced into the extra-embryonic membrane. The model's relevance rests on its morphological and biological similarity to the human disease.

pmid-3383978.summary_ja: ヌードマウスの皮下異種移植片として増殖させたヒト胚細胞腫瘍細胞株GCT 27で、化学療法への反応を検討した。シスプラチンとカルボプラチンは用量依存的に腫瘍増殖を遅延させた。ブレオマイシンは高用量で体重減少を招いた。エトポシドを低用量のシスプラチンと併用すると、単独では無効でも高用量シスプラチンに匹敵する増殖遅延が得られた。
pmid-3383978.summary_en: The human germ cell tumour line GCT 27, grown as subcutaneous xenografts in nude mice, was used to test chemotherapeutic responses. Cisplatin and carboplatin produced clear dose-dependent growth delay, while bleomycin caused weight loss at high doses. Vinblastine and etoposide alone had no effect at nontoxic doses. Combining etoposide with cisplatin, which were each ineffective alone, produced growth delay comparable to higher cisplatin doses, possibly by interfering with cisplatin-induced DNA crosslink repair via topoisomerase II inhibition.

pmid-3385278.summary_ja: 絨毛癌に対するエトポシドの有効性を検討した基礎・臨床研究。5種の絨毛癌細胞株で強い抗腫瘍効果を示し、栄養膜性疾患29例では有効率93.3%と、アクチノマイシンD(50.0%)やMTX(21.0%)より高かった。副作用も軽度で、高リスク群ではMECA療法が全例で寛解を得た。
pmid-3385278.summary_en: This study evaluated etoposide against choriocarcinoma. In vitro, etoposide showed strong cytotoxicity across five human choriocarcinoma cell lines, comparable to actinomycin D and cyclophosphamide. Clinically, in 29 patients with trophoblastic disease (15 choriocarcinoma, 14 invasive mole), etoposide achieved a 93.3% effective rate, versus 50.0% with actinomycin D and 21.0% with methotrexate. Side effects were milder. In high-risk choriocarcinoma, the MECA protocol achieved complete or partial remission in all five patients, compared with 50% under the MAC protocol.

pmid-3385592.summary_ja: 新生児の巨大扁桃奇形腫(epignathus)の男児症例の報告と治療経過の記載。極めて稀な病変で、生存例の報告は少ない。性腺外に生じた奇形腫の症例で、中枢神経系ではない。新生児期に発症した性腺外奇形腫の希少例として位置づけられる。
pmid-3385592.summary_en: A case report of a newborn boy with a giant tonsillar teratoma, also called epignathus, describing his clinical management.
