Such lesions are rare, and the authors note that few survivors have been reported. The paper is a single-patient report of an extragonadal teratoma arising in the oropharynx, outside the central nervous system. It is relevant as an example of a teratoma at an unusual extragonadal site presenting in the neonatal period.

pmid-3390378.summary_ja: 若年女性の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍73例と対照138例を比較した症例対照研究。母親の外因性ホルモン曝露(OR 3.60)、妊娠前の高BMI、妊娠時の母親年齢20歳未満などがリスク上昇と関連した。精巣がんと同様にホルモン要因が関与し、エストロゲンの作用機序が示唆された。
pmid-3390378.summary_en: A case-control study of 73 women under 35 with ovarian germ cell tumors and 138 matched controls from Los Angeles and Seattle. Maternal exogenous hormone exposure during pregnancy, including hormonal pregnancy tests, DES, and inadvertent oral contraceptive use, was associated with increased risk (OR 3.60). High pre-pregnancy body mass, rapid menstrual onset, and maternal age under 20 at pregnancy were also linked to elevated risk. The findings parallel testicular cancer studies, supporting a hormonal etiology for germ cell tumors, with estrogen proposed as a mechanism.

pmid-3391419.summary_ja: クアラルンプールの病院で治療された卵巣の純粋未熟奇形腫9例の報告。6例が病期I、3例が病期IIIで、ほとんどの腫瘍はグレード2または3であった。病期I患者は症例に応じて保存的手術または根治的手術を受け、補助化学療法にはパルス投与シクロホスファミド、VAC、PVBのレジメンが用いられた。患者7例が疾患の証拠なく最長9年間生存した。
pmid-3391419.summary_en: A report of nine pure immature teratomas of the ovary treated at a hospital in Kuala Lumpur. Six patients had stage I disease and three stage III, with most tumors grade 2 or 3. Stage I patients underwent conservative or radical surgery depending on the case, and adjuvant chemotherapy used pulsed cyclophosphamide, VAC, or PVB regimens. Seven patients survived up to nine years without evidence of disease, showing favorable outcomes for this rare ovarian germ cell tumor.

pmid-3391825.summary_ja: ホジキン病およびセミノーマに対する中等量の横隔膜下放射線照射後の合併症を、1,026例で解析した研究。3年合併症率は任意で14%、重篤で4%。消化管障害が最多で、線量の増加とともに合併症が増えた。治療効果と毒性のバランスから、線量の最適化が必要とされる。
pmid-3391825.summary_en: Analysis of 1,026 patients from the Patterns of Care Outcome Studies who received intermediate-dose infradiaphragmatic radiation for Hodgkin's disease or seminoma. Overall, 3-year complication rates were 14% for any complication and 4% for major ones, with gastrointestinal injury most common. Complications rose significantly with total dose, and prior GI disease increased bowel complication risk. The authors conclude that dose should be optimized to balance tumor control with toxicity, ideally keeping doses at or below 3,500 cGy where possible.

pmid-3392438.summary_ja: 1978〜1987年に治療された妊娠性絨毛癌16例の後方視的検討で、肺および脳転移に対する外科的治療に焦点を当てた。寛解率は87.5%。肺転移では肺葉切除で完全寛解、脳転移では腫瘍摘出と放射線療法で完全寛解が得られた。化学療法との併用による選択的な積極的手術が有効と結論づけられた。
pmid-3392438.summary_en: A review of 16 women with gestational choriocarcinoma treated from 1978 to 1987, focusing on surgical management of lung and brain metastases. Of the 16 patients, 14 had pulmonary metastases, and 10 of these underwent lobectomy with complete remission. Three had brain metastases; tumorectomy with irradiation was performed in two, both achieving complete remission. Overall remission was 87.5%. The authors conclude that aggressive, selective surgery combined with systemic chemotherapy is effective for metastatic sites.

pmid-3392891.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者52例を対象とした後方視的研究で、HLA抗原頻度を検討した。多重比較補正後に有意に増加したのはBW41のみで、セミノーマの発症に遺伝因子が関与する根拠は弱いと結論づけた。転移性セミノーマではA29、BW41、DR7の増加傾向がみられ、MHCクラスII抗原の関与を含め今後の検討が必要とされている。
pmid-3392891.summary_en: This retrospective study examined HLA class I and II antigen frequencies in 52 patients with histologically pure testicular seminoma to assess genetic susceptibility. After correction for the number of antigens tested, only BW41 was significantly increased (P = 0.0005). HLA-DR1 was decreased but not significantly. In metastatic seminoma, trends toward increased A29, BW41, and DR7 were observed. The authors conclude that evidence for a genetic role in seminoma pathogenesis is weak, and that the metastatic trend and possible MHC class II involvement merit further study.

pmid-3396287.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後12年で組織学的に確認された転移性精巣奇形腫の症例報告である。2年前にも再発を疑う所見で受診していたが、大きな腹腔内膿瘍のため診断が遅れた。経過中、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCGは一度も上昇しなかった。腫瘍マーカーが晩期再発を示さない場合があり、炎症所見で画像診断が不明瞭な際には組織診断が必要であることを示す。
pmid-3396287.summary_en: This case report describes metastatic testicular teratoma confirmed histologically 12 years after orchidectomy. The patient had presented with a possible recurrence two years earlier, but a large intra-abdominal abscess delayed the diagnosis. Serum alpha-fetoprotein and beta-hCG were never elevated during the course. The case illustrates that tumor markers may fail to signal late relapse in testicular germ cell tumors, and that histological confirmation may be needed when inflammatory findings confound imaging.

pmid-3397045.summary_ja: 出生から18歳までの小児胚細胞腫瘍216例を後方視的に検討し、27例の未熟奇形腫を確認した。17例は1回の手術で根治的に治療され、腫瘍死は2例のみであった。再発や転移は治療可能なことが多く、卵巣腫瘍では組織学的悪性度が予後に重要であった。「悪性奇形腫」という用語は混乱を招くため避けるべきだとしている。
pmid-3397045.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 216 germ cell tumors in children from birth to age 18 and identified 27 immature teratomas arising at various sites. Seventeen were treated curatively with a single operation, and only two patients died directly from tumor growth. Recurrences and metastases were often treatable. In ovarian tumors, histological grading carried important prognostic value. The authors recommend avoiding the term malignant teratoma, which they consider confusing.

pmid-3400468.summary_ja: 42歳日本人男性の食道原発絨毛癌の剖検例である。食道中部の腫瘍は出血・壊死を伴う純粋な絨毛癌で、肝・肺・リンパ節に転移していた。免疫染色ではヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が主に検出された。食道発生の性腺外絨毛癌は既報が少なく、発生機序と病理学的特徴を考察している。
pmid-3400468.summary_en: This autopsy report describes primary esophageal choriocarcinoma in a 42-year-old Japanese man. The mid-esophageal tumor was pure choriocarcinoma with hemorrhagic and necrotic features and had metastasized to liver, lung, and lymph nodes. Immunohistochemistry showed predominantly human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), with human placental lactogen in a few syncytiotrophoblastic cells. The authors note only three prior esophageal extragonadal choriocarcinomas and discuss possible pathogenesis.

pmid-3404520.summary_ja: 卵管妊娠に合併した卵管の良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。極めて稀な所見であり、卵管内に2つの腫瘤を認めた場合には本併存の可能性を考慮すべきと報告している。妊娠初期に付属器腫瘤を評価する際には、本病態を鑑別に含めて術式や病理診断を計画することの重要性を示している。
pmid-3404520.summary_en: This case report describes a benign cystic teratoma of the fallopian tube coexisting with a tubal pregnancy. The finding is rare, and the authors note that two masses within one fallopian tube should prompt consideration of this combination. Because the tubal pregnancy and the teratoma appeared together, clinicians evaluating an adnexal mass in early pregnancy should keep this rare possibility in mind when planning surgical management and pathological review.

pmid-3405571.summary_ja: ディスジャーミノーマにおける血清LDHの腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性を検討した。4例で術前にLDHの上昇を認め、軽度の肝酵素上昇を伴った。このパターンの認識により2例で適切な術中病期分類と化学療法の早期開始が可能となり、見落とした1例では不十分な病期分類と再手術を要した。LDHはLDH-1とLDH-2のアイソザイム選択的上昇が本腫瘍を示唆し得る。
pmid-3405571.summary_en: This study examined whether serum lactic dehydrogenase (LDH) can serve as a tumor marker for dysgerminoma. Four patients with stage IA to IIIC disease had preoperative LDH elevations up to 51.5 times normal, with mild liver enzyme elevations. Recognizing this profile led to proper intraoperative staging and earlier chemotherapy in two patients, whereas missing it caused inadequate staging and reoperation in another. LDH levels correlated with tumor size and stage, and selective elevation of LDH-1 and LDH-2 isoenzymes may suggest dysgerminoma.

pmid-3408875.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの悪性精巣奇形腫97例について、精巣摘除術後2か月以内に精液検査を行い再発との関連を検討した。精子数10×10⁶/mL未満で再発は28%、以上で32%と差はなかった。未分化型では再発率が高く、無精子症例では再発や対側精巣の胚細胞腫瘍を認めた。精子数分析は病期Iの再発リスク推定に有用でないと結論された。
pmid-3408875.summary_en: This study analyzed semen parameters within two months of orchiectomy in 97 patients with clinical stage I malignant testicular teratoma managed by surveillance. Relapse occurred in 28% with sperm counts below 10 million per milliliter and 32% above that threshold, showing no meaningful difference. Relapse rates were higher in undifferentiated teratoma, and azoospermic patients had relapses or contralateral germ cell tumors. The authors concluded that sperm count analysis does not usefully estimate relapse risk in clinical stage I teratoma.

pmid-3408876.summary_ja: 病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍を対象とした前向き研究で、低精子数が病勢進行の予測因子かを検討した。精巣摘除術後は進行が確認されるまで治療を行わなかった。精子数10×10⁶/mL未満の20例中9例で進行を認めたが、それ以上の例では進行はなかった。精子数は病勢進行と良好に相関し、サーベイランスの判断に有用な予後マーカーとなり得る。
pmid-3408876.summary_en: This prospective study examined whether low sperm count predicts disease progression in patients with stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours. Patients received no treatment after orchiectomy until progression was confirmed. Progression occurred in 9 of 20 patients with sperm counts below 10 million per milliliter and in none of those above that threshold. The authors found a good correlation between semen sperm counts around orchiectomy and progression, suggesting sperm count may be a useful prognostic marker for surveillance decisions.

pmid-3409169.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株NaUCC-2が標準的な併用化学療法に不応だった背景を、in vitroで検討した。他の3株と比べメトトレキサートの取り込みは高かったが、メトトレキサートとダクチノマイシンの併用は単独使用より殺細胞効果が弱かった。DHFR活性に差はなく、取り込みやDHFR以外の耐性機序の関与が示唆された。標準的なダクチノマイシン・メトトレキサート併用の最適性にも疑問を投げかけている。
pmid-3409169.summary_en: This in vitro study investigated why the choriocarcinoma cell line NaUCC-2 responds poorly to standard combination chemotherapy. Compared with three other choriocarcinoma lines, NaUCC-2 showed higher methotrexate uptake, and methotrexate combined with dactinomycin was less lethal than dactinomycin alone. Dihydrofolate reductase activity was similar. The authors conclude that mechanisms beyond drug uptake and DHFR activity contribute to resistance, and suggest the standard dactinomycin-methotrexate combination may not always be optimal.

pmid-3409178.summary_ja: 1970〜1985年に進行精巣がんを治療した81例のうち、5例が初回治療後58〜195か月で異時性の再発を来した。全例が救援化学療法に反応したが、完全奏効は2例のみであった。成熟奇形腫の悪性転化などを晩期再発の機序として挙げている。治癒した患者には2年以降も少なくとも年1回の評価を含むフォローアップが必要と提唱している。
pmid-3409178.summary_en: This Vanderbilt series reviewed late recurrences in germ cell neoplasm patients who were in remission at two years. Of 81 patients with advanced testicular cancer treated between 1970 and 1985, five developed a recurrence 58 to 195 months after initial treatment, and all responded to salvage chemotherapy, though only two achieved complete responses. The authors propose mechanisms for late relapse, including malignant transformation of mature teratoma. They recommend that cured patients receive careful follow-up beyond two years, at least annually, with more frequent evaluations after teratoma is found post-chemotherapy.

pmid-3409183.summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜純粋絨毛癌の2例の症例報告で、稀少かつ従来最も予後不良とされる性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の亜型である。両例とも積極的な初回多剤併用化学療法を受け、24か月および81か月の時点で無病生存している。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は、腫瘍量や進展度が同等でも性腺由来より予後が悪い可能性があると述べている。積極的な多剤療法により良好な長期予後が期待できるとしている。
pmid-3409183.summary_en: This case report describes two patients with primary retroperitoneal pure choriocarcinoma, one of the rarest and historically most lethal extragonadal germ cell tumor subgroups. Both received aggressive primary multiagent chemotherapy and remain disease-free at 24 and 81 months. The authors note that extragonadal germ cell tumors may have a worse prognosis than gonadal tumors even at equal tumor burden. They conclude that aggressive multiagent therapy may yield favorable long-term outcomes.

pmid-3411688.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマに対する化学療法後に残存する後腹膜腫瘤の管理を論じた1988年の論文。文献レビューにより、こうした腫瘤の15～25%に残存がんが含まれると示唆された。そのため、これらの患者には後腹膜リンパ節郭清が適切と結論づけている。非セミノーマ性精巣がんで残存腫瘤切除が標準とされる点との比較も含まれる。
pmid-3411688.summary_en: This 1988 J Urol review addresses how to manage residual retroperitoneal masses after chemotherapy for advanced seminoma. The literature suggests that 15 to 25 percent of such masses contain residual cancer. The authors conclude that retroperitoneal lymph node dissection is appropriate for these patients. Management of residual masses after nonseminomatous testicular cancer, where resection is standard, is used as the point of comparison.

pmid-3411972.summary_ja: 12歳女児の前縦隔に生じた成熟奇形腫の症例報告。初経後に急速に増大し、切除組織にエストロゲン受容体およびプロゲステロン受容体が検出された。性ホルモンが腫瘍の増殖に影響した可能性が示唆されている。思春期のホルモン変化が急速な増大に関与したと考えられる。
pmid-3411972.summary_en: A case report of a 12-year-old girl with a rapidly growing anterior mediastinal mature teratoma that expanded after menarche. The resected tumor tissue contained both estrogen and progesterone receptors. The authors propose that sex hormones may have influenced the growth of this extragonadal teratoma. Hormonal change at puberty may have contributed to the rapid enlargement.

pmid-2457525.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌の胚様体から臓側内胚葉様細胞を単離し、培養条件による分化を検討した基礎研究。単層培養ではAFPが低下し壁側内胚葉型へ移行した。幹細胞との相互作用や曲面培養ではAFP発現が維持・促進された。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍治療を扱うものではない。
pmid-2457525.summary_en: This developmental biology study isolated visceral endoderm-like cells from F9 embryonal carcinoma embryoid bodies and cultured them under different conditions. Monolayer culture markedly reduced alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) expression and shifted cells toward a parietal endoderm phenotype, while interaction with stem cell aggregates or curved bead surfaces maintained or promoted AFP expression. The findings point to cell interactions and cell shape as drivers of endoderm differentiation. The work uses a teratocarcinoma model rather than clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-2457527.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞でc-fosアンチセンスRNAを発現させ、分化への関与を検討した基礎研究。c-fos低下クローンでは壁側内胚葉マーカーの誘導が抑制された。一方、AFPで示される臓側内胚葉への分化は正常に進んだ。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍治療を扱うものではない。
pmid-2457527.summary_en: This study tested whether c-fos is required for F9 embryonal carcinoma cell differentiation by expressing c-fos antisense RNA from an SV40-based vector. Clones with reduced c-fos protein showed impaired induction of parietal endoderm and extracellular matrix markers after retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP treatment. Visceral endoderm differentiation, marked by alpha-fetoprotein, proceeded normally. The findings suggest c-fos contributes to selected aspects of F9 differentiation but not to visceral endoderm formation. The work is basic developmental biology using a teratocarcinoma cell model rather than clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-2458292.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞に発現する発生段階依存性の糖鎖エピトープを認識するモノクローナル抗体TEC-05の性質を報告した基礎研究である。このエピトープは8細胞期胚から検出され、レチノイン酸による分化に伴い消失した。抗体は細胞の基質への接着を阻害し、その作用はラクトースで打ち消された。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を直接扱うものではない。
pmid-2458292.summary_en: This basic research study describes monoclonal antibody TEC-05, which recognizes a developmentally regulated carbohydrate epitope on embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells such as F9 and OTF9-63. The epitope is first detected at the 8-cell stage of mouse embryos and disappears when EC cells differentiate under retinoic acid. The antigen is carried on high-molecular-weight glycoconjugates, and the antibody inhibits F9 cell adhesion to substratum in a lactose-reversible manner. The work offers a new marker for stage-specific embryonic antigens but does not address clinical germ cell tumors.

pmid-2458954.summary_ja: 胎児性癌(EC)細胞株F9、PC13、P19を発生研究のモデルとして用い、c-srcとc-ablの発現を成体組織と比較した基礎研究である。3株すべてで両遺伝子の発現が確認された。分化誘導による発現変化は株ごとに異なった。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を対象とした研究ではない。
pmid-2458954.summary_en: This study examines c-src and c-abl proto-oncogene expression in embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines F9, PC13 and P19 and in adult mouse tissues. Both transcripts were detected in all three EC lines. Differentiation of F9 and PC13 into endoderm did not change expression, whereas P19 cells showed altered levels after neural or muscle-directed differentiation. The authors conclude these genes matter for later embryonic cell differentiation rather than early embryo. The work uses EC cells as a developmental model, not as clinical tumor material.

pmid-2461362.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で胚様体へ分化させたF9奇形癌細胞が、レチノール結合タンパク質とトランスサイレチンを合成・分泌することを示した基礎研究である。主に内胚葉様細胞で発現し、未分化細胞や壁側内胚葉へ分化させた細胞では発現しなかった。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床研究ではなく、発生研究のモデルとして奇形癌株を用いている。
pmid-2461362.summary_en: This basic study shows that F9 teratocarcinoma cells induced by retinoic acid to form embryoid bodies express retinol-binding protein and transthyretin mRNAs and secrete both proteins, mainly from visceral endoderm-like cells. Undifferentiated and parietal endoderm-differentiated cells lacked these transcripts. The findings suggest these proteins may be synthesized very early in rodent embryos. It is a developmental study using a teratocarcinoma line as a model, not a clinical germ cell tumor study.

pmid-2461850.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株Jarを胎盤細胞モデルとして用い、増殖因子によるhCGβ分泌の調節を検討した研究です。上皮増殖因子と線維芽細胞増殖因子(FGF)は、細胞数を増やさずにhCGβ分泌を著明に増加させ、de novo合成が示唆されました。インスリンはFGFによる増強作用をさらに高めました。
pmid-2461850.summary_en: This study uses the Jar choriocarcinoma cell line as an in vitro placental model to examine how polypeptide growth factors regulate hCG beta secretion. Epidermal growth factor and fibroblast growth factor markedly increased hCG beta secretion in serum-free culture without increasing cell number, suggesting de novo synthesis. Insulin-like growth factor I, nerve growth factor, and TGF-beta had no significant effect, while insulin augmented the FGF-induced response.

pmid-2838167.summary_ja: PYS奇形癌由来細胞を用いて、ホルボールエステル(TPA)によるcAMP依存性プロテインキナーゼ(PK.A)の細胞内分布の変化を調べた基礎研究である。TPAは細胞質のPK.Aを増加させ膜では減少させた。レチノイン酸は同時添加で完全に拮抗したが、事前添加では拮抗しなかった。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床研究ではなく、細胞モデルの研究である。
pmid-2838167.summary_en: PYS teratocarcinoma-derived cells were treated with the tumor promoter TPA, with and without retinoic acid, to study cAMP-dependent protein kinase (PK.A) redistribution. TPA rapidly increased cytosolic PK.A and decreased membrane PK.A, measured by kemptide phosphorylation and photoaffinity labeling. Retinoic acid added simultaneously completely blocked this effect, while pretreatment did not. The results suggest retinoic acid antagonizes TPA-induced PK.A translocation at the plasma membrane.

pmid-2842348.summary_ja: F9奇形癌細胞をレチノイン酸による分化のモデルとして用い、分化関連遺伝子の誘導にタンパク質合成が必要かを検討した基礎研究。シクロヘキシミドやピューロマイシンにより誘導が阻害され、レチノイン酸による遺伝子制御は間接的であると示唆された。腫瘍の臨床的特徴は扱っていない。
pmid-2842348.summary_en: This basic study uses F9 teratocarcinoma cells as a model of retinoic acid-induced differentiation. The authors show that cycloheximide and puromycin block the induction of collagen IV alpha1, laminin B1, and J6 mRNAs by retinoic acid, while metallothionein induction by zinc is unaffected. Protein synthesis is therefore required for these genes, suggesting that their transcriptional regulation by retinoic acid is indirect. The work concerns gene regulation during differentiation rather than tumor clinical features.

pmid-2842791.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞F9を用い、Myc発現の低下が分化に十分かつ必要であることを示した基礎研究。アンチセンスMyc導入で自発的な分化が生じ、Myc過剰発現はレチノイン酸による分化を抑制した。患者の腫瘍生物学を直接扱う内容ではない。
pmid-2842791.summary_en: This study uses murine F9 teratocarcinoma cells as a model of retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Cells transfected with antisense Myc sequences showed decreased Myc protein and spontaneously differentiated, resembling retinoic acid-treated cells. Conversely, cells expressing Myc resisted retinoic acid-induced differentiation. The authors conclude that Myc down-regulation is both sufficient and necessary for F9 differentiation. The focus is Myc regulation rather than tumor biology in patients.

pmid-2848513.summary_ja: 未分化のマウスF9胎児性癌細胞が産生する短鎖コラーゲン様分子を解析した研究です。レチノイン酸による壁側内胚葉への分化に伴い、この分子は減少しました。約60kDaのコラゲナーゼ感受性蛋白で、ペプシン抵抗性の断片を含み、部分的な三重らせん構造が示唆されます。臨床的な管理ではなく、細胞モデルを用いた基底膜関連の基礎研究です。
pmid-2848513.summary_en: This study characterizes a short-chain collagen produced by undifferentiated F9 murine embryonal carcinoma cells. The collagen decreases during retinoic acid-induced differentiation into parietal endoderm. Biochemical analyses showed a collagenase-sensitive protein of about 60 kDa with pepsin-resistant hydroxyproline-containing fragments, suggesting a partially stable triple helix. mRNA from undifferentiated F9 cells encodes a collagenase-sensitive protein consistent with this molecule. The work uses an embryonal carcinoma cell line as a model for basement membrane matrix biology rather than clinical tumor management.

pmid-2900709.summary_ja: 1988年のマウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞の基礎研究。SSEA-1陽性のOTF9と陰性のSOTF9を同系マウスに静脈内投与し、肝転移の頻度を比較した。細胞集団が臨界数未満では肝腫瘍頻度が低下した。転移性変異体の発生率は動的不均一性モデルと一致し、細胞融合は否定された。
pmid-2900709.summary_en: This study compares the experimental liver metastasis behavior of two mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) lines, OTF9 (SSEA-1-positive) and SOTF9 (SSEA-1-negative), after intravenous injection into syngeneic mice. Liver metastasis frequency rose with cell population size and was reduced below a critical number of about 2 x 10^5 cells. Clones from individual liver metastases showed no difference in metastatic ability, and somatic cell hybridization was ruled out. The authors estimate the rate of generating liver-metastasizing variants at about 7 x 10^-6 per cell per generation.

pmid-2962849.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3とBeWoのI型IGF受容体を解析した研究です。受容体への結合は高親和性で、1細胞あたり約2〜3万部位でした。架橋実験で単量体と二量体が確認され、IGF-Iはアミノ酸取り込みを促進しました。絨毛癌細胞は栄養膜細胞研究のモデルとして有用とされています。
pmid-2962849.summary_en: This study characterizes type I insulin-like growth factor (IGF) receptors on two human choriocarcinoma cell lines, JEG-3 and BeWo. Binding of labeled IGF-I was reversible, saturable and specific, with high affinity and about 20,000 to 30,000 sites per cell. Cross-linking revealed receptor monomer and dimer forms. IGF-I stimulated amino acid uptake, showing the receptors are functional. The authors propose these cells as a model for studying IGF roles in trophoblast physiology and growth regulation.

pmid-2963822.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞由来のcDNAライブラリから、発生段階で変化する糖鎖マーカーを持つ糖タンパク質を同定しました。その遺伝子は免疫グロブリンスーパーファミリーに属します。胎児性癌細胞で顕著に発現しており、未分化な初期胚細胞との類似が示されました。臨床的な腫瘍学研究ではなく分子・発生生物学的研究です。
pmid-2963822.summary_en: The authors used a lambda gt11 library made from murine teratocarcinoma cells to clone a core glycoprotein that carries a developmentally regulated carbohydrate marker. The deduced protein has a leader sequence, nine potential glycosylation sites and a transmembrane region. Its variable-like domain resembles immunoglobulin kappa chain, placing it in the immunoglobulin superfamily. The gene is notably expressed in embryonal carcinoma cells, which resemble undifferentiated early embryonic cells. The study is primarily molecular and developmental rather than clinical.

pmid-2966584.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3ではc-myc転写産物が正常栄養膜より多く、遺伝子が約20コピーに増幅していました。増幅遺伝子のメチル化パターンは正常胎盤と同じでした。RNA合成阻害薬マイトラマイシンはc-mycを選択的に抑制しました。絨毛癌細胞株をモデルとした癌遺伝子の薬理学的制御の研究です。
pmid-2966584.summary_en: This study examines c-myc expression in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. The authors found elevated c-myc transcripts compared with nonmalignant trophoblast at all gestational stages, and gene amplification with about 20 copies. The amplified gene's methylation pattern matched normal placenta. Mithramycin, an RNA synthesis inhibitor, selectively reduced c-myc expression relative to c-Ha-ras. The work suggests selective pharmacologic modulation of an oncogene, using a choriocarcinoma cell line as the model system.

pmid-3045808.summary_ja: 1988年のPNAS論文は、奇形腫由来の脂肪形成細胞株から得られたインスリン非依存性株1246-3Aを解析した。この細胞は、インスリン様の増殖因子（IRF）を分泌し、自身の細胞表面受容体に結合する。抗インスリン抗体は増殖を抑制した。IRFによる自己分泌性増殖刺激が結論とされた。
pmid-3045808.summary_en: This 1988 PNAS study characterized an insulin-independent cell line, 1246-3A, derived from a teratoma-derived adipogenic line. The cells secrete an insulin-related growth factor (IRF) that binds to their own surface receptors. Anti-insulin antibody inhibited proliferation of these cells. The authors conclude that IRF stimulates proliferation in an autocrine manner. The paper focuses on growth factor biology using this teratoma-derived cell model rather than on germ cell tumors clinically.

pmid-3174602.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJAR細胞株において、125I標識トランスフェリンを用いた受容体介在性エンドサイトーシスを検討した。結合は飽和性で、細胞あたり約160万の結合部位を示し、受容体の大部分は細胞内に存在した。リガンドは内在化後約6分間留まり、モネンシンにより放出が阻害された。栄養膜由来細胞の受容体動態を示す研究である。
pmid-3174602.summary_en: This study examined transferrin receptor-mediated endocytosis in the JAR choriocarcinoma cell line using 125I-labeled transferrin. The cells showed saturable binding with about 1.6 x 10^6 sites per cell, and most receptors resided intracellularly. Ligand was internalized, remained for about 6 minutes, and was released intact, a process largely blocked by monensin. Transferrin receptors were also internalized independently of ligand, suggesting receptor-recycling dynamics in trophoblast-derived cells.

pmid-3187895.summary_ja: 左眼窩にゆっくり増大する病変を持つ男性の症例で、CTで側頭窩に交通する大きな類皮嚢腫と診断された。著者らは、乳児期に頬骨と前頭骨の接合部に異所性組織が存在し、縫合の正常な閉鎖を妨げたと考察した。論文の主題は胚細胞腫瘍ではなく、頭蓋顔面の発達異常と画像所見である。CT所見は眼窩類皮嚢腫に特徴的とされる。
pmid-3187895.summary_en: A case report describes a man with a slowly enlarging left orbital lesion, shown on CT to be a large dermoid cyst communicating with the temporal fossa. The authors propose that choristomatous tissue at the zygomaticofrontal junction prevented normal suture closure in infancy. The paper focuses on craniofacial developmental anomaly and imaging features rather than germ cell neoplasia. They state that CT findings are pathognomonic of orbital dermoid cyst.

pmid-3190550.summary_ja: 小児の皮下および眼窩の類皮嚢腫・表皮嚢腫を、上眼瞼の皺襞切開から切除する手術法を報告した論文である。露出の良さ、最小限の剥離、単純な創閉鎖、目立たない瘢痕が利点とされる。24例で良好な結果が得られ合併症はなかった。主題は手術手技であり、胚細胞腫瘍そのものではないため、関連性は境界的である。
pmid-3190550.summary_en: This report describes an upper eyelid crease incision approach for excising subcutaneous and orbital dermoid and epidermoid cysts in children. The authors list advantages including good exposure, minimal dissection, simple closure, and cosmetically hidden scars. They report use in 24 patients with excellent results and no complications. The focus is surgical technique rather than germ cell neoplasia, so topic relevance is borderline.

pmid-3191956.summary_ja: 1988年の研究で、X染色体の状態が異なるマウス胎児性癌細胞クローン間で核内非ヒストンタンパク質を一次元ポリアクリルアミドゲル電気泳動により比較した。不活性X染色体を持つクローンでは約46kDaに追加バンドが見られ、約71kDaのバンドも増強していた。X染色体不活化の生物学が主題であり、臨床的なGCT研究ではない。
pmid-3191956.summary_en: This 1988 study compared nonhistone nuclear proteins across murine embryonal carcinoma cell clones differing in X-chromosome status, using one-dimensional polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis. Clones with an inactive X chromosome showed two extra bands near 46 kDa, and a band near 71 kDa was heavier than in clones with two active X chromosomes or a single X. The work centers on X-inactivation biology, with embryonal carcinoma cells serving as the experimental system rather than as a clinical tumor study. Relevance to human germ cell tumor management is indirect.

pmid-3202874.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢癌由来の細胞株PYS-2で発現するH-2抗原を解析した。フローサイトメトリーでKbおよび/またはDb特異的抗原の低発現が確認された。PYS-2のcDNAライブラリー解析では、H-2クローン10件中8件がKb、2件がDbであった。Qa、Tlaなどの胎児型クラスI cDNAは単離されなかった。臨床ではなく、細胞株のMHCクラスI遺伝子発現を扱う研究である。
pmid-3202874.summary_en: This study examined H-2 histocompatibility antigen expression in the parietal yolk sac carcinoma cell line PYS-2, which was previously reported to synthesize trace amounts of H-2 antigens. Flow cytometry detected low levels of Kb and/or Db-specific antigens. Analysis of H-2 cDNA clones from a PYS-2 library identified eight clones as H-2Kb and two as H-2Db, confirming the immunofluorescence results. Embryonic class I cDNAs such as Qa and Tla were not isolated. The work characterizes MHC class I gene expression in a yolk sac carcinoma cell line rather than clinical tumor biology.

pmid-3237651.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJAr細胞を21日間、多細胞スフェロイドとして培養した。スフェロイドはhCGやエストラジオールなどを分泌し、機能的に活性であった。大きなスフェロイドは付着が悪く、早期分化が示唆された。胎盤の着床研究のための三次元モデルとして提案している。
pmid-3237651.summary_en: This study grew JAr choriocarcinoma cells as multicellular spheroids for up to 21 days. Spheroids secreted hCG, estradiol, and progesterone in proportion to their size, and showed lipid droplets, glycogen, Golgi apparatus, and microvilli, indicating functional activity. Larger spheroids attached poorly and showed delayed outgrowth with more multinucleated cells, suggesting early differentiation. The authors propose this three-dimensional system as a model for studying placental processes such as implantation rather than the disease itself.

pmid-3246522.summary_ja: PCC3胎児性癌細胞を、有糸分裂後の姉妹細胞対のタンパク質量分配を調べるためのモデルとして用いた細胞生物学研究です。姉妹細胞間の質量差は細胞集団の質量のばらつきにはわずかな影響しか与えませんでした。一方、間期の長さのばらつきには影響を与えると推定されています。腫瘍の診断や治療を扱うものではありません。
pmid-3246522.summary_en: This cell biology study uses PCC3 embryonal carcinoma cells as a model to evaluate protein mass distribution between sister cell pairs after mitosis. Using microspectrophotometry after Feulgen-Naphthol Yellow staining, the authors found that postmitotic mass differences minimally affect population mass variability but influence interphase duration variation. No correlation was found between sister mass difference and mother cell size. The paper uses embryonal carcinoma cells as a tool rather than studying tumor disease.

pmid-3334875.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株F9の糖鎖(ラクトサミノグリカン)を解析し、分化誘導に伴うH1、H3型の発現変化を示した生化学研究である。臨床の腫瘍ではなく、初期分化のモデル系としてF9細胞が用いられている。
pmid-3334875.summary_en: This biochemistry study analyzes high-molecular-weight lactosaminoglycans from the mouse embryonal carcinoma line F9. It shows that these glycopeptides fall into two molecular classes, H1 and H3, and that retinoic acid-induced differentiation shifts their expression. The authors also report changes in lower-molecular-weight species and small structural modifications. The work uses F9 cells as a model of early differentiation rather than studying tumors in patients.

pmid-3338078.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株を用いて、リシンおよび絨毛癌細胞を標的とする免疫毒素の作用速度を数理モデルで解析。タンパク質合成阻害の遅延を説明するには2段階の処理過程が必要であった。リシンの細胞質への取り込みは遅く、リボソームの酵素的不活性化は非常に速いと結論づけている。
pmid-3338078.summary_en: This study modeled protein synthesis inhibition in the choriocarcinoma-derived BeWo cell line after treatment with ricin or a ricin A-chain immunotoxin that targets choriocarcinoma cells. Kinetic data were best explained by two rate-limiting processing steps before ribosomal inactivation. The authors conclude that cytoplasmic internalization of ricin is slow, compensated by very fast enzymatic inactivation of ribosomes, and that endocytosis may not be required for the few ricin A-chain molecules that enter the cytoplasm.

pmid-3340734.summary_ja: 胎生期奇形癌（embryonal carcinoma）由来のヒト細胞株P3を、チャイニーズハムスター肺由来のV79細胞と比較した放射線生物学研究です。ガンマ線、X線、中性子線に対する致死効果はP3細胞の方が高感受性でしたが、DNA損傷は両細胞株で同程度でした。両細胞とも分割照射や高張塩処理後の回復は効率的でした。前臨床研究であり、患者は対象としていません。
pmid-3340734.summary_en: This radiobiology study characterizes human epithelial P3 cells, derived from an embryonic teratocarcinoma, in comparison with Chinese hamster V79 cells after gamma, X-ray and fission-spectrum neutron irradiation. P3 cells were about twice as sensitive as V79 cells to the lethal effects of photons and were more sensitive to neutrons, while DNA damage was similar in both lines. Both cell types recovered efficiently from split-dose and hypertonic salt treatments. The work is preclinical and does not address patients.

pmid-3355557.summary_ja: 分化誘導された胎児性癌細胞とマウス胎仔の双方で発現が変化する新規遺伝子MK1のcDNAをクローニングし、配列を決定した。MK1は塩基性アミノ酸に富む小型ポリペプチドをコードすると予測された。胎児性癌細胞は分化モデルとして用いられており、臨床的な生殖細胞腫瘍を扱う研究ではない。
pmid-3355557.summary_en: The authors isolated MK1, a cDNA encoding a small basic polypeptide, by differential hybridization. MK1 RNA increased early during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells and then declined. In mouse embryos, MK1 RNA was abundant at mid-gestation (days 8 to 11). The cDNA was sequenced and predicted to encode a 9,971 Da polypeptide. The study uses embryonal carcinoma cells as a differentiation model for developmental biology, and does not address germ cell tumors as clinical disease.

pmid-3371375.summary_ja: 絨毛癌に反応する放射性標識モノクローナル抗体(5F9.3)を、BEWO絨毛癌のヌードマウス異種移植片で評価した研究である。皮下投与は静脈内投与より腫瘍対非腫瘍比が高く、画像化も早期に可能だった。皮下投与はリンパ管を介した取り込みを利用し、リンパ節転移の画像診断への応用が示唆された。
pmid-3371375.summary_en: This study evaluated radiolabeled anti-choriocarcinoma monoclonal antibody (5F9.3) localization in nude mouse xenografts of BEWO choriocarcinoma, comparing subcutaneous and intravenous delivery. Subcutaneous injection, which uses intralymphatic uptake, gave higher tumor-to-nontumor ratios and earlier gamma-scan imaging than intravenous injection, even for tumors larger than normal nodes. Control experiments with a nonspecific antibody and BALB/c mice confirmed antibody specificity. The authors suggest subcutaneous delivery could improve imaging of nodal metastases of human tumors.

pmid-3404997.summary_ja: 本研究は胎児性癌細胞株PCC3/N1の未分化状態における細胞周期の挙動を検討したものである。細胞周期時間の二峰性様変動がG1期に局在し、細胞サイズと世代時間が逆相関することを示した。胚細胞腫瘍由来のモデルを用いた細胞生物学研究であり、臨床的な腫瘍の検討ではない。
pmid-3404997.summary_en: This study examines the cell cycle behavior of the embryonal carcinoma line PCC3/N1 in its undifferentiated state. The authors previously reported bimodal-like intraclonal variation in cell cycle time, localized to G1. Here they find an inverse relation between cell size and generation time and propose a random intraclonal shift between two G1-differing cell-growth cycles. Growth-rate heterogeneity required three cell cycles to disperse, suggesting decreased inheritance across sister and cousin cell pairs. The work is cell biology using a germ cell tumor-derived model rather than a clinical tumor study.

pmid-2432080.summary_ja: 遊離β-hCGに特異的なRIAを開発し、正常妊娠と栄養膜疾患患者で測定した研究です。正常妊娠では検出されず、多くの患者では検出されました。遊離β-hCG/hCG比は胞状奇胎で最も低く絨毛癌で最も高く、栄養膜細胞の分化度を反映すると考えられました。
pmid-2432080.summary_en: The authors developed a specific RIA for free beta-hCG using monoclonal antibody 1D12 and applied it to 38 normal pregnant women and 72 untreated trophoblastic disease patients. Free beta-hCG was undetectable in normal pregnancy but measurable in most patients. The free beta-hCG to hCG ratio was lowest in hydatidiform mole and highest in choriocarcinoma, suggesting the ratio reflects trophoblastic differentiation. Serial measurements in seven patients showed stable ratios over time.

pmid-2432784.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の広範な治療後にβ-hCGが上昇した患者の肺再発病変を、131I標識抗体(5F9.3)シンチグラフィーで局在化した症例報告です。病変の抗体集積は正常肺の約10倍で、外科的切除に役立ちました。潜在性病変の検出法として提案されています。
pmid-2432784.summary_en: A patient with rising serum beta-hCG after extensive therapy for gestational choriocarcinoma had a pulmonary recurrence that was not clearly seen on conventional imaging. Iodine-131-labeled monoclonal antibody (5F9.3) scintigraphy localized the lesion, which showed roughly tenfold higher antibody uptake than normal lung. The scan guided surgical resection of the tumor focus. The authors propose this approach for detecting occult gestational choriocarcinoma lesions in patients with rising beta-hCG.

pmid-2432785.summary_ja: 妊娠4〜11週のヒト卵黄嚢と卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍を比較した形態学的研究です。両者は小管構造やSchiller-Duval小体様の乳頭状内胚葉を示し、超微細構造も類似していました。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性で、卵黄嚢腫瘍は妊娠4〜7週の内胚葉に相当すると結論されました。
pmid-2432785.summary_en: The authors compared human yolk sacs from 4- to 11-week pregnancies with yolk sac tumors of the ovary. Both showed tubular structures, papillary endoderm resembling Schiller-Duval bodies, and similar ultrastructure. Both were AFP-positive, although fetal yolk sac AFP expression ceased around week seven. The authors conclude that yolk sac tumor resembles the endoderm of 4- to 7-week embryos. The study is morphologic and ultrastructural.

pmid-2433126.summary_ja: モノクローナル免疫放射定量法で妊娠経過と絨毛癌のhCG、αhCG、βhCGを測定した研究です。絨毛癌では血清β-hCGが妊娠時最大値の3〜100倍で、β-hCG/hCG比も極めて高値でした。非栄養膜性腫瘍178例では異所性産生は稀で、マーカーとしての有用性は低いと結論されました。
pmid-2433126.summary_en: The authors developed monoclonal immunoradiometric assays for hCG, alpha-hCG, and beta-hCG and used them to study early pregnancy, normal gestation, and choriocarcinoma. Choriocarcinoma showed serum beta-hCG 3 to 100 times higher than pregnancy maxima and exceptionally high beta-hCG to hCG ratios. In 178 patients with nontrophoblastic tumors, ectopic subunit production was rare and hCG was not detected. The authors conclude these markers are not useful for nontrophoblastic tumors.

pmid-2433543.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の絨毛癌の症例を報告した論文です。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍の多くは精巣からの転移であり、原発例は極めて稀です。腫瘍は絨毛癌の組織像を示し、免疫組織化学でβ-hCG陽性でした。患者は手術と化学療法の後、2年経過時点で無症状で生存しています。文献的考察も含まれます。
pmid-2433543.summary_en: This case report describes primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma, an extremely rare entity, since most mediastinal germ cell tumors represent testicular metastases. The tumor showed choriocarcinoma histology and stained positively for beta-hCG by immunoperoxidase. The patient received surgery and chemotherapy and was alive and asymptomatic two years after treatment. The paper also includes a review of the literature.

pmid-2433834.summary_ja: 免疫組織化学と電子顕微鏡により、精巣セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍におけるサイトケラチン、ビメンチン、デスモソームを検討した。大部分のセミノーマ細胞はサイトケラチンフィラメントを欠くがデスモソームを有し、主にビメンチンフィラメントと関連していた。対照的に、悪性奇形腫の癌細胞ではサイトケラチン束とデスモソームが認められ、そのパターンは組織の成熟度により異なった。一部のセミノーマにはサイトケラチン陽性細胞が含まれ、多分化能起源と胎児性癌との移行型の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2433834.summary_en: This immunohistochemical and electron microscopic study examined cytokeratin, vimentin, and desmosomes in testicular seminomas and non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Most seminoma cells lacked cytokeratin filaments but contained desmosomes, mainly associated with vimentin filaments. In contrast, carcinoma cells in malignant teratomas showed cytokeratin bundles and desmosomes, with patterns varying by tissue maturation. Some seminomas contained cytokeratin-positive cells, suggesting a multipotential origin and possible transitional forms with embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-2433940.summary_ja: 女性化乳房、乳汁漏出、β-hCG高値で受診した24歳男性の症例報告です。広範な検索でも原発巣を特定できませんでした。右精巣摘除術では精巣は正常でしたが、リンパ節に胎児性癌と絨毛癌の成分が認められました。化学療法によりβ-hCGは正常化し、患者は治癒したとみられています。
pmid-2433940.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with gynecomastia, galactorrhea, and elevated beta-hCG. Extensive workup, including CT and selective testicular vein catheterization, did not identify the source. Right orchiectomy showed a normal testis, but a lymph node biopsy contained embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma elements. Chemotherapy normalized beta-hCG levels, and the patient appeared cured. The authors emphasize the need for an extensive malignancy search and consideration of orchiectomy in such cases.

pmid-2434627.summary_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍患者41例を対象に、EP療法とVAB-6療法を交互に6か月行った第II相試験です。縦隔・後腹膜腫瘍の完全寛解率は57%、予後不良の精巣がんは52%でした。非セミノーマ性腫瘍の成績はVAB-6単独と同等でしたが、毒性は強く出ました。著者らはこの交互療法を推奨せず、臨床試験実施施設への紹介を勧めています。
pmid-2434627.summary_en: This phase II trial tested six months of alternating etoposide plus cisplatin (EP) and VAB-6 in 41 evaluable patients with poor-risk germ cell tumors. Complete remission rates were 57% for mediastinal and retroperitoneal tumors and 52% for poor-risk testicular cancer. Outcomes for nonseminomatous tumors matched those of VAB-6 alone, but toxicity was greater. The authors did not recommend this schedule and advised referral of such patients to centers conducting prospective trials.

pmid-2437131.summary_ja: P19胎児性癌細胞の凝集体をDMSOで処理し、分化を観察した基礎研究。小型凝集体は原始内胚葉様の上皮へ、大型凝集体では壊死領域近傍に心筋様の筋細胞が出現した。筋分化には上皮被覆に加え、壊死への近接などの別の因子が必要と考察している。凝集体サイズと微小環境が胎児性癌の分化に影響することを示す。
pmid-2437131.summary_en: P19 embryonal carcinoma cells were aggregated and exposed to DMSO to examine their differentiation. Small aggregates mainly formed a primitive extraembryonic endoderm-like epithelium, identified by ultrastructure and cytokeratin expression. Cardiac-like muscle cells appeared only in large aggregates, typically near necrotic regions, after 5 to 6 days. The authors propose that muscle differentiation requires both a DMSO-induced epithelial coat and a second factor, possibly proximity to necrosis. The findings show how aggregate size and microenvironment shape embryonal carcinoma differentiation.

pmid-2437336.summary_ja: 1971〜1983年に小児病院で治療された、2歳未満の病期I精巣卵黄嚢癌11例の後方視的検討。全例に根治的鼠径精巣摘除術を施行した。術後AFPが正常で局所限局の症例は、追加治療の利益が乏しかった。リンパ節浸潤、広範な転移、再発例は化学療法や放射線療法で治療された。
pmid-2437336.summary_en: This report reviews 11 children under two years old with stage I yolk sac carcinoma of the testis, treated at Children's Hospital of Philadelphia from 1971 to 1983. All underwent radical inguinal orchiectomy, and four also had retroperitoneal node dissection, with no tumor found in the nodes. Patients with normal postoperative AFP levels and localized disease did not benefit from additional surgery, irradiation, or chemotherapy. Patients with nodal involvement, widespread metastasis, or recurrence responded to chemotherapy, sometimes with radiation therapy.

pmid-2437682.summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法と治療方針をまとめた総説。シスプラチン併用化学療法と補助的な外科的処置で約70〜80%が治癒する。血清腫瘍マーカーは診断、予後判定、治療モニタリングに用いられる。治療前マーカー、病変範囲、組織型、原発部位で予後良好群と不良群に分類し、それぞれに応じた治療開発の必要性を論じる。
pmid-2437682.summary_en: This review summarizes management of germ cell tumors. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy combined with adjunctive surgery cures roughly 70 to 80 percent of patients with advanced disease. Serum tumor markers guide diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment monitoring. Patients are classified as good risk or poor risk using pretreatment markers, disease extent, histology, and primary site. Good-risk patients are being studied in trials of less toxic regimens, while poor-risk patients need innovative therapy. Progress will depend on randomized trials and new drug discovery.

pmid-2437779.summary_ja: 進行精巣がん14例(病期II 2例、病期III 12例)にシスプラチン(CDDP)・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン療法を実施した報告。完全奏効4例、部分奏効6例で、奏効率は71.4%。完全奏効例の50%が再発した。腫瘤の大きい転移では予後不良で、高負荷転移にはエトポシドによる早期導入療法が必要とされる。
pmid-2437779.summary_en: This report describes 14 patients with advanced testicular cancer, 2 with stage II and 12 with stage III, treated with CDDP, vinblastine, and bleomycin. Complete response occurred in 4 (28.6%) and partial response in 6 (42.9%), for an overall response rate of 71.4%. Two of the complete responders relapsed. The authors conclude the regimen has some efficacy, but prognosis is poor with bulky metastasis. Early induction with etoposide is needed in cases of high-volume metastatic disease.

pmid-2438223.summary_ja: 1977〜1986年にPOMB/ACE化学療法を完了した未分化胚細胞腫瘍の男性170例の報告。1979年以降はPOMBを3コース以上投与し、初診時のhCGやAFPの高値が予後不良因子でなくなった。治療完了139例の全生存期間(全生存率)は89%、放射線療法歴のない例では92%だった。
pmid-2438223.summary_en: This report describes 170 male patients with anaplastic germ cell tumors of the testis or other sites who were treated with POMB/ACE chemotherapy from 1977 to 1986. After 1979, patients received at least three POMB courses, which removed the adverse prognostic effect of high initial hCG and AFP. Among 139 who completed therapy, overall survival was 89%, and 92% in patients without prior radiotherapy. Stage at presentation and metastatic volume were not major adverse factors with this regimen.

pmid-2438230.summary_ja: 1969〜1984年に精巣セミノーマの放射線療法を受けた男性を対象とした、子の発達に関する調査。回答33例で、放射線照射の前後に生まれた子を比較した。放射線療法後に生まれた子に、情緒、身体、発達上の有害な影響は認められなかった。精巣セミノーマ長期生存者の生殖転帰への懸念に答える研究である。
pmid-2438230.summary_en: Researchers at NYU Medical Center surveyed men treated with radiotherapy for testicular seminoma between 1969 and 1984 about the development of their children. Of 33 respondents, the survey covered offspring conceived before and after radiation treatment. The authors found no detrimental emotional, physical, or developmental effects in offspring fathered after radiation therapy for seminoma. The study addresses concerns about reproductive outcomes in long-term survivors of testicular seminoma.

pmid-2438234.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍由来のクローン株2102Ep・TERA-2を用い、ヒト胎児性癌細胞の共通特性を総説した。SSEA-3/4、TRA-1-60/81などの表面抗原とサイトケラチンの発現が特徴。SSEA-3/4陰性の変異株もあり、糖脂質のコア構造の変化が分化の指標と考えられる。インターフェロンはクラスI MHC抗原の発現を誘導するが、増殖や分化には影響しなかった。
pmid-2438234.summary_en: This paper reviews properties of human embryonal carcinoma cells, using the clonal lines 2102Ep and TERA-2 derived from human germ cell tumours. Common features include expression of surface antigens SSEA-3, SSEA-4, TRA-1-60, and TRA-1-81, and cytokeratin. Some variants lack SSEA-3 and -4 yet still produce the relevant glycolipids, suggesting that a switch in core structure synthesis marks differentiation. Interferon induces class I MHC antigen expression without altering growth, differentiation, or viral resistance.

pmid-2438389.summary_ja: 1987年の報告。病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍50例に初回化学療法を施行し、96%が完全奏効を得た。化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)は22%で必要で、胎児性癌では8%、奇形腫成分を有する例では36%だった。組織型と残存腫瘍の大きさに基づく個別化治療を提案している。
pmid-2438389.summary_en: This 1987 study reports 50 patients with clinical stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis treated with primary chemotherapy, with postchemotherapy RPLND in selected cases. Complete response was achieved in 96%, with mean disease-free survival of 132 weeks. Postchemotherapy RPLND was needed in 22%, less often for embryonal carcinoma (8%) than for teratomatous primaries (36%). The authors propose individualized therapy by histology and residual tumor volume: chemotherapy alone for embryonal carcinoma, RPLND for teratomatous elements, and chemotherapy plus surgery for larger volumes.

pmid-2438431.summary_ja: 1987年の泌尿器科報告。進行セミノーマの導入化学療法後に残る腫瘤を扱う。後腹膜線維化は切除不能で病理学的に陰性であることが多い一方、限局性腫瘤は切除可能だが生存セミノーマを含むことが多く、追加治療の適応となる。化学療法後の残存病変に対する治療方針の考え方の変化を示す。
pmid-2438431.summary_en: This short 1987 urology paper addresses residual masses after induction chemotherapy for advanced seminoma. Radiographic and clinical findings can reflect either retroperitoneal fibrosis or a discrete mass. Fibrotic residue is unresectable and usually pathologically negative, while discrete masses are resectable but often contain viable seminoma, indicating further therapy. The authors update management concepts for post-chemotherapy residual disease.

pmid-2438437.summary_ja: 31歳男性の原発性後腹膜腫瘍の1例。胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織像を併せ持っていた。当初は汎腹膜炎と診断され、開腹術で腹部大動脈に付着する大きな腫瘍が見つかった。網状構造の腫瘍細胞はαフェトプロテイン陽性であった。精巣は触診と超音波検査で異常がなく、精巣外の原発と判断された。
pmid-2438437.summary_en: A case report of a 31-year-old man with a primary retroperitoneal tumor showing combined embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor histology. He presented with severe abdominal pain, initially diagnosed as panperitonitis, and a large tumor adherent to the abdominal aorta with hemorrhage and necrosis was found at laparotomy. Histology showed solid immature large cells with reticular, tubular and glomeruloid patterns, and immunohistochemistry showed alpha-fetoprotein positivity in the reticular component. Testes were normal on examination and ultrasound.

pmid-2439013.summary_ja: 精巣がんの進行例52例にPVB療法(シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン)を施行した1987年の報告。完全寛解が得られなかった24例中18例に後腹膜リンパ節郭清などのサルベージ手術を行った。残存組織は線維化40%、奇形腫28%、活動性癌32%であった。線維化と奇形腫の症例の多くは無病生存を続けたが、活動性癌では8例中3例のみであった。全体の67.3%が無病生存した。
pmid-2439013.summary_en: A Japanese series of 52 patients with advanced testicular cancer treated with PVB chemotherapy (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin). Of 24 without complete remission, 18 underwent salvage resection, including retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, lung, cervical and brain lesions. Residual histology was fibrosis in 40%, teratoma in 28%, and active cancer in 32%. Patients with fibrous tissue or teratoma remained disease-free, whereas only three of eight with active cancer were alive without disease. Overall, 67.3% were alive without evidence of disease.

pmid-2439163.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍18例の組織標本で、AFPとhCGの局在を血清値と比較した1987年の報告。組織染色の陽性所見は血清腫瘍マーカーの上昇と密接に相関した。AFPとhCGは異なる細胞に局在し、同一細胞での共染色はなかった。血清値が正常でも組織で陽性を示す例があり、免疫細胞化学は血清測定より感度が高いと結論された。
pmid-2439163.summary_en: This 1987 study compares tissue localization of AFP and hCG with serum levels in 20 specimens from 18 patients with nonseminomatous testicular tumors. Immunoperoxidase staining correlated closely with elevated serum markers. AFP and hCG were localized to different cells, with no cell staining for both. Some patients with normal serum markers still showed tumor marker positivity in tissue, leading the authors to conclude that immunocytochemistry is more sensitive than serum measurement.

pmid-2439404.summary_ja: 分化段階の異なるヒト胚細胞腫瘍細胞株4種を用い、インターフェロン(IFN)への感受性を検討した1987年の基礎研究。胎児性癌株はIFNによる抗ウイルス作用や2-5Aシンテターゼ誘導が認められなかった。一方、絨毛癌株と卵黄嚢腫瘍株は抗ウイルス作用に感受性を示した。絨毛癌株のみが抗増殖効果も示した。IFNの産生と感受性は細胞の分化度に依存すると結論づけられた。
pmid-2439404.summary_en: Four human germ cell tumor cell lines representing different differentiation stages (two embryonal carcinomas, one choriocarcinoma, one yolk sac tumor) were tested for responses to human interferons in vitro. Poly I:C induced IFN production in choriocarcinoma and yolk sac lines but not in embryonal carcinoma lines. Embryonal carcinoma lines were resistant to antiviral effects and 2-5A synthetase induction, while the choriocarcinoma and yolk sac lines responded. Only the choriocarcinoma line showed antiproliferative response, suggesting IFN sensitivity tracks differentiation.

pmid-2439660.summary_ja: 進行転移性セミノーマ55例の治療成績を報告した1987年の論文。未治療39例中36例が完全奏効を得た。初回放射線療法後に再発した15例にもシスプラチン併用化学療法が施行され、13例が完全奏効した。重篤な合併症で4例が死亡した。病期の軽い症例では、毒性の少ない化学療法レジメンの検討を提唱している。
pmid-2439660.summary_en: A 1987 series of 55 patients with advanced metastatic seminoma treated with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy with or without surgery or radiotherapy. Of 39 untreated patients, 36 achieved complete response and 33 were alive without evidence of disease at median 36 months. Fifteen patients with relapse after radiotherapy also responded. Efficacy was high, but severe toxicities including septicemia and marrow aplasia caused four deaths. The authors suggest that less toxic regimens be explored for less advanced disease.

pmid-2439890.summary_ja: 1987年の本報告は、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍12例の臨床経験と文献レビューに基づき、診断と治療をまとめたものである。セミノーマは手術と放射線療法で治療でき、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍にはシスプラチンを含む化学療法が第一選択とされる。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は診断と効果判定に有用である。縦隔病変の生存期間中央値は14カ月で、精巣例より短かった。
pmid-2439890.summary_en: This 1987 Japanese report reviews 12 patients with mediastinal germ cell tumors and the literature. Seminomas are radiosensitive and can be treated with surgery and radiation, while non-seminomatous germ cell tumors require cisplatin-based chemotherapy. AFP and hCG are recommended for diagnosis and for monitoring response, with tissue diagnosis obtained by mediastinoscopy or anterior mediastinotomy. Median survival with mediastinal involvement was 14 months, lower than in testicular disease.

pmid-2440095.summary_ja: 1987年の本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍30例を対象に、ケラチン、上皮糖蛋白、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼなどに対する単クローン抗体パネルで免疫染色を行った。奇形腫や混合型腫瘍のケラチン発現は正常上皮に類似していた。ケラチン19抗体などは胎児性癌とセミノーマの鑑別に有用であった。胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼは大多数の症例で陽性であり、胚細胞腫瘍のマーカーとして有用である。
pmid-2440095.summary_en: This 1987 study used a panel of monoclonal antibodies to keratins, epithelial glycoproteins, placental alkaline phosphatase, and collagen IV to examine 30 human testicular germ cell tumors. Keratin expression resembled normal epithelium in teratomas and mixed tumors. Keratin 19 antibodies and the RICEO-MFG-06.3 antibody helped distinguish embryonal carcinoma from seminoma. Placental alkaline phosphatase was positive in nearly all tumors, supporting its use as a germ cell tumor marker.

pmid-2440118.summary_ja: 1987年の南アフリカからの症例報告で、鼠径部精巣に生じた転移のない局所進行セミノーマの33歳男性を対象とする。シスプラチンを含む多剤併用化学療法の後、残存腫瘤を切除したが生存腫瘍は認められなかった。31カ月経過時点で再発の所見はない。局所進行精巣セミノーマに対する化学療法の有効性を示す。
pmid-2440118.summary_en: This 1987 South African case report describes a 33-year-old man with a locally advanced seminoma arising in an inguinal testis without metastases. He received cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy, followed by resection of the residual mass, which contained no viable tumor. At 31 months of follow-up there was no evidence of disease. The report illustrates that chemotherapy can be effective for locally advanced testicular seminoma.

pmid-2440225.summary_ja: 1987年の本症例報告は、純粋卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ7例のうち1例で術前に血清hCGとAFPが軽度上昇していた事例を検討した。摘出後にいずれも正常範囲に戻った。免疫染色により、hCGは多核巨細胞と紡錘形細胞、AFPは円形細胞に局在した。腫瘍細胞自体が腫瘍マーカーを産生することが示唆された。
pmid-2440225.summary_en: This 1987 case report examined one of seven patients with pure ovarian dysgerminoma who had mildly elevated serum hCG and AFP before surgery. Both markers normalized after tumor removal. Immunohistochemistry localized hCG to multinucleated giant cells and spindle-shaped cells, and AFP to round cells. The findings suggest that the tumor cells themselves produce these markers. The study provides insight into the marker-producing components of dysgerminoma.

pmid-2440552.summary_ja: 1987年の研究は、精巣がん105例で血清神経特異的エノラーゼ(NSE)を評価し、AFPやhCGと比較した。転移性セミノーマの73%でNSEが上昇し、化学療法後に正常化した。非セミノーマでは上昇例は15%にすぎなかった。セミノーマの治療モニタリングにNSEが有用と考えられる。
pmid-2440552.summary_en: This 1987 study evaluated serum neuron-specific enolase (NSE) in 105 patients with testicular cancer, compared with AFP and hCG. NSE was elevated in 73% of patients with metastatic seminoma and normalized after chemotherapy. Only 15% of patients with metastatic nonseminomatous tumors had elevated NSE, so AFP and hCG remained more informative for them. NSE was normal in 53 of 54 patients after orchiectomy without metastatic disease. The authors propose NSE as a marker for monitoring metastatic seminoma.

pmid-2441844.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌の根治的切除後に、進行性の肺門・縦隔リンパ節腫大と多発肺結節を呈した症例報告である。縦隔リンパ節生検で肉芽腫が見られ結節性サルコイドーシスが疑われたが、肺結節の穿刺吸引で精巣がんの転移と判明した。類肉腫反応は精巣がん切除後にも起こるが、併存する肺結節は転移除外のため生検すべきだと著者らは述べている。
pmid-2441844.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with progressive hilar and mediastinal lymphadenopathy and multiple pulmonary nodules after apparently curative resection of testicular embryonal cell cancer. Mediastinal node biopsy showed granulomas, suggesting nodular sarcoidosis. However, needle aspiration of the lung nodules revealed metastatic testicular cancer. The authors emphasise that sarcoid-like reactions can follow resection, but coexisting pulmonary nodules should be biopsied to exclude metastases.

pmid-2441845.summary_ja: 14か月の女児に発生した心膜内卵黄嚢腫瘍の初めての報告例である。収縮期雑音、心拡大、心不全症状で発症し、手術で心膜内に巨大で脆い腫瘤を認めた。初回切除、化学療法、13か月後の再切除を行ったが、診断から24か月後に死亡した。腫瘍の増大は血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇と関連していた。
pmid-2441845.summary_en: This report describes the first known case of an intrapericardial yolk sac tumour, in a 14-month-old girl who presented with a systolic murmur, cardiomegaly and cardiac failure. Surgery revealed a large, friable intrapericardial mass without extrapericardial spread, confirmed as yolk sac tumour histologically and immunohistochemically. After resection, chemotherapy and a second resection 13 months later, the patient died 24 months after diagnosis. Tumour enlargement was associated with elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein.

pmid-2442105.summary_ja: ヒト精巣奇形腫から6株の細胞株を樹立し、3種類の細胞型に分類した。GCT27、35、48は胎児性癌で、サイトケラチンや表面抗原SSEA3/4を発現した。GCT27、35はヌードマウスでαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性腫瘍を形成した。GCT72は臓側内胚葉様の性質を示し卵黄嚢腫瘍を形成した。GCT44、46は壁側内胚葉様で、卵黄嚢癌を形成した。
pmid-2442105.summary_en: The authors established six cell lines from human testicular teratomas, representing three cell types. GCT27, GCT35 and GCT48 were embryonal carcinoma lines expressing cytokeratin and stage-specific embryonic antigens; GCT27 and GCT35 formed AFP- and hCG-positive tumours in nude mice. GCT72 showed visceral endoderm-like properties and produced solid yolk sac tumours with high AFP secretion. GCT44 and GCT46 resembled parietal endoderm and formed yolk sac carcinomas. The findings suggest testicular teratoma epithelial cells may be nullipotent, pluripotent or committed to extraembryonic endoderm.

pmid-2442317.summary_ja: 1978〜1984年に南東部がん研究グループの2つの連続したプロトコルで治療された、精巣・性腺外の進行性セミノーマ62例の解析である。全例が進行性疾患の患者で、全体の68%が完全寛解に達し、37例が無病生存していた。病変の広がりと既往の放射線療法が有意な予後因子であった。
pmid-2442317.summary_en: This cooperative-group analysis reviewed 62 patients with advanced seminoma of testicular or extragonadal origin treated on two consecutive SECSG protocols between 1978 and 1984, all with progressive disease. Regimens were PVB with or without doxorubicin, or PVB versus cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin. Overall, 68% achieved complete remission and 37 patients were alive and disease-free. Extent of disease and prior radiotherapy were significant prognostic factors. The study confirms chemosensitivity of metastatic seminoma in a cooperative-group setting.

pmid-2442421.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対しブレオマイシン、シスプラチン、ビンブラスチンの併用化学療法を受けた患者で、感染症状を伴わず多発性の空洞性肺結節が出現した。開胸肺生検で悪性腫瘍や感染のない広範な肉芽腫が認められた。著者らは、この所見をブレオマイシンによる肺毒性の範囲に加えるべきだと報告している。
pmid-2442421.summary_en: A patient with metastatic testicular cancer developed multiple cavitary lung nodules without infectious symptoms after combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, cisplatin and vinblastine. Open lung biopsy showed extensive granulomas without malignancy or infection. The authors propose that cavitary nodules with granuloma formation should be added to the spectrum of bleomycin pulmonary toxicity.

pmid-2442873.summary_ja: 絨毛癌成分を伴う進行セミノーマの患者で、化学療法後もβ-hCGが高値で、CTで残存腫瘤を認めた。肝楔状切除と後腹膜リンパ節郭清では壊死組織のみが得られ、それにβ-hCGが検出された。術後に血清β-hCGは検出限界以下となり、3年間再発なく経過した。壊死腫瘍の貪食によって閉じ込められていたβ-hCGが放出され、偽陽性の腫瘍マーカーとなったと考察されている。
pmid-2442873.summary_en: A patient with advanced seminoma containing choriocarcinoma had persistently elevated serum beta-hCG and residual masses on CT after chemotherapy. Wedge liver resection and retroperitoneal node dissection yielded only necrotic tissue, which was positive for beta-hCG on assay and immunostaining. Serum beta-hCG fell to undetectable levels after surgery, and the patient remained disease-free for three years. The authors suggest that phagocytosis of necrotic tumour released entrapped beta-hCG, producing a false positive tumour marker.

pmid-2443003.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍20例とセミノーマ21例で、鑑別に有用な免疫組織化学マーカーを比較した。サイトケラチンは全卵黄嚢腫瘍で陽性だったが、セミノーマの43%でも陽性であった。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は卵黄嚢腫瘍の55%で陽性、セミノーマでは全例陰性であり特異性が高かった。α1-アンチトリプシンは感度・特異度ともに不十分であった。鑑別には光学顕微鏡所見の評価が依然として最も重要である。
pmid-2443003.summary_en: The authors compared immunohistochemical markers for distinguishing yolk sac tumour from seminoma in 20 yolk sac tumours and 21 seminomas. Cytokeratin was positive in all yolk sac tumours but also in 43% of seminomas, although staining was typically more diffuse and intense in yolk sac tumour. AFP stained 55% of yolk sac tumours but no seminomas, making it specific. Alpha-1-antitrypsin showed poor sensitivity and specificity. Light microscopic pattern interpretation remains paramount in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-2443027.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍516例の検討で、肝組織は9.3%に認められた。頻度は後腹膜および仙尾部の腫瘍、卵黄嚢腫瘍、混合型胚細胞腫瘍で高く、多くは乳児期に見られた。成熟奇形腫や未熟奇形腫(Grade 1)の肝組織は成人肝に類似し、混合型腫瘍の肝組織は胎児肝に類似していた。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分に接する肝組織は肝細胞癌様の所見を示した。
pmid-2443027.summary_en: This study of 516 germ cell tumours found hepatic tissue in 9.3%, most often in retroperitoneal and sacrococcygeal tumours and in yolk sac and mixed germ cell tumours, mainly in infancy. Hepatic tissue in mature or immature grade 1 teratomas resembled adult liver, whereas tissue in mixed tumours resembled fetal liver. Immunohistochemistry showed alpha-1-antitrypsin, albumin and complement positivity, with AFP in some fetal-type cases. Tissue adjacent to yolk sac elements showed hepatocellular carcinoma-like features.

pmid-2443070.summary_ja: 1987年の研究で、ヒト胎児性腫瘍と妊娠初期の正常胎児組織におけるHMG-CoA還元酵素およびLDL受容体遺伝子の発現を比較した。すべての発生期腫瘍でHMG-CoA還元酵素RNAが高値を示したが、3種の小型転写産物の増加は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のみで認められた。LDL受容体転写産物の増加は、胎児性癌の1例にのみ見られた。
pmid-2443070.summary_en: This 1987 study compared expression of the HMG-CoA reductase and LDL-receptor genes in primary human embryonic tumours and normal first-trimester foetal tissues. All developmental tumours showed high HMG-CoA reductase RNA, but only non-seminomatous germ cell tumours contained increased levels of three smaller transcripts. Among these tumours, only one embryonal carcinoma showed elevated LDL-receptor transcript, of the expected 5.3 kB size. The findings suggest qualitative differences in cholesterol-regulatory gene transcripts between embryonal tumour types.

pmid-2443231.summary_ja: 精巣の病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に補助化学療法を行ったが失敗した2例を報告した。両例とも初回外科的切除は完全であった。1例は救援化学療法後も無病を維持したが、もう1例は集中治療にもかかわらず進行性疾患で死亡した。著者らは補助療法を研究的な場に限定し、厳密なフォローアップが必要と結論づけている。
pmid-2443231.summary_en: This 1987 report describes two patients who failed adjuvant chemotherapy after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis. Both had complete initial surgical resection and received two cycles of cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin at appropriate doses. One patient remained disease-free after salvage chemotherapy with cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin, while the other died of progressive disease despite intensive cisplatin and etoposide treatment. The authors conclude adjuvant therapy should be restricted to investigative settings with close follow-up.

pmid-2443254.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌由来細胞株を用い、モノクローナル抗体TEC-02が認識するエピトープを解析した。TEC-2抗原は壁側内胚葉細胞PYS-2と胎児性癌細胞F9の一部に検出され、レチノイン酸による分化誘導中に一過性に増加した。TEC-2は高分子量の多分散性糖複合体で、糖鎖がエピトープ本体であることが示された。胎児性癌細胞において発生依存的に制御される糖鎖エピトープである。
pmid-2443254.summary_en: This study characterised the TEC-02 monoclonal antibody epitope in mouse teratocarcinoma-derived cells. TEC-2 antigens were detected in parietal endoderm PYS-2 cells and a fraction of embryonal carcinoma F9 cells, and their expression transiently rose during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Biochemically, TEC-2 is a polydisperse high-molecular-weight glycoconjugate, and immunostaining indicated a GalNAc beta1-4Gal beta1-4R sequence. The authors conclude TEC-2 is a developmentally regulated carbohydrate epitope carried mainly on large glycoprotein-bound carbohydrates in embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-2443358.summary_ja: 1980年から1985年に、悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者9例に対し、エトポシドおよびブレオマイシンに、シスプラチンまたはカルボプラチンを併用した一次化学療法を行った。8例が6〜62か月で無病生存した。病期IIIのディスジャーミノーマ2例は、化学療法後に放射線療法を受けて無病であった。早期ディスジャーミノーマにはサーベイランスを、非ディスジャーミノーマ性腫瘍には全病期で併用化学療法を提案している。
pmid-2443358.summary_en: This study reported nine patients with malignant ovarian germ-cell tumours treated with first-line etoposide and bleomycin plus cisplatin or carboplatin between 1980 and 1985. Eight were alive and disease-free at 6 to 62 months. Two stage III dysgerminomas were disease-free after chemotherapy followed by radiotherapy. Among seven non-dysgerminomatous tumours, six remained disease-free. The authors propose surveillance for early-stage dysgerminoma and recommend combination chemotherapy for all stages of non-dysgerminomatous tumours.

pmid-2443827.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群を有する10歳男児が、思春期早発症と、β-hCGおよびαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇を伴う悪性胸部奇形腫を呈した。縦隔腫瘍は完全切除され補助化学療法が開始されたが、3週間以内に血液異常が生じ悪性組織球症と診断された。著者らは、XXY核型が縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の発生と造血器悪性腫瘍の併発に影響する可能性を指摘している。
pmid-2443827.summary_en: This case report describes a 10-year-old boy with Klinefelter syndrome, precocious puberty and a malignant thoracic teratoma with elevated beta-hCG and alpha-fetoprotein. The mediastinal tumour was completely excised and adjuvant chemotherapy began, but within three weeks he developed haematological abnormalities and was diagnosed with malignant histiocytosis. He died a few days after starting therapy for that condition. The authors suggest the XXY karyotype may influence mediastinal germ cell tumour development and its association with haematological malignancy.

pmid-2443988.summary_ja: 1979年から1985年に、転移(性)非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の精巣がん患者18例をシスプラチン併用化学療法で治療した。病期分類のためのリンパ節郭清後に化学療法を受けた病期II 3例は無病であった。病期IIの不良因子例および病期IIIの15例中11例は、中央値52か月で無病であった。全体の5年生存率は81%で、シスプラチン導入前の9例は全員死亡していた。
pmid-2443988.summary_en: This South African report describes 18 patients with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis treated with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy between 1979 and 1985. Three stage 2 patients were disease-free after chemotherapy following staging lymphadenectomy. Of 15 patients with stage II disease with adverse factors or stage III disease, 11 were disease-free at a median 52 months. The overall five-year survival was 81%, compared with no survivors among nine patients treated before cisplatin.

pmid-2444719.summary_ja: 1987年の本研究では、精巣がん58例(セミノーマ31例、非セミノーマ27例)の血清マーカーとしてbasic fetoprotein(BFP)を評価した。BFPはセミノーマの71%、非セミノーマの56%で上昇し、AFP・β-hCG・LDHが正常の症例も検出できた。再発患者4例中3例で再上昇が見られた。BFPは精巣がんの有用な血清マーカーと結論づけられた。
pmid-2444719.summary_en: This 1987 study evaluated basic fetoprotein (BFP) as a serum marker in 58 men with testicular cancer (31 seminoma, 27 nonseminoma). BFP was elevated in 71% of seminoma and 56% of nonseminoma patients, detecting cases where AFP, beta-hCG, and LDH were normal. Levels tracked clinical course and rose again in 3 of 4 patients with recurrence. Tissue BFP exceeded normal testis, confirmed immunohistochemically. The authors concluded BFP is a useful serum marker for testicular cancer.

pmid-2445089.summary_ja: 1987年の本研究では、精巣腫瘍患者の血清および組織中のAFPとβ-hCGを、免疫組織学的定量法で評価した。非セミノーマの66%では主に多核巨細胞がβ-hCGを産生し、絨毛上皮細胞がない場合は非特異的であった。AFPは真のセミノーマを陰性として識別し、AFP陽性の純粋セミノーマは硬化性奇形腫成分を示唆した。転移巣では原発巣に比べマーカー合成が有意に低下していた。
pmid-2445089.summary_en: This 1987 study measured serum and tissue levels of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and beta-hCG in patients with testis tumors, using immunohistochemistry with computer-assisted quantitation. Beta-hCG was produced mainly by polynuclear giant cells in 66% of nonseminomas, making it relatively nonspecific without chorioepithelial cells. AFP reliably distinguished true seminoma, which was consistently negative, while AFP-positive pure seminoma suggested sclerotic teratoma. Metastases showed markedly reduced marker synthesis compared with primary tumors.

pmid-2445090.summary_ja: 1987年の本報告は、普遍的な腫瘍マーカーとして提案された赤血球抗原B5を、精巣がん患者63例で評価したものである。赤血球凝集試験によりB5の状態を定量化した。奇形腫とセミノーマの両方でB5の上昇が認められ、セミノーマ患者28例中20例(71%)がB5陽性であった(病期I の13例を含む)。一方、hCGが上昇していたのは2例のみであった。有効な治療後、B5は有意に低下したが、対照群では安定していた。
pmid-2445090.summary_en: This 1987 report evaluated B5, an erythrocyte antigen proposed as a universal tumour marker, in 63 patients with testicular cancer. A haemagglutination test quantified B5 status. Both teratoma and seminoma were marked by B5; 20 of 28 seminoma patients (71%) were B5-positive, including 13 of 20 with stage I disease, while only 2 had raised beta-hCG. Successful treatment produced a significant downward shift in B5, whereas controls remained stable.

pmid-2445169.summary_ja: 本研究は、手術標本、培養細胞、ヌードマウスに移植した腫瘍を用い、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍のAFP産生を検討した。AFPは卵黄嚢腫瘍で最も高頻度に検出され、胎児性癌や奇形腫でも時に検出された。奇形腫のAFP陽性細胞は腺様または肝様の形態を示した。胎児性癌のAFP産生は、形態的発現に先行する卵黄嚢分化の機能的発現によると考えられた。移植腫瘍では産生が維持されたが、培養細胞では維持されなかった。
pmid-2445169.summary_en: This Japanese study examined alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) production by human germ cell tumors using surgical specimens, cultured cells, and transplanted tumors in nude mice. AFP was detected most often in yolk sac tumors, and occasionally in embryonal carcinomas and teratomas, where positive cells showed glandular or hepatoid features. The authors propose that AFP in embryonal carcinoma reflects yolk sac differentiation that precedes its morphologic expression. Transplanted tumors maintained AFP production, while cultured cells did not.

pmid-2445293.summary_ja: 1987年の本研究では、卵巣癌24例で7種類の腫瘍マーカーを評価し、経時的モニタリングにはCA125が最も有用であった。手術後にVAC化学療法を受けた卵巣胎児性癌27例では、血清AFPは半減期約7日で低下し、全例で10週以内に正常範囲に戻った。その後死亡した症例では、初回治療後10〜30週でAFPが再上昇した。
pmid-2445293.summary_en: This 1987 Japanese study assessed seven tumor markers in 24 patients with ovarian cancer; CA125 was the most useful for serial monitoring of disease. In 27 patients with ovarian embryonal carcinoma treated with VAC chemotherapy after surgery, serum AFP fell with a half-life of about 7 days and normalized within 10 weeks in all cases. In patients who later died, AFP rose again 10 to 30 weeks after initial treatment, indicating its value for tracking outcome.

pmid-2445294.summary_ja: 1987年の日本の総説で、泌尿器悪性腫瘍の腫瘍マーカーを概観している。精巣腫瘍では、血清AFPが卵黄嚢腫瘍の75%、胎児性癌の70%、奇形腫の62%で陽性となり、絨毛癌では全例でhCGが上昇する。前立腺癌のPAPやPSA、骨病変のマーカーも論じられている。腎癌と膀胱癌には特異的マーカーがない。
pmid-2445294.summary_en: This 1987 Japanese review summarizes tumor markers in urological malignancies. For testicular tumors, serum AFP is positive in 75% of yolk sac tumors, 70% of embryonal carcinomas, and 62% of teratomas, and all choriocarcinomas show elevated hCG. Prostate cancer markers such as PAP and PSA are discussed, along with bone-related markers. Renal and bladder cancers lack specific markers, with several nonspecific candidates noted. The authors anticipate future clinical use of immunohistochemical and flow cytometric findings.

pmid-2445518.summary_ja: 1987年の臨床薬学の総説で、精巣がんの疫学、病態生理、診断、病期分類、治療をまとめている。精巣腫瘍の90%以上は胚細胞由来で、セミノーマが約40%、純粋な胎児性癌が15〜20%を占める。セミノーマは放射線感受性が高く、播種病変にはシスプラチン併用療法が用いられる。転移のない症例は精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、約10%が再発する。
pmid-2445518.summary_en: This 1987 clinical pharmacy review covers epidemiology, pathophysiology, diagnosis, staging, and treatment of testicular cancer. More than 90% of testicular neoplasms are germ-cell derived, with seminoma about 40% and pure embryonal carcinoma 15-20%. Seminoma is highly radiosensitive, and cisplatin combinations treat disseminated disease. Patients without metastases undergo orchiectomy with retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection, with about 10% relapsing. The review notes that toxicity reduction and identifying patients who can be spared intensive treatment are research priorities.

pmid-2445635.summary_ja: 1987年の追跡報告では、悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者13例にVBP療法を行った。12例が完全寛解に達し、うち10例が寛解を維持した。2例で6か月と27か月に再発した。全体で11例が治療後14〜84か月の長期寛解にある。大きな残存腫瘍を有する症例にも有効と結論づけられた。
pmid-2445635.summary_en: This 1987 update reports 13 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated with vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin (VBP). Twelve achieved complete remission, and 10 of these remained in remission. Recurrence occurred in two patients at 6 and 27 months. Overall, 11 patients are in long-term remission 14 to 84 months after treatment. The authors conclude that VBP is effective for ovarian malignant germ cell tumors, including patients with large residual disease.

pmid-2445700.summary_ja: 1987年の本研究では、セミノーマ18例と対照組織の腫瘍マーカーを解析した。全セミノーマでPLAP様酵素が高値で、正常組織の約100倍、胎盤の約10分の1であった。純粋セミノーマ17例中13例でhCGが上昇し、正常精巣では認められなかった。純粋セミノーマではAFPは検出されなかった。CA-50は低下していた。
pmid-2445700.summary_en: This 1987 study analyzed tissue markers in 18 seminomas and control tissues. All seminomas showed very high placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP)-like enzyme, about 100 times normal tissue but 10 times lower than placenta. HCG was elevated in 13 of 17 pure seminomas, unlike normal testes. Liver and intestinal alkaline phosphatase were markedly increased, and AFP was not detected in pure seminomas. CA-50 decreased compared with normal testis. The authors suggest enzyme defects explain the PLAP rise and CA-50 decrease.

pmid-2446018.summary_ja: 進行期胚細胞腫瘍30例で、高用量白金系化学療法後の残存病変切除の意義を検討した。残存悪性成分は非セミノーマ患者の35%、後腹膜外残存病変の40%で認められ、追加の白金・エトポシド化学療法で約75〜80%が持続寛解に至った。初診時の広範な肺病変と切除病変での残存悪性成分が治療失敗の予測因子であった。
pmid-2446018.summary_en: This 1987 J Urol study of 30 patients with stage B3 or B3C advanced germ cell tumors evaluated adjunctive surgical resection after high-dose platinum-based chemotherapy. Residual malignant elements were found in 35% of nonseminomatous patients with retroperitoneal residuals and 40% with residual disease beyond the retroperitoneum. Additional platinum-etoposide chemotherapy yielded sustained complete remission in roughly 75 to 80% of stage B3 and B3C patients. Extensive pulmonary disease at presentation and residual malignancy in resected lesions predicted treatment failure. The authors support resecting residual lesions after initial chemotherapy in advanced metastatic germ cell tumors.

pmid-2446022.summary_ja: AFP産生腫瘍を総論的に検討し、卵黄嚢腫瘍のほか肝細胞癌、成人型胎児性癌、胃癌、卵巣腺癌などを取り上げた。卵黄嚢腫瘍はヒト卵黄嚢内胚葉細胞を模倣することが示された。AFP産生腫瘍の組織発生は内胚葉起源、または卵黄嚢内胚葉細胞への逆分化に帰すると考察している。
pmid-2446022.summary_en: This general review examines alpha-fetoprotein (AFP)-secreting tumors beyond classic yolk sac tumors, including hepatocellular carcinoma, adult-type embryonal carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and ovarian adenocarcinoma. Morphological comparison of yolk sac tumors with the human yolk sac suggests tumor cells mimic human yolk sac endodermal cells. Some non-yolk sac carcinomas may show selective differentiation toward these endodermal cells, producing increased serum AFP. The authors propose that AFP-secreting tumors share an endodermal origin, or retrodifferentiation to yolk sac endodermal cells, and suggest the term endodermal cell tumors.

pmid-2446132.summary_ja: 完全切除された病理病期II期精巣がん195例を対象とした無作為化試験である。補助シスプラチン併用化学療法群の再発率は6%、経過観察群は49%であった。経過観察群の再発例はほぼ全例が救済可能であった。
pmid-2446132.summary_en: This international randomized trial of 195 patients with completely resected pathological stage II testicular cancer compared immediate adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy (two cycles) with observation and treatment only at relapse. Relapse occurred in 6% of the adjuvant group versus 49% of the observation group. Nearly all relapses in the observation group were successfully salvaged, with 93 of 98 patients alive and disease-free. The authors conclude that adjuvant chemotherapy almost always prevents relapse, but optimal surgery, follow-up, and chemotherapy at relapse yield equivalent cure rates.

pmid-2446292.summary_ja: 卵巣2例と精巣1例の卵黄嚢腫瘍を検討した。いずれも血清AFPが高値で、円柱上皮に囲まれた腺房状構造を示した。免疫組織化学と電子顕微鏡で腸管分化のみを示すことが確認され、純粋な腸管分化型卵黄嚢腫瘍という新しい組織型と提唱された。
pmid-2446292.summary_en: Three endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors, two arising in the ovary and one in the testis, were studied in patients with markedly elevated serum AFP. All showed a distinctive histology of acinar structures lined by columnar epithelium with large immature nuclei. Immunohistochemistry and electron microscopy, including freeze-fracture studies, confirmed exclusive intestinal differentiation. The authors propose this as a new histologic variant, a pure yolk sac tumor with exclusive intestinal differentiation.

pmid-2446493.summary_ja: 純粋卵巣奇形腫12例を免疫組織化学的にAFP産生を検討した。3例で卵黄嚢様小胞などにAFP陽性巣が認められた。術前AFP高値の2例は卵巣摘出後に正常化した。術前のAFP上昇は成熟奇形腫ではない可能性を示唆すると結論づけている。
pmid-2446493.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study of 12 pure ovarian teratomas (six mature, six immature) assessed alpha-fetoprotein production and localization. AFP-positive foci were found in three tumors, within yolk-sac-like vesicles, intestinal epithelium, or liver-like tissue, while nine were negative. Preoperative serum AFP was elevated in two of the three positive cases and normalized after oophorectomy. The authors conclude that AFP expression in pure ovarian teratomas recapitulates ontogenic patterns, and a raised preoperative AFP suggests the tumor is not mature.

pmid-2446567.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株8株を用い、hCGやSP1などの胎盤蛋白産生を検討した。hCG産生は細胞株間で大きく異なり、in vitroと異種移植腫瘍で一致した。SP1はhCG産生と逆相関を示した。胎盤蛋白は絨毛癌細胞内で不均一に発現しており、腫瘍全体で一様には産生されないことが示された。
pmid-2446567.summary_en: This study characterized placental protein production (hCG, SP1, and several placental tissue proteins) in human choriocarcinoma cell lines, including gestational and nongestational lines, using radioimmunoassay and immunoperoxidase staining. hCG production varied substantially among cell lines and was consistent between in vitro culture and xenograft tumors. SP1 was inversely correlated with hCG output in three lines. Placental proteins were heterogeneously expressed within choriocarcinoma cells, indicating they are not produced uniformly across the tumor.

pmid-2446690.summary_ja: 精巣悪性奇形腫でブレオマイシンを投与された18例を対象に、CTで肺障害を評価した。視覚的評価はブレオマイシン障害の特徴づけと確定診断に有用だった。CTによる定量的濃度測定はKCOと逆相関し、治療中の生理学的モニタリングに使える。
pmid-2446690.summary_en: Eighteen patients receiving bleomycin for testicular malignant teratoma were assessed with computed tomography to quantify lung damage. Visual CT assessment characterized bleomycin-induced injury and allowed confident diagnosis, though it did not correlate with changes in gas transfer (KCO). Quantitative CT lung density, however, inversely correlated with KCO and could serve as a physiological monitoring tool. The authors conclude that CT can characterize and monitor bleomycin lung damage during treatment.

pmid-2446691.summary_ja: 転移性悪性奇形腫93例の予後因子を多変量解析で検討した。血清AFP 500μg/L超と、臨床病期分類で示される腫瘍量の多い病変が、初回化学療法後の再発の独立した不良因子だった。血清hCG高値による悪影響は認められなかった。腫瘍マーカーは転移性疾患の体積と相関した。
pmid-2446691.summary_en: Multiple regression analysis of 93 patients with metastatic malignant teratoma treated at the Royal Marsden Hospital between 1979 and 1981. In 53 patients with CT-calculated tumor volume, tumor marker levels correlated with metastatic burden. Serum AFP above 500 μg/L and bulky disease on clinical staging were independent adverse factors for relapse after initial chemotherapy. High hCG levels showed no adverse effect, possibly reflecting the small number of such patients.

pmid-2447309.summary_ja: 64歳女性の卵巣類皮嚢腫内に発生した高分化型扁平上皮癌の症例報告である。奇形腫からの悪性転化の一例にあたる。免疫組織化学ではTPAが多くの癌細胞で陽性、CEAとAFPは陰性だった。臨床病期はIa(i)と判定された。
pmid-2447309.summary_en: A case report of a 64-year-old woman with a 1550 g ovarian tumor in which a well-differentiated keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma developed within a dermoid cyst, representing malignant transformation of a teratoma. Clinically staged as Ia(i). Immunohistochemistry showed TPA positivity in many cancer cells, while CEA and AFP were negative. The study documents this rare teratoma-derived squamous malignancy and its immunophenotype.

pmid-2447765.summary_ja: 1984〜1985年に当科で治療した精巣がん12例の臨床報告。セミノーマ8例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍4例。病期に応じて放射線療法、PVB療法、CDDP含有化学療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った。原発巣が大きい症例でLDHが上昇し、セミノーマの多くでβ-hCGが軽度上昇していた。再発は認められず、精巣がんはほぼ治癒可能な疾患と考察している。
pmid-2447765.summary_en: This clinical report describes twelve testicular cancer patients treated at a Japanese urology department in 1984-1985. Eight had pure seminoma and four had non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Treatments, chosen by stage, included radiotherapy, PVB and cisplatin-containing chemotherapy, and retroperitoneal lymph node resection. Lactate dehydrogenase was elevated in large primary tumors, and most seminomas had mildly raised beta-hCG. No recurrences occurred, supporting a largely curable prognosis.

pmid-2452560.summary_ja: 29歳男性の精巣セミノーマ症例。血清β-hCG高値を伴い、小脳失調、複視、構音障害を呈した亜急性小脳変性症と考えられた。脳CTは正常。高位精巣摘除術後、後腹膜転移はVAB VI療法で消退し完全寛解に至ったが、寛解後14か月も小脳症状が残存した。精巣腫瘍に伴う本症の報告は本例で2例目とされる。
pmid-2452560.summary_en: Case report of a 29-year-old man with a left testicular seminoma and high serum beta-hCG (200 ng/ml) who developed subacute cerebellar degeneration with ataxia, diplopia, and dysarthria. Brain CT was normal. High orchiectomy showed typical seminoma. Retroperitoneal metastases shrank after VAB VI chemotherapy, and beta-hCG normalized with complete remission. Cerebellar symptoms persisted 14 months later. The authors attribute this to a paraneoplastic process associated with seminoma and note it is only the second such testicular case reported.

pmid-2458883.summary_ja: 欧州系の胞状奇胎65例、対照71例、家系6組を対象に、hCGα鎖遺伝子のRFLPを解析した。奇胎では対照と遺伝子型分布が異なったが、対立遺伝子頻度に有意差はなかった。絨毛癌との関連が示唆されるR-R-,H+H+遺伝子型は、自然寛解例と栄養膜細胞性腫瘍への進展例で同程度に認められた。遺伝子型と臨床経過に関連はなく、予後マーカーとしては不適切と結論づけている。
pmid-2458883.summary_en: This study examined EcoR1 and HindIII restriction fragment length polymorphisms in the hCG alpha subunit gene, comparing 65 hydatidiform moles with 71 controls and six families, all of European origin. Genotype distributions differed between moles and controls, though allele frequencies did not. The rare homozygous R-R-,H+H+ genotype occurred at similar rates in moles that resolved spontaneously and in those that progressed to trophoblastic tumours. Genotype showed no association with clinical outcome, so this marker is unsuitable for predicting prognosis.

pmid-2820104.summary_ja: 1施設で7年間に治療した精巣腫瘍115例の後方視的解析。うち25例はAIDS、AIDS関連症候群、またはAIDS発症リスクありと判定された。AIDS群では非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍がより多く認められた。抄録は短く、臨床転帰の詳細は示されていない。免疫不全状態と精巣の胚細胞腫瘍の組織型との関連を示唆する報告である。
pmid-2820104.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of all testicular tumors treated at one institution over seven years. Of 115 patients, 25 had AIDS, AIDS-related complex, or were judged to be at risk of developing AIDS. Non-seminomatous germ cell tumors were more common in the AIDS group. The abstract is brief and does not report detailed clinical outcomes. The finding raises the possibility that HIV-related immune status is linked to the histology of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-2820253.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍124例と妊娠性絨毛癌11例を、胎盤マーカーおよびサイトケラチンで免疫染色した。栄養膜様細胞は40例に認められ、全例の絨毛癌や混合型胚細胞腫瘍の絨毛癌成分、一部の胎児性癌とセミノーマに存在した。大型単核細胞は各組織型でマーカー陽性を示した。正常胎盤の中間栄養膜細胞と同等とみなす考えを提唱している。
pmid-2820253.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of 124 germ cell tumors and 11 gestational choriocarcinomas for placental markers hCG, hPL, PSG1, and cytokeratin. Trophoblastic-type cells were found in 40 cases, including all choriocarcinomas and choriocarcinomatous foci in mixed tumors, as well as some embryonal carcinomas and seminomas. Large mononuclear cells reactive for these markers appeared across histologies. The authors propose that these cells are equivalent to the intermediate trophoblast of normal placenta and of gestational trophoblastic neoplasms.
