pmid-3299487.summary_en: This prospective study analyzes high-resolution real-time ultrasonography findings in 57 testicular lesions, including 48 malignancies. Most malignant tumors showed decreased echogenicity, but ultrasound alone could not classify histology. Abdominal ultrasonography detected retroperitoneal nodal metastases with 96% accuracy, outperforming bipedal lymphangiography.

pmid-3299661.summary_ja: PCC4-aza-1株由来のマウス奇形癌において、H血液型抗原の発現を免疫細胞化学で検討した研究です。H抗原は内胚葉性および外胚葉性の構造に陽性でしたが、中胚葉性・神経外胚葉性成分や胎児性癌細胞は陰性でした。マウス胚やヒト奇形癌との比較も行われ、胚発生との関連を考える上で示唆に富みます。
pmid-3299661.summary_en: This immunocytochemical study examines H blood group antigen expression in ectoblastic components of murine teratocarcinoma derived from the PCC4-aza-1 line. H antigen was present in endodermal and ectodermal structures but absent in mesodermal and neuroectodermal components, and embryonal carcinoma cells were negative. The findings are compared with murine embryos, adult mice, and human teratocarcinomas.

pmid-3300005.summary_ja: B6C3F1マウスに発生した卵巣絨毛癌7例の病理所見を記載した報告です。肉眼的には暗色または出血性の嚢胞性病変として確認されました。顕微鏡下では血性嚢胞、細胞性・合胞体性栄養膜細胞、栄養膜巨細胞がみられ、絨毛癌の形態学的な参照例となります。
pmid-3300005.summary_en: This veterinary pathology report describes seven ovarian choriocarcinomas in B6C3F1 mice, a rare tumor even in animals. Tumors appeared as dark or hemorrhagic cystic lesions at necropsy, with a mean age at death of 47 weeks. Microscopy showed hematocysts, cytotrophoblasts, syncytiotrophoblasts, and trophoblastic giant cells. The findings offer a morphologic reference for choriocarcinoma in a rodent model.

pmid-3301449.summary_ja: 1970年から1982年にかけて地域一般病院で診断・治療された卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫72例の後方視的検討である。大多数は無症状で受診し、平均年齢は37歳であった。急性腹症で受診した症例もあった。骨盤超音波検査を受けた22例のうち9例で、嚢胞が正しく診断された。
pmid-3301449.summary_en: This retrospective review examines 72 cases of benign cystic ovarian teratoma diagnosed and treated at a district general hospital over 11 years. Most patients were asymptomatic at presentation, with a mean age of 37 years, and some presented with acute abdomen. Pelvic ultrasound correctly diagnosed the cyst in 9 of 22 patients who underwent it.

pmid-3301646.summary_ja: MHCクラスI陰性の402AX奇形癌に対してマウスが抵抗性を示す機序を検討した免疫遺伝学的研究です。抵抗性は免疫介在性で、腫瘍のゲノム型（129/J）由来のマイナー組織適合抗原が標的と考えられました。皮膚移植による免疫化でも防御効果が得られ、この抗原が認識対象であることを示唆しています。
pmid-3301646.summary_en: This immunogenetics study investigates why mice resist the 402AX teratocarcinoma, an MHC class I-negative tumor. Resistance is immune-mediated and involves responses to minor histocompatibility antigens of the tumor's 129/J genotype. Tumor-primed C57BL/6 splenocytes induced graft-versus-host disease, and skin-graft immunization conferred protection, supporting these antigens as the targets.

pmid-3304507.summary_ja: 陰嚢超音波検査を230例に実施し、臨床診断と病理診断を比較した。触知しない精巣や臨床的に正常な精巣の評価に有用で、臨床的に良性と考えられた精巣腫瘍5例を正しく診断した。精巣腫瘍の検出例の28%を占めた。陰嚢超音波検査は精巣腫瘍の診断において実用的な画像検査であることを示している。
pmid-3304507.summary_en: This study reports scrotal ultrasonography performed in 230 patients over 18 months, correlating findings with clinical and, where available, pathological diagnoses. Ultrasound was useful for evaluating clinically normal or impalpable testes, and correctly identified testicular tumours in five cases thought clinically to be benign. These five cases accounted for 28% of tumours detected. The paper also reviews abnormal sonographic appearances, supporting ultrasound as a practical tool in the assessment of scrotal and testicular disease.

pmid-3311959.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の1症例において、分化した奇形腫組織のS-100タンパク分布を免疫組織化学的に検討した。正常組織と類似の反応性を示し、骨芽細胞・骨細胞・歯胚の象牙芽細胞にも陽性所見があった。奇形腫内の脈絡叢様構造も陽性であった。S-100は器官形成の有無によらず基本的な細胞機能と関連する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-3311959.summary_en: S-100 protein distribution was examined by immunoperoxidase staining in a case of ovarian teratoma containing well-differentiated teratomatous tissues. Immunoreactivity mirrored that of normal human counterparts, and unexpected positivity was seen in bone osteoblasts, osteocytes and tooth germ odontoblasts. Choroid plexus-like structures within the teratoma were also positive. The authors suggest S-100 expression may relate to basic cell function regardless of whether a fully developed organism is formed. The study is a single-case pathology report of ovarian germ cell tumour histology.

pmid-3314057.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の180例を後方視的に検討し、受診までの症状持続期間（平均170日）を解析した。セミノーマと非セミノーマで差があり、1969年以降は短縮していた。診断遅延が予後に悪影響を与えたのは非セミノーマのみと結論し、定期的な精巣の自己検査を推奨している。
pmid-3314057.summary_en: This retrospective study of 180 patients with testicular germ cell tumors examined presentation features and diagnostic delay. Mean symptom duration was 170 days, differing between seminoma and nonseminoma and decreasing steadily since 1969. The longest delays occurred in stage I seminoma and in stage III nonseminoma. The authors conclude that prolonged delay adversely affects prognosis only in nonseminoma and recommend periodic testicular self-examination.

pmid-3316321.summary_ja: 妊娠中の若い女性の卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した悪性黒色腫の症例報告である。このような悪性転化はきわめてまれで、従来は高齢者で予後不良のことが多かった。本症例は予後が良好で、妊娠に伴う初めての報告例とされ、関連文献を概説している。
pmid-3316321.summary_en: This case report describes malignant melanoma arising within an ovarian cystic teratoma in a young pregnant woman. Malignant transformation of such teratomas is extremely rare and has usually been reported in older patients with poor outcomes. This patient had an optimistic prognosis, and it is the first reported case associated with pregnancy. The authors briefly review the relevant literature.

pmid-3317175.summary_ja: 非双生児の兄弟3組の精巣腫瘍例と、文献上の家族性症例82例を解析し、家族歴が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の危険因子となるかを検討した。若年発症や両側性の多さ、民族差、HLA研究などから、遺伝因子の関与を支持すると結論している。
pmid-3317175.summary_en: This report of three pairs of non-twin brothers with testicular tumors, combined with a literature review of 82 familial cases, examines whether familial occurrence is a risk factor for testicular germ cell cancer. Features supporting a genetic component include early onset, frequent bilateral tumors, ethnic variation, and HLA associations. The authors conclude that genetic factors likely contribute to the etiology of testicular germ cell cancer.

pmid-3320400.summary_ja: 32歳男性の腸間膜腫瘍と肝転移を伴う絨毛癌の症例報告である。精巣は正常で、化学療法にもかかわらず術後2か月で死亡した。剖検で原発は胃の腺癌と判明し、転移巣に絨毛癌様の分化を示していた。原発巣の同定が診断上の課題となった症例であり、男性絨毛癌の文献的検討を付している。
pmid-3320400.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with a large mesenteric tumor and liver metastases, histologically diagnosed as choriocarcinoma despite a normal testis on serial examination. He died two months after resection despite chemotherapy. Autopsy showed a primary gastric adenocarcinoma with choriocarcinomatous differentiation at metastatic sites. The paper also reviews the literature on male choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3321862.summary_ja: 双胎妊娠の一方の胎児に生じた未熟性頸部奇形腫の初めての報告である。リアルタイム超音波検査で異常は捉えられたが、腫瘍の性質は病理組織学的検査で初めて確定した。急性羊水過多と腫瘍の急速な増大のため、妊娠20週で羊膜外プロスタグランジン投与による妊娠中絶が行われた。全身麻酔下で両胎児が娩出され、異常な胎児は子宮内で腫瘍を頸部から分離した後に摘出された。
pmid-3321862.summary_en: This is the first reported case of an immature cervical teratoma arising in one fetus of a twin pregnancy. Real-time ultrasound detected an abnormality, but its nature was confirmed only after histological examination. Because of acute hydramnios and rapid tumor growth, extra-amniotic prostaglandin termination was performed at 20 weeks. Both fetuses were delivered under general anesthesia, and the abnormal twin could be extracted only after the tumor was separated from the fetal neck in utero.

pmid-3321954.summary_ja: 42歳男性が左精巣腫瘍に対し左根治的精巣摘除術を受け、病理学的にセミノーマと診断された。15年後、43歳の弟も左精巣腫瘍を発症し、同様にセミノーマと診断されて摘除された。兄には陰嚢外傷歴があったが、両者とも精巣炎や停留精巣の既往はなかった。著者らは兄弟における精巣腫瘍の報告例を文献的に検討した。
pmid-3321954.summary_en: A 42-year-old man underwent left radical orchiectomy for a left testicular tumor, which was pathologically a seminoma. Fifteen years later, his 43-year-old younger brother developed a left testicular tumor, also a seminoma, and underwent left radical orchiectomy. The elder brother had a history of scrotal trauma, and neither brother had orchitis or cryptorchidism. The authors reviewed 45 reported sets of sibling testicular tumors, including 11 twin sets and 33 non-twin sets, and discussed the cases.

pmid-3323363.summary_ja: 侵入奇胎と絨毛癌の患者31例の超音波像を解析し、治療前の画像を三型に分類した。侵入奇胎は主にII型、絨毛癌は主にI型を示した。腫瘍体積は尿中hCG値と正の相関を示し、化学療法を受けた22例中9例では、hCGが陰性化した時点で超音波上腫瘍が消失していた。治療経過の評価における超音波検査の臨床的意義を検討した報告である。
pmid-3323363.summary_en: This study assessed ultrasonography in managing invasive mole and choriocarcinoma using images from 31 patients. Pretreatment images were classified into three types, with invasive mole mostly type II and choriocarcinoma mostly type I. Tumor volume correlated with urinary hCG, and in 22 chemotherapy patients, 9 had no visible tumor on ultrasound once hCG became negative. Fourteen patients followed a standard course defined by ultrasound changes during chemotherapy.

pmid-3324746.summary_ja: 81歳男性が、11年前から無痛性の右精巣腫大を認めていた。1981年に併用療法を行わず右精巣摘除術を受け、病理学的に精母細胞性セミノーマと確定した。その後5年間にわたり再発の所見はなく、良好に経過している。精巣摘除術のみで管理された高齢者の稀なセミノーマ亜型の経過を示した症例である。
pmid-3324746.summary_en: An 81-year-old man had painless enlargement of the right testis for 11 years. He underwent right orchiectomy in 1981 without combined therapy, and pathology confirmed spermatocytic seminoma. He has remained well for the past 5 years with no evidence of recurrence. The report illustrates the clinical course of this rare seminoma variant in an elderly patient managed by orchiectomy alone.

pmid-3326883.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の多能性幹細胞である胎児性癌(EC)細胞の糖脂質抗原発現を検討した。ヒトとマウスのEC細胞はグロボ系糖脂質を発現するが、末端修飾が異なる。分化に伴いグロボ系構造は減少し、ラクト系やガングリオ系へ置き換わる。NTERA-2細胞では特定のガングリオシドにより神経細胞の亜集団が区別される。
pmid-3326883.summary_en: This study examines glycolipid antigen expression in human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, the pluripotent stem cells of teratocarcinomas, which are germ cell tumors. Human and mouse EC cells express globoseries glycolipids that differ in terminal modification, and the P-blood group system may influence early embryonic and teratocarcinoma behavior. As EC cells differentiate, globoseries structures decline and are replaced by lactoseries and ganglioseries glycolipids. Specific gangliosides mark neuronal subsets in NTERA-2 cells.

pmid-3328501.summary_ja: 35歳男性の両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の1例を報告。両側高位精巣摘除術と術後放射線療法を施行し、1年間のフォローアップで転移は認めなかった。さらに本邦文献の両側例115例を集計し、左右の組織型の異同(異なる39例、類似76例)、年齢分布、精巣の部位、発症時期、組織学的分類を検討した。
pmid-3328501.summary_en: This report describes a 35-year-old man with bilateral testicular germ cell tumors, both histologically typical seminomas, treated with bilateral high orchiectomy followed by postoperative irradiation. He remained free of metastasis after one year of follow-up. The authors also reviewed 115 bilateral testicular germ cell tumor cases from the Japanese literature, comparing histology between the two testes (39 different, 76 similar) and analyzing age distribution, testicular location, onset timing, and histological classification.

pmid-3332742.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫(SCT)の定義、自然経過、予後を概説した総説。出生前に診断された2例を詳細に提示し、集中的な周産期管理を要した。両例とも全身質量の30~50%に相当する腫瘤を切除し、無事に生存した。出生前治療の適応選択の難しさと、子宮内治療の展望についても検討している。
pmid-3332742.summary_en: This review covers the definition, natural history, and prognosis of sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT), a common extragonadal germ cell tumor in neonates and fetuses. The authors describe two cases diagnosed well before delivery that required intensive perinatal management, with removal of 30 to 50 percent of total body mass. Both infants survived intact. The paper also reviews the difficulties of case selection for antenatal therapy and the prospects for in utero treatment.

pmid-3332743.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された仙尾部奇形腫8例と文献的考察をまとめた報告。腫瘍は通常良性である。正確な出生前診断は胎児の喪失や新生児の罹患率・死亡率と関連する。非免疫性水腫は予後不良の徴候で、分娩時期が生存に影響する。超音波検査で神経管欠損との鑑別が可能である。
pmid-3332743.summary_en: This report analyzes eight prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratomas alongside a literature review. Accurate prenatal diagnosis is linked to fetal wastage and neonatal morbidity and mortality. Tumors are usually benign, with long-term morbidity related to the AAP surgical type rather than overall survival. Alpha-fetoprotein and amniotic acetylcholinesterase can be unhelpful, while sonography distinguishes these lesions from neural tube defects. Nonimmune hydrops is ominous, and delivery timing matters for survival.

pmid-3332744.summary_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫の出生前診断例を2例追加し、既報の27例に加えて報告。うち1例は最早期の診断例である。胎児SCTは新生児SCTとは異なる経過をとる。妊娠中期に診断された場合、子宮内での処置が可能かもしれない。周産期チームは出生前から管理を計画できる。
pmid-3332744.summary_en: This report describes the early prenatal diagnosis of fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) in two additional cases, extending the authors' series of 27 patients. One case represents the earliest diagnosis of SCT reported. The authors note that fetal SCT behaves differently from neonatal SCT. In utero manipulation may be possible when the tumor is diagnosed in the second trimester.

pmid-3423305.summary_ja: 1963~1983年にロイヤル・マーズデン病院で治療された病期I精巣奇形腫248例の後方視的解析。1979年以前は補助的な腹部・骨盤照射を行い、以後は監視療法を採用し、再発例には化学療法を行った。照射群では4.9%に十二指腸潰瘍を認めたが、監視群では認めなかった。既往の十二指腸潰瘍が有意な危険因子であった。
pmid-3423305.summary_en: This retrospective analysis from the Royal Marsden Hospital reviews 248 patients with stage I testicular teratoma treated between 1963 and 1983. Before 1979, patients received adjuvant abdominal and pelvic irradiation; afterward a surveillance policy was used, with chemotherapy for relapse. Duodenal ulceration developed in 4.9% of irradiated patients and in none under surveillance. A history of duodenal ulcer was a significant risk factor, while prior abdominal surgery was not.

pmid-3425244.summary_ja: 1980~84年にクアラルンプール大学病院で治療された絨毛癌36例のうち、脳転移を有した6例の検討。全例に髄腔内メトトレキサートと併用化学療法を行い、β-hCGとCTで追跡した。6例中4例(66%)が2.5~6年の寛解を維持し、2例は無効で死亡した。毒性のため化学療法を減量した症例があり、そのうち1例は脳への放射線療法を受けた。
pmid-3425244.summary_en: This study from University Hospital Kuala Lumpur reviews 36 choriocarcinoma patients treated in 1980–84, six of whom had cerebral metastases. All received intrathecal methotrexate and combination chemotherapy, monitored by serial β-hCG and CT. Four of six (66%) remained in remission for 2.5 to 6 years, while two died without response. Chemotherapy was reduced in two patients for toxicity, one of whom also received brain radiotherapy.

pmid-3425249.summary_ja: 閉経後3年の57歳女性に発生した未熟卵巣奇形腫の1例で、閉経後発生の初めての報告。切除後1年以内に腹膜のブドウ状横紋筋肉腫を発症し、奇形腫内の横紋筋芽細胞に由来すると考えられた。アドリアマイシンに一時的な奏効を示したが、6か月後に病勢進行により死亡した。両腫瘍の文献を概説する。
pmid-3425249.summary_en: This report describes a 57-year-old woman, three years postmenopausal, with immature ovarian teratoma, believed to be the first such case after menopause. Within one year of resection she developed peritoneal botryoid rhabdomyosarcoma, probably arising from rhabdomyoblasts in the teratoma. She had a transient response to adriamycin but died six months later from progressive disease. The literature on both tumor types is briefly reviewed.

pmid-3428508.summary_ja: 多能性マウス胎児性癌細胞株PSA1-NG2由来のコンカナバリンA耐性変異株NG2-2.16を解析した。この変異株は試験管内および腫瘍内のいずれにおいても自然分化を示さず、コンカナバリンA耐性と分化障害は同一変異に起因すると推定された。レチノイン酸で分化が誘導され、分化能の喪失ではなく分化制御の異常が示唆された。
pmid-3428508.summary_en: This study isolates a concanavalin-A-resistant variant, NG2-2.16, of the pluripotent mouse embryonal carcinoma line PSA1-NG2. The variant fails to undergo spontaneous differentiation in vitro and in vivo. Statistical evidence suggests one mutation underlies both concanavalin-A resistance and the differentiation defect. Retinoic acid still induces differentiation, indicating impaired regulation rather than lost differentiation potential. These findings offer insight into how embryonal carcinoma cells control differentiation.

pmid-3429105.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫350例と、微小な未熟組織巣を伴う卵巣類皮嚢腫10例を解析し、両者の関連を検討した。未熟奇形腫の約26%に肉眼的に明らかな類皮嚢腫が存在し、2.6%は同一卵巣の類皮嚢腫切除後に発生していた。微小な未熟組織を伴う類皮嚢腫の多くはフォローアップ期間中に再発を認めなかった。未熟奇形腫に先行した類皮嚢腫は多発や破裂が多く、両者の関連が示唆された。
pmid-3429105.summary_en: This study analyzes 350 ovarian immature teratomas and 10 dermoid cysts with microscopic immature foci to assess their relation. About a quarter of immature teratomas contained grossly visible dermoid cysts, and 2.6% followed resection of a dermoid cyst from the same ovary. Cysts with microscopic immature foci showed no recurrence during follow-up. Dermoid cysts that preceded immature teratoma were often multiple or ruptured, suggesting a relation that warrants further study.

pmid-3429990.summary_ja: 8種類のヒト絨毛癌細胞株について腫瘍血管新生因子（TAF）活性を、マウス皮下組織、ニワトリ漿尿膜、ウサギ角膜、内皮細胞増殖の各アッセイで評価した。異種移植腫瘍の大きさは血管数およびTAF活性と相関した。TAFは分子量1万ダルトン以上の画分に検出され、細胞株間で活性に不均一性が認められた。TAFが絨毛癌細胞の増殖を開始させる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-3429990.summary_en: Eight human choriocarcinoma cell lines were examined for tumor angiogenesis factor (TAF) activity using mouse, chick chorioallantoic membrane, rabbit cornea, and endothelial proliferation assays. Xenograft tumor size correlated with vessel number and TAF activity. TAF in all lines eluted in gel-filtration fractions above 10,000 daltons, with heterogeneity among lines. These findings suggest TAF may initiate choriocarcinoma cell proliferation.

pmid-3429992.summary_ja: ヒト卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）をヌードマウスに継代移植し、初回腫瘍のエストロゲン受容体（ER）含量で群分けしてタモキシフェンの効果を検討した。ER高値の腫瘍では増殖が著明に抑制され、細胞・核の縮小と分裂像の減少、プロゲステロン受容体の誘導がみられた。ER低値の腫瘍では効果は弱かった。胚細胞由来でもER陽性の卵巣癌は抗エストロゲン療法に反応しうると考察された。
pmid-3429992.summary_en: Tamoxifen was tested in nude mice bearing serially transplanted human ovarian dysgerminoma, grouped by the estrogen receptor content of the initial tumor. In ER-rich tumors, tamoxifen markedly suppressed growth, reduced cell and nuclear size and mitoses, and induced progesterone receptor. ER-poor tumors showed weaker effects. The authors suggest that ER-positive ovarian tumors of germ cell origin may respond to antiestrogen therapy.

pmid-3434495.summary_ja: 1972～1984年に当科を受診した44,698例中、精巣腫瘍は58例（発生率0.13%）であった。無痛性の精巣腫大が93.1%に認められ、組織型はセミノーマ51.7%、胎児性癌13.8%などであった。セミノーマには高位精巣摘除術と放射線療法、非セミノーマには主に化学療法が行われた。5年生存率は低病期セミノーマで100%、非セミノーマ性腫瘍で62%であった。
pmid-3434495.summary_en: This study reviews 58 testicular tumor patients among 44,698 patients seen at the department from 1972 to 1984, an incidence of 0.13%. Mean age was 28.6 years, with peaks in early childhood and the late twenties. Most presented with painless swelling; 51.7% were seminoma and 13.8% embryonal carcinoma. Seminomas were mainly treated with orchiectomy and radiotherapy, non-seminomas with chemotherapy. Five-year survival was 100% for low-stage seminoma and 62% for non-seminomatous tumors.

pmid-3436721.summary_ja: 正期産の新生児で、上咽頭、口咽頭、左鼻腔を満たす奇形腫が気道閉塞を起こし、出生直後に気管挿管を要した。当初、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)は鼻篩骨部脳瘤と判断されたが、開頭術で硬膜欠損は認められず、経鼻的に完全摘出された。奇形腫を脳瘤と誤認する診断上の落とし穴を示す症例である。
pmid-3436721.summary_en: This report describes a full-term neonate with a nasopharyngeal teratoma filling the oropharynx, nasopharynx, and left nasal cavity, causing airway obstruction that required immediate intubation. Computed tomography was initially read as a nasoethmoidal encephalocele, and craniotomy found no dural defect before the mass was removed completely through the nose. The case highlights the diagnostic pitfall of confusing teratoma with encephalocele. The infant recovered uneventfully.

pmid-3438723.summary_ja: 1978～1985年に手術を受けた、組織学的に良性の縦隔奇形腫8例を報告した。7例で根治的切除が行われたが、1例は重要臓器への浸潤のため完全切除できず、術後9か月で死亡した。残る7例（急速増大4例を含む）では再発は認められなかった。縦隔奇形腫は稀で、15～20%が悪性である。
pmid-3438723.summary_en: This report reviews eight patients operated on from 1978 to 1985 for histologically benign mediastinal teratoma. Radical excision was performed in seven; one tumor infiltrating vital structures could not be fully removed, and that patient died nine months later. The other seven, including four with rapid growth, showed no recurrence. Mediastinal teratomas are rare, and 15-20% are malignant.

pmid-3441784.summary_ja: 36歳男性に発生した精巣類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。精巣の類皮嚢腫は稀な腫瘍であり、本論文ではこれを他の分化型奇形腫との関係から考察している。抄録では臨床像と分類上の問題に焦点が当てられており、治療内容や転帰、フォローアップの詳細までは記載されていない。
pmid-3441784.summary_en: A case report of a dermoid cyst of the testis in a 36-year-old man. The authors discuss the relationship between this rare testicular tumour and other differentiated teratomas, placing it within the spectrum of teratomatous germ cell lesions. The abstract focuses on the clinical presentation and classification issues rather than detailed histology, treatment, or follow-up outcomes.

pmid-3445867.summary_ja: 片側の精巣腫瘍患者20例で対側精巣の生検を行い、腫瘍による形態学的変化を評価した。同側精巣に上皮内癌が1例、対側精巣に異型胚細胞が3例、精子形成低下が5例にみられた。精細管壁の肥厚は腫瘍重量150g超で多かったが、病期や血清β-hCG、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、FSH、LHとは関連がなかった。
pmid-3445867.summary_en: Biopsies of the contralateral testis were performed in 20 men with unilateral testicular tumours to assess morphological changes caused by the tumour. Histology showed carcinoma in situ in one ipsilateral testis, atypical germ cells in three contralateral testes, and hypospermatogenesis in five. Tubular wall thickening correlated with larger tumour weight (over 150 g) but not with stage or serum beta-hCG, AFP, FSH or LH levels.

pmid-3448884.summary_ja: 自宅分娩後に腟円蓋から脱出した卵巣類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。当初は産褥期の子宮内反症が疑われた。手術で脱出した腫瘤は卵巣の類皮嚢腫と判明した。本症例は分娩時に卵巣腫瘍が脱出する稀な合併症を示すものである。抄録では治療方法や転帰の詳細は記載されていない。
pmid-3448884.summary_en: A case report of a dermoid ovarian tumour that prolapsed through the vaginal fornix after home delivery. A puerperal uterine inversion was initially suspected. Surgery identified the prolapsed mass as a dermoid ovarian tumour. The case illustrates a rare complication of an ovarian tumour presenting as prolapse during labour, and the abstract gives no details on treatment or outcome.

pmid-3448885.summary_ja: 膀胱結石の症状で受診した30歳女性の症例報告である。手術で大きな膀胱結石に加え、膀胱から卵巣類皮嚢腫への瘻孔が見つかった。瘻孔形成の原因は不明のままである。良性の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と尿路との稀な関連を示す症例であるが、抄録には治療内容やフォローアップの記載はない。
pmid-3448885.summary_en: A case report of a 30-year-old woman with bladder stone symptoms, in whom surgery revealed a fistula from the bladder to an ovarian dermoid tumour. The cause of fistula formation remains unexplained. The report describes an unusual association between a benign ovarian germ cell tumour and the urinary tract, with no treatment details or follow-up given in the abstract.

pmid-3449817.summary_ja: 正期産の胎盤に生じた上皮内絨毛癌が、慢性の胎児母体間出血を介して胎児水腫と子宮内胎児死亡を引き起こした症例を報告する。類似の報告例および施設内の別の胎盤絨毛癌例と比較している。また、大量の胎児母体間出血と胎児死亡をもたらした絨毛血管腫2例についても記述している。
pmid-3449817.summary_en: Reports a term placenta with choriocarcinoma in situ causing fetal hydrops and intrauterine death through chronic fetal-maternal hemorrhage. Compares the case with similar reports and an additional placental choriocarcinoma from the authors' files. Also describes two chorangiomas that caused massive fetal-maternal hemorrhage and fetal death.

pmid-3449820.summary_ja: 胎盤奇形腫の1症例を報告し、これまでの報告7例を概観している。胎児無形成との鑑別を重視し、診断基準を検討している。認識可能な臍帯がないことと骨格形成がないことを、胎盤の腫瘤を奇形腫と診断する基準として用いた。
pmid-3449820.summary_en: A case report of placental teratoma, with a review of the seven previously reported cases. The authors discuss diagnostic criteria, emphasising differentiation from fetus amorphous. Absence of a recognisable umbilical cord and lack of skeletal development were used as criteria for diagnosing teratoma in this placental mass.

pmid-3453674.summary_ja: 1976年から1986年にかけてパプアニューギニアで20歳未満の女性にみられた卵巣腫瘍を後方視的に検討した。101例のうち上皮性腫瘍が最多（66.3%）で、胚細胞腫瘍が24.8%を占めた。10例が捻転で受診した。11歳女児の原発性非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌が1例含まれている。
pmid-3453674.summary_en: Retrospective review of ovarian tumours in girls under 20 in Papua New Guinea from 1976 to 1986. Among 101 cases, epithelial tumours were most common (66.3%), followed by germ cell tumours (24.8%). Ten patients presented with torsion. A single case of primary non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma in an 11-year-old is noted.

pmid-3455373.summary_ja: 22歳で甲状腺機能亢進症を発症した女性が、20年後に再び甲状腺中毒症を呈した症例である。放射性ヨウ素プロファイルスキャンにより卵巣甲状腺腫と診断し、卵巣腫瘍を摘除した。病理所見は卵巣甲状腺腫に合致し、術前投与した125Iの集積も病変内に確認された。甲状腺刺激物質は術前後で陽性であり、病変が自律性であったか循環因子による刺激を受けていたかは不明である。
pmid-3455373.summary_en: A woman with Graves' hyperthyroidism developed recurrent thyrotoxicosis twenty years after initial treatment. Radioiodine profile scanning identified a struma ovarii, and the ovarian tumour was removed. Pathology confirmed struma ovarii, and autoradiography showed preoperative 125I uptake within the lesion. Thyroid-stimulating activity was detected pre- and postoperatively, leaving unclear whether the lesion was autonomous or driven by circulating stimulators. The authors suggest profile scanning as a useful diagnostic investigation.

pmid-3471312.summary_ja: 3例の悪性卵巣腫瘍について、腹腔洗浄液または腹水を用いて細胞遺伝学的解析を行った。漿液性嚢胞腺癌では偽二倍体クローンが認められ、未熟奇形腫ではトリソミー2などの異常が認められた。ディスジャーミノーマではi(12p)が認められ、これは悪性精巣腫瘍でも見られる非ランダムな異常である。胚細胞腫瘍を含む、異なる卵巣悪性腫瘍における染色体変化が示されている。
pmid-3471312.summary_en: Cytogenetic analysis was performed on three malignant ovarian tumors using peritoneal washings or ascitic fluid. A serous cystadenocarcinoma showed a pseudodiploid clone after chemotherapy. An immature teratoma, stage II, showed trisomy 2, del(3)(p14) and der(5)t(5;8). A dysgerminoma, stage IV, showed i(12p), a nonrandom abnormality also seen in malignant testicular tumors. The findings illustrate chromosomal alterations across distinct ovarian malignancies, including germ cell tumors.

pmid-3471997.summary_ja: 米国の精巣がん3,346例を解析し、未婚男性は既婚男性より発症リスクが高いことを示した。白人、黒人、ヒスパニック系のいずれでも同様の傾向があり、非セミノーマではとくに顕著であった。1973〜1982年には45歳未満の未婚男性で発症率が増加し、特に30〜44歳で著しかった。30歳以降の未婚男性は非セミノーマ精巣がんに対して感受性が高いと結論づけられている。
pmid-3471997.summary_en: This US analysis of 3,346 testicular cancer patients found that single men had higher risk than married men across white, Black and Hispanic groups. Excess risk for non-seminoma histologies was seen in several groups. Incidence rose among single men under 45 during 1973 to 1982, notably at ages 30 to 44, while changes for married men were small. The authors conclude that single men after age 30 are more susceptible to non-seminomatous testicular cancer.

pmid-3475660.summary_ja: 11歳男児の上顎に生じた口腔内奇形腫の症例報告。軟骨、平滑筋、呼吸上皮、脳組織、骨格筋を含み、頸部リンパ節の一つは脳組織に置換されていた。性腺外原発の奇形腫の組織像を示す症例である。
pmid-3475660.summary_en: This case report describes an intraoral teratoma in an 11-year-old boy, arising in the maxilla. The tumor contained cartilage, smooth muscle, respiratory epithelium, brain, and skeletal muscle, consistent with a mature teratoma with multiple tissue lineages. Two adjacent cervical lymph nodes showed reactive changes, while another node was largely replaced by brain tissue, a finding that illustrates the histologic spectrum of teratomatous lesions outside the gonads.

pmid-3479288.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ77例を対象に、ガリウム67シンチグラフィの病期診断および再発疑い時の有用性を検討。感度83%、特異度95%であった。非セミノーマでは有用性が低く中止された。
pmid-3479288.summary_en: This study analyzed 77 patients with histologically confirmed testicular seminoma who were assessed and treated between 1977 and 1982 at the Cross Cancer Institute. Gallium-67 citrate scanning was used for initial staging and for suspected recurrence, and was compared with intravenous pyelography and bipedal lymphography. Scan sensitivity was 83% and specificity was 95%. Gallium was less useful in nonseminomatous tumors, so its routine use was discontinued for them.

pmid-3493310.summary_ja: 絨毛癌患者と夫のHLA適合率は60%で、確立した細胞株SMT-cc 1に対する患者T細胞の傷害活性は夫のリンパ球による刺激で上昇した。夫由来リンパ球を用いた免疫療法の可能性を示唆する基礎研究。
pmid-3493310.summary_en: This study examined whether lymphocytes from the husbands of choriocarcinoma patients could be used for immunotherapy. HLA histocompatibility between patients and husbands was 60% in the choriocarcinoma group. A cultured choriocarcinoma line, SMT-cc 1, was established, and patient T-lymphocytes showed increased cytotoxicity against autologous tumor cells after stimulation with the husband's lymphocytes. The authors propose specific immunotherapy by intravenous injection of stimulated lymphocytes.

pmid-3497531.summary_ja: 純粋型精巣セミノーマ200例の胸部X線とCTを比較。胸腔内転移の検出率はX線12.5%、CT15%で、縦隔リンパ節腫大が最多。CTはX線より転移範囲の判定に優れた。
pmid-3497531.summary_en: This study reviewed chest radiographs and CT scans of 200 patients with pure testicular seminoma. Intrathoracic metastases were detected in 12.5% by radiography and 15% by CT, with mediastinal nodal enlargement being the most common manifestation. CT detected disease in five patients with normal radiographs and showed additional sites in four others. CT was more accurate than chest radiography for detecting and defining the extent of metastatic seminoma.

pmid-3497716.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来BeWo細胞はメトトレキサートで増殖が停止し、細胞死ではなく可逆的な合胞体栄養膜様分化を示した。チミジンやロイコボリンがこれを阻害し、チミジン欠乏が分化を誘導すると考えられた。
pmid-3497716.summary_en: This study examined methotrexate effects on cultured human choriocarcinoma BeWo cells. Methotrexate halted proliferation and induced a reversible syncytiotrophoblast-like differentiation rather than cell death. Thymidine or leucovorin blocked both antiproliferative and differentiative effects, while hypoxanthine did not block the antiproliferative effect. The findings suggest that thymidylate starvation drives the reversible differentiated state.

pmid-3501790.summary_ja: 1974〜1983年に日本の16都道府県で登録された妊娠性絨毛性疾患19,951例の統計解析。胞状奇胎（侵入奇胎を含む）の発生率は生児306例に1例だった。組織学的に分類不能な約5%は侵入奇胎や絨毛癌の可能性があり、部分胞状奇胎と完全胞状奇胎の鑑別基準は定まらなかった。
pmid-3501790.summary_en: This 1987 Hum Reprod study analyzes 19,951 trophoblastic disease patients registered across 16 Japanese prefectures from 1974 to 1983, covering about 40% of the national population. The overall incidence of hydatidiform mole including invasive mole was 1 in 306 live births. Incidence per 100,000 women declined alongside birth rates, while the per-live-birth rate did not change significantly. About 5% of cases were undetermined histologically and might be invasive mole or choriocarcinoma, and partial versus complete mole criteria could not be satisfactorily defined.

pmid-3502964.summary_ja: 単為発生した卵母細胞由来のマウス卵巣奇形腫を用い、発生遺伝学的解析を行った1987年の研究。26腫瘍の遺伝子型解析からt複合体までの距離を推定した。t/t腫瘍は著しく少なく、致死t遺伝子のホモ接合胚は原条期に至らなかった。奇形癌形成には三胚葉形成など正常な初期発生段階の通過が必要と示唆された。
pmid-3502964.summary_en: This 1987 Developmental Genetics study uses ovarian teratomas arising from parthenogenetically activated oocytes in LT/Sv mice as a tool for developmental genetics. In 26 tumors genotyped by MHC Southern blotting, the centromere-to-t-complex distance was 5.6 ± 2.3 cM. t/t genotypes were markedly underrepresented among tumors, although T/T genotypes formed teratomas at control-like levels. Lethal t-haplotype homozygous embryos failed to reach the primitive streak, suggesting that teratocarcinoma-forming parthenogenetic embryos must pass through normal early stages, including three germ layer formation and primitive streak formation.

pmid-3503713.summary_ja: 1987年のDevelopment誌掲載の仮説論文。Y染色体上の性腺芽腫座（GBY）遺伝子が、異形成性性腺に性腺芽腫を発生させやすくすると提唱した。GBYは正常男性では精子形成前後に機能する可能性がある。部分欠失Y染色体を持つ患者でのY-DNA解析による検証を提案している。
pmid-3503713.summary_en: This 1987 Development hypothesis paper proposes that a gene on the human Y chromosome, termed GBY (GonadoBlastoma locus on Y), predisposes dysgenetic gonads to develop gonadoblastoma. The authors further propose that GBY has a physiological role in normal males, possibly in or before spermatogenesis. They suggest testing the model with Y-DNA hybridization analysis of gonadoblastoma patients with partial Y deletions, and point to a location in deletion intervals 4B to 7 near the centromere or on the long arm.

pmid-3538918.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍89例を対象に、胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼ（PLAP）抗体の感度を検討した1987年の研究。PLAPはセミノーマの98%、胎児性癌の97%、卵黄嚢腫瘍の85%で陽性だった。精細管内胚細胞腫瘍でも高率に検出された。セミノーマや多くの胎児性癌・卵黄嚢腫瘍に対する高感度マーカーと結論づけられた。
pmid-3538918.summary_en: This 1987 Am J Surg Pathol study tests a polyclonal antibody against placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) in 89 testicular germ cell tumors. PLAP was present in 98% of seminomas, 97% of embryonal carcinomas, and 85% of endodermal sinus tumors, with one of two choriocarcinoma cases focally positive. Intratubular germ cell neoplasia showed PLAP in 98% of evaluable cases. PLAP was also found in gonadoblastoma germ cells and some undescended testes and dysgenetic gonads. The authors conclude PLAP is a highly sensitive marker for seminoma and most embryonal and yolk sac tumors.

pmid-3541031.summary_ja: 小児に多い消化管奇形腫5例（胃2例、膵臓、腸間膜、小網各1例）を後方視的に検討した報告です。CTと超音波検査の所見に着目し、嚢胞成分と充実成分が混在する明瞭な腫瘤、脂肪濃度の領域、充実部内の粗大な球状石灰化を特徴として挙げ、これらの認識が術前診断に役立つと述べています。
pmid-3541031.summary_en: This retrospective review describes five cases of gastrointestinal teratomas, arising in the stomach, pancreas, mesentery, and lesser omentum, mostly in children. The authors emphasize computed tomography and ultrasonography features, including a well-defined mass with separate cystic and solid components, fat-density areas, and coarse globular calcifications within the solid part. Correlating these imaging findings with pathology may enable a correct preoperative diagnosis of teratoma, which is otherwise uncommon and benign.

pmid-3542196.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌（EC）細胞株におけるc-Ki-ras遺伝子の増幅を検討した研究です。PCC3、PCC6、F9株では増幅はみられず、継代の異なるPCC4株間で増幅の程度に大きな不均一性がありました。増幅は実験室での継代中に生じた可能性があり、c-Ki-rasの増幅だけではEC細胞の悪性挙動は決まらないと結論づけています。
pmid-3542196.summary_en: This study examines c-Ki-ras proto-oncogene amplification in murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines, the malignant components of murine teratomas. Amplification was absent in PCC3, PCC6, and F9 lines, and showed marked heterogeneity among three independently passaged PCC4 lines, with two showing amplification and elevated expression, suggesting it arose during laboratory passage. Malignant behavior in syngeneic mice was also assessed. The authors conclude that c-Ki-ras amplification alone does not determine the malignant behavior of EC cells.

pmid-3545020.summary_ja: 出生前超音波検査で診断された頸部奇形腫の1例の症例報告です。気道閉塞を予測して帝王切開の際に手術室の体制を整え、出生後に新生児の呼吸窮迫が生じたため気道を確保しました。児に脳低酸素の所見はなく、神経学的異常もなく成長しています。出生前診断の向上に伴い、耳鼻咽喉科医の周産期の役割が増すと述べています。
pmid-3545020.summary_en: This case report describes a cervical teratoma diagnosed prenatally by ultrasound, in which airway obstruction was anticipated. Resources were mobilized to the operating room for the planned cesarean section, and the neonate developed respiratory distress that required securing the airway. The infant showed no initial evidence of cerebral anoxia and was thriving without neurologic defects at follow-up. The authors emphasize that as prenatal ultrasound improves, otolaryngologists will play a growing role in perinatal planning and in managing airway emergencies at delivery.

pmid-3545938.summary_ja: 篩骨洞から発生したエピグナサス（奇形腫）の男児胎児の症例報告です。羊水過多のため妊娠29週で帝王切開により娩出されましたが、児は数分で死亡しました。このような腫瘍は切除が困難で新生児期に致死的となることが多く、遺伝カウンセリング、産科管理、一部では新生児外科的治療のため出生前診断が重要だと述べています。
pmid-3545938.summary_en: This case report describes a male fetus with epignathus, a teratoma arising from the ethmoidal sinus. The tumor caused hydramnios, and the fetus was delivered by cesarean section at 29 weeks of gestation; the child died within minutes. The authors note such tumors are rarely resectable and usually lethal in the neonatal period due to airway compromise. They stress that prenatal diagnosis is important for genetic counselling, obstetric management, and, in some cases, neonatal surgery.

pmid-3548370.summary_ja: 周産期センターで5年間に診断された仙尾部奇形腫10例の検討です。うち6例は出生前超音波検査で診断されました。腫瘍が大きいため帝王切開率は75%でした。新生児1例は腫瘍の血行過多と破裂により出血性ショックを起こしました。全例で切除腫瘍は良性で、適切な産科・小児科管理により多くの症例で良好な転帰が見込めると結論づけています。
pmid-3548370.summary_en: This series reviews ten sacrococcygeal teratomas diagnosed over five years at a perinatal center, six of them by prenatal ultrasound. Serial scans were performed in three cases, and large tumors led to a 75% cesarean delivery rate. One pregnancy was terminated at 19 weeks. One neonate developed hypovolemic shock from tumor vascularity and rupture. All resected tumors were benign. The authors propose a management plan and expect good outcomes with appropriate obstetric and pediatric care.

pmid-3548446.summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した副腎皮質刺激ホルモン産生性下垂体腺腫によりクッシング症候群を呈した24歳女性の症例報告です。卵巣腫瘍を切除するとACTHとコルチゾールは正常化しました。病理組織学的に、細胞質内にACTHを有する顆粒に富む腫瘍細胞が確認されました。良性嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した機能性下垂体腺腫の初の報告で、クッシング症候群の新たな原因だと述べています。
pmid-3548446.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with severe Cushing's syndrome caused by a corticotroph cell pituitary adenoma arising within a benign cystic ovarian teratoma. She had sustained hypercortisolemia without suppression of ACTH or cortisol, but no pituitary mass was seen. Resection of the ovarian tumor normalized hormone levels. Immunohistochemistry showed densely granulated tumor cells with intracytoplasmic ACTH. The authors believe this is the first reported functioning pituitary adenoma arising within a benign cystic teratoma, identifying a new cause of Cushing's syndrome.

pmid-3548944.summary_ja: 性分化異常に伴う腫瘍形成のリスクを総説した論文です。停留精巣では正常な陰嚢内精巣の約10倍腫瘍化しやすく、XY性腺異形成では少なくとも30%に性腺腫瘍（主に性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ）がみられます。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍も多いとされています。多くの症例で早期の性腺摘出を勧め、完全型アンドロゲン不応症では思春期後の精巣摘除術を推奨しています。
pmid-3548944.summary_en: This review examines how disorders of sexual differentiation increase neoplasia risk. Undescended testes carry at least a tenfold higher risk of tumor, and gonadal tumors, mainly gonadoblastomas and dysgerminomas, occur in at least 30% of XY gonadal dysgenesis and 15-20% of 45,X/46,XY patients. Extragonadal germ cell tumors are also more common. The authors recommend early gonadal removal in many patients and orchiectomy after pubertal feminization in complete androgen insensitivity. They suggest gonadotropins alone are not carcinogenic.

pmid-3549933.summary_ja: 肺絨毛癌15例を臨床病理学的に検討し、hCGモニタリングの方法を評価した研究です。尿中hCGのLH様反応が持続する症例や、血清β-hCGが感度以上の症例では生存腫瘍細胞が多く確認されました。血清β-hCGが検出限界未満でも残存する例があり、β-hCG-CTP-EIAが血清hCGモニタリングに最も有用と結論づけています。
pmid-3549933.summary_en: This study analyzes 15 cases of pulmonary choriocarcinoma, focusing on hCG monitoring systems. Viable tumor cells persisted in most cases with a continued urinary hCG LH-level pattern and in cases with serum beta-hCG above assay sensitivity. Persistence was also found in some cases when serum beta-hCG fell below the detection limit. Beta-hCG-CTP enzyme immunoassay detected viable tumor cells in all operative specimens with levels above its sensitivity, suggesting it is the most useful serum marker for monitoring.

pmid-3551874.summary_ja: 卵巣のストルマ性カルチノイド6例を免疫組織化学と電子顕微鏡で検討した。甲状腺濾胞上皮はサイログロブリン陽性と超微細構造で確認され、カルチノイド細胞が上皮を置換していた。ソマトスタチン、クロモグラニン、セロトニンなど複数の神経内分泌物質が陽性で、髄様癌と類似するが独立した名称に値すると結論した。
pmid-3551874.summary_en: Six ovarian strumal carcinoids were examined by immunohistochemistry and electron microscopy. Thyroid follicular epithelium was confirmed by thyroglobulin positivity and ultrastructure. Carcinoid cells progressively replaced the thyroid epithelium and expressed multiple neuroendocrine substances, including somatostatin, chromogranin, serotonin, glucagon, insulin, and gastrin. Carcinoembryonic antigen was absent. The authors conclude that strumal carcinoid resembles medullary thyroid carcinoma but differs enough to warrant a separate designation.

pmid-3551876.summary_ja: 閉経後女性の原発性肺絨毛癌1例を報告した。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の免疫染色と剖検で肺原発と確認された。過去の報告は15例未満と整理された。上皮細胞の化生や分化異常から発生し、体細胞由来の悪性腫瘍で胎児性遺伝子が発現したものと考察された。
pmid-3551876.summary_en: A postmenopausal woman had primary choriocarcinoma of the lung, confirmed by immunoperoxidase staining for hCG and by autopsy showing a pulmonary origin. The authors review the literature, noting fewer than 15 previously reported primary pulmonary cases. They propose that the tumor arises from epithelial cells undergoing metaplasia or divergent differentiation, and that it represents expression of a fetal gene in a malignancy of somatic origin. This is an extragonadal, nongestational form of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3552955.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ10例で、MHC抗原と炎症細胞浸潤を単クローン抗体で検討した。腫瘍細胞はHLAクラスI・II抗原およびβ2ミクログロブリンを発現しなかった。浸潤はT細胞が主体で、腫瘍小葉内では細胞傷害・抑制性、辺縁ではヘルパー・誘導性T細胞が優位であった。2種類の免疫反応が関与し、炎症反応にMHC抗原は不要と考察された。
pmid-3552955.summary_en: Ten testicular seminomas were studied with monoclonal antibodies to examine major histocompatibility antigens and the inflammatory infiltrate. Tumor cells did not express HLA class I or II antigens or beta-2 microglobulin. All tumors had inflammatory infiltrates, mainly T cells, with cytotoxic-suppressor cells predominating in tumor lobules and helper-inducer cells at the periphery. Macrophage aggregates were present in most tumors. The authors suggest that two immune reactions operate and that MHC antigens are not required for the inflammatory response.

pmid-3556420.summary_ja: マウスPC13胎児性癌細胞の無血清馴化培地から、3T3線維芽細胞に有糸分裂促進活性を示すポリペプチド増殖因子を単離した。塩基性FGFに近い溶出挙動とヘパリン結合性を示した。中胚葉由来の胎児性癌派生細胞に対してのみ増殖促進作用を示した。以前報告された胎児性癌由来増殖因子と同一の可能性が高いと結論された。
pmid-3556420.summary_en: Serum-free medium conditioned by PC13 mouse embryonal carcinoma cells contained a polypeptide growth factor mitogenic for Swiss 3T3 fibroblasts. It eluted from cation-exchange chromatography near basic FGF and bound heparin-Sepharose similarly. It stimulated mesodermal-derived embryonal carcinoma cells but not endodermal or ectodermal derivatives. The authors conclude that PC13 cells secrete a basic heparin-binding growth factor, most likely identical to a previously described embryonal carcinoma-derived growth factor.

pmid-3558376.summary_ja: レチノイン酸処理によりF9胎児性癌細胞が胚体外内胚葉様細胞へ分化する。分化中に誘導される中間径フィラメント蛋白質p57とp54を同定した。両者は汎中間径フィラメント抗体と抗ケラチン血清に反応した。内胚葉性ケラチンendo A/Bとは異なる発現パターンを示した。
pmid-3558376.summary_en: Retinoic acid induced differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells into extraembryonic endoderm-like cells. Two-dimensional electrophoresis and immunoblotting identified two new intermediate filament proteins, p57 and p54, induced during differentiation. Both reacted with a pan-intermediate filament antibody and with anti-keratin serum. They differed from the endoderm keratins endo A and endo B, being abundant in differentiating cells but nearly absent from terminally differentiated cells, which suggests distinct expression patterns.

pmid-3559872.summary_ja: 1948年から1986年にメルボルンで治療された仙尾部奇形腫57例を後方視的に検討した。良性40例、悪性19例で、良性は乳児期に多く切除されていた。悪性例は1970年以降の多剤化学療法と計画的に遅延した外科的切除で生存が改善し、1976～1980年の5例中3例が無病生存した。シスプラチン併用療法では初期奏効が良好だったが、長期的効果は不明である。
pmid-3559872.summary_en: This retrospective review of 57 patients with sacrococcygeal teratoma treated in Melbourne from 1948 to 1986 found 40 benign and 19 malignant tumors. Benign lesions were mostly excised in infancy, whereas malignant tumors presented later and had high mortality before 1975. After intensive multiagent chemotherapy was introduced in 1970, delayed surgical resection improved survival, with three of five patients treated from 1976 to 1980 surviving disease-free. Cisplatin-based regimens produced impressive early responses, but long-term benefit remained unclear.

pmid-3560342.summary_ja: 性腺外縦隔セミノーマの症例報告。放線菌素Dとクロラムブシルで寛解後、約19年で再発した。鎖骨上リンパ節1個の切除に続き、シスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシンによる併用化学療法を行い、3年間再発を認めていない。胚細胞腫瘍として報告された最長の再発間隔とされる。
pmid-3560342.summary_en: This case report describes an extragonadal mediastinal seminoma that recurred nearly 19 years after initial remission achieved with actinomycin D and chlorambucil. The recurrence was treated by excising a single involved supraclavicular lymph node, followed by combination chemotherapy with cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin. The patient has remained free of residual disease for three years. The authors note that this is the longest reported interval to recurrence for a germ cell neoplasm.

pmid-3560455.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴う稀な合併症である腹膜神経膠腫症の症例報告と、既報38例のレビュー。原発腫瘍の悪性度は0～3と様々だった。39例中5例が死亡し、他は3か月から38年生存した。予後は治療法によらず概ね良好で、原発腫瘍には保存的治療、播種には治療不要と提言している。
pmid-3560455.summary_en: This Japanese report describes gliomatosis peritonei, a rare complication of solid ovarian teratoma in which mature glial tissue implants on the peritoneum or omentum. The authors present one case and review 38 previously reported cases. Primary tumor grades ranged from 0 to 3, and only five cases were composed entirely of mature tissue. Five of 39 patients died, while the rest survived from 3 months to 38 years. Conservative management of the primary tumor was recommended, with no treatment required for the implants.

pmid-3563798.summary_ja: 44歳女性の良性嚢胞性奇形腫の自然破裂例の症例報告。この稀な現象の臨床的特徴を記述し、文献をレビューしている。要旨には発生臓器の記載はないが、女性の嚢胞性奇形腫は卵巣由来が多い。抄録のみのため、詳細な臨床情報は不明である。
pmid-3563798.summary_en: This case report presents a 44-year-old woman with spontaneous rupture of a benign cystic teratoma. The authors describe the clinical features of this rare phenomenon and review the relevant literature. The abstract does not specify the organ of origin, although cystic teratomas in women most commonly arise in the ovary. Because the source text is a brief abstract, further clinical detail is not available.

pmid-3567879.summary_ja: 精巣原発の混合型胚細胞腫瘍を、均衡型(13;14)転座保因者から細胞遺伝学的に解析した。主体は胎児性癌で奇形腫成分を伴った。染色体数は62本が最頻で、非ランダムな9つの異常を認めた。文献上の精巣腫瘍のデータと比較し、体質性転座と悪性腫瘍の関連を考察している。
pmid-3567879.summary_en: This cytogenetic study analyzed a primary testicular tumor from a patient found to carry a balanced (13q14q) translocation. Histologically the tumor was a mixed germ cell neoplasm, predominantly embryonal carcinoma with teratomatous elements. Karyotyping showed a modal count of 62 chromosomes and nine nonrandomly acquired abnormalities, including an abnormal chromosome 1 and a probable i(12p). The findings are compared with literature data on human testicular neoplasms, and a possible link between constitutional t(13q14q) and malignancy is discussed.

pmid-3568136.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌由来のTera-2細胞株のサブクローンを、レチノイン酸で分化誘導した際の細胞周期の変化を解析した。増殖抑制はラグなく生じ、S期延長とG1期延長が関与し、細胞はG1期に蓄積した。マウスEC細胞株（PC13、P19）とは反応が異なることも示した。
pmid-3568136.summary_en: This study examines cell cycle kinetics during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of Tera-2 subclones, derived from a human embryonal carcinoma line. Using a transition probability model, the authors show that growth inhibition occurs without a lag and is partly due to a longer S phase, with a larger contribution from a prolonged G1 phase that causes cells to accumulate there. In contrast, murine EC lines PC13 and P19 show a lag of about two cell cycles and mainly a longer S phase, highlighting differing human and murine responses.

pmid-3568555.summary_ja: フィレンツェ大学放射線科で1960〜1983年に治療された純粋型卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ29例の報告である。手術の後、術後放射線療法の有無にかかわらず、5例が再発し、そのうち多くは照射野外での再発であった。3例が死亡し、全生存率は90%であった。生存率は病期だけでなく、初期の正確な病期分類と適切な治療にも左右される。術後放射線療法を省略できる患者選択基準についても考察している。
pmid-3568555.summary_en: This series of 29 patients with pure ovarian dysgerminoma treated at the University of Florence (1960–1983) describes outcomes after surgery with or without postoperative radiotherapy. Five patients relapsed, mostly outside the irradiated field, and three died. Overall survival was 90%. The authors conclude that survival depends on accurate initial staging and appropriate therapy, and discuss criteria for withholding postoperative radiotherapy in selected early-stage patients.

pmid-3569331.summary_ja: 出産後わずか2か月で、授乳中の女性に生じた卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。腫瘍は例外的に大きく、急速に発育していた。著者らは、妊娠および授乳に伴うホルモンの影響が腫瘍の進行に関与した可能性を指摘している。ただし本報告は単一症例であり、因果関係は確立されていない。
pmid-3569331.summary_en: A case report of a rapidly enlarging yolk sac tumor of the ovary in a woman who was breastfeeding her baby, delivered only two months earlier. The tumor was notable for its exceptional size and rapid development. The authors suggest that hormonal influences of pregnancy and lactation may have contributed to tumor progression, though causality cannot be established from a single case. Clinical details beyond the abstract are limited.

pmid-3571609.summary_ja: 大網に生じた稀な良性嚢胞性奇形腫の7例目の報告である。これまで術前に診断された例はなく、卵巣奇形腫に合併した例が6例報告されていた。本症例では術前に超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)が行われた。この稀な婦人科疾患の評価において、術前画像診断の役割に注目している。
pmid-3571609.summary_en: Case report of a rare benign cystic teratoma of the omentum. Previously, no omental cases had been diagnosed preoperatively, and six cases had been reported in association with ovarian teratoma. In this seventh case, ultrasound and computed tomography were used before surgery. The report highlights the role of preoperative imaging in evaluating this uncommon gynecologic condition, which is otherwise typically identified only at surgery.

pmid-3574816.summary_ja: 1935〜1985年にアイオワ大学で治療された純粋型卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ24例の報告である。病期Iの片側性腫瘍10例は無病生存を保っており、病期IAでは片側付属器切除術のみで全例が生存した。進行例11例のうち9例が無病生存している。再発例として紹介された3例は全例が死亡しており、再発後の予後は不良である。
pmid-3574816.summary_en: A series of 24 patients with pure ovarian dysgerminoma treated at the University of Iowa from 1935 to 1985. Ten patients had stage I unilateral disease and remain disease-free, and all patients treated with unilateral adnexectomy alone for stage IA survived. Of 11 patients with advanced disease treated at the institution, nine are alive without disease. Three referred patients with recurrent disease did not survive, showing a poor prognosis after relapse.

pmid-3576274.summary_ja: 16歳の女児が充実性卵巣奇形腫(グレード0)に対して片側付属器切除術を受けた症例報告である。傍大動脈リンパ節と大網に、グレード0の神経グリア転移が認められた。卵巣奇形腫の神経グリア成分が腹腔内リンパ節や大網へ転移し得ることを示している。稀な転移形式であり、臨床的に注意が必要である。
pmid-3576274.summary_en: Case report of a 16-year-old girl who underwent unilateral adnexectomy for a solid ovarian teratoma (grade 0). Periaortic lymph nodes and omentum contained grade 0 neuroglial metastases, demonstrating extraovarian spread of the tumor's neuroglial component. The report illustrates that neuroglial tissue can metastasize from an ovarian teratoma to abdominal lymph nodes and omentum, a rare pattern of metastatic behavior that warrants clinical attention.

pmid-3576381.summary_ja: 1973〜1984年にグルート・シューア病院で治療された精巣セミノーマ47例の後方視的検討である。黒人および混血患者では精巣下降不全の合併率が高かった。精巣摘除術後の後腹膜照射で5年生存率は87%であった。病期I・IIA/Bでは再発が少なく、進行例にはシスプラチン併用化学療法が有効であった。病期I・IIA/Bには後腹膜照射、より進行した病期には化学療法が推奨されている。
pmid-3576381.summary_en: This retrospective review of 47 patients with testicular seminoma treated at Groote Schuur Hospital between 1973 and 1984 found a higher rate of testicular maldescent among Black and mixed-race patients. Retroperitoneal irradiation after orchiectomy gave a 5-year survival of 87%, with few relapses in stage I and IIA/B disease. Irradiation also controlled some advanced disease, and cisplatin-based chemotherapy was effective in unresectable cases. The authors recommend retroperitoneal irradiation for stage I and IIA/B disease and cisplatin combination chemotherapy for more advanced disease.

pmid-3578423.summary_ja: 両側嚢胞性奇形腫の既往がある女性の体外受精のための採卵時に得られた、2細胞期の単為生殖胚の可能性がある症例を報告している。卵巣奇形腫の既往と単為生殖の関連が示唆されるが、単一症例であり胚の由来は確認されていない。臨床的意義は不明であり、今後の検討が必要である。
pmid-3578423.summary_en: This brief report describes a possible two-cell parthenogenetic embryo aspirated during oocyte retrieval for in vitro fertilization in a woman with a history of bilateral cystic teratomas. The case raises the possibility of parthenogenetic development in a patient with prior ovarian teratoma. Because it describes a single patient and the embryo's origin was not confirmed, the findings remain a case observation. The clinical significance of the finding is uncertain.

pmid-3580267.summary_ja: 1970〜1981年にエディンバラの地域センターで治療された精巣セミノーマ152例の検討である。5年生存率は84.4%であった。病期、原発巣のT分類、初回治療時期が生存に影響し、1979年以降の治療例で予後が良好であった。臨床病期Iには予防的後腹膜照射、IIA/Bには放射線療法、IIC・III・IVには化学療法が推奨されている。
pmid-3580267.summary_en: This regional study reviewed 152 patients with testicular seminoma treated in Edinburgh from 1970 to 1981, most of them primarily with radiotherapy. Five-year actuarial survival was 84.4%. Clinical stage, T-stage of the primary tumor, and date of first treatment significantly influenced survival, and patients treated after 1979 fared better. The authors recommend prophylactic retroperitoneal irradiation for clinical stage I, radiotherapy for stages IIA and IIB, and chemotherapy for stages IIC, III, and IV. Radiation therapy remains an important option.

pmid-3580759.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣奇形腫101例に対して腹部骨盤CTを施行し、18か月以上追跡した検討である。腹部のみの再発は8例で、CTの陰性的中率は92%であった。後腹膜リンパ節転移の分布は後腹膜リンパ節郭清の報告と一致した。病期分類にはCTが第一選択の画像診断であり、侵襲的検査は正当化されないと結論づけている。
pmid-3580759.summary_en: This study evaluated abdominopelvic computed tomography in 101 patients with stage I testicular teratoma, followed for at least 18 months. Only eight patients relapsed in the abdomen alone, and CT had a negative predictive value of 92%. In patients with retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy on CT, the distribution of disease closely matched that reported after retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. The authors conclude that CT is the imaging modality of choice for staging and that invasive staging techniques are not justified.

pmid-3580775.summary_ja: 1983〜1985年に、臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマ52例を精巣摘除術後に、リンパ節照射を行わず観察した検討である。13%(7例)が再発し、多くは後腹膜リンパ節に生じた。術前にhCGが上昇していた8例では再発はなく、hCGが正常であった14例では1例が再発した。これらの結果が今後の管理方針に与える意義について考察している。
pmid-3580775.summary_en: This study followed 52 patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma after orchiectomy, without lymph node irradiation, between 1983 and 1985. Seven patients (13%) relapsed, mostly in retroperitoneal lymph nodes, and most relapses occurred within the first two years. Among patients with elevated serum hCG before orchiectomy, none relapsed, whereas one of 14 patients with normal hCG relapsed. The authors discuss the implications of these findings for future management policy in surveillance.

pmid-3581415.summary_ja: ヒト妊娠性絨毛癌の異種移植モデル(CC3)と細胞株(JAR)を用いて、エトポシドとミトゾロミドの抗腫瘍活性を検討している。マウスにおける両薬の活性は限定的で、このモデルは臨床での薬剤選択には適さないと示唆された。組織内濃度は血漿濃度の一部であった。JAR細胞では、エトポシドの作用は曝露時間に強く依存した。ミトゾロミドは効果が乏しかった。
pmid-3581415.summary_en: This study tested etoposide and mitozolomide against gestational choriocarcinoma in vivo and in vitro. In nude mice bearing a CC3 xenograft, both agents showed only marginal activity, suggesting the model is poor for selecting clinical agents. Tumor tissue drug concentrations were 60% of plasma for mitozolomide and 30% for etoposide. In the JAR choriocarcinoma cell line, etoposide produced maximal cell kill with 3 to 24 hours of exposure, showing the importance of exposure time, whereas mitozolomide had little effect.

pmid-3581678.summary_ja: 若年男性の副腎に生じた大きな腫瘤と肺転移を伴う性腺外奇形腫の症例である。精巣の異常はなく、血清AFPとhCGは正常であった。副腎摘除術により診断された。原発不明の悪性腫瘍を呈する若年男性では、有効な化学療法が存在するため、本疾患を念頭に置くべきと強調されている。腫瘍マーカーが正常でも診断を除外できないことを示す。
pmid-3581678.summary_en: This case report describes extragonadal teratoma presenting as a large adrenal mass with lung metastases in a young man. He had no testicular abnormality, and serum alpha-fetoprotein and hCG were normal. The diagnosis was established by adrenalectomy. The authors emphasize considering this tumor in young men with malignancy of unknown primary, because effective chemotherapy is available. The case highlights that normal tumor markers do not exclude this diagnosis.

pmid-3581859.summary_ja: 1987年の報告で、仙尾部腫瘍5例をCTで評価した。CTは術前診断と腫瘍の進展範囲の把握に大きく貢献した。矢状断像は病期分類を容易にし、軸位断像では横断面への進展、特に脊柱管内進展が描出された。仙尾部奇形腫の術前評価におけるCTの有用性が示された。
pmid-3581859.summary_en: This 1987 report describes five cases of sacrococcygeal tumors evaluated with axial and, in some cases, direct sagittal computed tomography. CT greatly aided correct preoperative diagnosis and defined tumor extent. Sagittal scans allowed the tumors to be staged readily, while axial scans revealed transverse extension, particularly intraspinal extension. The authors conclude that CT is valuable for preoperative assessment of sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-3583415.summary_ja: 1987年の研究では、純粋セミノーマ3例に含まれる合胞体栄養膜様細胞(STLC)5個を電子顕微鏡で観察した。いずれも正常の合胞体栄養膜細胞と同一の超微細構造を示し、周囲は類洞様構造とセミノーマ細胞に囲まれていた。STLCは真の合胞体栄養膜細胞であるが、その発生機序は不明とされた。
pmid-3583415.summary_en: This 1987 study used electron microscopy to examine five syncytiotrophoblast-like cells (STLC) from three pure seminomas. All five showed ultrastructural features identical to normal syncytiotrophoblastic cells, and were surrounded by sinusoidal spaces and seminoma-like cells. The authors could not entirely exclude cytotrophoblastic cells. They concluded that STLC in seminomas are truly syncytiotrophoblastic, while their origin remains unexplained.

pmid-3583416.summary_ja: 1987年の研究では、古典的セミノーマや奇形腫と同様に、精母細胞性セミノーマが精細管内上皮内癌(CIS)から生じるかを検討した。15例を評価したところ、隣接精細管のある12例では全例でCISを認めなかった。DNA含量は主に二倍体または四倍体であった。他の精巣胚細胞腫瘍とは起源細胞が異なるとの見解が示された。
pmid-3583416.summary_en: This 1987 study examined whether spermatocytic seminoma arises from intratubular carcinoma-in-situ (CIS), as classical seminomas and teratomas are thought to. Fifteen tumours were assessed for adjacent CIS and DNA content. CIS was absent in all twelve specimens with adjacent seminiferous tubules, and DNA distributions were mostly diploid or tetraploid. The authors propose that spermatocytic seminoma has a different cell of origin from other testicular germ cell tumours.

pmid-3583417.summary_ja: 1987年のレクチン組織化学研究では、ヒトの精子形成過程の胚細胞、CIS細胞、セミノーマにおける糖鎖分布を比較した。胚細胞は分化段階に応じてグルコシル基の発現が変化した。CIS細胞は正常な精子形成細胞とは異なるレクチン結合を示し、セミノーマ細胞と類似していた。CIS胚細胞の悪性の性質を支持する所見とされた。
pmid-3583417.summary_en: This 1987 lectin histochemistry study compared glycoconjugate patterns in human germ cells during spermatogenesis, in carcinoma-in-situ (CIS) cells, and in seminoma. Germ cells showed stage-specific changes in glucosyl expression. CIS cells displayed lectin binding distinct from normal spermatogenic cells but similar to seminoma cells. The authors suggest this supports the malignant nature of CIS germ cells.

pmid-3583419.summary_ja: 1987年の研究では、病期Iセミノーマ26例に対し予防的放射線療法の代替として、生化学的・画像的サーベイランスを前向きに行った。再発は4例(15%)のみで、いずれも化学療法で救済された。しかし診断が遅れやすく、日常診療には不向きとされた。放射線療法と短期補助カルボプラチン療法の比較には無作為化試験が必要とされた。
pmid-3583419.summary_en: This 1987 study evaluated prospective biochemical and radiological surveillance in 26 patients with stage I seminoma, as an alternative to prophylactic radiotherapy. Only four patients (15%) relapsed, all salvaged by chemotherapy. However, the late and difficult diagnosis made the approach unsuitable for routine service use. The authors suggest that a randomized trial is needed to compare radiotherapy with short courses of adjuvant carboplatin.

pmid-3583420.summary_ja: 1987年の研究では、胎生期から成人期までの精巣、停留精巣および腫瘍の計82検体で胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PlAP)を免疫組織化学的に検出した。PlAPは原始胚細胞の細胞膜に発現し、他の正常組織では認められなかった。CISの93%、セミノーマの94%で陽性で、腫瘍の分化とともに陽性率は低下した。胚細胞腫瘍で再出現する原始胚細胞のマーカーとして提唱された。
pmid-3583420.summary_en: This 1987 study localized placental alkaline phosphatase (PlAP) by immunohistochemistry in 82 testicular samples spanning embryonic to adult stages, cryptorchid tissue and tumours. PlAP was expressed on primitive germ cells but not in other normal tissues. It was positive in 93% of carcinoma-in-situ and 94% of seminomas, with positivity declining as tumours differentiated. The authors propose PlAP as a marker of primitive germ cells that reappears in germ cell neoplasms.

pmid-3583856.summary_ja: 1987年のミラノ国立腫瘍研究所の報告では、1970～1982年に治療した卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ25例を検討した。病期I 13例は中央値77か月のフォローアップで全例が生存し無病であった。病期III 12例中4例が再発し、5年無再発生存率は61.4%だった。放射線療法による無月経は7.7%に認められた。進行例にはより積極的な治療が必要とされた。
pmid-3583856.summary_en: This 1987 report from the Milan National Cancer Institute describes 25 patients with ovarian dysgerminoma treated between 1970 and 1982 with surgery and radiotherapy tailored to disease extent. All 13 stage I patients were alive and disease-free at a median follow-up of 77 months. Among 12 stage III patients, four relapsed, with 5-year relapse-free survival of 61.4%. Radiation-induced amenorrhea occurred in 7.7%. The authors call for more aggressive treatment of advanced disease.

pmid-3584487.summary_ja: 1987年の症例報告では、セミノーマに類似した精巣胚細胞腫瘍の2例を提示した。セミノーマと充実性胎児性癌は肉眼・組織学的に重なる所見を示すことが示された。両者を鑑別するための有用な特徴が示され、診断の一助となる。本症例は、鑑別診断の難しさを具体的に示すものである。
pmid-3584487.summary_en: This 1987 case report describes two patients with testicular germ cell tumour in whom embryonal carcinoma closely mimicked seminoma. It illustrates the gross and histological overlap between seminoma and solid embryonal carcinoma. The authors highlight distinguishing features that may aid diagnosis in such cases. The report underscores the diagnostic difficulty posed by these two tumour types when they present with similar morphology.

pmid-3585108.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株GCH-1をヌードマウスで繰り返し移植し、肺転移能の高いサブラインGCH-1(m)を樹立した。GCH-1(m)は肺転移を高率に生じ、hCGとβ-hCGの分泌も多かった。肺抽出物により増殖が促進され、絨毛癌の転移研究に有用なモデルとなる。
pmid-3585108.summary_en: Investigators derived a subline, GCH-1(m), from the human choriocarcinoma line GCH-1 by serial passage in nude mice. The subline reliably formed lung metastases, grew faster in vitro than the parent line (doubling time 36.2 vs 22.6 hours), and secreted more hCG and β-hCG. Lung extracts stimulated its growth. The model offers a tool for studying choriocarcinoma metastasis.

pmid-3589527.summary_ja: 父と息子がともに精巣がんを発症した稀な家族例の症例報告である。両者とも転移性の胎児性癌であった。父子発症の報告は少なく、病因解明に環境要因と遺伝要因の両面から寄与しうると述べている。
pmid-3589527.summary_en: The authors describe a father and son who both developed testicular cancer, an unusual finding within a family. Both tumors were embryonal carcinoma with metastatic spread. Because few father-son pairs have been reported, the case adds material to research on the etiology of testicular cancer, where environmental and genetic factors are both considered.

pmid-3590172.summary_ja: 奇形癌OTT6050をマウスに移植し、宿主ホルモンが腫瘍増殖に与える影響を検討した。加齢に伴う血清ホルモン値の変化が見られ、エストラジオール投与は特に老齢雌マウスで増殖を促進した。雌の加齢による増殖低下は、部分的にエストロゲン低下によると結論している。
pmid-3590172.summary_en: Teratocarcinoma OTT6050 was transplanted into mice of different ages and sexes to examine how host hormones affect tumor growth. Serum hormone levels changed with age, and estradiol administration accelerated tumor growth, especially in old female mice, restoring a rate close to that in young mice. The authors conclude that estrogen decline partly explains the slower growth of this tumor in aged females.

pmid-3593569.summary_ja: 1960～1985年に放射線療法施設で治療された卵巣未分化胚細胞腫27例のリンパ管造影所見を検討した。44%でリンパ節陽性で、陽性例は全例が大動脈傍リンパ節に病変を認めた。病期分類とフォローアップにおける本検査の意義を論じている。
pmid-3593569.summary_en: Lymphangiography findings were reviewed in 27 patients with ovarian dysgerminoma treated at a radiation therapy unit between 1960 and 1985. Nodes were positive in 44% of cases, and all positive cases showed paraaortic node involvement. The authors discuss how lymphography informs staging and follow-up decisions in patients with this tumor.

pmid-3594357.summary_ja: 19歳男性の精巣原発混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、リンパ節転移は主に絨毛癌であった。絨毛癌の複数の部位に絨毛様構造がみられ、男性例での報告は初めてと述べている。精巣絨毛癌の組織学的特徴を示した症例報告である。
pmid-3594357.summary_en: A 19-year-old man presented with a mixed germ cell tumor metastatic from the testis, with predominantly choriocarcinoma in the lymph node metastases. Several areas of choriocarcinoma showed chorionic villous-like structures, which had not previously been described in a male patient. The report documents this histologic feature in a case of testicular choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3594367.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法で治癒した転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者13例の骨髄系前駆細胞を検討した。通常の骨髄塗抹標本は正常でも、6例でコロニー形成が異常で、多くの例でプロスタグランジンEによる増殖抑制に対する感受性が低下していた。治療後の生存者では長期フォローアップが必要と述べている。
pmid-3594367.summary_en: Myeloid progenitor cells were studied in 13 patients who had been cured of metastatic germ cell tumors after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Six showed abnormal colony formation, and most had decreased sensitivity of granulocyte-macrophage progenitors to prostaglandin E inhibition, despite normal routine marrow smears. The authors suggest defects in myelopoiesis may persist after treatment and call for long-term surveillance of survivors.

pmid-3594400.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者124例を後方視的に検討した研究。縦隔への放射線療法を受けた群のみで心疾患が6例発生し（うち突然死2例）、非照射群との差は統計学的に有意だった（P=0.019）。ただし一般集団との比較では両群とも有意差はなく、縦隔照射群の観察/期待比は1.97であった。追加の多施設検証が必要とされている。
pmid-3594400.summary_en: This retrospective study of 124 seminoma patients compared cardiac outcomes after mediastinal irradiation with those after infradiaphragmatic-only treatment. All six cardiac complications, including two sudden deaths, occurred in the mediastinal-irradiation group, and the between-group difference was statistically significant (P = 0.019). Compared with the general population, however, neither group differed significantly, although the observed-to-expected ratio was 1.97 in the mediastinal group. The authors call for confirmation in further series.

pmid-3594413.summary_ja: 46,XXの androgenetic 胞状奇胎21例と正常妊娠14例の絨毛細胞核のDNA量をフローサイトメトリーで測定。15例で3倍体から4倍体領域の核が多い高DNA量パターンを示し、侵入奇胎や絨毛癌に類似していた。この群は既報の「II型」奇胎に相当すると考えられ、DNA倍数性と奇胎の亜型の関連が示唆された。
pmid-3594413.summary_en: Flow cytometry of villous nuclei was used to measure DNA content in 14 normal pregnancies and 21 46,XX androgenetic moles. Six molar specimens had a low mean DNA content similar to normal villi. Fifteen showed a high mean DNA content with many triploid-to-tetraploid nuclei, a pattern that resembles invasive moles and choriocarcinoma. The authors suggest the high-DNA group corresponds to the previously described type II moles. The study links DNA ploidy patterns to molar subtypes.

pmid-3598610.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが正常化し画像上の奏効が得られた進行セミノーマ41例を検討。3cm以上の残存腫瘤を有した14例中6例で生細胞腫瘍が確認された。残存腫瘤を認めない患者では生存腫瘍は認められなかった。3cm以上の残存腫瘤には追加治療が必要とされ、それ未満では慎重な経過観察が可能とされる。
pmid-3598610.summary_en: Forty-one advanced seminoma patients with normal markers and a radiographic response after cisplatin-based chemotherapy underwent reevaluation of residual disease. Six of 14 patients with residual masses of 3 cm or more had viable tumor, while none of the patients without residual mass had viable disease at surgery. The authors conclude that residual masses of 3 cm or greater warrant additional therapy, whereas smaller masses or normal imaging can be managed by close observation.

pmid-3598693.summary_ja: 新生児に生じた頸後頭部奇形腫の症例で、この部位における3例目の報告であり、新生児期に切除された最初の例である。放射線学的および組織学的所見、治療、フォローアップが文献レビューとともに記述された。性腺外奇形腫のまれな発症例を示し、新生児における早期外科的切除の実施可能性を示している。
pmid-3598693.summary_en: The authors present a neonate with a cervico-occipital teratoma, the third reported case in this unusual location and the first excised during the neonatal period. Radiographic and histological findings, treatment, and follow-up are described, along with a literature review. The report documents an uncommon extragonadal teratoma presentation in a newborn and highlights early surgical excision as feasible.

pmid-3599151.summary_ja: 1987年の報告で、10年間に集められた前縦隔の良性成熟奇形腫5例のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を記述している。多くは嚢胞性で、水より高いCT値を示し、一部に石灰化や脂肪を認めた。隣接構造への癒着はCTで全例正確に予測された。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の起源と病理も簡潔に総説している。
pmid-3599151.summary_en: This 1987 study describes computed tomography (CT) findings in five benign mature teratomas of the anterior mediastinum collected over ten years. Most lesions were predominantly cystic with CT attenuation higher than water, and some contained calcification or fat. CT accurately predicted adherence to adjacent structures in all cases. Most patients were under 22 years old. The authors also briefly review the origin and pathology of mediastinal germ cell tumors.

pmid-3599203.summary_ja: 精巣がん(胎児性がん)に対する化学療法と開腹術の4年後に生じた巨大な腹壁腫瘤の症例報告である。当初は胚細胞腫瘍の再発が疑われた。完全切除により再発ではなく腹壁のデスモイド腫瘍と判明し、強力な化学療法を回避できた。再発が疑われる際には組織学的確認の重要性を示す症例である。
pmid-3599203.summary_en: This report describes a large abdominal wall mass that developed four years after chemotherapy and laparotomy for stage III embryonal testicular cancer. It was initially suspected to be a recurrent germ cell neoplasm. Complete surgical excision revealed a desmoid tumor of the abdominal wall rather than recurrent cancer. Because the mass was excised rather than treated with aggressive chemotherapy, unnecessary treatment was avoided. The case highlights the importance of histologic confirmation when evaluating suspected relapse.

pmid-3601738.summary_ja: 生後3日以内に非侵襲的に診断され、外科的に切除された心膜内奇形腫の新生児例である。心エコーとコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)の診断精度を比較している。重症新生児の管理において非侵襲的評価が優れると論じている。稀な縦隔腫瘍であり、迅速な画像診断が早期手術に役立つことを示している。
pmid-3601738.summary_en: This report describes a neonate with intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed noninvasively and surgically removed within the first three days of life. The authors compare the diagnostic accuracy of echocardiography and computed tomography. They argue that noninvasive evaluation is superior in managing critically ill infants with this rare mediastinal tumor. The case shows that rapid imaging can guide timely surgical intervention in neonates.

pmid-3602987.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術の8か月後に肺転移を切除され、その9年後に対側精巣にセミノーマを生じた症例の報告である。積極的治療により精巣セミノーマの治療成績が向上したと述べている。生存期間の延長に伴い、今後は異時性の対側精巣セミノーマが増えると予測している。そのため長期の経過観察の重要性を指摘している。
pmid-3602987.summary_en: This case report describes a patient who underwent orchidectomy and, eight months later, had a pulmonary metastasis excised. Nine years later, he developed a seminoma in the contralateral testis. The authors emphasize that aggressive therapy has improved outcomes for testicular seminoma. Longer survival may lead to more metachronous contralateral testicular seminomas in the future, which underscores the need for long-term surveillance.

pmid-3606949.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者259例を、放射線療法施設の対照238例および病院入院の対照251例と比較した症例対照研究である。初産の男性では母親の出産時年齢が高いほどリスクが上昇し、特にセミノーマで顕著であった。兄弟数が少ないことや出生順位が早いこともリスクを高めた。妊娠初期の母体エストロゲン上昇が関与するという仮説を支持する結果である。
pmid-3606949.summary_en: This case-control study compared 259 testicular cancer patients with 238 radiotherapy-center controls and 251 hospital inpatient controls, examining prenatal and familial risk factors. Firstborn men showed increased risk with higher maternal age at birth, most markedly for seminoma. Small sibship size and early birth order also raised risk. The findings support the hypothesis that elevated maternal estrogen early in pregnancy contributes to testicular cancer, with seminoma particularly affected.

pmid-3606950.summary_ja: 1971〜1984年にイングランドとウェールズで診断された、1940年以降生まれの男性の精巣がん症例全例を用いて、出生月の周期性を検証した研究である。4か月周期の証拠は限られ、1945〜1949年生まれの奇形腫症例に見られた2か月周期が原因であった。その期間以外では特定の月のピークは認められなかった。一貫した出生季節性はないと結論している。
pmid-3606950.summary_en: This study tests a reported temporal birth-month cycle in testis cancer, using all cases diagnosed in England and Wales from 1971 to 1984 in men born in 1940 or later. Limited evidence for a 4-monthly cycle was found, but it reflected a 2-monthly cycle among teratomas in men born 1945 to 1949. No cycle or peak in any particular birth month was found outside that period, suggesting no consistent seasonal birth pattern.

pmid-3609157.summary_ja: 本研究はWistar-Imamichi系から作出された遺伝性ラット系統(Tera)を報告する。雌雄とも約25%に精巣または卵巣の奇形腫が自然発生し、三胚葉性組織からなる。遺伝形式は常染色体性単一劣性形質と考えられ、胚細胞腫瘍の研究モデルとして位置づけられる。
pmid-3609157.summary_en: This study reports a hereditary rat strain, Tera, developed from Wistar-Imamichi rats that spontaneously develops testicular or ovarian teratomas. The tumors contained tissues from three germ layers, including bone, epithelium and neural tissue, and occurred in about 25% of animals of both sexes without sexual difference. Inheritance was consistent with an autosomal single recessive trait, designated tera. The model is relevant as an animal system for studying germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-3610785.summary_ja: 膣分泌物を主訴とする5歳の雌イヌに卵巣奇形腫が認められ、卵巣子宮摘出術で治癒した。X線で石灰化像が確認され、組織学的に複数胚葉由来の組織が認められた。イヌの奇形腫は稀で、報告例の約33%に転移がみられるとされる。比較腫瘍学の観点から示唆に富む症例報告である。
pmid-3610785.summary_en: A 5-year-old female dog with vaginal discharge was found to have an ovarian teratoma on abdominal palpation, and radiographs showed mineralized densities. Histology confirmed tissues from multiple germ layers. The authors note that canine teratomas are uncommon, may behave malignantly with metastasis in about one third of reported cases, and that ovariohysterectomy is the preferred treatment. Surgery was curative in this patient. The report is a veterinary case description of a true ovarian germ cell neoplasm and offers comparative oncology insight.

pmid-3611867.summary_ja: 妊娠性子宮絨毛癌由来のヒト細胞株NJGを樹立し、7年間にわたり73回以上継代した。細胞はLanghans様細胞が主体で上皮性・異数性の特徴を示し、hCGなどの腫瘍マーカー染色はヌードマウス移植腫瘍と一致した。単一細胞クローンも得られ、両細胞型が同一細胞に由来することが示された。絨毛癌研究のモデル細胞株として有用である。
pmid-3611867.summary_en: Researchers established NJG, a continuously cultured human gestational uterine choriocarcinoma cell line, subcultured more than 73 times over seven years. Cells were predominantly Langhans-like with occasional multinucleated cells, showed epithelial features by electron microscopy, and were aneuploid. Immunostaining for tumor markers including hCG matched the transplanted tumors in nude mice. A single-cell clone was also derived, and both Langhans and syncytial cells were shown to originate from one cell. The line serves as a model for studying choriocarcinoma biology.

pmid-3611870.summary_ja: 新規抗癌剤VP16-213(エトポシド)を、BeWo、HCCM-5、SCHの3種のヒト絨毛癌細胞株でメトトレキサートおよびアクチノマイシンDと比較した。全株で3H-チミジン取り込みが約70%抑制され、6日目の生存率は10%未満となった。薬物の流入・流出動態はメトトレキサートに類似し、効果は比較薬と同等以上と結論された。
pmid-3611870.summary_en: This in vitro study compares the anticancer activity of the agent VP16-213 (etoposide) with methotrexate and actinomycin D against three human choriocarcinoma cell lines: BeWo, HCCM-5 and SCH. Etoposide suppressed 3H-thymidine uptake by about 70% and reduced cell survival below 10% by day six in all lines. Its rapid influx and efflux kinetics resembled methotrexate. The authors conclude its effect equals or exceeds that of the comparators, supporting its use in choriocarcinoma chemotherapy.

pmid-3611879.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患373例の寛解率を治療法別に解析した。低リスク群および非転移性高リスク群は全例寛解したが、転移性高リスク群は3剤併用化学療法で71.4%にとどまった。再発例での寛解率は44.4%であった。MEA療法(メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、エトポシド)は6例中5例で寛解を得て、難治性絨毛癌の救援療法として有用性が示唆された。
pmid-3611879.summary_en: This Japanese series analyzed remission rates in 373 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease according to treatment regimen. Low-risk and nonmetastatic high-risk patients achieved 100% remission, whereas metastatic high-risk patients achieved only 71.4% with triple methotrexate, actinomycin D and cyclophosphamide. Remission with triple therapy in recurrent cases was 44.4%. The MEA regimen, combining methotrexate, actinomycin D and etoposide, produced remission in five of six patients with tolerable toxicity. Findings support MEA as a salvage option for drug-resistant choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3611882.summary_ja: ヌードマウス異種移植モデルを用い、卵巣癌術後の経口HCFU維持化学療法を検討した。卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍(YST-2)モデルでは、腫瘍を完全切除した場合に再発率低下と生存改善が認められた。卵巣腺癌モデル(OVA-2)では腫瘍増殖が抑制された。肉眼的残存がない場合に術後維持療法が有効と示唆される。
pmid-3611882.summary_en: Using nude mouse xenografts, this study examined maintenance chemotherapy after ovarian cancer surgery with oral HCFU for 60 days. In a yolk sac tumor model (YST-2), HCFU reduced recurrence and improved survival only when the tumor was completely resected. In an adenocarcinoma model (OVA-2), it suppressed tumor growth and prolonged survival. The results suggest post-operative maintenance therapy is beneficial when no macroscopic residual disease remains. The yolk sac tumor experiment is directly relevant to ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-3613109.summary_ja: 63歳女性が下腹部痛を主訴に受診し、右卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断されて腫瘍を摘出された。奇形腫壁には汗腺の分泌部および導管への分化を示す腺癌を認め、ムコタンパク質の染色性低下、電子顕微鏡での分泌顆粒と細胞内小管の所見から、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来する汗腺癌と診断された。卵巣奇形腫の稀な悪性転化の症例報告である。
pmid-3613109.summary_en: A 63-year-old woman presented with lower abdominal pain and was diagnosed with a mature cystic teratoma of the right ovary. Histology revealed adenocarcinoma within the teratoma wall showing sweat gland differentiation. Histochemistry showed absence of sialic acid-containing mucoprotein, and electron microscopy revealed secretory granules and intracytoplasmic canaliculi. The tumor was therefore diagnosed as sweat gland carcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma. This case report illustrates a rare malignant transformation of ovarian teratoma.

pmid-3614753.summary_ja: 生後8か月の男児が精巣腫瘍(胎児性癌)と診断された症例である。1973年当時、オランダでは治療範囲について定まった見解がなく、カナダの報告に基づき半側去勢術のみが施行された。その後の文献と自施設の経験から、この方針は妥当であったと考察されている。小児の病期I精巣腫瘍では半側去勢術で十分であると結論づけている。
pmid-3614753.summary_en: An eight-month-old boy presented with a testicular tumor diagnosed as embryonal cell carcinoma. At the time of treatment in 1973, no consensus existed in the Netherlands on the extent of treatment, and hemicastration alone was performed based on a Canadian report. The authors note that subsequent literature and their own experience support this policy. They conclude that for stage I tumors in children, hemicastration is sufficient treatment.

pmid-3617293.summary_ja: Memorial Sloan-Kettering癌センターで経験した転移性精巣絨毛癌の男性患者3例を報告する。化学療法直後または急速に進行した進行期に大量出血が生じ、2例が死亡した。早期認識と積極的な支持療法の重要性が強調され、選択例では出血性転移の外科的切除が有用な場合があるとされている。
pmid-3617293.summary_en: This series describes three men at Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Center with metastatic testicular choriocarcinoma who developed massive hemorrhage. Bleeding occurred either immediately after chemotherapy or in rapidly progressive advanced disease, and two patients died. The authors emphasize early recognition and aggressive supportive care. Surgical excision of bleeding metastases may help in selected cases. The report highlights hemorrhage as a life-threatening complication of choriocarcinoma in men.

pmid-3617307.summary_ja: 両側の精巣に組織型の異なる腫瘍が同時に生じた症例を報告し、関連文献を検討している。左右で異なる細胞型を示す両側同時性の精巣腫瘍は稀であり、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断と管理に重要な示唆を与える。自験例1例を追加した症例報告と文献レビューである。
pmid-3617307.summary_en: The authors describe a patient with synchronous bilateral testicular tumors in which each testis contained a different histologic cell type. They report one additional case and review the relevant literature on this rare presentation. Such bilateral synchronous tumors with discordant histology are uncommon and have important implications for diagnosis and management of germ cell tumors. The paper is a brief case report with literature review.

pmid-3618120.summary_ja: 良性卵巣奇形腫内にみられる神経組織の超微細構造を電子顕微鏡で検討した報告である。髄膜様および上衣様の表面を有する領域に、星状膠細胞、上衣細胞、シナプスを有する神経細胞、ミクログリアが認められ、正常神経組織に類似していた。異所性に存在することによる変性所見も見られたが、乏突起膠細胞と髄鞘は欠如していた。卵巣奇形腫における神経分化を示す。
pmid-3618120.summary_en: This electron microscopy study examines neural tissue within a benign ovarian teratoma. Areas resembling meninges and ependyma contained astrocytes, ependymal cells, neurons with synapses, and microglia, showing ultrastructural similarity to normal nervous tissue. Some degenerative changes were noted, possibly due to the abnormal location of the tissue. Oligodendrocytes and myelin were absent, perhaps reflecting vascular insufficiency. The work illustrates the neural differentiation possible within ovarian teratomas.

pmid-3618142.summary_ja: 子宮重複症、多毛、稀発月経、高アンドロゲン血症を呈した21歳女性が、両側卵巣類皮嚢腫と診断された。術後に月経とアンドロゲン値は正常化し、組織学的に卵巣被膜直下に多嚢胞性変化が認められた。腫瘍内にはセルトリ細胞も見られた。症例と文献から、多嚢胞性卵巣疾患の確定診断が非手術的および外科的管理の双方で重要であると論じている。
pmid-3618142.summary_en: A 21-year-old woman with a double uterus, hirsutism, oligomenorrhea and elevated androgens was found to have bilateral ovarian dermoid cysts. After surgery her menses and androgen levels normalized, and histology showed polycystic changes beneath the ovarian capsule. Sertoli cells were noted within the tumors. The authors discuss the importance of a definitive diagnosis of polycystic ovarian disease in both non-surgical and surgical management of the syndrome, using their case and the literature.

pmid-3618143.summary_ja: 胎盤奇形腫の1症例を報告している。本腫瘍は組織発生に議論のある稀な腫瘍であり、独立した疾患とする見解と、無形胎児(fetus amorphus)の極端な形とみなす見解がある。本腫瘍は良性で臨床的意義はないとされている。限られた文献に1例を加える簡潔な症例報告である。
pmid-3618143.summary_en: A case of placental teratoma is presented. The authors note this rare tumor has disputed histogenesis, with some regarding it as a separate entity and others as an extreme form of fetus amorphus. The tumor was benign and without clinical significance. The brief report adds a case to the limited literature on placental teratomas.

pmid-3618218.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の純粋型と混合型に由来するヒト細胞株4種を、in vitroおよびヌードマウス移植で検討した。胎児性癌株2種はin vitroで栄養膜への分化能を示したが、マウスでは純粋な胎児性癌を形成した。残り2株はin vitroで栄養膜細胞および卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞へ形態学的に分化し、マウスでは未熟奇形腫を含む混合腫瘍を形成した。胎児性癌の多分化能には差があることが示唆された。
pmid-3618218.summary_en: Four human cell lines derived from pure and mixed testicular germ cell tumors were characterized in vitro and after xenotransplantation into athymic nude mice. Two embryonal carcinoma lines showed trophoblastic potential in vitro but produced pure embryonal carcinoma in mice. Two other lines underwent morphologic differentiation toward trophoblast and yolk sac tumor cells in vitro and formed mixed tumors in vivo, including immature teratoma. The findings suggest that some embryonal carcinomas have multipotent differentiation while others do not.

pmid-3618436.summary_ja: 女性として育てられた43歳の症例が左鼠径部腫瘤で受診し、混合型性腺異形成に未分化型セミノーマを合併していた。低身長と外性器の不明瞭さを認めたが、ターナー徴候はなかった。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で大きな鼠径部腫瘍が示され、右性腺摘出と骨盤リンパ節郭清が行われた。国内では性腺腫瘍を伴う混合型性腺異形成が本例を含め7例報告されている。
pmid-3618436.summary_en: A 43-year-old individual raised as female presented with a left inguinal mass and was found to have mixed gonadal dysgenesis with anaplastic seminoma. Examination showed short stature and ambiguous external genitalia without Turner stigmata. CT demonstrated a large inguinal tumor. The right gonad was removed with pelvic lymph node dissection, showing a streak gonad and immature uterine structures. The authors also note that seven Japanese cases of mixed gonadal dysgenesis with gonadal tumor, including this one, have been reported.
