pmid-3620310.summary_ja: 血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が高値で腫瘍部位不明の18例を対象に、抗hCG抗体シンチグラフィーを従来の画像診断と比較した研究。薬剤抵抗性または再発絨毛癌の局所病変の検出に有用だった。陽性例で切除を試みた8例中5例が5年までの完全寛解を維持し、手術適応の選択に役立つと結論づけている。
pmid-3620310.summary_en: This study evaluated radiolabelled antibody scintigraphy directed against human chorionic gonadotrophin (hCG) in 18 patients with raised serum hCG and unknown tumour sites. Results were compared with conventional imaging, including CT. Antibody imaging was useful for detecting localised drug-resistant or recurrent choriocarcinoma. Among eight patients with positive antibody imaging who underwent resection attempts, five achieved sustained complete response for up to five years. The authors conclude that antibody imaging can help select patients for surgery.

pmid-3621115.summary_ja: 胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)の免疫染色とPAS染色により、精巣組織中の異型胚細胞を同定する手法を検討した研究。胎児・成人の精巣41例の予備検討に続き、停留精巣や胚細胞腫瘍を有する乳児・成人の精巣121例を解析した。PLAP陽性でグリコーゲンに富む異型細胞は、セミノーマなど他の胚細胞腫瘍へ分化しうる多能性の悪性細胞と考えられた。
pmid-3621115.summary_en: The authors used immunohistochemistry for placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) and PAS staining for glycogen to identify atypical germ cells in testicular tissue. A preliminary study examined 41 fetal and adult testes, followed by 121 testes from infants and adults with cryptorchidism or germ cell tumours. Atypical cells were PLAP-positive with glycogen-rich cytoplasm and appeared to be multipotent malignant cells capable of giving rise to seminoma and other germ cell tumours. In infant yolk sac tumour, such cells were absent from adjacent seminiferous tubules.

pmid-3627612.summary_ja: 42歳女性に発生した21.5kgの後腹膜奇形腫の症例報告。腫瘍は上腸間膜動脈起始部の下方に発生し、腹腔内容を圧排していた。十二指腸、膵臓、横行結腸間膜が偽被膜内に取り込まれていた。評価と手術的治療を記述し、卵巣以外の奇形腫の診断と発生機序を概説している。
pmid-3627612.summary_en: A case of a 21.5-kg retroperitoneal teratoma in a 42-year-old woman is presented. The tumour arose below the origin of the superior mesenteric artery and displaced the entire abdominal contents. The duodenum, pancreas and transverse colon mesentery were incorporated into its pseudocapsule. The authors describe evaluation and operative management and review the diagnosis and pathogenesis of non-ovarian teratomas, which are common in children but rare in adults.

pmid-3630698.summary_ja: 56歳女性の卵巣に偶然発見された腫瘍の症例報告。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の前腸由来成分から生じた原発性索状カルチノイドと考えられた。奇形腫の近傍では索状構造が長く波状を示し、周辺部では直線的で短かった。銀親和性顆粒を有し、電子顕微鏡で神経分泌顆粒を認めた。その組織発生について考察している。
pmid-3630698.summary_en: This case report describes a 56-year-old woman with an incidental ovarian tumor. Histology showed a primary trabecular carcinoid arising from the foregut elements of a mature cystic teratoma, which was composed only of respiratory epithelium with no thyroid tissue. The carcinoid trabeculae were longer and wavier near the teratoma and straight at the periphery. Immunostaining showed argyrophil but not argentaffin granules, and electron microscopy revealed neurosecretory granules. The authors discuss the histogenesis of this rare ovarian carcinoid.

pmid-3632294.summary_ja: 大網に発生した未熟奇形腫の稀な症例報告。文献上2例目以降の報告で、神経外胚葉への顕著な分化を示した。未熟奇形腫の悪性度は部位によっては神経外胚葉成分の量と相関するとされ、本例はその点で示唆に富む。性腺外奇形腫の組織学的評価に寄与する知見である。
pmid-3632294.summary_en: This report describes an extremely rare immature teratoma arising in the omentum, a site where such tumors have been documented in only two prior cases. The tumor showed prominent neuroectodermal differentiation. The authors note that at some anatomic locations, the malignant potential of immature teratoma correlates with the amount of neuroectoderm present. This is presented as the first immature omental teratoma with prominent neuroectodermal differentiation, adding to understanding of grading in extragonadal teratomas.

pmid-3646091.summary_ja: 精巣とセミノーマ組織におけるアルカリホスファターゼ3種のアイソザイムを、特異的モノクローナル抗体で定量した研究。セミノーマでは3種すべてが著明に増加した。セミノーマ由来の胎盤型様酵素は妊娠関連PLAPと異なり不均一で熱感受性を示し、経過観察に用いるPLAP測定法の解釈に影響すると示唆された。
pmid-3646091.summary_en: This study quantified the three human alkaline phosphatase isozymes in normal testis and seminoma tissue using isozyme-specific monoclonal antibodies. All three isozymes were markedly increased in seminoma, with the tissue-unspecific and placental-like enzymes rising 10- to 100-fold. The placental-like enzyme in seminoma was heterogeneous and partially heat sensitive, unlike pregnancy-related placental alkaline phosphatase. The findings suggest that PLAP assays used to monitor seminoma patients may need reconsideration.

pmid-3652018.summary_ja: 1970〜1975年診断の3285例と1983年診断の1887例を比較した精巣がんの全国調査。精巣のしこりで受診する例が増え、早期発見の傾向が示された。病期Iのセミノーマは10年生存率96%超、病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は87.1%、病期III非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は22.1%だった。化学療法の進歩により1年生存率は50.5%から78.4%へ改善した。
pmid-3652018.summary_en: A national survey compared patterns of care for testicular cancer between 3285 patients diagnosed from 1970 to 1975 and 1887 patients diagnosed in 1983. Patients increasingly presented with a testicular lump, suggesting earlier detection. Ten-year survival exceeded 96% for stage I seminoma, 87.1% for stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, and 22.1% for stage III nonseminomatous disease. One-year survival for stage III nonseminomatous tumors rose from 50.5% to 78.4% with advances in chemotherapy.

pmid-3652073.summary_ja: ナイジェリアの新生児に生じた巨大な良性頭蓋外奇形腫の症例報告。腫瘍の部位と大きさ、外科的治療について記述している。手術後4年時点で再発なく、発達も正常に経過した。先天性の大きな奇形腫は切除により良好な予後が期待できることを示す。
pmid-3652073.summary_en: This report describes a huge benign extracranial teratoma in a Nigerian neonate, noting the tumor's site, size, and surgical management. The child underwent surgical resection and had a good outcome. Four years after surgery, the child remained well and had developed normally. The case highlights that large congenital teratomas can be treated successfully with resection and carry a favorable prognosis.

pmid-3653199.summary_ja: スコットランドにおける胚細胞性精巣がんの時間的推移を、純粋セミノーマと奇形腫に分けて分析した研究。1959〜1984年に罹患率は50%以上上昇し、増加の大部分は奇形腫によるものだった。罹患率の上昇にもかかわらず死亡率は低下し、特に15〜44歳で顕著だった。新しい治療の効果が示唆される。
pmid-3653199.summary_en: This Scottish study examines temporal trends in germ-cell testicular cancer, separately analysing pure seminoma and teratoma. Incidence rose by over 50% between 1959 and 1984, mainly due to teratoma, while seminoma rose only marginally. Mortality declined despite rising incidence, particularly in men aged 15 to 44, reflecting improved survival from new therapies. The authors conclude that prognosis for this malignancy has improved in Scotland.

pmid-3654923.summary_ja: 本研究は、妊娠女性と絨毛癌患者の尿中hCGに結合するO結合型糖鎖構造を比較した。ヘキササッカライドは妊娠hCGでは約6%にすぎないが、絨毛癌hCGでは約52%を占めた。このため、ヘキササッカライドに富むhCGは絨毛癌を示す指標となりうると結論づけている。ただし症例数は少数（妊娠10例、絨毛癌3例）である。
pmid-3654923.summary_en: This study compared O-linked oligosaccharide structures on hCG from pregnant women and from choriocarcinoma patients, using urinary hCG purified by immunoaffinity chromatography and gel filtration. The hexasaccharide NeuAc α2-3Gal β1-3(NeuAc α2-3Gal β1-4GlcNAc β1-6)GalNAc was a minor component of pregnancy hCG (mean 6%) but accounted for about half (mean 52%) of O-linked units in choriocarcinoma hCG. The authors conclude that hexasaccharide-rich hCG may serve as a specific marker indicating choriocarcinoma. The sample sizes were small (10 pregnancy, 3 choriocarcinoma).

pmid-3656535.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマ52例に対し、シクロホスファミドと週1回シスプラチンの併用（44例）または週1回シスプラチン単独（8例）による一次化学療法を行った。完全寛解は44例で得られ、計48例（92%）が無病で経過した。神経毒性は31%に認められた。播種性セミノーマに対する治療選択肢として有用と結論している。
pmid-3656535.summary_en: Fifty-two patients with advanced seminoma were treated with primary chemotherapy, 44 with cyclophosphamide plus weekly cisplatin and 8 with weekly cisplatin alone. Complete remission was achieved in 44 patients, and four more were salvaged with further therapy including radiation therapy, so 48 (92%) remained disease-free during follow-up of 30 to 471 weeks. Prior chemotherapy was the only factor associated with a lower complete remission rate. Renal toxicity was uncommon, while neurotoxicity occurred in 31%. The authors conclude this regimen is the treatment of choice for disseminated seminoma.

pmid-3658844.summary_ja: 46,XY核型、ミュラー管欠如、停留精巣を伴う患者の片側精巣に性腺芽腫が見つかった症例報告である。hCG刺激試験や内分泌学的検査は正常であった。ミュラー管の欠如を除けば、臨床像は異形成性男性仮性半陰陽に最も近い。異形成精巣では胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが高いため、精巣生検の重要性を強調している。
pmid-3658844.summary_en: A patient with a 46,XY karyotype, absent internal Müllerian ducts, a vaginal pouch, hypospadias and bilateral cryptorchidism was found to have a gonadoblastoma in one testis. The hCG stimulation test and tissue 5α-reductase and androgen receptor assays were normal. Apart from the absent Müllerian structures, the clinical picture most resembled dysgenetic male pseudohermaphroditism. The authors propose that Müllerian duct remnants in this disorder may vary along a spectrum depending on the degree of gonadal dysgenesis. They emphasize testicular biopsy in dysgenetic testes given the high risk of germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-3658923.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株（GCH-1、GCH-1(m)、TAK-N）と、卵巣癌、子宮内膜癌、悪性黒色腫などの悪性細胞株におけるHLA-DR α鎖・β鎖mRNAの発現をノーザンハイブリダイゼーションで検討した。GCH-1ではα・β鎖の両方が転写されていたが、GCH-1(m)や一部の細胞株ではHLA-DR分子は認められなかった。免疫細胞化学的所見と比較している。
pmid-3658923.summary_en: Northern hybridization was used to examine HLA-DR alpha and beta chain mRNA in human gestational choriocarcinoma cell lines (GCH-1, GCH-1(m), TAK-N) and in several other malignant cell lines, including ovarian and endometrial carcinoma and melanoma lines. GCH-1 transcribed both alpha and beta chains, and TYK-nu also expressed both, while L-14 and TAK-N transcribed little or only alpha-chain mRNA. HLA-DR molecules were not detected in GCH-1(m), M-14, or KKNS-1, -2, and -3. The authors compared these results with immunocytochemical findings obtained previously in their laboratory.

pmid-3660400.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌OTT6050を皮下移植したマウスにヒドロコルチゾンを投与した。投与により、リンパ節および内臓転移の数は増加したが、リンパ節転移巣の増殖は用量依存的に抑制された。転移巣はグルココルチコイド受容体含量が高く、分化した組織を多く含んでいた。受容体を介する機序と分化が関与すると考察している。
pmid-3660400.summary_en: Syngeneic 129/Sv-CP+SlJ mice bearing subcutaneous mouse teratocarcinoma OTT6050 were treated with hydrocortisone. Treatment increased the number of lymph-node and visceral metastases irrespective of dose or sex, while dose-dependently inhibiting the growth of lymph-node metastases. Lymph-node metastases contained more well-differentiated tissue than the subcutaneous tumors. Glucocorticoid receptor content was higher in lymph-node metastatic tumors than in subcutaneous tumors. The authors suggest the metastatic growth inhibition may relate to receptor-mediated mechanisms and differentiation.

pmid-3660993.summary_ja: 過去5年間に治療された精巣腫瘍患者16例の治療成績を検討した短報である。一般に行われている複合的治療に加え、病期の早い段階で疾患を認識することの重要性を強調している。抄録には組織型、病期、マーカーの使用、個々の転帰などの詳細は記載されていない。
pmid-3660993.summary_en: This short report describes the therapeutic results of 16 testicular tumor patients treated over the preceding five years. Beyond the generally accepted complex treatment, the authors stress the importance of recognizing the disease at an early stage. The abstract gives no detail on histological types, stages, marker use, or individual outcomes. The report is therefore best read as a brief clinical observation supporting early diagnosis.

pmid-3661822.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍のうち類内膜腺癌に類似した腺管パターンを示す8例を解析した。対象は11〜34歳で、検査された7例全例で血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇していた。3例で卵巣外進展がみられ、3例が術後19〜60か月で再発・転移により死亡した。類内膜癌とは区別すべき変異型と結論している。
pmid-3661822.summary_en: Eight ovarian yolk sac tumors with glandular patterns resembling endometrioid adenocarcinoma were analysed in patients aged 11 to 34 years. Serum AFP was elevated in all seven patients in whom it was measured. Most tumors were unilateral, and three had spread beyond the ovary. Microscopy showed endometrioid-like glands alongside reticular, polyvesicular-vitelline, and hepatoid patterns of yolk sac tumor. Three patients died of recurrent or metastatic tumor 19 to 60 months after surgery. The authors argue that this variant should be distinguished from endometrioid carcinoma.

pmid-3664206.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍61例のフォローアップ経過から骨シンチグラフィの有用性を検討した。セミノーマで死亡した全例と奇形腫で死亡した8例中2例に骨転移を認めた。セミノーマの根治治療後の再発例やstage IVセミノーマでの予後不良群の同定に適応があり、その他は臨床的に骨転移が疑われる場合に限るとした。
pmid-3664206.summary_en: This retrospective review of 61 patients with testicular tumours evaluated bone scintigraphy during follow-up. Skeletal metastases occurred in all five patients who died of seminoma and in two of eight who died of teratoma. The only long-surviving patient with bone metastases had mixed teratoma/seminoma. The authors conclude that bone scintigraphy is indicated for suspected recurrence after radical treatment of seminoma and possibly for stage IV seminoma to identify a poor-prognosis subgroup. In other patients it should be reserved for specific clinical suspicion of bone metastasis.

pmid-3668965.summary_ja: 部分胞状奇胎の臨床病理学的特徴をまとめた総説である。三倍体で二精子受精由来の妊娠で、絨毛の限局性過形成と胞状変化を特徴とし、胎児は8〜9週まで生存することが多い。症状は多様で、掻把前の診断は困難なことが多い。部分胞状奇胎に絨毛癌の合併は報告されていないが、非転移性の遺残病変は起こりうる。確定診断は病理医が行い、絨毛水腫を伴う流産や完全奇胎と正常胎児の双胎との鑑別が必要である。
pmid-3668965.summary_en: This clinicopathologic review describes partial hydatidiform mole, a triploid, diandric conception with focal trophoblastic hyperplasia and focal hydatidiform change, in which the fetus often survives to 8 to 9 weeks. Presentation is variable and preevacuation diagnosis is often difficult. No choriocarcinoma has been linked to partial mole, although residual nonmetastatic disease can occur. Diagnosis rests with the pathologist, who must distinguish partial mole from a missed abortion with villous edema and from twins combining a complete mole and a normal conceptus.

pmid-3669367.summary_ja: 胃生検で診断された原発性胃絨毛癌の55歳男性の剖検例である。血清および尿中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が著明に上昇していた。剖検では腺癌成分を含まない純粋な絨毛癌で、肝、肺、膵、大網、胸膜、腹膜、リンパ節へ転移していた。免疫組織化学と電子顕微鏡でhCG-βの局在を確認した。性腺外に生じた極めてまれな絨毛癌の広範な播種の一例である。
pmid-3669367.summary_en: This autopsy report describes a 55-year-old man with primary gastric choriocarcinoma, diagnosed by gastric biopsy and presenting with markedly elevated serum and urinary hCG. Autopsy showed a pure choriocarcinoma without adenocarcinoma elements, with metastases to liver, lungs, pancreas, omentum, pleura, peritoneum, and lymph nodes. Immunohistochemistry and electron microscopy demonstrated hCG-beta within syncytiotrophoblasts and transitional cells. The case illustrates an extremely rare extragonadal origin of choriocarcinoma with widespread dissemination.

pmid-3671227.summary_ja: 大網の類皮嚢腫による圧迫で腰仙骨神経叢障害を来した66歳女性の症例報告である。このような合併症の報告は過去にないとされる。良性の大網嚢胞性病変が腹腔から離れた部位の神経を圧迫しうることを示す。腰仙骨神経叢障害の鑑別に大網病変を含めるべきである。抄録には画像所見、手術、転帰の詳細は記載されていない。
pmid-3671227.summary_en: This case report describes a 66-year-old woman who developed lumbosacral plexopathy due to compression by a dermoid cyst of the greater omentum. The authors note that this complication had not been reported before. The case shows that a benign omental cystic lesion can compress nerves at a site remote from the abdominal cavity, and that it should be considered in the differential diagnosis of lumbosacral plexus syndromes. Imaging, surgical, and outcome details are not included in the abstract.

pmid-3671243.summary_ja: 原発不明の会陰部腫瘍で受診した若年男性の症例報告である。精査にもかかわらず原発巣は特定できず、腫瘍は根治的に切除された。病理学的には退縮した精巣奇形腫からの転移と判明した。このような患者では、腫瘍が化学療法に感受性が高いことが多いため、可能な限り精巣由来を除外すべきと強調している。
pmid-3671243.summary_en: This short case report describes a young man who presented with a perineal tumor of unknown origin. Despite extensive investigation, the primary site could not be identified, and the mass required radical excision. Pathology showed it was a metastasis from a regressed testicular teratoma. The authors stress that testicular origin should be excluded whenever possible in such patients, because these tumors are often chemosensitive and respond well to treatment.

pmid-3674171.summary_ja: 35例の部分奇胎をフローサイトメトリーでDNA倍数性解析した。三倍体6例には合併症がなく、二倍体25例中5例で後遺症（化学療法を要する絨毛癌や胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍等）が生じた。増殖指数3.6超で後遺症例を高感度・高特異度に識別できた。形態学的・遺伝学的併用分類によるリスク評価が提案されている。
pmid-3674171.summary_en: This study analyzed 35 partial hydatidiform moles by flow cytometric DNA ploidy measurement. Six were triploid and none had complications, whereas 5 of 25 diploid cases had sequelae, including persistent mole, metastasis, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumor requiring chemotherapy. A proliferation index above 3.6 distinguished most cases with sequelae from uncomplicated ones, with 100% sensitivity and 95% specificity. The authors recommend combined morphologic and genetic classification for risk assessment.

pmid-3674984.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣腫瘍16例に保存的治療を行い、術後に12例が化学療法、1例が放射線療法を受けた。13例で計18回の妊娠が成立した。18児の転帰は健常14、奇形2、子宮内死亡2であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍の2例と粘液性癌の1例は再発により死亡した。
pmid-3674984.summary_en: Sixteen patients with malignant ovarian tumors, including dysgerminoma, mature teratoma and endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor, were treated conservatively. Twelve received postoperative chemotherapy and one with dysgerminoma received radiotherapy. Eighteen pregnancies occurred in 13 patients. Of the 18 infants, 14 were well, 2 had malformations and 2 died in utero. Two patients with endodermal sinus tumor and one with mucinous carcinoma died of recurrence.

pmid-3677004.summary_ja: 性腺芽腫が原因で同性性偽思春期を呈した6歳半の女児例。腫瘍静脈と末梢静脈間のプロラクチン勾配と免疫染色により、腫瘍が生物活性を有するプロラクチンを分泌していることが示された。産生細胞はセルトリ様細胞と考えられた。成長ホルモンおよびGHRHは腫瘍内で検出されなかった。
pmid-3677004.summary_en: A 6.5-year-old girl with isosexual pseudoprecocious puberty due to gonadoblastoma was reported. Immunohistochemistry and a prolactin gradient between the tumor vein and peripheral vein showed that the tumor produced and secreted bioactive prolactin, with Sertoli-like cells identified as the source. Growth hormone and GHRH were not detected in the tumor. The case supports ectopic prolactin production by neoplastic tissue.

pmid-3677047.summary_ja: 完全奇胎14例から栄養膜細胞を分離し細胞遺伝学的に解析した。奇胎栄養膜細胞は正常栄養膜より倍数体細胞が2.8倍多く、染色体切断を受けやすかった。切断点は脆弱部位や絨毛癌細胞株の切断点と一致した。ゲノム不安定性が絨毛癌への悪性転化に寄与すると示唆された。
pmid-3677047.summary_en: Trophoblasts and stromal cells were separated from 14 complete hydatidiform moles and analyzed cytogenetically. Molar trophoblasts had 2.8-fold more polyploid cells than normal trophoblasts and were more prone to chromosomal breakage than control cells, though no consistent abnormality was found. Many breakpoints coincided with fragile sites, oncogenes, and breakpoints in choriocarcinoma cell lines. The authors suggest genomic instability may drive progressive karyotypic change and susceptibility to malignant transformation.

pmid-3677079.summary_ja: マウスの胚性癌細胞株を左心室に注入すると、卵巣、精巣、副腎、虹彩、顎下腺などの特定部位に腫瘍が形成された。標的組織やその馴化培地が細胞のin vitro遊走を促進し、組織特異的シグナルへの遊走反応が転移の特異性に関与することが示唆された。腹腔内注入では卵巣のみに転移し、標的臓器への高い接着性が必要であった。
pmid-3677079.summary_en: Mouse embryonal carcinoma cell lines injected into the left ventricle produced tumors in specific sites, including ovary, testis, adrenal, iris and submaxillary gland. Tissues from these target sites, or their conditioned medium, stimulated in vitro migration of the cells, suggesting that migration responses to tissue-specific signals underlie metastatic specificity. Intraperitoneal injection produced ovary-only metastasis, which additionally required high adhesion to the target organ.

pmid-3677080.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞の遊走には、フィブロネクチン基質と雄顎下腺馴化培地中の成分（神経成長因子の可能性）が必要であった。精製NGFは細胞増殖ではなく遊走を誘導し、高分子量の7S NGFのみが活性を示した。生体内でも組織特異的な7S NGFが標的臓器への遊走を導く可能性がある。
pmid-3677080.summary_en: This study shows that migration of mouse embryonal carcinoma cells in vitro requires both a fibronectin substrate and a component from male submaxillary conditioned medium, likely nerve growth factor. Purified NGF induced migration but not proliferation, and only the high-molecular-weight 7S NGF complex was active, while 2.5S NGF inhibited migration. The authors propose that tissue-specific 7S NGF may guide these cells to migrate into target organs in vivo.

pmid-3677108.summary_ja: 培養ヒト胎児性癌細胞はシスプラチンに対して高い感受性を示し、生存率はDNA結合白金量と相関した。DNA結合白金量自体は他の細胞と同程度であったため、胎児性癌細胞は白金-DNA付加体に対して本来的に感受性が高いと結論づけられた。ファンコニ貧血線維芽細胞と同程度の感受性であった。
pmid-3677108.summary_en: Cultured human embryonal carcinoma cells were highly sensitive to cisplatin in colony-formation assays, with survival correlating with DNA-bound platinum. Their sensitivity was comparable to that of Fanconi's anemia fibroblasts and exceeded many other cell types, although the platinum bound to DNA was similar to that in other cells. The authors conclude that embryonal carcinoma cells are inherently sensitive to DNA-bound platinum adducts.

pmid-3679203.summary_ja: 50歳女性の卵巣類内膜腺癌内に生じた卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。腫瘍はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性で、転移出現時に血清AFP値が上昇した。体細胞由来癌から発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍としては4例目、類内膜型上皮を伴う例としては2例目である。
pmid-3679203.summary_en: A case of yolk sac tumor arising within an ovarian endometrioid adenocarcinoma in a 50-year-old woman. The tumor showed typical histology, stained positive for alpha-fetoprotein, and serum AFP rose when metastases appeared. It is only the fourth reported yolk sac tumor arising from a somatic carcinoma and the second associated with endometrioid epithelium. Tumor heterogeneity or neometaplasia is proposed as the origin of the germ-cell component.

pmid-3682835.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの病期II症例を対象に、組織学的リスク因子と予後への関連を検討した研究。原発腫瘍径はpT分類や小血管浸潤と相関したが、pT分類は臨床病期亜分類や再発率とは相関しなかった。未分化型は古典型より3年生存率が低い傾向があったが有意差はなかった。hCG産生の有無は生存率・再発率に差がなく、多くの組織学的因子は病期II予後指標として明確ではないと示唆された。
pmid-3682835.summary_en: This study analyzes risk factors and the prognostic significance of histological features in stage II testicular seminoma. Primary tumor size correlated with pT category and small-vessel invasion, while pT category did not correlate with clinical substage or relapse rate. Anaplastic seminomas showed a poorer three-year survival than classical seminomas, though not significantly. Lymphocyte-rich tumors trended toward better five-year survival, and hCG production had no effect on survival or relapse. The findings suggest that many histological features lack clear prognostic value in stage II seminoma.

pmid-3682840.summary_ja: 性腺外セミノーマの再発に対し根治的後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った後、大量の乳び漏出による乳び腹水が生じた症例報告。腹水は3か月以上持続し、1日平均1.5リットルの体外ドレナージを要した。腹膜静脈シャントにより良好に治療できた。後腹膜リンパ節郭清の重篤な合併症と、その有効な治療法を示した報告である。
pmid-3682840.summary_en: This case report describes a patient who developed a massive lymphatic leak with chylous ascites after radical retroperitoneal lymph node dissection performed for recurrent extragonadal seminoma. Ascites persisted for more than three months, with average external drainage of 1.5 liters daily. The condition was successfully managed with a peritoneovenous shunt. The report highlights a serious complication of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and a effective treatment option for prolonged chylous ascites.

pmid-3682960.summary_ja: 1950年から1984年に治療された純粋な卵巣未分化胚細胞腫35例を対象とした、メイヨー・クリニックの後方視的研究。病期IA1の18例では5年生存率が100%であった。予防的放射線療法を受けなかった病期IA1の16例のうち6例(38%)が傍大動脈領域で再発し、多くは放射線療法で救済された。片側卵巣摘出後は、経過観察か、妊孕性を温存する予防的放射線療法のいずれかが妥当な選択肢であるとされている。
pmid-3682960.summary_en: This retrospective Mayo Clinic series analyzed 35 patients with pure ovarian dysgerminoma treated between 1950 and 1984. Twenty-year overall survival was 82.9 percent, and the 18 patients with stage IA1 disease had 100 percent five-year survival. Among 16 stage IA1 patients who did not receive prophylactic radiation, six (38 percent) relapsed in the para-aortic region, and most were salvaged with radiotherapy. The authors suggest that after unilateral oophorectomy for stage IA1 disease, either observation with salvage radiation or prophylactic para-aortic radiation, which preserves fertility, are reasonable options.

pmid-3688610.summary_ja: 若い女性が急性腹痛、貧血、妊娠検査陽性で受診した。手術で右腎破裂による後腹膜血腫が見つかり、病理学的に原発性腎絨毛癌の出血性壊死と診断された。化学療法を受け、10か月のフォローアップで再発は認められなかった。妊娠検査陽性で骨盤内診察が正常な場合は絨毛癌を考慮すべきと著者は強調している。
pmid-3688610.summary_en: A young woman presented with acute abdominal pain, anemia, and a positive pregnancy test. Surgery revealed a retroperitoneal hematoma from a ruptured right kidney, and pathology showed hemorrhagic necrosis of primary renal choriocarcinoma. She received chemotherapy and remained free of recurrence at ten months. The authors emphasize considering choriocarcinoma when a pregnancy test is positive but the pelvic examination is normal.

pmid-3688807.summary_ja: 1967年から1984年にシンガポールの心臓胸部外科で治療された16例を後方視的に解析し、縦隔良性奇形腫の臨床像を検討した。疾患パターンは欧米の報告と類似していた。完全な外科的切除により根治が得られ、安全に施行可能であった。本疾患に対する外科的切除の有用性が示された。
pmid-3688807.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 16 patients treated at a Singapore cardiothoracic unit from 1967 to 1984 describes benign mediastinal teratomas. The disease pattern resembled that reported in Western series. Complete surgical excision was curative and could be performed safely. The authors conclude that surgery is the definitive treatment for this rare mediastinal neoplasm in the region.

pmid-3689074.summary_ja: セミノーマを有する49歳男性が高カルシウム血症と血清カルシトリオールの著明な高値を呈した。リン、副甲状腺ホルモンは正常で、高カルシウム尿症を認めた。部分切除と併用化学療法後にカルシウムとカルシトリオールは正常化した。著者らはカルシトリオールが高カルシウム血症の原因物質である可能性を示唆している。
pmid-3689074.summary_en: A 49-year-old man with seminoma presented with hypercalcemia and markedly elevated serum calcitriol, with normal phosphate and parathyroid hormone levels. Hypercalciuria was present. After partial resection and combination chemotherapy, calcium and calcitriol normalized. The authors propose calcitriol as the likely mediator of hypercalcemia, a link previously described mainly in lymphoma rather than solid tumors.

pmid-3690188.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ151例の血清hCGを、遊離βサブユニットと完全hCGの両方を検出する免疫測定法で評価した。精巣摘除術前の上昇は病期Iの39%、病期II〜IVの68%にみられた。病期Iでは精巣摘除術後にほぼ全例で正常化した。診断時にhCG産生があった進行例で再発が多かったが、非産生例でも再発は認められた。
pmid-3690188.summary_en: Serum hCG was measured with an immunoassay detecting free beta-chains and intact hCG in 151 testicular seminoma patients. Pre-orchiectomy elevation occurred in 39% of stage I and 68% of stage II to IV patients. After orchiectomy, values normalized in nearly all stage I patients. Relapse was more frequent among advanced patients who produced hCG at diagnosis, although relapses also occurred in non-producers.

pmid-3690966.summary_ja: 進行精巣セミノーマ33例に対し、化学療法の前後と経過中に腹部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)を連続施行した。化学療法直後のCTでは29例で有意な縮小、4例で完全消失を認め、平均縮小率は70%であった。残存腫瘤は追加治療なしで1年、2年にかけてさらに縮小した。著者らは化学療法直後と1年時点でのCTを推奨している。
pmid-3690966.summary_en: Thirty-three patients with advanced testicular seminoma underwent serial abdominal CT before, during, and after chemotherapy. Immediate post-chemotherapy CT showed significant regression in 29 patients and complete resolution in four, with mean regression of 70%. Residual masses continued to shrink at one and two years without further treatment. The authors recommend CT immediately after chemotherapy and at one year.

pmid-3691668.summary_ja: マウスの胎児性癌細胞株F9を単層培養および凝集培養で分化誘導し、がん遺伝子の転写産物量の変化を解析した。初期にはc-mybが減少し、c-mycは変化しなかった。後期にはc-srcが増加し、増殖速度の低下と関連する可能性が示された。胚細胞腫瘍の分化に関する基礎研究である。
pmid-3691668.summary_en: F9 mouse embryonal carcinoma cells were induced to differentiate into parietal or visceral endoderm-type cells in monolayer and aggregate cultures. Transcript levels of several c-oncogenes changed similarly in both conditions. An early c-myb decrease without c-myc change, and a later c-src increase, may relate to slowed growth. c-abl depended on retinoic acid, and c-fos rose late in monolayer culture only.

pmid-3692432.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株5種について、c-onc遺伝子の変化と発現を解析した。1株でc-mycの8倍増幅とc-fmsの再構成が認められた。ノーザン解析で少なくとも11種のc-onc遺伝子の発現が確認され、N-mycとfosは特に亢進していた。NIH3T3細胞への導入では形質転換巣は形成されず、染色体不安定性が多種のがん遺伝子発現の原因と考えられた。
pmid-3692432.summary_en: Five choriocarcinoma cell lines were analyzed for c-onc gene alterations and expression. Southern blotting showed eightfold c-myc amplification and a c-fms rearrangement in one line. Northern blotting revealed expression of at least 11 c-onc genes, with N-myc and fos especially enhanced. Transfection of NIH3T3 cells produced no transformed foci. The authors attribute the multiple oncogene expression to chromosomal instability.

pmid-3692668.summary_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の電子顕微鏡所見を、正常発生卵巣の胚細胞と比較した。腫瘍細胞は胎児卵原細胞に類似した超微細構造を示した。卵母細胞分化の特徴は認められず、全例で細胞間橋が欠如していた。細胞間連絡の欠如が無制御な有糸分裂と胚細胞腫瘍化につながると著者らは示唆している。
pmid-3692668.summary_en: Electron microscopy of ovarian dysgerminomas was compared with germ cells in the normal developing ovary. Neoplastic cells showed prominent reticular nucleoli and sparse organelles, resembling fetal oogonia. Oocyte differentiation features were absent, and intercellular bridges were lost in all tumors. The authors suggest that the lack of intercellular communication may allow uncontrolled mitosis and drive germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-3693570.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の転移巣に対する細針穿刺吸引細胞診の有用性を検討した1987年の報告。奇形腫と典型的なセミノーマは細胞学的に診断可能だったが、陰性所見では生存腫瘍を除外できないとしている。化学療法後の壊死性腫瘤での検体採取の困難さも指摘し、原発性精巣腫瘍の診断への応用は推奨していない。
pmid-3693570.summary_en: This 1987 study established cytological features of testicular germ cell tumors from 15 resected specimens, then applied them to fine needle aspiration cytology of metastases in 27 patients referred for chemotherapy. Teratomas and typical seminomas showed characteristic features enabling diagnosis, whereas spermatocytic and anaplastic seminomas were not represented. Positive cytology aided management, but negative results did not exclude viable tumor, especially in necrotic masses after chemotherapy. The authors caution against using the technique to diagnose primary testicular tumors.

pmid-3795345.summary_ja: 1987年の症例報告で、18歳女性に生じた後腹膜原発の良性嚢胞性奇形腫を記述している。単純X線で右上腹部の歯牙状石灰化が認められた。CTとMRIで腫瘤を評価し、矢状断・冠状断MRIが病変範囲の決定と隣接臓器との鑑別に有用であったとしている。後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍の画像所見として参考になる。
pmid-3795345.summary_en: This 1987 case report describes a primary benign cystic teratoma of the retroperitoneum in an 18-year-old woman. Plain abdominal radiographs showed tooth-like calcifications in the right upper quadrant. Computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging were used to characterize the mass. The authors found sagittal and coronal MRI particularly useful for defining the lesion's extent and separating it from adjacent structures. The report illustrates imaging features relevant to retroperitoneal germ cell tumors.

pmid-3801178.summary_ja: 1987年の本報告は、耳に発生した卵黄嚢(内胚葉洞)腫瘍の、著者らの知る限り初めての症例を記述している。腫瘍は側頭骨異常を伴う発達遅滞の小児に生じ、病理組織学的および免疫細胞化学的特徴は性腺の卵黄嚢腫瘍と一致した。腫瘍は化学療法後に消失し、患者は報告時点で病変を認めなかった。著者らは、この希少な疾患を小児耳腫瘍の鑑別診断に加えることを目的としている。
pmid-3801178.summary_en: This 1987 report describes what the authors believe is the first case of a yolk sac (endodermal sinus) tumor arising in the ear. The tumor occurred in a developmentally delayed child with an abnormal temporal bone. Histopathologic and immunocytochemical features matched gonadal yolk sac tumors. The tumor resolved after chemotherapy, and the patient remained disease-free at reporting. The authors aim to add this rare entity to the differential diagnosis of pediatric ear neoplasms.

pmid-3802016.summary_ja: 1987年の報告で、46XY核型をもつ4人きょうだいの家系を記述している。表現型女性のXY姉妹2例と男性1例に胚細胞腫瘍が発生した。46XY性腺異形成症候群は悪性化リスクが高く、女性きょうだいには予防的性腺摘除を含むスクリーニングが推奨される。罹患女性の兄弟もリスクがあることを示した。
pmid-3802016.summary_en: This 1987 report describes a family of four siblings with a 46,XY karyotype. Two phenotypically female XY sisters and one male sibling each developed germ cell tumors, including dysgerminoma, gonadoblastoma and testicular germ cell neoplasia. The syndrome of 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis carries a high risk of malignancy, and screening of female siblings with prophylactic gonadectomy is generally recommended. The authors show that brothers of affected sisters may also be at risk, so family members should be considered for surveillance.

pmid-3802066.summary_ja: 1987年の報告で、マウス奇形癌細胞PCC4-aza1を腹腔内に留置した拡散チャンバーで培養すると腫瘍原性が変化するかを検討した。拡散チャンバー培養により腫瘍原性は低下した。F9およびH-2抗原の発現は変化せず、多能性奇形癌細胞の腫瘍原性低下がこれらの抗原変化を伴うとは限らないことが示唆された。
pmid-3802066.summary_en: This 1987 study tested whether culturing mouse teratocarcinoma PCC4-aza1 cells in diffusion chambers implanted in the peritoneal cavity alters their tumorigenicity. Diffusion chamber culture reduced tumorigenic activity. F9 and H-2 antigen expression stayed unchanged, a pattern similar to that previously reported for OTT6050 embryoid body cells. The findings suggest that reduced tumorigenicity in multipotent teratocarcinoma cells does not necessarily involve changes in these antigens. The work models germ cell tumor biology in vitro and in vivo.

pmid-3803455.summary_ja: 1987年の報告で、F9胎児性癌細胞が単層培養において多系統へ分化できることを示した。壁側および臓側内胚葉、神経細胞、脂肪細胞の特徴を持つ細胞が同定された。単一のF9細胞に由来するコロニーに複数の細胞型が混在し、in vitroで多能性であると結論づけた。胎児性癌の分化に関する基礎的知見を提供する。
pmid-3803455.summary_en: This 1987 study showed that individual F9 embryonal carcinoma cells can differentiate in monolayer culture into multiple lineages. Cells with parietal and visceral endoderm, neuronal and adipocyte features were identified. Thy-1-positive cells and large multinucleated cells expressing cytoplasmic fibronectin were also seen. Mixed cell types arose within colonies derived from single F9 cells, supporting the conclusion that F9 cells are pluripotent in vitro. The paper provides foundational data on embryonal carcinoma differentiation.

pmid-3805404.summary_ja: 本報告は後縦隔奇形腫の単純X線およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を示したものである。CTにより腫瘤が後縦隔由来であることが確認され、内容物に関する追加情報が得られ、周囲構造は保たれているように見えた。これらの所見は手術計画において重要な役割を果たした。この症例は、術前の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍評価におけるCTの有用性を示している。
pmid-3805404.summary_en: This report describes plain radiographic and computed tomography (CT) features of a posterior mediastinal teratoma. CT confirmed the posterior mediastinal origin of the mass, provided additional information about its contents, and showed apparent sparing of surrounding structures. These findings were important for surgical planning. The report highlights the value of CT in evaluating posterior mediastinal germ cell lesions before surgery.

pmid-3806826.summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマにより下大静脈の血栓症および閉塞を来した症例を報告する。この稀な合併症の病態機序について考察し、静脈血栓の検出に用いられる画像診断および臨床的管理戦略についても概説している。精巣胚細胞腫瘍に伴う静脈合併症を診療する臨床医にとって関連の深い内容である。
pmid-3806826.summary_en: This report describes a case of metastatic seminoma causing thrombosis and obstruction of the inferior vena cava. The authors discuss the pathogenesis of this rare complication. They also review diagnostic studies used to detect vena caval thrombosis and clinical management strategies. The paper is relevant to clinicians managing testicular germ cell tumors with venous complications, particularly those with retroperitoneal or caval involvement.

pmid-3808272.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の転移に続発した多発性腫瘍性頭蓋内動脈瘤を有する症例を報告する。4個の動脈瘤が認められ、左心室の絨毛癌移植巣由来の腫瘍組織が頭側へ塞栓したものと考えられた。過去に報告された10例をレビューしている。本論文は胚細胞腫瘍の脳および心臓への転移に関する内容である。
pmid-3808272.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with multiple oncotic intracranial aneurysms secondary to metastatic choriocarcinoma, with four aneurysms identified. The aneurysms were thought to arise from cephalic embolization of neoplastic tissue from a choriocarcinoma implant in the left ventricle of the heart. The authors review the ten previously reported cases of this complication. The paper concerns metastasis of a germ cell tumor to the brain and heart.

pmid-3809479.summary_ja: 手術で確定した卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫23例（患者18例）のMR画像所見を評価した。腫瘍内の脂肪は皮下脂肪と類似した信号を示し、特徴的な化学シフトアーチファクトにより子宮内膜嚢胞との鑑別が可能であった。20例で確定診断が可能で、2cmの腫瘍も描出された。他の画像診断で診断が困難な症例において有用と考えられる。
pmid-3809479.summary_en: This study evaluated magnetic resonance (MR) imaging features of ovarian cystic teratomas in 18 patients with 23 surgically proven tumors. Fat within the lesion showed signal similar to subcutaneous fat, with a characteristic chemical shift artifact that distinguished these tumors from endometrial cysts. Other features, including floating debris and dermoid plugs, allowed confident diagnosis. MR imaging was diagnostic in 20 tumors and detected a 2 cm lesion, making it valuable in problematic cases.

pmid-3810217.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ44例に対する初回放射線療法の成績を後方視的に検討した。病期Iでは3年無病生存率が100%、病期IIでは放射線単独で92%であった。サルベージ療法を含めた全生存率は98%であった。未分化組織像や精巣摘除術前のβ-hCG高値は予後に影響しなかった。本研究は、精巣セミノーマにおける初回放射線療法の位置づけを示すものである。
pmid-3810217.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 44 patients with testicular seminoma treated with primary radiation therapy. Stage I patients received infradiaphragmatic irradiation, while more advanced disease received mediastinal and infradiaphragmatic fields. Three-year disease-free survival was 100% for stage I and 92% for stage II with radiation alone. Overall survival with primary radiotherapy and salvage therapy was 98%. Anaplastic histology and elevated beta-hCG did not affect prognosis.

pmid-3810227.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の初回治療の成功後2年に、局所浸潤性の前縦隔カルチノイド腫瘍を発症した33歳男性を報告する。腫瘍は化学療法に抵抗性で、電子顕微鏡では緻密芯内分泌顆粒が認められた。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の有効な治療後にカルチノイドが発生した例は、これまでに報告を見いだせなかったとしている。長期経過観察の重要性を示す症例である。
pmid-3810227.summary_en: This report describes a 33-year-old man who developed a locally aggressive anterior mediastinal carcinoid tumor two years after successful treatment of a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor. The carcinoid was refractory to chemotherapy and showed dense-core endocrine granules on electron microscopy. The authors note that they found no previous examples of a carcinoid arising as a sequel to or refractory component of a mediastinal germ cell tumor after effective therapy.

pmid-3814144.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞の糖タンパク質プロセシングにおける糖鎖の動態を検討した基礎研究である。分化に伴い消失する大型で複雑な糖鎖を発現し、代謝標識により二シアル酸型の二分岐糖鎖が一過性に現れることを示した。その後、ガラクトースとN-アセチルグルコサミンが伸長した非シアル化糖鎖へと置き換わった。多能性を持つ胚細胞由来癌細胞の糖鎖修飾の動態を理解する上で有用である。
pmid-3814144.summary_en: This basic biochemistry study examines glycan processing in embryonal carcinoma cells, which express large, complex, poorly sialylated carbohydrates that are lost upon differentiation. Metabolic labeling showed a transient expression of sialylated biantennary glycans during glycoprotein processing. During chase periods, these were replaced by unsialylated glycans with elongated galactose and N-acetylglucosamine branches. The findings clarify the dynamic glycosylation of pluripotent germ-cell-derived carcinoma cells.

pmid-3815296.summary_ja: 1987年のフィラデルフィアの小児18例の解析。卵黄嚢腫瘍が最多で、外科切除後のシスプラチン含有化学療法で成績が改善した一方、アドリアマイシンは心不全死の原因となった。PBVbとACによる術後化学療法を推奨し、放射線療法は限定的とする。
pmid-3815296.summary_en: This 1987 Philadelphia series reviewed 18 children and adolescents treated for malignant ovarian tumors, mostly endodermal sinus tumors and embryonal carcinomas, with dysgerminomas also included. Patients with endodermal sinus tumors treated with surgery and cisplatin-based chemotherapy generally fared better than those with earlier regimens, while adriamycin was associated with cardiac deaths. Children with embryonal carcinoma did well after surgery with or without chemotherapy. The authors recommend cisplatin, bleomycin, vinblastine and actinomycin-based chemotherapy after surgery, consider radiation therapy of limited use, and advise against routine adriamycin.

pmid-3816068.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが尿道周囲組織と胃粘膜下に転移した1例の報告。放射線療法と化学療法で良好に反応し、バリウム造影とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で腫瘤の縮小が確認された。非典型部位への転移例として、多角的治療の有効性と胃転移の文献的概観を示す。
pmid-3816068.summary_en: This 1987 Clinical Radiology report describes a patient with testicular seminoma who developed unusual metastases to periurethral tissue and the gastric submucosa. Both sites responded well to combined irradiation and chemotherapy, with regression demonstrated on barium meal and computed tomography. The authors also present a brief review of gastric metastases from germ cell tumors. The case illustrates that seminoma can spread to atypical sites and that early diagnosis matters, with favorable outcomes achievable with multimodal therapy.

pmid-3817167.summary_ja: 若年男性に生じた脾臓絨毛癌の症例報告。未分化癌様の所見を呈する若年男性では、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべきと強調する。早期診断により治療反応は良好となる。治療経過の詳細は記載されていない。
pmid-3817167.summary_en: This 1987 European Journal of Surgical Oncology case report describes choriocarcinoma involving the spleen in a young man presenting with apparently undifferentiated carcinoma. The authors emphasize that a non-testicular germ cell tumor should be considered in young men with such presentations, and that extragonadal germ cell tumors respond well to treatment when diagnosed early. The report is brief and does not detail the treatment regimen or outcome, but highlights a rare extragonadal site of choriocarcinoma and the importance of early diagnosis.

pmid-3818383.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマ163例を対象に、精巣摘除術後の放射線療法の成績を後方視的に検討した。無病生存率は15年まで95%。精索浸潤のみが予後不良因子で、傍大動脈領域照射により有意差は消失した。術後放射線療法を第一選択とすると結論づける。
pmid-3818383.summary_en: This 1987 retrospective study evaluated 163 patients with Stage I testicular seminoma treated with orchiectomy followed by adjuvant radiation therapy. Disease-free survival was 95% at 5, 10, and 15 years. Spermatic cord involvement was the only significant adverse prognostic factor, though this was not significant when para-aortic fields were irradiated. No patient in the para-aortic-irradiated group developed subdiaphragmatic recurrence, and no delayed complications were observed. The authors conclude that routine postorchiectomy radiation therapy is the treatment of choice and discuss the advantages and limits of surveillance.

pmid-3818384.summary_ja: 病期II精巣セミノーマ62例の後方視的検討。無病生存率は86%で、放射線療法と白金製剤化学療法の間に有意差はなかった。腹部病変の大きさが予後因子であり、10cm未満は放射線療法、大きな病変は化学療法を推奨する。
pmid-3818384.summary_en: This 1987 retrospective review analyzed 62 patients with Stage II testicular seminoma treated with initial radiation therapy or platinum-containing chemotherapy. Disease-free survival from 2 to 20 years was 86%, with no significant difference between treatment groups. Most clinical features did not predict outcome, but bulk of abdominal disease did: patients with small-volume disease had 95% disease-free survival with radiation, versus 64% for bulky disease. The authors recommend radiation for small-volume disease and platinum chemotherapy for bulky disease, with irradiation of residual masses, while acknowledging the lack of prospective data.

pmid-3819510.summary_ja: 新規に樹立した3種のヒト絨毛癌細胞株の抗がん剤感受性を、BeWo株と比較したin vitro研究。NaUCC-2ではメトトレキサートがアクチノマイシンDの効果を抑制した。薬剤の細胞内取り込みの違いも感受性を部分的に説明し、難治性絨毛癌の化学療法の組み合わせ選択に示唆を与える。
pmid-3819510.summary_en: This 1987 Japanese in vitro study established three new human choriocarcinoma cell lines (NaUCC-1, -2, -3) in nude mice and compared their sensitivity to actinomycin D, methotrexate, and their combination with BeWo cells. NaUCC-1, derived from a treatment-resistant patient, showed low methotrexate sensitivity but high actinomycin D sensitivity. In NaUCC-2, methotrexate added simultaneously reduced actinomycin D sensitivity, suggesting antagonism. Drug uptake differences partly explained these patterns. The findings inform the rationale for choosing chemotherapy combinations in refractory choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3819512.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoとSCHにおいて、アンホテリシンBがアクチノマイシンDの細胞内濃度を高め、相乗的な細胞殺傷効果を示した。感受性は細胞内濃度と相関していた。薬剤抵抗性絨毛癌に対する併用療法の試みとして示唆される基礎研究。
pmid-3819512.summary_en: This 1987 Japanese in vitro study examined how amphotericin B affects the sensitivity of two human choriocarcinoma cell lines, BeWo and SCH, to actinomycin D. BeWo was more sensitive to actinomycin D than SCH, and sensitivity tracked intracellular drug concentration. Amphotericin B increased intracellular actinomycin D levels in a dose-dependent way, and combined treatment produced synergistic cell kill, reported as 1,000-fold in BeWo and 100-fold in SCH. The authors suggest combination therapy with actinomycin D and amphotericin B as a possible approach for drug-resistant choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3819516.summary_ja: MAC療法に抵抗性の難治性絨毛癌を対象に、メトトレキサート（MTX）、ビンクリスチン、アクチノマイシンDを組み合わせたMOA療法を開発した。再発例8例中、MAC療法は1例のみ有効であったのに対し、MOA療法は5例で有効であり、MAC抵抗例2例も含まれた。
pmid-3819516.summary_en: This 1987 Japanese study addresses refractory choriocarcinoma that failed MAC therapy. Fundamental experiments with methotrexate-resistant cell lines identified effective drug concentrations for combinations of methotrexate and actinomycin D. Based on these results and nude mouse data on vincristine, the authors developed MOA therapy, combining moderate-dose methotrexate, vincristine, and actinomycin D. Among eight recurrent cases, MAC was effective in only one, while MOA was effective in five, including two MAC-resistant cases, suggesting MOA is more effective than MAC for refractory choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3820022.summary_ja: 先天性鼻咽頭奇形腫の1例を報告し、頸部へ進展した症例の臨床像を記述するとともに、過去の鼻咽頭奇形腫文献を総括している。奇形腫は胚細胞腫瘍の一型であり、性腺外に発生した稀な例として位置づけられる。抄録は簡潔で、治療や転帰の詳細は記載されていない。
pmid-3820022.summary_en: This 1987 case report describes a congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma extending into the cervical region, followed by a review of previously reported nasopharyngeal teratomas. As a rare extragonadal teratoma arising in the head and neck, it falls within the germ cell tumor spectrum. The abstract is brief and does not describe the patient's treatment, outcome, or detailed histology. Its main contribution is the clinical documentation of an unusual anatomical site together with a literature synthesis.

pmid-3820391.summary_ja: 63歳男性の精巣に発生した巨大腫瘍(160g)で、純粋型絨毛癌と診断された稀な症例を報告している。組織学的に合胞体栄養膜細胞と細胞性栄養膜細胞のみから成り、免疫染色でヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が強陽性、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は陰性であった。抄録には治療や転帰は記載されていない。
pmid-3820391.summary_en: This 1987 report describes a 63-year-old man with a large testicular tumor diagnosed as pure choriocarcinoma, a histological type rarely seen at this age. Immunostaining showed strong human chorionic gonadotropin reactivity in syncytiotrophoblastic cells, moderate keratin positivity, and no alpha-fetoprotein staining. The tumor showed necrosis and hemorrhage, and the title indicates metastatic spread. The abstract does not describe treatment or outcome. The case is notable for its rarity in both histology and patient age.

pmid-3820395.summary_ja: 精巣由来の絨毛癌細胞株JHTK-1を樹立し、その特性を解析した研究である。混合型胚細胞腫瘍をヌードマウスに異種移植した腫瘍から樹立され、3年間の培養でヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を持続的に産生した。ジブチリル環状AMPによりhCG分泌が15倍以上に増加し、細胞の分化が示唆された。ヌードマウスでは絨毛癌に類似した嚢胞性腫瘍を形成した。
pmid-3820395.summary_en: This 1987 study establishes JHTK-1, an in vitro human cell line of testicular choriocarcinoma derived from a xenografted mixed germ cell tumor. The line has been maintained for three years and persistently secretes human chorionic gonadotropin. Its chromosome numbers range from tetraploid to septaploid. Dibutyryl cyclic AMP strongly increased hCG secretion and induced morphological changes consistent with differentiation from cytotrophoblasts to syncytiotrophoblasts. After transplantation into nude mice, the cells formed cystic tumors resembling choriocarcinoma, making the line a useful model.

pmid-3820595.summary_ja: 精巣悪性腫瘍の後腹膜転移に対し経動脈塞栓療法(TAE)を施行し、全身状態の改善が得られた症例を報告している。腫瘍栄養血管は肋間動脈と腰動脈であった。化学療法や放射線療法に抵抗性、または手術不能な転移性後腹膜腫瘍に対して有効である可能性が示唆されている。抄録は1例の報告にとどまる。
pmid-3820595.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a patient with retroperitoneal metastasis from a malignant testicular tumor treated with transarterial embolization (TAE). The tumor was fed by intercostal and lumbar arteries, and TAE improved the patient's condition. The authors suggest TAE may be useful for metastatic retroperitoneal tumors that are resistant to chemotherapy or radiotherapy, or are inoperable. The abstract is brief and does not report the number of cases, embolic agents, follow-up duration, or long-term outcomes, which limits the conclusions that can be drawn.

pmid-3822306.summary_ja: 中枢神経系に転移した妊娠性絨毛癌について、登録症例70例と自施設の8例を解析している。無治療群、化学療法単独群、化学療法と全脳照射の併用群の生存率は、それぞれ0%、24%、50%であった。併用療法群では中枢神経系による死亡が認められなかった。放射線療法は中枢神経系絨毛癌に特有の治療的役割を持つと結論づけている。
pmid-3822306.summary_en: This 1987 study examines treatment of gestational choriocarcinoma metastatic to the central nervous system. Data from 70 registry cases and eight patients at the USC Western Trophoblastic Disease Center were analyzed, comparing no treatment, chemotherapy alone, and chemotherapy with whole-brain irradiation. Survival was 0%, 24%, and 50% respectively, and CNS-related deaths fell from 74% to 58% to none. The authors conclude that radiation has a distinct therapeutic role for CNS choriocarcinoma, and that irradiated brains resist recurrence even in fatal cases.

pmid-3823458.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫200例の連続コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を検討した研究である。転移例120例に化学療法を行い、病期I 80例を対照群とした。化学療法群の14例(11.6%)で治療後3〜14か月に胸腺増大が出現し、対照群では1例のみであった。増大例では平均45か月のフォローアップで93%が無病であった。胸腺増大は予後良好の指標となりうると考察している。
pmid-3823458.summary_en: This 1987 Radiology study reviewed serial CT scans of 200 men with malignant testicular teratoma. 120 patients with metastatic disease received chemotherapy, while 80 with stage I disease served as untreated controls. Thymic enlargement appeared 3 to 14 months after treatment in 14 chemotherapy patients, compared with one control. Histology in one case confirmed true hyperplasia. Patients with thymic enlargement had a higher rate of disease-free survival (93% versus 78%). The authors suggest rebound thymic hyperplasia may be a favorable prognostic sign.

pmid-3824729.summary_ja: 成人に発生した原発性後腹膜奇形腫の1例で、腫瘍は甲状腺組織のみから構成されていた。単一組織型からなる単胚葉性奇形腫は稀な亜型である。後腹膜原発は稀な部位であり、類似病変の鑑別に役立つと考えられる。本報告ではコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を提示している。抄録には患者の年齢、症状、治療、経過は記載されていない。
pmid-3824729.summary_en: This 1987 Urology report describes a primary monodermal retroperitoneal teratoma in an adult, composed entirely of thyroid tissue. Monodermal teratomas are a rare variant in which a single tissue type predominates, and primary retroperitoneal sites are unusual. The authors present the CT appearance of the tumor, which may help radiologists recognize similar lesions. The abstract is brief and does not describe the patient's age, symptoms, surgical management, or follow-up outcome.

pmid-2434373.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞から接着能が欠損した変異株を分離し、分化能を調べた基礎研究です。変異株は胚様体を形成せず、主に壁側内胚葉へ分化しました。ラミニンやIV型コラーゲンは増加しましたが、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は低下しました。臓側内胚葉への分化には細胞同士の凝集が必要と結論づけています。
pmid-2434373.summary_en: This study isolated adhesion-defective variants of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Mutant cells grew as loosely aggregated clusters and, under low-dose retinoic acid, failed to form embryoid bodies. They differentiated mainly toward parietal endoderm, producing higher laminin and type IV collagen but lower alpha-fetoprotein. The authors conclude that cell-cell aggregation provides signals essential for differentiation toward visceral endoderm.

pmid-2434442.summary_ja: 白金化合物をポリ-L-グルタミン酸と結合させ、シスプラチンの毒性を抑える製剤を検討した前臨床研究です。F9胎児性癌細胞に対するin vitroの細胞傷害性は遊離薬より弱いものでした。マウスモデルでは治療域が広く、毒性は低く、高腫瘍量でも遊離薬より高い抗腫瘍効果を示しました。反復高用量投与で腫瘍の消失も認められました。
pmid-2434442.summary_en: This preclinical study complexed platinum compounds with poly-L-glutamic acid to improve drug delivery. The complexes were less cytotoxic in vitro against F9 embryonal carcinoma cells than free cis-DDP. In mice, they had a wider therapeutic range, lower toxicity, and superior antitumor activity at high tumor loads. Repeated high doses caused partial or complete tumor eradication without toxic deaths. The results suggest the complexes could permit higher, more effective drug doses.

pmid-2434952.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株3種を、レチノイン酸の有無で分化誘導し、ホメオボックス遺伝子の発現を解析した基礎研究です。多くの遺伝子は、レチノイン酸処理でのみ高発現しました。非化学的な分化誘導では発現は検出されませんでした。胚発生パターン形成の研究モデルとして、胎児性癌細胞の意義が示唆されています。
pmid-2434952.summary_en: This study analyzed homeobox-containing gene expression in three mouse embryonal carcinoma cell lines induced to differentiate with or without retinoic acid. High expression of several homeobox genes occurred only with retinoic acid treatment, while nonchemical differentiation did not induce it. Expression correlated with retinoic acid-induced differentiation rather than differentiation per se. The authors suggest these genes may participate in embryonic pattern formation, using EC cells as a developmental model.

pmid-2439896.summary_ja: 1987年の本研究は、未分化F9奇形癌(胎児性癌)細胞へのアデノウイルスE1a遺伝子導入が形態変化と分化を誘導することを示した。SSEA-1の発現は消失し、レチノイン酸処理で誘導される分化と同様にケラチンが発現した。この効果にはE1a蛋白の発現が必要であった。腫瘍学的な臨床課題ではなく、ウイルス癌遺伝子の基礎研究である。
pmid-2439896.summary_en: This 1987 study shows that transfecting undifferentiated F9 teratocarcinoma (embryonal carcinoma) cells with adenovirus E1a plasmids induces morphological differentiation. The cells lost the SSEA-1 stem cell marker and acquired keratin expression, a feature of retinoic acid-induced differentiation. The effect required full-length E1a expression. The authors discuss these findings in the context of E1a functions and other oncogenes that drive F9 differentiation.

pmid-2440957.summary_ja: 1987年の研究は、ヒト奇形癌由来の3細胞株(tera I、tera II、PA1)のインターフェロン産生と感受性を比較した。ウイルスや合成ポリヌクレオチドで刺激すると、tera IIとPA1のみがインターフェロンを産生した。増殖への影響はいずれの細胞株にも認められなかった。奇形癌細胞株の間で、インターフェロン生物学に大きな差があることが示された。
pmid-2440957.summary_en: This 1987 study tested three human teratocarcinoma-derived cell lines (tera I, tera II, PA1) for interferon production and sensitivity. Only tera II and PA1 produced interferon after viral or poly(rI):poly(rC) stimulation, and only tera II was fully protected against all tested viruses. None of the lines responded to IFN treatment in terms of growth. The results show that teratocarcinoma cell lines differ widely in interferon biology.

pmid-2441394.summary_ja: 1987年の研究は、リシン結合抗体を用いた選択法により、TEC-1糖鎖エピトープを欠く胎児性癌細胞変異体(P19由来)を単離した。変異体は少なくとも2つの相補群に分かれ、胚糖鎖の合成に3つの遺伝子が関与すると示唆された。完全に欠損した変異体も胎児性癌腫瘍を形成した。胚糖鎖は胎児性癌の特性の一部に必須ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-2441394.summary_en: This 1987 study isolated mutant embryonal carcinoma cells (P19 derivatives) lacking the TEC-1 carbohydrate epitope, using a ricin-conjugated antibody selection method. Three mutants fell into at least two complementation groups, suggesting three genes control embryoglycan synthesis. One mutant lacked embryoglycan entirely but still formed embryonal carcinoma tumors. The authors conclude that embryoglycan is not required for several core embryonal carcinoma properties.

pmid-2445905.summary_ja: 1987年のウイルス学研究で、ヒト奇形癌腫由来の培養細胞株からレトロウイルス様粒子を解析した。精製したウイルスは60S RNAをゲノムとし、逆転写酵素活性も確認された。形態学的・生物学的・免疫学的にHTLVやHIVとは区別された。胚細胞腫瘍由来の細胞株を用いているが、主題はウイルスそのものである。
pmid-2445905.summary_en: This 1987 virology study characterized retroviruses from human teratocarcinomas. Five cultured tumor lines yielded only very low amounts of retrovirus-like particles, and one line supplied enough virus for purification. The purified virus had high molecular weight 60S RNA as its genome and partially purified reverse transcriptase activity. These HTDVs were distinguished from human T-lymphotropic viruses and HIV by morphology, biology, and immunology. The germ cell tumor is the source of the cells, but the focus is the virus.

pmid-2824633.summary_ja: 本研究は、ジブチリルcAMPとEGFがhCGおよびそのサブユニットの合成・分泌をどのように調節するかを、in vitroで比較したものである。両物質は正常胎盤外植片と絨毛癌細胞株BeWoでhCG産生を増加させ、BeWoでの効果はより大きかった。一方、子宮頸癌細胞株CaSkiではhCGβの刺激は認められず、トロフォブラストと非トロフォブラスト腫瘍細胞では調節機構が異なると結論づけている。
pmid-2824633.summary_en: This in vitro study compared how dibutyryl cAMP and epidermal growth factor (EGF) regulate hCG and its subunit synthesis and secretion. Both agents increased hCG output in normal placental explants and in BeWo choriocarcinoma cells, with a much stronger effect in BeWo. In contrast, CaSki cervical carcinoma cells showed no stimulation of hCG beta. The authors conclude that trophoblastic cells share a regulatory mechanism that differs from that in non-trophoblastic tumor cells.

pmid-2825135.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来の胎児性癌細胞、体細胞組織、精子および胎盤におけるヒトDNA配列のCpGメチル化を比較した。Sp-0.3配列などは胎児性癌細胞で高メチル化していたが、卵黄嚢癌細胞株では低メチル化していた。これらは初期胚発生の過程で協調的にメチル化が変化することを示唆する。
pmid-2825135.summary_en: This study compared CpG methylation of human DNA sequences in embryonal carcinoma cells derived from testicular germ cell tumors, somatic tissues, sperm, and placenta. The Sp-0.3 sequences and newly isolated sperm-hypomethylated sequences were hypermethylated in EC cells but hypomethylated in a yolk sac carcinoma line. The findings suggest coordinated methylation changes during early embryonic differentiation.

pmid-2834254.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞の凝集体を用い、レチノイン酸およびcAMPによる分化過程で細胞外基質遺伝子の発現を測定した。ラミニンB2は特異的な制御を受け、PG-19は100倍以上誘導された。F9細胞は分化やホルモンの影響、腫瘍原性の喪失を研究するモデルとして有用とされる。
pmid-2834254.summary_en: In F9 embryonal carcinoma cell aggregates, expression of proteoglycan-19, laminin B1/B2, and type IV collagen genes was measured during retinoic acid-induced and cAMP-enhanced differentiation toward visceral and parietal endoderm. Laminin B2 was uniquely regulated, and PG-19 was induced more than 100-fold. The authors conclude that matrix gene regulation differs among components and that F9 cells provide a model for hormone effects on differentiation and loss of tumorigenicity.

pmid-2847374.summary_ja: 培養ヒト胎盤細胞とJAr絨毛癌細胞株のアロマターゼ発現を比較した研究です。絨毛癌細胞ではアロマターゼ成分の発現陽性細胞が多く、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)陽性細胞も多く認められました。胎盤線維芽細胞の活性は低値でした。絨毛癌細胞株は主に正常栄養膜との比較対象として用いられています。
pmid-2847374.summary_en: This study compares aromatase expression in cultured human term placental cells with that in the JAr choriocarcinoma cell line. Immunocytochemistry showed that a much larger fraction of choriocarcinoma cells expressed each aromatase component than primary trophoblast cells, and hCG-containing cells were also more frequent in choriocarcinoma cultures. Placental fibroblasts had lower aromatase activity, which did not change with cAMP treatment. The choriocarcinoma line thus serves mainly as a comparator for normal trophoblast biology.

pmid-2883035.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で分化誘導されたマウス胎児性癌細胞のトランスグルタミナーゼ活性を検討した基礎研究です。TGase阻害化合物は、培養下でのEC細胞の分化を阻害しました。TGaseがレチノイン酸誘導性分化に関与する可能性が示唆されています。臨床的な腫瘍データは含まれていません。
pmid-2883035.summary_en: This study examines transglutaminase (TGase) activity in murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells induced to differentiate with retinoic acid. TGase activity changes shortly after retinoic acid exposure. Compounds that inhibit TGase enzyme activity in vitro successfully block retinoic acid-induced EC cell differentiation in culture. The findings suggest TGase may mediate retinoic acid-induced differentiation of EC cells. The work is a cell biology study using a murine EC cell model without clinical tumor data.

pmid-2883052.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で誘導されるP19胎児性癌細胞の分化過程を検討した基礎研究です。同期化細胞は2時間の曝露で分化へのコミットメントを示しました。分化決定はG1期の曝露で成立し、S期では成立しませんでした。臨床的な腫瘍データは含まれていません。
pmid-2883052.summary_en: This study investigates how P19 embryonal carcinoma cells become anchorage dependent during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Anchorage dependence developed after a lag period, and synchronized cells committed to differentiation after only 2 hours of retinoic acid exposure, while asynchronous cells needed at least 24 hours. Commitment depended on cell cycle phase, with G1 exposure sufficient and S phase exposure not. Plasminogen activator secretion and EGF binding increased later, days after retinoic acid addition.

pmid-2952280.summary_ja: マウス胚性癌幹細胞が、分化細胞より効率よくE1A誘導性プロモーターを活性化する、E1A類似の転写活性を持つことを示した研究である。胚性癌細胞の表現型は分化細胞との混合実験で優性であった。F9およびPCC4の胚性癌細胞にだけ結合活性が認められた。ヒト患者の腫瘍を扱う研究ではなく、細胞株を用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-2952280.summary_en: The authors find that murine embryonal carcinoma stem cells contain a transcription activity analogous to adenoviral E1A, which activates E1A-inducible promoters more efficiently than extracts from differentiated cells. Mixing experiments show the EC phenotype is dominant, and a DNA-binding activity is present in F9 and PCC4 EC cells but absent in differentiated cells. The work is basic cell biology of EC cell lines and does not address tumors in patients.

pmid-2956269.summary_ja: 奇形癌幹細胞由来の胚様体から分化する壁側内胚葉の移動と分化に対する細胞外基質の役割を検討した1987年の研究。フィブロネクチンが移動を促進する主要因子であり、RGDSペプチドやフィブロネクチン受容体(140kD)抗体で付着と増殖が阻害された。腫瘍そのものではなく発生モデルとして胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞を用いている。
pmid-2956269.summary_en: This 1987 study examines how extracellular matrix components influence the migration and differentiation of parietal endoderm from embryoid bodies formed by teratocarcinoma stem cells. Fibronectin was identified as the principal migration-promoting substrate, far more effective than laminin or collagen IV. The RGDS peptide blocked attachment and outgrowth, and an antibody against the 140-kD fibronectin receptor confirmed the receptor's involvement. The work uses teratocarcinoma-derived cells as a developmental model rather than studying tumor behavior directly.

pmid-2960554.summary_ja: 多能性マウス奇形癌細胞株311細胞に新規分化誘導剤Ch55を作用させた1987年の研究。c-mos遺伝子の発現抑制とともに、プラスミノゲンアクチベーター分泌増加などの初期分化マーカーの変化を認めた。Ch55は奇形癌細胞の強力な分化誘導剤であると結論している。胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞株を主に分化モデルとして用いている。
pmid-2960554.summary_en: This 1987 study tests Ch55, a chalcone derivative, as an inducer of differentiation in 311 cells, a pluripotent mouse teratocarcinoma line. Treatment suppressed c-mos gene expression and produced early differentiation markers, including increased plasminogen activator secretion and reduced peanut agglutinin receptors and glucose transport. The authors conclude that Ch55 is a potent inducer of teratocarcinoma cells that suppresses c-mos. The work uses this embryonal carcinoma-derived line mainly as a model of cellular differentiation.

pmid-3029143.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞の核と、レチノイン酸結合タンパク質CRABPおよびレチノール結合タンパク質CRBPの相互作用を検討した。単離核へのレチノイド結合は飽和性を示し、結合タンパク質によって修飾された。界面活性剤処理で結合リガンドの多くが除去された。結果は結合タンパク質の細胞質から核への移行を反映する可能性があるが、他の解釈も検討されている。
pmid-3029143.summary_en: This study examines how retinoid-binding proteins CRABP and CRBP interact with nuclei of embryonal carcinoma cells. Binding of retinoic acid and retinol to isolated nuclei was saturable and was modulated by the binding proteins, and detergent treatment removed much of the bound ligand. Nucleoplasmic extracts from retinoic acid or retinol treated cells showed specific retinoid binding. Results may reflect translocation of binding proteins from cytoplasm to nucleus, though alternative explanations are considered.

pmid-3034091.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞がレチノイドにより壁側内胚葉へ分化する程度を、ラミニンのELISA法で定量する方法を開発した研究である。測定条件を標準化し、用量反応曲線を統計的に比較した。レチノイン酸が最も強力で（半数効果濃度1.3 nM）、レチノールはその175倍弱かった。酸化・異性化代謝物は効力が低く、合成レチノイドおよびビタミンD類似物質は不活性であった。
pmid-3034091.summary_en: This 1987 methods study developed an ELISA for laminin to quantify retinoid-induced differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells into parietal endoderm. The assay was standardized for incubation time, laminin production kinetics, and dibutyryl cAMP effects, and dose-response curves were compared statistically with a microcomputer program. Retinoic acid was most potent (half-maximal response at 1.3 nM), while retinol was 175-fold less potent. Several oxidized or isomerized retinoic acid metabolites were less potent, and synthetic retinoids and vitamin D were inactive.

pmid-3034405.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌由来の細胞株PA-1を用い、活性化N-rasがん遺伝子が腫瘍形成能を誘導するかを検討した研究です。腫瘍形成能を持つ後期継代細胞は活性化N-rasを保持し、非腫瘍性の初期継代復帰株は生殖細胞系列の原がん遺伝子のみを保持していました。活性化遺伝子を導入すると復帰株に腫瘍形成が生じ、N-rasの因果的関与が示唆されました。臨床研究ではなく、胚細胞腫瘍由来株を用いた基礎研究です。
pmid-3034405.summary_en: This study examines whether an activated N-ras oncogene causes tumorigenicity in human cells. Using PA-1, a human teratocarcinoma cell line, the authors compare tumorigenic late-passage cells carrying an activated N-ras gene with nontumorigenic early-passage revertant cells that retain only the germ-line protooncogene. Introducing the activated oncogene by gene transfer induced the revertant cells to form tumors, supporting a causal role for N-ras in tumorigenesis of these cells. The work is primarily a cancer-genetics study using a germ cell tumor-derived line as a model, rather than a clinical investigation of germ cell tumors.

pmid-3112523.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌由来の株から得られた、アフィジコリン耐性の変異誘発株を解析した基礎研究である。3株すべてで自然変異頻度が上昇し、dNTPプール量が変化していた。いずれも同系マウスで腫瘍を形成したが、多能性の有無は株により異なった。主題はDNA複製の忠実度であり、臨床の胚細胞腫瘍に関する内容は乏しい。
pmid-3112523.summary_en: This basic research study characterizes aphidicolin-resistant mutator strains derived from a mouse teratocarcinoma line. Three mutants showed elevated spontaneous mutation rates and altered dNTP pools, with some showing increased DNA polymerase alpha activity or altered enzyme sensitivity to aphidicolin. All three formed tumors in syngeneic mice, though differing in multipotency. The work is primarily about DNA replication fidelity using teratocarcinoma cells as a model, with little direct clinical germ cell tumor content.

pmid-3139347.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株におけるIAPレトロエレメント遺伝子の発現を検討し、既報の矛盾の解消を目指した。ノーザン解析と核内転写アッセイにより、定常状態のIAP RNA量は転写後機構によって制御されることが示された。IAP発現株ではIAP遺伝子のDNA低メチル化も認められた。本研究は細胞モデルを用いたもので、臨床の胚細胞腫瘍は扱っていない。
pmid-3139347.summary_en: This study examined intracisternal A particle (IAP) retroelement expression in embryonal carcinoma cell lines, where prior reports conflicted. Northern blotting and nuclear run-on transcription assays indicated that post-transcriptional mechanisms determine steady-state IAP RNA levels. IAP genes were also undermethylated in the cell lines that expressed them. The work uses EC cells as a model system and does not address clinical germ cell tumors.

pmid-3298422.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞において、分子量75,000の膜タンパク質を免疫染色と免疫電顕で局在解析した研究です。本タンパク質は頂端側の微絨毛に特異的に存在し、脂質二重膜の細胞質側に位置することが示されました。臨床的な絨毛癌ではなく、細胞株を用いた基礎的研究です。
pmid-3298422.summary_en: This study localizes an Mr 75,000 plasma membrane protein in JEG-3 human choriocarcinoma cells using immunofluorescence and immunoelectron microscopy. The protein is highly specific to the apical microvilli and lies just inside the lipid bilayer, and it is largely soluble after detergent extraction. The work is cell biology focused on a choriocarcinoma-derived line rather than on the clinical disease.

pmid-3308117.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌由来のNT2/D1細胞をレチノイン酸で処理し、S-100bタンパクが選択的に誘導されることを酵素免疫測定法で示した。二重免疫蛍光染色で、S-100bとニューロフィラメントが同じ神経系細胞群に発現することを確認した。胚細胞腫瘍由来株を神経分化の実験モデルとして用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-3308117.summary_en: Human teratocarcinoma NT2/D1 cells were treated with retinoic acid to induce differentiation, and levels of S-100 and enolase subunits were measured by enzyme immunoassay. S-100b (ββ) was markedly induced by retinoic acid, but not by forskolin, dibutyryl cAMP, or cholera toxin. Double immunofluorescence showed S-100b and neurofilament co-expression in the same neuronal subpopulation. The study uses a germ cell tumour-derived line as an in vitro neuronal differentiation model and does not address clinical germ cell tumour management.

pmid-3308402.summary_ja: マウスEGF受容体に対するモノクローナル抗体とポリクローナル抗体を作製し、その性質を解析した。胚性癌細胞OC15の内胚葉分化過程におけるEGF受容体の誘導を検討し、無傷の細胞では反応しないが可溶化後にはEGF依存性自己リン酸化が検出されることから、潜在性のEGF受容体の存在を示唆した。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍の治療を扱う研究ではなく、基礎発生学研究である。
pmid-3308402.summary_en: Monoclonal and polyclonal antibodies against mouse EGF receptor were prepared and characterized. Rabbit polyclonal antibodies blocked EGF binding and stimulated DNA synthesis at high concentrations, indicating binding near the EGF site. Using these tools, the authors examined EGF receptor induction when OC15 embryonal carcinoma cells differentiate into endodermal derivatives. Intact EC cells did not bind or respond to EGF, but EGF-stimulated autophosphorylation was detectable in solubilized cells, suggesting cryptic EGF receptors in EC stem cells. The work is basic developmental biology and does not address clinical germ cell tumour treatment.

pmid-3308495.summary_ja: マウス胚性癌細胞株F9とPCC7を用い、N-mycとc-mycの発現制御機構を比較した。両遺伝子は主に転写後レベルで調節され、PCC7ではc-mycが転写レベルでも抑制されていた。血清やインスリン等によりc-mycのみが増加する。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床的病態を扱うものではなく、分化と遺伝子発現制御の基礎研究である。
pmid-3308495.summary_en: This study compares regulation of N-myc and c-myc in murine embryonal carcinoma lines F9 and PCC7 under growth conditions and during differentiation. Both genes are mainly controlled post-transcriptionally, with c-myc additionally repressed transcriptionally in PCC7. Serum, insulin and transferrin raise c-myc but not N-myc mRNA, and the two genes differ in expression kinetics, protein-synthesis dependence and transcript half-lives. The EC lines serve as general models of differentiation and myc gene regulation rather than as models of clinical germ cell tumour disease.

pmid-3311384.summary_ja: 奇形癌幹細胞と初期マウス胚の核ラミンを解析し、胚性癌細胞と8日齢以前の胚は、ラミンBに近い単一のラミンのみを発現することを示した。ラミンA/Cは受精卵に出現後消失し、着床後8日胚で再出現する。EC細胞は胚様のモデルとして用いられており、発生過程の核構造を扱う基礎研究である。
pmid-3311384.summary_en: The nuclear lamina of teratocarcinoma stem cells and early mouse embryos was examined. Embryos up to day 8 and embryonal carcinoma cells express only one lamin species closely resembling lamin B. Lamins A and C appear in fertilized eggs, disappear during early cleavage, and reappear at day 8 after implantation. EC cells lack lamins A and C, but some of their differentiated derivatives express them strongly. The work addresses nuclear organization during embryogenesis, using EC cells as embryonic-like models, and does not concern clinical germ cell tumour management.

pmid-3327864.summary_ja: 網膜酸で誘導した多能性ヒト奇形腫細胞株Tera-2 cl.13の分化過程において、c-myc mRNA量を測定した。曝露期間が長くなると細胞周期は延長し、細胞はほぼ静止状態となり分化マーカーを発現した。c-myc発現は未分化細胞に比べ最大1.6倍に増加した。サザンブロットでは、Tera-2においてc-mycの大きな再構成や増幅は認められなかった。
pmid-3327864.summary_en: The study measured c-myc mRNA during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of the pluripotent human teratoma cell line Tera-2 clone 13. With longer exposure, cell cycle duration increased until cells became effectively quiescent and expressed differentiation markers. Steady-state c-myc expression rose up to 1.6-fold relative to undifferentiated cells. Southern blotting showed no major rearrangement or amplification of the c-myc gene in Tera-2.

pmid-3443205.summary_ja: 13年間に眼窩類皮嚢腫の手術を受けた40例を検討している。3歳以降に発見された嚢腫は深部にあり、より大きかった。17歳以降に現れた類表皮嚢腫の多くは頭蓋内成分を伴っていた。組織学的には大半の嚢腫に漏出と炎症がみられた。嚢腫は徐々に増大し周囲組織に炎症と瘢痕を起こすため、全摘出が望ましいと著者らは述べている。
pmid-3443205.summary_en: Reviews 40 patients who underwent surgery for orbital dermoid cysts over 13 years. Cysts found after age three were deeper and larger, and epidermoid cysts appearing after age 17 often had an intracranial component. Most cysts showed leakage and inflammation on histology. The authors recommend total excision because the cysts enlarge gradually and cause inflammation and scarring in adjacent structures.

pmid-3569655.summary_ja: バッファローラット肝細胞の馴化培地に、マウス胎児性癌細胞および胚性幹細胞の自発的分化を抑える活性(DIA)があることを示した研究である。フィーダー細胞なしで未分化状態を維持できる可能性を示す。DIAは透析可能で酸に安定な、分子量約2〜3.5万の因子である。その作用はIGF-IIやTGF-βとは異なる。胎児性癌細胞は実験モデルとして用いられ、腫瘍の臨床的研究ではない。
pmid-3569655.summary_en: Buffalo rat liver (BRL) cell-conditioned medium is shown to prevent spontaneous differentiation of murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) and embryonic stem cells, allowing feeder-free maintenance of undifferentiated cells. It also restricts embryoid body differentiation and partly inhibits retinoic acid-induced differentiation. The factor, DIA, is a dialysable, acid-stable molecule of 20–35 kDa, distinct from IGF-II and TGF-beta. EC cell lines are used as experimental models; the paper addresses stem cell culture biology rather than tumor clinical management.

pmid-3569663.summary_ja: H6胎児性癌細胞の凝集体において、ギャップ結合を介した代謝協同が起こるかを検討した基礎研究である。相補的な変異株を用い、3種の方法で相互供給を確認した。緩い凝集体より圧縮凝集体で、より大きなギャップ結合クラスターを介した供給が多いことを示した。腫瘍の臨床研究ではなく、細胞の圧縮と分化に関する基礎生物学である。
pmid-3569663.summary_en: This study examines whether gap junctions in loose and compacted aggregates of H6 embryonal carcinoma (ECC) cells mediate metabolic cooperation. Using complementary mutant H6 cells and three crossfeeding assays (HAT medium, 6-thioguanine, and tritiated thymidine), the authors show that metabolic crossfeeding occurs through gap junctions in both aggregate types, and more extensively through larger gap junction clusters in compacted aggregates. The work is basic cell biology relating to compaction and differentiation.

pmid-3596087.summary_ja: 蛍光ラベルした胎児性癌細胞（ECa-247）をマウス胚盤胞に導入し、培養中の運命を追跡した研究。細胞は主に壁側栄養外胚葉に分布し、原始内胚葉には少数、内細胞塊にはまれにしか認められなかった。細胞は局在に応じて分化したことが電子顕微鏡で確認された。腫瘍生物学ではなく発生学の研究である。
pmid-3596087.summary_en: The authors injected or aggregated fluorescently labeled embryonal carcinoma (ECa-247) cells into mouse blastocysts and tracked them through culture. The cells localized mainly to mural trophectoderm, with fewer in primitive endoderm and rarely in the inner cell mass. Autoradiography and electron microscopy showed that the cancer-derived cells differentiated according to their position. The study addresses developmental fate of embryonal carcinoma cells rather than tumor biology or clinical care.

pmid-3624271.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARを栄養膜細胞のモデルとして用い、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のαβサブユニットの会合機構を検討した基礎研究。βサブユニットの分子内ジスルフィド結合形成が二量体化の律速段階であり、正しく結合できないβ鎖は遊離型として分泌されると示唆された。
pmid-3624271.summary_en: Using the choriocarcinoma cell line JAR as a model of trophoblastic cells, the authors used pulse-chase labelling and immunoprecipitation to study how hCG alpha and beta subunits assemble. They identified a glycosylated beta-subunit precursor (pre-beta 1) that converts to a disulfide-bonded form able to bind the alpha subunit. Free beta subunits that fail to form correct disulfide bonds are secreted uncombined. The findings suggest that intramolecular disulfide bond formation in the beta subunit is the rate-limiting step in hCG dimer formation.

pmid-3664484.summary_ja: 奇形癌細胞株F9およびPC13を用いた基礎研究で、レチノイン酸が核内のcAMP依存性プロテインキナーゼに与える影響を検討した。レチノイン酸処理により両細胞で4時間以内に核内酵素活性とRI・RII調節サブユニットが急速に減少した。これは分化誘導の初期事象である可能性が示唆された。臨床的なGCTの治療を扱ったものではなく、胚性癌由来の細胞を用いた細胞モデル研究である。
pmid-3664484.summary_en: This basic cell biology study examined how retinoic acid affects cyclic AMP-dependent protein kinase in the nuclei of teratocarcinoma cell lines F9 and PC13. In both cell types, retinoic acid rapidly reduced nuclear PKA activity and the regulatory RI and RII subunits within four hours, in association with differentiation to parietal or visceral endoderm. The authors propose that this early nuclear decrease may be an initiating event in retinoid-driven differentiation. The work uses embryonal carcinoma-derived cells as a model rather than addressing clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-3671567.summary_ja: 同一部位の皮下類皮嚢腫を伴う片側乳頭欠損症の症例報告である。嚢胞壁の組織所見から乳輪乳頭複合体由来が示唆された。先天性乳房欠損症候群を概説し、乳頭欠損と類皮嚢腫の合併は過去に報告がないとしている。胚細胞腫瘍の生物学や治療を扱ったものではなく、形成外科・先天異常の報告である。
pmid-3671567.summary_en: This report describes a case of unilateral athelia, absence of the nipple, accompanied by a subcutaneous dermoid cyst in the same region. The histology of the cyst wall suggests derivation from the nipple-areola complex. The authors review congenital breast absence syndromes and note that the combination of athelia with a dermoid cyst has not been reported before. The paper is a plastic surgery and congenital anomaly report rather than a study of germ cell tumor biology or treatment.

pmid-3678613.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株PCC4および1009では、ストレス下で熱ショックタンパク質HSP68の転写が活性化されなかった。この欠損はDNAメチル化やクロマチン構造では説明できず、in vitro分化後にはストレス誘導性を獲得した。転写活性化因子の欠如またはリプレッサーの存在が示唆された。
pmid-3678613.summary_en: Mouse embryonal carcinoma cell lines PCC4 and 1009 failed to induce heat shock protein HSP68 mRNA or transcription under stress, and a heterologous heat shock promoter was also not activated. The defect is not explained by DNA methylation or chromatin structure, but became stress-inducible after in vitro differentiation. The authors suggest these cells lack an activating transcription factor or contain a repressor, possibly resembling very early embryonic cells.

pmid-3680397.summary_ja: 未分化の胎児性癌幹細胞株(F9、PCC4、PC13、P19)と分化誘導した細胞を用い、膜アデニル酸シクラーゼのホルモン応答性の変化を検討した基礎研究。未分化EC細胞はカルシトニンに主に応答し、壁側内胚葉への分化ではパラトルモンへの感受性が現れ、臓側内胚葉への分化では両方の応答が消失した。これらの変化は初期分化のマーカーになりうると提案している。臨床的な腫瘍治療の知見は含まない。
pmid-3680397.summary_en: This in vitro study examines hormone responsiveness of membrane adenylate cyclase in embryonal carcinoma (EC) stem cell lines (F9, PCC4, PC13, P19) and their differentiated derivatives. Undifferentiated EC cells respond mainly to calcitonin. Differentiation toward parietal endoderm shifts sensitivity toward parathyroid hormone, while differentiation toward visceral endoderm abolishes both responses. The authors propose these changes as markers of early differentiation. The work is developmental biology using teratocarcinoma-derived cells rather than clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-37281862.summary_ja: 1987年の電子顕微鏡による研究で、B242g胎児性癌細胞がキメラ胚盤胞形成の過程でマウス正常胚に取り込まれる様子を検討した。胚細胞が胎児性癌細胞を覆い、凝集体の発生に伴い内部に取り込まれた。胎児性癌細胞は内部へ分離され、内部細胞塊に組み込まれると結論づけた。腫瘍の臨床的側面ではなく、発生モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-37281862.summary_en: This 1987 electron microscopy study examined how B242g embryonal carcinoma cells are incorporated into normal mouse embryos during chimeric blastocyst formation. Embryonic cells spread over the EC cells, which became internalized as aggregates developed. When a single blastomere of an 8-cell embryo was aggregated with EC cells, it engulfed them. The authors conclude that EC cells are segregated to inside positions and incorporated into the inner cell mass. The work uses EC cells as a developmental model rather than addressing tumor clinical aspects.

pmid-37282067.summary_ja: 1987年の報告で、B242g胎児性癌細胞とマウス胚からキメラを作成する際に、凝集法と注入法の効率を比較した。妊娠中期の胎児と生後マウスでキメラ形成を評価した。注入法の方が凝集法よりも効率よくキメラが得られた。B242g細胞は胚由来奇形癌から単離された細胞株である。腫瘍生物学ではなく発生学的手法に焦点を当てた研究である。
pmid-37282067.summary_en: This 1987 study compared aggregation and injection methods for producing chimeras between B242g embryonal carcinoma cells and mouse embryos. Chimerism was assessed in midgestation conceptuses and live-born mice. Injection produced chimeras more efficiently than aggregation. The EC cell line was originally isolated from embryo-derived teratocarcinomas and was among five lines pre-selected for chimera competence. The work focuses on developmental methodology rather than tumor biology or clinical management.

pmid-2416888.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマに対する化学療法中に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著明に上昇した2例を報告している。両例とも肝機能障害があり、1例はB型肝炎の再活性化を伴った。腫瘍は著明に縮小していたため化学療法を中止し、肝機能の回復とともにAFPは正常化した。15か月および17か月の無病生存が確認され、治療中のAFP上昇は必ずしも腫瘍進行を示さないと結論づけている。
pmid-2416888.summary_en: The authors report two patients with advanced seminoma who developed substantial rises in serum AFP during chemotherapy. Both had hepatic dysfunction, and one had reactivation of hepatitis B. Despite the elevated AFP, marked tumor regression had occurred, so chemotherapy was stopped. AFP returned to normal as liver function recovered, and both patients remained disease-free for 15 and 17 months. The report shows that AFP elevation during treatment does not always indicate tumor progression, particularly when liver injury is present.

pmid-2417687.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマの3例を報告し、前立腺、腎臓、腰椎への転移・再発を示している。このような非典型的な部位への再発は、化学療法後の残存病変の管理に影響するため、その治療上の意義を論じている。日常的なフォローアップで見落とされうるため、臨床医はこれらの部位を認識しておくべきであることを示唆する。
pmid-2417687.summary_en: The authors present three patients with advanced seminoma whose disease metastasized to uncommon sites: the prostate, the kidney, and a lumbar vertebra. These atypical sites are relevant to the management of residual lesions after chemotherapy. The report discusses how such unusual metastases should influence decisions about residual mass evaluation and further treatment. Because these sites may be overlooked during routine follow-up, clinicians should be aware of them. The brief case series offers practical considerations for clinicians managing residual seminoma.

pmid-2417919.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍を含む卵巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告している。治療後に血清AFPは正常化したが、セカンドルック手術で顕微鏡的なリンパ節転移が見つかり、その後AFPが上昇して患者は死亡した。卵黄嚢腫瘍はAFPを産生しないことがあるため、リンパ節生検を伴うセカンドルック手術が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-2417919.summary_en: This paper reports a patient with a mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary containing endodermal sinus tumor. Serum AFP normalized after treatment, yet second-look surgery revealed microscopic lymph node metastases. The disease later progressed with rising AFP, and the patient died. The authors argue that second-look surgery with lymph node sampling is necessary, because endodermal sinus tumor may not always produce AFP, small tumor volumes may not elevate it, and some malignant elements are detectable only histologically. They suggest that further therapy might achieve cure if microscopic disease is treated.

pmid-2418789.summary_ja: 男性泌尿生殖器腫瘍の治療選択を病態生理学的観点から論じた総説で、精巣がんではセミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に分けて放射線療法、化学療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の位置づけを整理している。前立腺がんの病期別治療や陰茎がんへのブレオマイシン併用療法にも言及している。
pmid-2418789.summary_en: This 1986 Japanese review discusses treatment selection for male urogenital tumors from a pathophysiological standpoint. For testicular cancer, it contrasts radiotherapy for seminoma with chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for non-seminomatous germ cell tumor, and it reports complete response rates of 70 to 90 percent. It also covers stage-based management of prostate cancer and bleomycin-based treatment of penile cancer.

pmid-2419524.summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法反応に関する予後因子を、南東部がん研究グループの無作為化試験180例で検討した。インディアナ病期分類はMDアンダーソン分類より予後予測能に優れ、進行群では腫瘍マーカーの上昇数がさらに予後を層別化した。後続の試験で前向きに検証された。
pmid-2419524.summary_en: This 1986 study of 180 patients with disseminated germ cell tumors, from a Southeastern Cancer Study Group randomized trial, identified prognostic factors for favorable response to cisplatin-based chemotherapy. The Indiana staging system proved more prognostic than the MD Anderson system, separating patients into minimal, moderate, and advanced disease groups with favorable response rates of 99, 90, and 58 percent. Elevated tumor markers further stratified the advanced group, and the Indiana system was prospectively validated in a later trial.
