pmid-2409495.summary_ja: 進行精巣腫瘍24例に、シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、アクチノマイシンDの併用療法を行った。完全寛解は50%、部分寛解は33%であった。肺転移例で治療効果が最も高かった。
pmid-2409495.summary_en: Twenty-four patients with advanced testicular tumours, including eight seminomas and sixteen nonseminomas, were treated with cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin and actinomycin D. Complete remission was achieved in 50% and partial remission in 33%, while treatment failed in 16.7%. Patients with lung metastases had the best results, with 11 complete remissions among 16. Nausea, vomiting and alopecia were the most common toxicities. Nine patients remained in complete remission at the time of reporting.

pmid-2409496.summary_ja: 1985年の研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍100例において従来のマーカー(CEA、AFP、hCG)と併せて血清フェリチンを測定した。精巣摘除後の病期分類には有用ではなかった。白金を含まない治療や再発時には、フェリチンの低下が治療反応、上昇が再発と相関した。シスプラチン併用化学療法では、従来のマーカーが正常化する一方でフェリチンは2~3倍に上昇し、白金製剤の毒性を反映する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2409496.summary_en: This 1985 study measured serum ferritin alongside conventional markers (CEA, AFP, hCG) in 100 patients with testicular germ cell tumors, including seminoma and nonseminoma. Ferritin was not useful for staging after orchiectomy. During treatment without platinum or at relapse, falling ferritin tracked response and rising levels tracked relapse. With cisplatin-based chemotherapy, ferritin rose two- to threefold while conventional markers normalized, suggesting hyperferritinemia reflects platinum toxicity rather than tumor activity.

pmid-2409924.summary_ja: 若年男性の前縦隔悪性奇形腫様腫瘍の診断と治療をまとめた総説。非セミノーマ型ではAFPやhCGが診断と治療効果判定に有用で、シスプラチン併用化学療法を第一選択とし、手術を補助療法と位置づける。セミノーマでもマーカー産生例は予後不良因子として化学療法を追加すべきとしている。
pmid-2409924.summary_en: This 1985 Japanese review addresses malignant teratoid tumors of the anterior mediastinum in young men. These tumors are classified as seminoma, nonseminoma, or mixed. In nonseminomatous cases, AFP and hCG serve as markers for diagnosis and treatment response. The authors recommend cisplatin-based chemotherapy as first-line treatment, with surgery as adjuvant. Seminomas are managed with surgery and radiation, but AFP or hCG production in seminoma signals poor prognosis, warranting added cisplatin chemotherapy.

pmid-2410164.summary_ja: hCGとそのαおよびβサブユニットを識別測定する免疫放射計測法を開発した1985年の方法論論文。絨毛癌細胞株では遊離αサブユニットが最も早期かつ優勢な腫瘍マーカーであり、関連腫瘍でもhCG分泌の不均衡が見られた。標準的なβ-hCG測定のみに頼る診断の見直しを提起している。
pmid-2410164.summary_en: A 1985 methods paper describes epitope-selective immunoradiometric assays for hCG and its alpha and beta subunits, built on known monoclonal antibody epitope specificities. Using these assays, the authors showed that in certain choriocarcinoma cell lines the earliest and predominant tumor marker is the free alpha-subunit, and similar unbalanced hCG secretion appeared in patients with related tumors. They argue this challenges reliance on standard beta-hCG assays alone for diagnosis and monitoring.

pmid-2410461.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫51例(セミノーマを伴うものを含む)をWHO分類で再分類し、精巣摘除術後1〜10年間追跡した研究。複数の臨床・病理因子を解析した結果、病理学的病期が生存を最も強く規定する因子であった。従来報告されていた卵黄嚢腫瘍成分による予後不良は、本コホートでは確認されなかった。
pmid-2410461.summary_en: This 1985 study reviewed 51 testicular teratomas, with or without seminoma, classified by WHO criteria and followed for one to ten years after orchiectomy. Multiple clinical and pathological factors were analyzed for prognostic significance. Pathological stage emerged as the most important predictor of survival. The previously reported poor prognosis associated with yolk sac tumor components was not confirmed in this cohort.

pmid-2410574.summary_ja: 1975〜1982年にMSKCCで治療された性腺外胚細胞腫瘍38例の成績。高用量シスプラチン併用化学療法で、純粋セミノーマは89%が完全奏効し全例無病生存。一方、性腺外非セミノーマは41%のみ完全奏効で、生存期間中央値は18か月。精巣原発例より予後不良のため、新規治療の臨床試験が必要と結論。
pmid-2410574.summary_en: This 1985 MSKCC series reports 38 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors treated with high-dose cisplatin-based chemotherapy between 1975 and 1982. Complete response occurred in 89% of pure seminoma patients, all of whom remained disease-free. Only 41% of extragonadal nonseminomatous patients achieved complete response, with median survival of 18 months. The authors conclude extragonadal nonseminomas have a worse prognosis than testicular primaries and call for trials of innovative therapy.

pmid-2410634.summary_ja: 下腹壁に原発した卵黄嚢腫瘍で鼠径リンパ節転移を伴う症例報告。根治的手術に続き、ブレオマイシン、ビンブラスチン、シスプラチンによる併用化学療法を実施。治療後2年以上無病で経過し、まれな性腺外発生例で良好な治療成績が得られた。下腹壁発生の最初の報告例とされる。
pmid-2410634.summary_en: This 1985 case report describes a primary yolk sac tumor arising in the lower abdominal wall with inguinal lymph node metastases, believed to be the first documented case from this site. Treatment consisted of radical surgery followed by combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, vinblastine and cisplatin. The patient remained disease-free for more than two years, illustrating an effective outcome for an unusual extragonadal presentation.

pmid-2410638.summary_ja: 妊娠9週の28歳女性にみられたIa期卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。初回手術後AFPは正常化したが、8か月後にAFP上昇を伴い、卵黄嚢成分のない未熟奇形腫(grade 2)として再発。FAM化学療法とUFT内服後、生存・健在。化学療法後により分化した腫瘍へ変化したと考察している。
pmid-2410638.summary_en: This 1985 Japanese case report describes a 28-year-old woman, nine weeks pregnant, with stage Ia ovarian mixed germ cell tumor containing grade 3 immature teratoma and yolk sac tumor. After surgery and normalization of AFP, recurrence occurred eight months later as a grade 2 immature teratoma without yolk sac elements, with raised AFP. Following FAM chemotherapy and oral UFT, she was alive and well. The authors note the tumor transformed to a more differentiated form after chemotherapy.

pmid-2410843.summary_ja: 小児・思春期の非精巣性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン・シスプラチンを順次投与したGPO試験の予備結果である。ブレオマイシンは累積用量180 mg/m2に制限された。評価可能42例中、治療関連死や肺線維症はなく、完遂した19例中4例のみが中央値12か月で再発した。
pmid-2410843.summary_en: This 1985 German trial report describes a sequential chemotherapy regimen (vinblastine, bleomycin, cisplatin) for non-testicular germ cell tumors in children and adolescents. Bleomycin was given separately from cisplatin and capped at 180 mg/m2 to reduce pulmonary and renal toxicity. Of 61 enrolled patients, 42 were evaluable; the regimen was well tolerated, with no treatment-related deaths or pulmonary fibrosis, and only 4 of 19 completers relapsed at a median 12-month follow-up.

pmid-2410971.summary_ja: 進行精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍18例の残存後腹膜組織を免疫組織化学的に検討した。残存組織は線維組織か成熟奇形腫が大半で、残存奇形腫は原発巣にも存在していた。奇形組織ではAFPとhCGが2例のみだったのに対し、A1AT、CEA、フェリチン、ラクトフェリン、SP1などが発現していた。
pmid-2410971.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined residual retroperitoneal tissue resected from 18 patients treated for advanced testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Most resections showed fibrosis or mature teratoma only, and residual teratoma was always present in the primary tumor. Teratoma tissue expressed A1AT, CEA, ferritin, lactoferrin and SP1, not only AFP and hCG, which were detected in just two cases. The authors suggest aspirating cystic fluid for these markers and proposing CEA and SP1 for antibody-based localization and therapy.

pmid-2411047.summary_ja: 正期産胎盤と絨毛癌細胞株2種の中間径フィラメントを免疫組織化学とイムノブロットで解析した。栄養膜由来の細胞はいずれも4種のケラチンを発現した。54 Kケラチンは胎児性癌や卵黄嚢腫瘍の細胞株では認められず、栄養膜性腫瘍と胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別に有用と考えられる。
pmid-2411047.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry and immunoblotting to characterize intermediate filament expression in normal term placenta and two choriocarcinoma cell lines. Both normal and malignant trophoblastic cells expressed four keratin polypeptides (40, 45, 52 and 54 kDa). The 54 kDa keratin was absent from embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac carcinoma cell lines, so it may help distinguish trophoblastic tumor cells from these germ cell tumor types. The work is basic cytoskeletal characterization with diagnostic implications.

pmid-2411108.summary_ja: 72歳日本人女性の胃に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。胃は稀な性腺外の発生部位である。Borrmann 2型の粘膜病変と漿膜下の主腫瘤を示し、胎児性癌や腺癌成分を伴っていた。血清と腫瘍組織でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が検出され、電子顕微鏡で基底膜様物質が確認された。
pmid-2411108.summary_en: This case report describes a 72-year-old Japanese woman with a yolk sac tumor arising in the stomach, an unusual extragonadal site. The lesion showed Borrmann type 2 features and a subserosal main mass, with coexisting embryonal carcinoma and adenocarcinoma components. Alpha-fetoprotein was detected in serum by radioimmunoassay and in tumor tissue by immunohistochemistry. Electron microscopy revealed basement membrane-like material between cells, supporting the diagnosis of gastric endodermal sinus tumor.

pmid-2411136.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍36例のレビューで、未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ、混合型胚細胞腫瘍を含む。多剤併用化学療法を受けた27例中、セカンドルック手術で残存病変があったのは2例のみだった。フォローアップ中央値68か月で36例中34例が無病生存しており、化学療法による予後改善を示す。
pmid-2411136.summary_en: This review of 36 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors reports histologic types, outcomes and treatment responses. Multiagent chemotherapy was given to 27 patients, and second-look surgery found persistent disease in only two. None of the patients with negative second-look operations relapsed. With a median follow-up of 68 months, 34 of 36 patients were alive without disease, supporting the marked prognostic improvement from multiagent chemotherapy for nondysgerminomatous tumors.

pmid-2411250.summary_ja: 悪性奇形腫患者15例と頭頸部扁平上皮癌患者12例にブレオマイシンを投与し、DLcoの推移を比較した。DLcoの低下は両群で同程度で、重篤な肺毒性の予測には有用でなかった。致死的肺毒性で死亡した2例は、いずれも化学療法中の持続的な腎機能低下を伴っていた。
pmid-2411250.summary_en: This study compared carbon monoxide diffusing capacity (DLco) changes in 15 patients with malignant teratoma and 12 with head and neck squamous cancer receiving bleomycin. DLco declined similarly in both groups, but DLco changes did not predict severe pulmonary toxicity. Two teratoma patients died of pulmonary toxicity despite no early DLco differences. Both fatal cases had sustained renal impairment during chemotherapy, which may have been a key risk factor.

pmid-2411330.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者39例（セミノーマ10例、非セミノーマ性29例）と対照20例で、治療前のヘモグロビンF値を測定した。患者のHbFは対照より有意に高く、非セミノーマ性はセミノーマより高値であった。HbFと病期に相関はなく、有用なマーカーとなりうると述べられている。
pmid-2411330.summary_en: This study measured pre-treatment haemoglobin F (HbF) levels in 39 patients with testicular tumours (10 seminoma, 29 non-seminomatous) and 20 controls. HbF was significantly higher in patients than controls, and higher still in non-seminomatous tumours than in seminomas. HbF did not correlate with disease stage. The authors suggest HbF production is reactivated in adults with testicular tumours and may serve as a useful marker.

pmid-2411378.summary_ja: 20か月齢の女児に発生した前縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告で、女性例としては初とされる。手術時の血清AFPは65,200 ng/mlと著明に上昇し、β-hCGは正常だった。ほぼ全摘後に化学療法を行い、18週後にAFPを含む所見が正常化、25か月時点で無病生存している。
pmid-2411378.summary_en: This report describes the first known primary anterior mediastinal yolk sac tumor in a female, occurring in a 20-month-old infant. Serum AFP was 65,200 ng/ml at surgery, while beta-hCG was normal. After near-total resection, combination chemotherapy with vinblastine, bleomycin, cisplatin, dactinomycin, cyclophosphamide and doxorubicin was given. After 18 weeks, all findings including AFP had normalized, and the child remained disease-free at 25 months.

pmid-2411451.summary_ja: 男性の生殖器腫瘍患者の血清で、hCGとそのサブユニットの分泌パターンをゲル濾過や免疫測定などにより検討した。完全型hCGが主体で、全例で遊離βサブユニットが増加していた。hCG産生男性生殖器腫瘍は、女性の絨毛癌に類似すると結論された。
pmid-2411451.summary_en: This study examined secretion patterns of hCG and its subunits in men with genital tract tumours using gel filtration, immunoassays and bioassay. Intact hCG predominated, and all patients had elevated free beta-subunit, a disproportionate increase compared with pregnancy. Intact hCG was biologically active and normally glycosylated. The authors conclude that hCG-secreting male genital tumours resemble female choriocarcinoma in producing large amounts of intact hormone with excess free beta subunit.

pmid-2411564.summary_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍84例で、3種類の化学療法レジメン(VB/AP、PVB、PVBI)を比較した1985年の研究。初回完全寛解は71%、再発率は29%で、レジメン間に有意差はなかった。残存組織像は予後を強く規定し、壊死・線維化群では完全寛解が75%、悪性腫瘍残存群では25%であった。残存病変は重要な予後因子とされた。
pmid-2411564.summary_en: This 1985 study analyzed 84 patients with bulky germ cell tumors treated with three chemotherapy regimens: VB/AP, PVB, and PVBI. Initial complete remission was 71%, with a 29% relapse rate. No significant differences in remission, relapse, or survival were found among the regimens. Residual histology strongly influenced outcome: complete remission was achieved in 75% of patients with necrosis or fibrosis, versus 25% with residual malignant tumor. The authors concluded that PVBI and VB/AD were not superior to the standard regimen, and that residual disease is an important prognostic factor.

pmid-2411565.summary_ja: 右精巣由来の卵黄嚢成分を伴う悪性奇形腫の後腹膜リンパ節転移の症例報告。大動脈と交差する下大静脈のため、CTで転移が見逃された。フォローアップ時に典型的な腫瘍マーカーの上昇が認められた。解剖学的変異により後腹膜病変が画像上隠れうること、精巣胚細胞腫瘍のフォローアップで腫瘍マーカーの監視が重要であることを示す。
pmid-2411565.summary_en: This case report describes a retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis from a malignant teratoma with yolk sac components arising in the right testis. The metastasis was missed on CT because a vena cava crossing over the aorta obscured the lesion. Typical tumor marker elevation was detected during follow-up, which prompted further evaluation. The case illustrates how anatomical variants can hide retroperitoneal disease on imaging, and why tumor marker monitoring remains important in testicular germ cell tumor follow-up.

pmid-2411614.summary_ja: 1985年の発生生物学研究で、胎児性癌細胞株PSMBを用い、細胞間接着に影響する抗体が胚様体形成と分化に与える影響を検討した。抗ウボモルリン抗体Fabは分化パターンを変えず、抗EC血清由来Fabは凝集塊の細胞を内胚葉様表現型へ分化させた。この効果は単層培養では認められず、接着相互作用と胎児性癌細胞の分化の関連を示した。
pmid-2411614.summary_en: This 1985 developmental biology study used the embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell line PSMB to examine how antibodies affecting cell-cell adhesion alter embryoid body formation and differentiation. Anti-uvomorulin Fab caused decompaction without changing differentiation pattern. In contrast, anti-EC Fab induced most cells in aggregates to differentiate into an endoderm-like phenotype, and this effect occurred only in aggregates, not monolayer cultures. The findings link cell adhesion interactions with the differentiation behavior of embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-2411963.summary_ja: 改良型の交差免疫電気泳動を用い、血清78例のAFPサブフラクションを検討した。対象は原発性肝癌、胃癌肝転移、卵黄嚢腫瘍や奇形腫などの性腺胚細胞腫瘍。疾患によりAFPの糖鎖付加が異なり、特徴的なサブフラクションパターンを示した。このパターンは、性腺胚細胞腫瘍を含むAFP産生悪性腫瘍の鑑別に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-2411963.summary_en: This study examined AFP subfractions in 78 sera using modified crossed-line immunoelectrophoresis with Con A, LCH, or PHA-E affinity. Samples included primary hepatoma, gastric cancer liver metastasis, and gonadal germ cell tumors such as yolk sac tumor and teratomas. AFP glycosylation differed among these diseases, producing distinct subfraction patterns. These patterns could help differentiate AFP-producing malignancies, including gonadal germ cell tumors from hepatic tumors.

pmid-2411992.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性奇形腫の再発腫瘍から樹立された細胞株HUOTの報告。50回の継代を通じて安定に増殖し、高二倍体の染色体数を示した。ヌードマウスに移植すると未分化癌を形成し、in vitroで多量のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を産生した。ジブチルcAMPは増殖を抑制しAFP産生を増加させた。卵巣悪性奇形腫の基礎研究に有用と考えられる。
pmid-2411992.summary_en: This study describes the establishment and characterization of HUOT, a cell line derived from a recurrent human ovarian malignant teratoma. The cells grew stably through 50 serial passages and were hyperdiploid. They produced anaplastic carcinomas when transplanted into nude mice, and secreted large amounts of alpha-fetoprotein in vitro. Dibutyl cAMP suppressed proliferation while increasing AFP production. The authors suggest HUOT will be useful for various laboratory studies of ovarian malignant teratoma.

pmid-2412341.summary_ja: 243例の純粋セミノーマと107例の混合型精巣胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、巨細胞を組織球性と腫瘍性に分類して検討した。腫瘍性巨細胞は純粋セミノーマの34.6%、β-hCG産生巨細胞は19.3%に認められた。著者らは、これらの所見は潜在性絨毛癌からの栄養膜成分の浸潤に反すると論じている。26例の臨床フォローアップでは、早期病期のセミノーマは従来の治療により、β-hCG陽性巨細胞を有する症例を含めて良好な経過をたどった。
pmid-2412341.summary_en: This study reviewed 243 pure seminomas and 107 mixed testicular germ cell tumors, classifying giant cells as histiocytic or neoplastic. Neoplastic giant cells occurred in 34.6% of pure seminomas, and beta-hCG-producing giant cells in 19.3%. The authors argue these findings argue against trophoblastic infiltration from occult choriocarcinoma. Clinical follow-up of 26 patients showed that early-stage seminomas treated conventionally, including those with beta-hCG-positive giant cells, had an excellent course.

pmid-2412392.summary_ja: 70歳日本人女性の原発性胃絨毛癌と腺癌の併存例の剖検報告。生検では低分化腺癌と診断されていた。血清hCGは著明に高値で、肝・肺・大網に転移した。免疫染色では絨毛癌細胞がhCG陽性、腺癌細胞がαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とCEA陽性であった。原発性胃絨毛癌の発生機序と病理学的特徴について考察している。
pmid-2412392.summary_en: This autopsy report describes a 70-year-old Japanese woman with primary gastric choriocarcinoma coexisting with adenocarcinoma. The tumor was initially misdiagnosed as poorly differentiated gastric adenocarcinoma on biopsy. Serum hCG was markedly elevated, and metastases involved the liver, lung, and omentum. Immunohistochemistry showed hCG in choriocarcinoma cells and AFP and CEA in adenocarcinoma cells. The authors discuss the pathogenesis and pathological features of primary gastric choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2412421.summary_ja: 1974年から1983年に治療された精巣腫瘍19例の後方視的検討。胚細胞腫瘍が94.7%を占めた。主症状は無痛性の精巣腫瘤であった。治療は精巣摘除術の単独、放射線療法または化学療法の併用で、後腹膜リンパ節郭清は行われなかった。3年および5年実生存率はいずれも92%であった。胎児性癌型とセミノーマ型で異なる年齢のピークが認められた。
pmid-2412421.summary_en: This retrospective review covered 19 patients with testicular tumors treated between 1974 and 1983. Germ cell tumors accounted for 94.7% of cases. Patients presented mostly with painless testicular masses. Treatments included orchiectomy alone, orchiectomy with radiation, or chemotherapy, but no retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy was performed. Overall 3- and 5-year actual survival rates were both 92%. Two age peaks were noted, one for embryonal carcinoma-type tumors and another for seminomatous tumors.

pmid-2412445.summary_ja: 正常精巣と76例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究である。胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌ではサイトケラチンが陽性で、セミノーマでは一部に陽性細胞がみられた。中間径フィラメントの発現パターンは分化の評価に有用で、特にセミノーマと胎児性癌の鑑別診断に役立つ可能性が示された。
pmid-2412445.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined intermediate filament expression in normal human testes and 76 testicular germ cell tumors of various histologic types. Cytokeratin was found in rete testis epithelium, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and choriocarcinoma, while vimentin marked stromal and Sertoli/Leydig cells. Seminomas showed sparse vimentin positivity and occasional cytokeratin-positive syncytiotrophoblast-like cells. Immature teratomas displayed epithelial cytokeratin and mesenchymal vimentin and desmin. The authors conclude that intermediate filament profiles can characterize differentiation patterns and aid differential diagnosis, particularly between seminoma and embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-2412536.summary_ja: 精巣がんの転移性頸部病変に対する治療戦略を論じた論考である。化学療法後の血清腫瘍マーカーの推移により残存病変を評価し、正常化した残存腫瘤は外科的に切除すべきとしている。頸部残存病変には変法頸部郭清術が有用であり、耳鼻咽喉科医の役割も強調されている。
pmid-2412536.summary_en: This otolaryngology report discusses management of metastatic testicular carcinoma presenting as residual neck disease. Chemotherapy followed by aggressive surgical resection can eradicate disease even with distant metastases. Serum human chorionic gonadotropin and alpha-fetoprotein guide monitoring: normalization after induction suggests elimination or conversion to teratoma, whereas persistent elevation indicates persistent or recurrent carcinoma. Residual masses after marker normalization should be resected, and large neck lesions are best approached through modified neck dissection.

pmid-2412541.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍45例への化学療法の成績と、血清LDH値の臨床的意義を検討した研究である。全体の63%が完全寛解し、精巣または卵巣由来の奇形腫では多くが寛解を維持した。血清LDH上昇は肝転移を伴わず治療反応と相関しており、治療効果判定の指標としての有用性が示唆された。
pmid-2412541.summary_en: This study describes 45 patients with metastatic germ cell tumor treated with chemotherapy, achieving complete remission in 63% overall and 65% of testicular or ovarian primaries. Surgery for persisting abdominal masses was performed in seven patients. Serum LDH was elevated in 28 patients with measurable disease, and the rise localized to LDH isoenzymes 1 or fractions 1+2 without hepatic involvement. LDH changes correlated with treatment response, suggesting utility as a monitoring marker warranting further study.

pmid-2412542.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に横紋筋肉腫を発症した症例を報告している。初発時に未熟奇形腫を含む患者では、再発病変を可能な限り再生検すべきだと論じている。再発に見えた病変が化学療法抵抗性の二次性肉腫である可能性を指摘し、完全切除できない場合の予後は極めて不良としている。
pmid-2412542.summary_en: The authors present a patient who developed rhabdomyosarcoma after apparently successful chemotherapy for metastatic testicular germ cell tumor, possibly associated with immature teratoma in the original tumor. They recommend re-biopsy of recurrent disease whenever possible, because some apparent relapses may be high-grade, chemoresistant sarcomas rather than recurrent germ cell malignancy. Such second tumors carry a very poor prognosis unless completely resectable.

pmid-2412681.summary_ja: 前治療を受けた精巣胚細胞がん32例に対するシスプラチン・エトポシド療法と残存腫瘍切除の成績を示した。前治療歴がある患者の無病生存は不良であった一方、シスプラチン未治療例では78%が無病状態を維持した。標準的なPE±B療法と外科的切除は、未治療例に対する救援療法として満足できると結論づけている。
pmid-2412681.summary_en: This study reports 32 consecutive patients with pretreated germinal testis cancer who received cisplatin and etoposide (PE) induction, with bleomycin in some, and surgical removal of residual masses in 16. Overall, 65.5% were disease-free, and complete remission correlated with prior therapy. Among patients not pretreated with cisplatin, 78% achieved continuous disease-free status, versus 22% of pretreated patients. The authors conclude normal-dose PE with or without bleomycin followed by surgery is satisfactory salvage therapy for cisplatin-naive patients.

pmid-2412683.summary_ja: 高度進行期の精巣胚細胞腫瘍40例に対し、PEB療法と残存腫瘍の早期切除を行った成績を報告している。82.5%が完全寛解に至り、追跡中央値24か月で33例が無病を維持した。毒性は中等度で、初回治療としての有用性が示されている。
pmid-2412683.summary_en: This study reviews 40 consecutive patients with far-advanced germinal testis tumors treated with five courses of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin (PEB), plus early resection of residual masses after three inductions. Complete remission was achieved in 82.5% of patients, with residual tumor removal contributing substantially. Toxicity was moderate. After median follow-up of 24 months, 33 patients remained continuously disease-free, and only one of four relapsed patients was salvaged. The authors conclude that first-line PEB with early surgery yields high durable remission.

pmid-2412688.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍45例を後方視的に解析し、転移の関連因子を検討した。原発巣の血管浸潤は、リンパ節転移や後の転移の発生と強く関連し、低病期や小型腫瘍でも有意な予後因子であった。監視のみのプロトコルや臨床病期Iの管理における血管浸潤評価の重要性が論じられている。
pmid-2412688.summary_en: This retrospective study of 45 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors evaluated factors associated with metastatic disease. Vascular invasion at the primary site strongly correlated with lymph node involvement and subsequent metastases. Among 29 tumors with invasion, 25 patients had metastatic disease, compared with 3 of 16 without invasion. Vascular invasion remained a significant prognostic factor even in low-stage and small tumors. The authors discuss its implications for staging and management of clinical stage I disease, including surveillance-only protocols.

pmid-2412689.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴って腹膜にグリア細胞性の播種を生じる稀な病態、腹膜神経膠腫症の4症例を報告している。病変は良性とされるが、高悪性度奇形腫例では予後良好を示さなかった。予後に関わる他の奇形腫性・胚細胞成分の除外のため、腹膜播種の広範な病理組織学的検索が必要と結論している。
pmid-2412689.summary_en: This case series describes four patients with gliomatosis peritonei, a rare complication of ovarian teratoma consisting of mature glial peritoneal implants. Across all grades of ovarian teratoma, the authors describe clinicopathologic features and note that gliomatosis is generally benign. However, its presence did not predict a favorable prognosis in one high-grade case. The authors emphasize extensive histopathologic sampling of peritoneal implants to exclude coexisting teratomatous or germ cell elements, which carry adverse prognostic significance.

pmid-2412863.summary_ja: マウス奇形腫由来の胎児性癌株と分化細胞株で、10種類の原がん遺伝子の発現を検討した。c-mycとc-Ki-rasは全株で発現し、一部の分化過程でc-mycが低下した。細胞増殖速度と遺伝子発現は必ずしも連動せず、多くの遺伝子は検出されなかった。
pmid-2412863.summary_en: This study examined expression of ten proto-oncogenes in mouse teratoma-derived cell lines representing stages of early embryonic differentiation, including two embryonal carcinoma lines and four differentiated derivatives. c-myc and c-Ki-ras were expressed in all lines, and c-myc declined during myoblast and F9 primitive endoderm differentiation, though endodermal growth reduction did not parallel this change. A v-sis-hybridizing transcript in Cl10 likely represents endogenous retroviral RNA. Several other oncogenes were undetectable.

pmid-2412924.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト奇形癌細胞株TERA-2から2つのクローンを単離し、胎児性癌の表現型を検討した。SSEA-3およびSSEA-4抗原の発現は両クローンで異なったが、いずれも多能性を示した。抗原陰性クローン由来の異種移植腫瘍では発現が再び現れ、環境要因による発現調節が示された。
pmid-2412924.summary_en: This 1985 study isolated two clones from the human teratocarcinoma line TERA-2 and examined their embryonal carcinoma phenotype. One clone expressed the SSEA-3 and SSEA-4 antigens, while the other did not. Both clones were pluripotent and formed xenograft tumors containing diverse cell types. Notably, EC cells in xenografts derived from the antigen-negative clone re-expressed SSEA-3 and SSEA-4, indicating that these globoseries epitopes are modulated by environmental influences rather than being fixed features of the EC phenotype.

pmid-2413029.summary_ja: 本研究は、絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3におけるhCGサブユニット合成の調節機構を検討した。8-Br-cAMPで48時間刺激すると、αおよびβサブユニットのタンパク産生は著明に増加し、対応するmRNAも増加した。αサブユニットのmRNA増加はβより先行した。hCGの転写前段階での選択的調節が示された。
pmid-2413029.summary_en: This 1985 study examined how 8-bromo-cAMP regulates human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) subunit synthesis in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. After 48 hours of stimulation, immunoreactive alpha and beta subunit production rose 25- and 52-fold, with corresponding mRNA increases of 36- and 43-fold. The alpha mRNA response preceded the beta mRNA response. The findings show that cAMP selectively regulates hCG subunit biosynthesis at the pretranslational level in this choriocarcinoma model, which is relevant to understanding hCG as a tumor marker.

pmid-2413180.summary_ja: 本研究は進行セミノーマ20例の化学療法成績を報告した。未治療の14例は全例で完全奏効が得られた。既治療の再発例では完全寛解は67%であった。放射線療法歴は再発時の化学療法の投与量を制限しうると結論された。残存腫瘤に対する外科的切除例も報告された。
pmid-2413180.summary_en: This early study reported outcomes of 20 patients with advanced seminoma treated with chemotherapy, including VPB and etoposide-cisplatin regimens. All 14 previously untreated patients achieved complete response, and most remained disease-free. Patients receiving radiotherapy for residual masses or surgical resection of fibrotic residuals also had favorable outcomes. Among 6 previously irradiated patients who relapsed, complete remission occurred in 67%. The authors concluded that chemotherapy is acceptable initial therapy and that prior radiotherapy may limit chemotherapy dosing at relapse.

pmid-2413985.summary_ja: 本研究は、非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の成熟奇形腫嚢胞液15検体のタンパク組成を血清と比較した。AFP、hCG、CEAなどの腫瘍マーカーは嚢胞液/血清濃度比が有意に高値であった。この上昇は奇形腫細胞による局所的合成や濃縮によると考察された。
pmid-2413985.summary_en: This 1985 study analyzed protein composition in 15 cyst fluids from mature teratomas in patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, comparing them with corresponding sera. Many proteins were similar between cyst fluid and serum, with some suggesting free diffusion and others a decreased size selectivity of the blood-teratoma barrier. Cyst-to-serum concentration ratios were significantly increased for AFP, hCG, CEA, lysozyme, and ferritin. The authors attribute these elevations to local synthesis or concentration by teratoma cells.

pmid-2414200.summary_ja: 本研究は、胎仔摘出後に卵黄嚢を転位させ、チャイニーズハムスターに奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍を誘発した。悪性腫瘍2例はラミニンとαFPの発現により卵黄嚢腫瘍と判定された。細胞株には一貫して1Pマーカー染色体が認められた。この異常が卵黄嚢腫瘍の発生に関与すると考察された。
pmid-2414200.summary_en: This 1985 study experimentally induced teratomas and yolk sac tumors in Chinese hamsters by displacing yolk sac after fetectomy. Of 33 hamsters, 10 developed benign teratomas and 2 developed malignant tumors with yolk sac tumor features, confirmed by laminin and alpha-FP expression. Electron microscopy suggested a yolk sac origin, and karyotyping of cell lines revealed XX and XY clones with a consistent 1p isochromosome marker. The authors propose this abnormality plays a role in yolk sac tumor development in this species.

pmid-2414470.summary_ja: 本予備報告は、病期II精巣がん28例に初回化学療法を行い、残存腫瘤に対して選択的後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った成績を示す。全例が平均93.6週の追跡期間で無病であった。奇形癌では胎児性癌より外科的探索の頻度が高かった。28例中8例のみが郭清を要し、合併症は増加しなかった。
pmid-2414470.summary_en: This preliminary report describes 28 patients with clinical stage II testicular carcinoma treated with primary chemotherapy, followed by selective retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for persistent masses. All patients were disease-free at a mean follow-up of 93.6 weeks. Patients with teratocarcinoma required surgical exploration more often than those with embryonal carcinoma (6 of 12 versus 1 of 15). Only 8 of 28 patients required lymphadenectomy, and the delayed surgical approach did not increase complications.

pmid-2414481.summary_ja: 本総説は、精巣がん診療の近年の進歩を概説する。化学療法は残存腫瘍の切除の有無にかかわらず、進行例を治癒させうる。未解決の課題として、病期I、非セミノーマ性病期III精巣がんにおける外科的治療の役割、化学療法による精巣障害が挙げられた。
pmid-2414481.summary_en: This Japanese review summarizes recent progress in managing testicular cancer. Chemotherapy, with or without resection of residual tumors, can cure far-advanced disease. The paper identifies unresolved issues, including management of stage I disease, the role of surgery in stage III nonseminomatous testicular cancer, and testicular damage caused by chemotherapy. These topics are discussed as directions for future clinical consideration.

pmid-2414665.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9を用いた基礎研究で、レチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPによる分化過程におけるmyc・p53遺伝子発現の調節を解析している。両遺伝子のmRNA減少は転写後段階で起こり、mycは24時間以内の早期に、p53は2〜3日後に制御されることを示した。腫瘍性から非増殖性へ移行する分化機構の理解に寄与する。
pmid-2414665.summary_en: This 1985 Nature study examines the embryonal carcinoma stem cell line F9, which differentiates into parietal endoderm after retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP treatment. The authors show that during irreversible differentiation, stable myc and p53 mRNA decline through post-transcriptional mechanisms, with polymerase II density on both genes unchanged. Myc regulation occurs early, within 24 hours, while p53 regulation occurs later, at two to three days. The work illuminates how a tumorigenic embryonal carcinoma state becomes non-dividing and non-tumorigenic. It is a basic-biology model rather than a clinical study.

pmid-2415075.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の片側性患者54例を対象に、精液所見と血清テストステロン、LH、FSHを精巣摘除術の前後で比較した。多くの患者で精液の質は不良で、摘除術による明らかな悪化は認められなかった。β-hCG産生腫瘍では術後にFSHが抑制された。残存精巣の機能不全が術前から存在していたことが示唆された。
pmid-2415075.summary_en: This study examined semen quality and serum testosterone, LH, and FSH in 54 men with unilateral nonseminomatous testicular tumors, before and after orchiectomy. Semen quality was poor in most men and was not clearly worsened by orchiectomy. Patients with beta-hCG-producing tumors had higher testosterone before surgery. After orchiectomy, testosterone fell and gonadotropins rose, with FSH suppressed in beta-hCG-producing tumors. The authors conclude that the remaining contralateral testis shows dysfunction, with impaired spermatogenesis and Leydig cell testosterone production already present before surgery.

pmid-2415203.summary_ja: 進行性非セミノーマ性胚細胞性精巣腫瘍の患者36例とセミノーマ2例を、シスプラチン併用療法（主にPVB、一部BEP）で治療した。評価可能な非セミノーマ患者は全例で奏効し、61%が完全奏効に達した。完全奏効率は腫瘍量が大きい例やAFP・β-hCG高値例で低かった。毒性は強く、脱毛、悪心、神経毒性などが多くみられた。
pmid-2415203.summary_en: This report describes 38 patients with advanced testicular germ-cell tumours, 36 non-seminomatous and two seminomatous, treated with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy, mostly PVB and some BEP. All 35 evaluable non-seminomatous patients responded, and 61 percent achieved complete response. Sixteen of 32 adequately treated patients, 50 percent, were alive and disease-free. Lower complete response rates were associated with bulky disease and high AFP or beta-hCG levels, but not with prior radiotherapy. Toxicity was substantial, including alopecia, nausea, vomiting, and neurotoxicity.

pmid-2416191.summary_ja: 転移性精巣癌42例にシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン(CVB)療法を行い、前後にCTで評価した研究である。21例に胸膜下の肺異常陰影が出現し、大半は無症状であった。組織学的には線維化のみで腫瘍は認められなかった。異常所見の多くは経過とともに消失または縮小した。治療関連の肺病変を腫瘍進行と誤らないよう、フォローアップ時の留意を提言している。
pmid-2416191.summary_en: This 1985 study examined chest CT in 42 patients with metastatic testicular carcinoma treated with cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin (CVB). Half developed subpleural lung abnormalities, mostly without symptoms. Histology in three patients showed fibrosis without tumor tissue. In twelve patients with marked changes, repeat CT within 6 to 24 weeks showed spontaneous disappearance in seven, reduction in three and progression in two, the latter two later regressing on chest radiography. The authors advise recognizing treatment-related lung changes at follow-up to avoid misdiagnosing tumor progression.

pmid-2416623.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍から樹立したヒト胎児性癌細胞株4種を、マウス由来細胞株と比較した研究である。3株は典型的な胎児性癌の特徴を示したが、NEC 8は増殖が速く腫瘍形成能が高く、分化が乏しかった。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やhCGの産生、LDHプロファイルも検討された。ヒト胎児性癌細胞には発生学的に異なる複数の型が存在すると結論づけている。
pmid-2416623.summary_en: Four human embryonal carcinoma cell lines (ITO, NEC 8, NEC 14, NEC 15) were established from testicular germ cell tumors and xenografted into mice, all showing embryonal carcinoma histology. Their biology was compared with murine EC lines across morphology, growth, tumorigenicity, karyotype, aggregate formation, HLA expression, AFP and hCG production, plasminogen activator secretion and LDH profiles. Three lines shared typical EC features, whereas NEC 8 grew rapidly, was highly tumorigenic and poorly differentiated. The authors propose that human EC cells comprise several developmentally distinct types.

pmid-2416924.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の症例で、羊水中のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)濃度が正常であった例を報告している。皮膚に覆われていない大きな腫瘍であったにもかかわらず、通常のAFPスクリーニングでは出生前診断できず、超音波検査で初めて確認された。AFPが正常であった理由を考察し、腫瘍の組織学的特徴も記載している。出生前診断における超音波検査の重要性を示す症例報告である。
pmid-2416924.summary_en: This 1985 case report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma in which amniotic fluid alphafetoprotein (AFP) concentration was normal despite a large tumor not covered by skin. Although elevated AFP is usually expected in this condition, the authors discuss possible reasons for the discrepancy. They describe the histological features of the tumor. The lesion could not have been detected antenatally by routine AFP screening and was identified only by ultrasound examination, underscoring the value of ultrasonography in prenatal diagnosis.

pmid-2417403.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍13例の中間径フィラメントタンパク質を免疫染色で検討した研究である。セミノーマはビメンチンに、非セミノーマ性腫瘍はサイトケラチンに陽性を示した。β-hCGとαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が高値のセミノーマ1例では、サイトケラチン陽性細胞が認められた。両抗体はセミノーマと非セミノーマ性腫瘍の鑑別に有用と結論された。
pmid-2417403.summary_en: Thirteen primary and metastatic testicular germ cell tumors, including classical and anaplastic seminomas and non-seminomatous tumors, were examined for intermediate filament proteins. Seminomas reacted with vimentin antibodies, while non-seminomatous tumors were strongly positive for cytokeratin. One seminoma with elevated beta-hCG and AFP contained cytokeratin-positive cells. In a teratocarcinoma, double-label immunofluorescence distinguished glandular, squamous and spindle cell components. The authors conclude that cytokeratin and vimentin antibodies aid diagnosis, particularly in distinguishing seminomas from non-seminomatous tumors.

pmid-2417461.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性腫瘍で脳転移を有する4例の治療成績を報告している。PVB療法は肺や後腹膜の転移には有効だったが脳病変には無効で、2例は3か月以内に死亡した。大量シスプラチンやメトトレキサートによる導入療法が検討された。早期発見のため頭部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)を行い、多科連携で化学療法を行うよう提言している。
pmid-2417461.summary_en: This 1985 Japanese study treated four patients with non-seminomatous testicular tumor and brain metastases using combination chemotherapy, and three also underwent craniotomy. Patients given PVB chemotherapy, effective against lung and retroperitoneal metastases, did not respond in the brain, and two died within three months. High-dose cisplatin or methotrexate achieved effective tissue concentrations as induction therapy. The authors note the blood brain barrier limits drug delivery and recommend routine brain CT for early detection with multidisciplinary chemotherapy.

pmid-2417467.summary_ja: 32か月齢男児の右精巣腫瘍（奇形腫・卵黄嚢癌・胎児性癌）の症例報告。摘除後の血清AFP漸増を受けて化学療法（VCR、CPM、ADM）を行い、両側後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。化学療法後にAFPは著明に低下したが、大動脈前リンパ節には生存腫瘍が残存しており、腫瘍マーカーの推移と組織像の乖離が示された。乳児精巣がんの管理について考察している。
pmid-2417467.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-month-old boy with a right testicular tumour containing teratoma, yolk sac carcinoma and embryonal carcinoma. A gradual rise in serum AFP after orchiectomy prompted combined chemotherapy (VCR, CPM, ADM), followed by bilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Pathology of the preaortic node showed viable yolk sac carcinoma and embryonal carcinoma despite a marked fall in AFP, highlighting a discrepancy between marker response and histology. The patient remained disease-free for 36 months. The authors discuss management of infantile testicular cancer.

pmid-2417651.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ50例を対象に、血清のHBD、β-hCG、AFP、PLAPと、原発巣組織のβ-hCG免疫染色を検討した。病期Iの術前血清では上昇例は少なく、HBDが最も多く上昇していた。病期IIまたはIIIの化学療法前血清ではHBDとβ-hCGの上昇が多かった。原発巣ではβ-hCGが病期Iの21例中6例、病期II/IIIの18例中5例で検出された。セミノーマの病期診断におけるHBDおよびβ-hCGの意義が示された。
pmid-2417651.summary_en: This study assessed serum tumour markers (HBD, beta-hCG, AFP, PLAP) in 50 consecutive patients with pure seminoma, and immunocytochemical beta-hCG in primary tumour tissue. Before orchiectomy, marker elevation was uncommon in stage I disease, with HBD the most frequently raised marker. In stage II or III patients before chemotherapy, HBD (19 of 27) and beta-hCG (11 of 27) were frequently elevated, and PLAP was elevated in 10 of 18 tested. Beta-hCG was detected immunocytochemically in 6 of 21 stage I and 5 of 18 stage II or III tumours. The findings support HBD and beta-hCG as key markers in seminoma staging.

pmid-2417652.summary_ja: 1977〜1984年に臨床病期IIの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍92例を初回化学療法で治療した結果を報告する。全体の87%が無病生存し、腫瘍径8cm超の後腹膜腫瘤では無病生存率が54%と、8cm未満の97%に比べて有意に低かった。組織型は予後に影響しなかったが、化学療法後の外科的切除は奇形癌で多かった。病期IIA・IIBの多くは手術を回避でき、射精機能も温存された。初回の非手術的アプローチを支持する結果である。
pmid-2417652.summary_en: This series reports 92 patients with clinical stage II non-seminomatous germ cell testicular tumours treated from 1977 to 1984 with primary chemotherapy, reserving surgery for persisting masses. Overall, 87% were alive and disease-free, with 96% for stages IIA and IIB and 74% for stage IIC. Patients with retroperitoneal masses over 8 cm had markedly lower disease-free rates (54% versus 97%). Histology did not affect outcome, although teratocarcinoma more often required post-chemotherapy resection than embryonal carcinoma. Most stage IIA and IIB patients avoided surgery and kept ejaculatory function, supporting an initially non-surgical approach.

pmid-2418223.summary_ja: 縦隔未熟奇形腫の1例を報告する。外科的切除、化学療法、放射線療法を組み合わせた集学的治療を行った。入院時より血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が高値で、治療経過および腫瘍増大と並行して変動した。治療にもかかわらず、入院18か月後に急性呼吸不全で死亡した。AFP高値の縦隔未熟奇形腫は卵黄嚢腫瘍と同様に予後不良であり、強力な化学療法と外科的切除、放射線療法の併用が推奨される。
pmid-2418223.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with mediastinal immature teratoma treated with a multimodal approach combining surgery, chemotherapy and radiotherapy. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was elevated at admission and changed in parallel with treatment response and tumour growth. Despite therapy, the patient died of sudden respiratory failure 18 months after admission. The authors note that mediastinal immature teratoma with high AFP carries a poor prognosis, similar to endodermal sinus tumour, and recommend intensive chemotherapy combined with surgical resection and radiotherapy.

pmid-2418628.summary_ja: 35歳男性の前縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍の剖検例で、当初は胸腺腫と診断された。末梢血に大型異型細胞が出現し、骨転移が疑われた。腫瘍は化学療法と放射線療法に抵抗性であった。剖検では縦隔の巨大腫瘍（24×13×10cm）と、ほぼ全臓器への白血病様浸潤が認められた。両側精巣に原発巣は認められなかった。悪性胚細胞腫瘍における白血病様浸潤の初の報告とされる。
pmid-2418628.summary_en: This autopsy case report describes a 35-year-old man with a malignant germ cell tumour of the anterior mediastinum, initially suspected to be thymoma. Atypical large cells appeared in peripheral blood, suggesting bone metastasis, and the tumour resisted chemotherapy and radiotherapy. Autopsy showed a 24 cm mediastinal mass with leukaemia-like infiltration of nearly all organs and no primary focus in either testis. The authors state this is the first report of leukaemia-like infiltration in malignant germ cell tumour, comparable to carcinocythemia described in non-haematologic cancers.

pmid-2418769.summary_ja: 1972〜1983年にナイジェリアのザリアで診療した小児奇形腫54例の後方視的検討。仙尾部奇形腫28例中4例、卵巣奇形腫13例中3例が悪性であった。治療は外科的切除が中心で、薬剤供給の不安定さからVAC補助化学療法が実施できない例があった。手術単独では治癒が難しく、複数の抗がん剤と放射線療法による併用療法の必要性が示された。
pmid-2418769.summary_en: This retrospective review from Zaria, Nigeria, examined 54 childhood teratomas seen between 1972 and 1983. Malignancy was found in four of 28 sacrococcygeal teratomas, three of 13 ovarian teratomas and the only lumbar teratoma. Surgical excision was the mainstay of treatment, and adjuvant VAC chemotherapy was often not delivered because of irregular drug supply. Two children died in hospital and three were discharged for terminal care. Two children with malignant ovarian teratomas survived 15 and 18 months with distant spread. The authors conclude that surgery alone is unlikely to cure these tumours.

pmid-2578049.summary_ja: hCGのカルボキシル末端を模した合成ペプチドで5種のモノクローナル抗体を作製し、β-hCG上の4つのエピトープを同定した研究である。これらを用いた2部位・3部位RIA法を開発し、絨毛癌患者の血清で遊離β-hCGとhCGを測定し、腫瘍のモニタリングへの応用可能性を示した。
pmid-2578049.summary_en: This study generated five monoclonal antibodies against a 37-amino acid synthetic peptide mimicking the carboxyl terminus of hCG. Epitope mapping located four distinct epitopes on the last 35 residues of beta-hCG. Using these antibodies, the authors built two- and three-site radioimmunoassays for free beta-hCG and hCG. The assays were applied to sera from patients with choriocarcinoma, and the authors suggest they could detect hCG-producing tumors and monitor response to surgery or chemotherapy. The antibodies had low affinity but did not cross-react with LH, TSH, or FSH. The work is primarily an immunochemical assay development study.

pmid-2578310.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌細胞株Tera-1と胎盤膜で作製したマウス抗体3種（K4、K21、P12）の反応性を解析した研究である。K4は奇形癌由来細胞株と精巣奇形癌組織で発現し、K21は奇形癌の一部に、P12は奇形癌の一部を含む広い組織に分布し、いずれも高分子量糖タンパク質上の糖鎖決定基を認識した。
pmid-2578310.summary_en: Three mouse monoclonal antibodies (K4, K21, P12) were raised against the human teratocarcinoma cell line Tera-1 and placental membrane. K4 was expressed only on teratocarcinoma-derived cell lines among 165 tested lines, and on normal adult colon and testicular teratocarcinoma specimens. K21 was found on teratocarcinoma lines and at lower levels on kidney epithelium, and was positive in 5 of 8 teratocarcinoma specimens. P12 was broadly distributed, including a subset of teratocarcinomas. All three recognized carbohydrate determinants on high-molecular-weight glycoproteins. The study characterizes surface antigens useful for distinguishing teratocarcinomas.

pmid-2579008.summary_ja: 卵巣の進行期純粋ディスジャーミノーマで、術前後にβ-hCGが上昇した24歳女性の症例報告である。全腹骨盤・縦隔照射後に腫瘤が縮小し、β-hCGは正常化して30か月無病生存した。文献的考察として、hCG上昇の意義と治療への示唆が論じられている。
pmid-2579008.summary_en: A 24-year-old woman with stage III pure ovarian dysgerminoma, bulky intrapelvic disease, para-aortic adenopathy, and elevated pre- and postoperative beta-hCG was treated with whole abdominal-pelvic and mediastinal irradiation. Adenopathy regressed, beta-hCG normalized, and she remained disease-free for 30 months. Giant cells in the tumor were hCG-negative by immunoperoxidase staining. The authors review the significance of elevated hCG, giant cells in ovarian dysgerminoma, and therapeutic implications. They suggest serial beta-hCG monitoring may be as valuable here as in testicular tumor patients.

pmid-2579212.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍49例とマーカー上昇を伴う未分化腫瘍7例を後方視的に解析した研究である。純粋セミノーマは白金製剤を含む化学療法で良好な無病生存を示し、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では約40%が無病生存した。未分化腫瘍は全例で無病生存は得られなかった。
pmid-2579212.summary_en: This retrospective review covers 49 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors, plus seven undifferentiated tumors with elevated beta-hCG and/or AFP. Sixteen of 19 patients with pure extragonadal seminoma and normal AFP were alive and disease-free, most receiving platinum-based regimens. Among 30 nonseminomatous tumors, 40% were disease-free with vinblastine/bleomycin with or without cisplatin, or CISCA-based regimens. None of seven undifferentiated tumors survived disease-free. Three of five treated anterior mediastinal endodermal sinus tumors and three of seven choriocarcinomas remained disease-free. The authors propose a classification by site, histology, and likelihood of true extragonadal origin.

pmid-2579213.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の48例に対し、CISCAIIとVBIVを交互に用いる周期的化学療法を実施した研究です。完全寛解率は92%で、寛解例の再発は認められませんでした。残存腫瘤の多くは成熟奇形腫または瘢痕でした。従来のVBP療法と比べ、完全寛解率が高く長期毒性も少ないと結論されています。
pmid-2579213.summary_en: This 1985 J Clin Oncol study reports 48 patients with advanced nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors treated with cyclic chemotherapy, alternating CISCAII and modified VBIV. Complete remission was achieved in 92% of patients, and none of those in remission relapsed at a mean follow-up of 139 weeks. Most residual masses explored were mature teratomas or scar. The authors conclude that this cyclic regimen is superior to VBP-based therapy, with high complete remission rates and reduced long-term toxicity.

pmid-2579214.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマ30例にVAB-6を投与した研究です。評価可能な28例のうち24例(86%)が完全寛解に到達し、再発は4例でした。完全寛解例の無病期間の中央値は32か月以上です。病期II(5cm超)、性腺外、病期IIIのセミノーマでは初回から化学療法を推奨すると結論されています。
pmid-2579214.summary_en: This 1985 J Clin Oncol study evaluates VAB-6 in 30 patients with advanced seminoma, including 18 untreated patients, 8 who relapsed after radiation therapy, and 4 with persistent disease after chemotherapy and radiation. Of 28 evaluable patients, 24 (86%) achieved complete remission, and four relapsed. Median disease-free follow-up exceeded 32 months. The authors conclude that VAB-6 is effective and recommend initial chemotherapy for stage II seminoma larger than 5 cm, extragonadal seminoma, and stage III seminoma.

pmid-2579253.summary_ja: 細胞性免疫異常を有する同性愛男性2例に生じた精巣胎児性癌の症例報告です。T細胞の機能異常が認められましたが、精巣がんの既知の危険因子は確認されませんでした。1例のリンパ節生検では、後天性免疫不全症候群(AIDS)でみられる反応性濾胞過形成が認められました。免疫異常を有する若年男性に生じる希少がんの範囲を広げる可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-2579253.summary_en: This 1985 Urology/J Urol report describes two homosexual men with testicular embryonal cell carcinoma and cellular immune abnormalities, including reduced T helper cells and increased T suppressor cells. Neither had recognized predisposing risk factors for testicular cancer. Lymph node biopsy in one patient showed reactive follicular hyperplasia resembling changes described in AIDS. The authors suggest these cases expand the spectrum of rare cancers arising in young men with acquired immune abnormalities.

pmid-2579442.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍と妊娠性絨毛癌の初回化学療法に、エトポシド(VP-16)を組み込んだレジメンの成績をまとめた総説です。男性胚細胞腫瘍112例の生存率は87%でした。脳転移例も手術や放射線療法なしで持続的寛解が得られています。初回からのVP-16使用が推奨されています。
pmid-2579442.summary_en: This 1985 Semin Oncol review describes incorporating VP-16 (etoposide) into first-line regimens for malignant germ cell tumors and gestational choriocarcinoma, including POMB and ACE alternation. In 112 male patients, survival was 87%, and patients with brain metastases achieved durable remission without surgery or radiotherapy. Drug-resistant patients responded to EP/OMB, and gestational choriocarcinoma results are reported by risk group. The authors recommend early VP-16 use rather than reserving it for relapse.

pmid-2579665.summary_ja: 1977〜1983年に治療された転移性セミノーマ28例を後方視的に解析した研究です。完全寛解率は89%、無病生存は82%でした。毒性は主にPVB療法後に骨髄抑制、腎毒性、神経障害、肺炎として現れました。イホスファミドとエトポシドの併用またはシスプラチン併用は、PVB療法より毒性が少ない可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-2579665.summary_en: This 1985 Br J Cancer study retrospectively analyzed 28 patients with bulky retroperitoneal or disseminated seminoma treated from 1977 to 1983 with cisplatin-, vinblastine-, bleomycin-based, ifosfamide, or ifosfamide-etoposide regimens. Complete remission occurred in 89%, and 82% were disease-free at a median follow-up of about 28 months. Toxicities included myelosuppression, nephrotoxicity, neuropathy, and pneumonitis, mostly after PVB. The authors suggest that ifosfamide-etoposide or cisplatin combinations may be less toxic than PVB regimens.

pmid-2579727.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ178例の5年原病死率に基づく生存率は97%でした。病期I の経過観察、病期IIAの予防的縦隔照射、病期IIBの初回放射線療法と化学療法の比較、病期IIIとIVの治療、腫瘍マーカー上昇の意義について論争を整理しています。予防的縦隔照射は推奨されず、病期IIIとIVには初回化学療法が適するとしています。
pmid-2579727.summary_en: This 1985 Cancer review from Princess Margaret Hospital reports 97% five-year cause-specific survival in 178 patients with testicular seminoma. It examines controversies in surveillance for stage I, prophylactic mediastinal radiotherapy for stage IIA, initial radiotherapy versus chemotherapy for stage IIB, treatment of stages III and IV, and the significance of elevated tumor markers. The authors conclude that prophylactic mediastinal radiotherapy is not recommended, initial chemotherapy suits stages III and IV, and sequential therapy can reduce morbidity without compromising cure.

pmid-2580029.summary_ja: 2種類のヒト絨毛癌細胞株と5種類の抗がん剤を用いたin vitro研究です。DNA合成と増殖が抑制されると細胞当たりのヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌が増加し、細胞死が増えると減少しました。化学療法中の一過性のhCG上昇(細胞効果)は、細胞死ではなく増殖抑制によるものと結論されています。
pmid-2580029.summary_en: This 1985 Nihon Sanka Fujinka Gakkai Zasshi in vitro study used two human choriocarcinoma cell lines and five anticancer drugs. Per-cell hCG secretion increased when DNA synthesis and cell growth were suppressed, and decreased when cell death increased. The authors conclude that the transient rise in hCG during chemotherapy, the so-called cellular effect, reflects suppressed growth rather than cell death.

pmid-2580384.summary_ja: 組織学的に純粋なセミノーマと診断された精巣腫瘍で、精巣摘除後に血清hCGが上昇した症例報告です。合胞体栄養膜巨細胞の存在や、転移性胎児性癌の可能性が示唆されています。術後にhCGが上昇したセミノーマ患者では、後腹膜リンパ節郭清と病理診断に基づく補助化学療法を検討すべきと提案しています。
pmid-2580384.summary_en: This 1985 Urology case report describes a patient whose histologically pure testicular seminoma was followed by elevated serum hCG after orchiectomy. The authors suggest this implies syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells in the primary or metastases, or possibly metastatic embryonal carcinoma. They recommend considering retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with pathology-based adjuvant chemotherapy for seminoma patients with postorchiectomy hCG elevation.

pmid-2580438.summary_ja: 1977年から1983年に治療された胞状奇胎149例を後方視的に解析し、術後のhCG消退に対する経口避妊薬の影響を検討した。異常な消退の頻度は、ホルモン避妊群で22.6%、非ホルモン避妊群で34.5%であり、有意差はなかった。経口避妊薬が侵入奇胎や絨毛癌のリスクを高める根拠は認められなかった。
pmid-2580438.summary_en: This retrospective study of 149 molar pregnancy cases compared postmolar hCG regression between patients who used hormonal contraception and those who used nonhormonal methods after evacuation. Abnormal hCG regression occurred in 22.6% of the hormonal group and 34.5% of the nonhormonal group, a difference that was not statistically significant. The nonhormonal group had shorter gestational age and more cases with very high preevacuation hCG. The authors found no evidence that oral contraceptives increase the risk of invasive mole or choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2580489.summary_ja: 上大静脈症候群を呈した進行性縦隔セミノーマの21歳男性例である。PVB療法(CDDP、VBL、BLM)を3コース施行し完全奏効が得られた。救済療法として縦隔に放射線療法を追加し、9か月のフォローアップでは再発は認められていない。併用化学療法の有効性を示す報告である。
pmid-2580489.summary_en: A 21-year-old man with advanced anterior mediastinal seminoma and superior vena cava syndrome achieved complete response after three courses of PVB chemotherapy (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin). The diagnosis was confirmed by needle biopsy. As salvage therapy, he received mediastinal radiotherapy of 4,000 rad. At nine months of follow-up, he remained free of recurrence. The report documents a favorable outcome of combination chemotherapy in advanced mediastinal seminoma.

pmid-2580758.summary_ja: 1962年から1978年に英国で診断された15歳未満の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍26例と胎児性癌4例を解析した。病期III が70%を占め、卵黄嚢腫瘍の5年生存率は39%であった。多剤化学療法の導入後は多くの症例で長期生存が得られ、放射線療法の役割は小さいと考えられた。
pmid-2580758.summary_en: This study reviewed 26 pure endodermal sinus tumors and four embryonal carcinomas of the ovary in British children under 15 years, diagnosed between 1962 and 1978. Most cases were advanced, with 70% at Stage III. The five-year survival rate was 39% for endodermal sinus tumor. Clinical stage was the only prognostic factor. Polychemotherapy introduced later produced long-term survival in many cases, whereas radiotherapy appeared to play little role.

pmid-2580759.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢成分を欠く未熟卵巣奇形腫の2例で、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を免疫細胞化学的に検出した。AFPは内胚葉性・外胚葉性の多様な細胞で産生されており、起源が不均一であることが示唆された。AFPの生物学的性質と、婦人科悪性腫瘍における腫瘍マーカーとしての利用についても概説している。
pmid-2580759.summary_en: Two cases of immature ovarian teratoma without a yolk sac component were examined for alpha-fetoprotein by immunocytochemistry. AFP was produced by a wide range of cells of both endodermal and ectodermal origin, suggesting a heterogeneous origin rather than yolk sac tissue alone. The paper also reviews the biology of AFP and its current and potential uses as a tumor marker in gynecologic malignancies.

pmid-2580800.summary_ja: モノクローナル抗体を用いて、ヒト栄養膜および絨毛癌の細胞表面抗原6種を同定し、150の細胞株と組織で分布を検討した。LK26は正常組織では栄養膜に限局し、絨毛癌と奇形癌で発現していた。LK26、SV19、PLAP、S4などは妊娠性絨毛癌や胚細胞腫瘍の診断マーカー、また免疫療法の標的となりうると考察されている。
pmid-2580800.summary_en: Six cell surface antigens of human trophoblast and choriocarcinoma were defined with monoclonal antibodies and characterized across 150 cell lines and tissues. LK26 was largely restricted to trophoblast among normal tissues and was expressed by choriocarcinoma and teratocarcinoma. The antigens, including LK26, SV19, PLAP, and S4, are proposed as potential diagnostic markers of gestational choriocarcinoma and germ cell tumors and possible targets for immunotherapy.

pmid-2581199.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍7例を免疫抑制マウスに移植し、そのうち1株(TT2)を継代可能な系として樹立した。異種移植片は胎児性癌成分を保持したが、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の産生能は失われた。胎児性癌株はシクロホスファミドとシスプラチンに高感受性を示し、PVB療法も一時的に有効であった。
pmid-2581199.summary_en: Seven human testicular tumors were transplanted into immunosuppressed mice, and one line (TT2) was serially propagated. The xenografts retained the embryonal carcinoma component but lost hCG and AFP expression. The embryonal carcinoma line was highly sensitive to cyclophosphamide and cisplatin, and PVB was effective although the response was temporary. The model provides a platform for studying chemotherapy sensitivity of testicular cancer.

pmid-2581525.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍53例を対象に、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(ITGCN)の頻度を調べ、検出法を比較した。浸潤性腫瘍の98%でITGCNが認められ、前浸潤期病変であることが支持された。PAS染色が最も信頼できる検出法であり、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の免疫染色は陽性率が2.3%と低かった。
pmid-2581525.summary_en: Intratubular germ cell neoplasia was evaluated in 53 testicular germ cell tumors. It was found in 98% of cases with invasive tumor, supporting its role as the preinvasive stage. PAS staining reliably identified ITGCN, whereas immunostains for AFP, hCG, CEA, and ferritin were focally positive in only 2.3% of cases. The authors conclude that PAS is the most reliable tool for detecting this lesion.

pmid-2581684.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がん患者からセミノーマ、奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍を含む2つのヒト細胞株(1411H、1411HRQmet)を樹立した。両株は体外でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を産生した。無胸腺マウスへの移植で多くの動物に腫瘍が生じ、初期の胎児性癌成分が後に卵黄嚢腫瘍へ変化した。
pmid-2581684.summary_en: Two human cell lines (1411H and 1411HRQmet) were established from a patient with metastatic testicular cancer containing seminoma, teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, and yolk sac tumor. Both produced AFP and hCG in vitro. When inoculated into athymic mice, most animals developed tumors that were initially embryonal carcinoma and later transformed into yolk sac tumor. The model is useful for studying the relationship between these germ cell cancer components.

pmid-2581882.summary_ja: 69歳男性に生じた悪性仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告です。通常は幼児期に見られる腫瘍ですが、本例は後頸部の割れ目に生じた褥瘡様病変として発見されました。組織学的に栄養膜成分を伴っていました。成人例の文献レビューを行い、既報の悪性成人例は3例のみであることを示し、本症例の稀少性と非典型的な発症年齢を強調しています。
pmid-2581882.summary_en: This case report describes a malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma in a 69-year-old man, a tumour usually seen in early childhood. It presented as a bedsore in the nuchal cleft and showed a trophoblastic component on histology. The authors review the adult literature and identify only three previously reported malignant adult cases, highlighting the rarity and atypical age of this presentation.

pmid-2581914.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の組織発生と病理分類に関する総説です。生物学的挙動と形態の多様性から、分類体系は一定していません。免疫組織化学、動物実験、超微細構造、臨床所見を総合すると、癌性幹細胞の分化によりセミノーマと非セミノーマの中間型が生じるとされています。統一的な臨床用語の確立には、組織発生の理解の進展が必要だと論じています。
pmid-2581914.summary_en: This review examines the histogenesis and classification of testicular germ cell tumours. Owing to their diverse biological behaviour and morphology, these tumours have been classified in differing ways. Immunohistochemical, experimental and ultrastructural data, together with clinical observations, suggest that carcinomatous stem cells differentiate into forms transitional between seminomatous and non-seminomatous tumours. The authors argue that a uniform clinical nomenclature will depend on advances in histogenetic understanding.

pmid-2582070.summary_ja: ヌードマウスに移植した絨毛癌に対し、放射標識したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)抗体およびそのβサブユニット抗体の局在を検討しました。抗hCG抗体は多くの臓器より腫瘍に集積しましたが、腫瘍対血液比は高くありませんでした。血中では免疫複合体が形成され、組織内に停滞していました。分泌産物であるhCGを標的とする腫瘍局在診断には特異性の限界があると結論づけています。
pmid-2582070.summary_en: This study tested radiolabelled monoclonal antibodies to human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) and its beta subunit in choriocarcinoma xenografts in athymic mice. Anti-hCG showed higher localisation in tumour than in most organs, but its tumour-to-blood ratio was modest. Anti-beta-subunit showed no tumour selectivity. Serum analysis revealed immune complex formation, and autoradiography showed retention in tumour capillaries and interstitium. The authors conclude that targeting secreted hCG has limited specificity for clinical localisation.

pmid-2856911.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、正常胎盤および妊娠性絨毛癌におけるSSEA-1およびSSEA-3の局在を検討しました。SSEA-3はいずれの検体でも検出されませんでした。SSEA-1は2株の絨毛癌細胞株で陽性でしたが、胞状奇胎10例および正常胎盤9例の栄養膜細胞では陰性でした。このマーカーによれば、胞状奇胎の栄養膜は妊娠性絨毛癌より正常栄養膜に近いと結論づけています。
pmid-2856911.summary_en: This study examined the localisation of murine oncofetal antigens SSEA-1 and SSEA-3 in hydatidiform mole, normal placenta and gestational choriocarcinoma. SSEA-3 was not detected in any sample. SSEA-1 was present in two choriocarcinoma cell lines but absent from the trophoblast of ten hydatidiform moles and nine normal placentas. The authors conclude that, by this marker, the trophoblast of hydatidiform mole resembles normal trophoblast more than choriocarcinoma does.

pmid-2861680.summary_ja: ダウン症候群を有する41歳日本人男性の停留精巣に生じた、3,500gに及ぶ巨大セミノーマの症例報告である。文献的考察も行い、ダウン症候群と精巣がんとの関連を検討している。停留精巣由来のセミノーマとして、これまでに報告された最大のものとされる。停留精巣の悪性化リスクや、染色体異常と胚細胞腫瘍との関係を考える上で示唆に富む症例である。
pmid-2861680.summary_en: This case report describes a giant seminoma, weighing 3,500 g, arising in an undescended testis of a 41-year-old Japanese man with Down syndrome. The authors review the literature and discuss the association between Down syndrome and testicular cancer. The tumor is noted to be the largest seminoma of undescended testis recorded to date, highlighting the malignancy risk of maldescended gonads and the potential link between chromosomal disorders and germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-2862513.summary_ja: 精巣の胚細胞がんや卵巣・子宮頸部がんが疑われた15例を対象に、インジウム111標識の抗PLAP抗体による放射免疫シンチグラフィを評価した。活動性疾患の多くで良好な画像が得られた。hCG高値でCTが正常の精巣奇形腫の1例では、CTで捉えられなかったリンパ節病変を検出した。偽陽性は認められず、病期分類や経過観察への応用が示唆された。
pmid-2862513.summary_en: This 1985 Lancet study evaluated indium-111-labelled monoclonal antibody H17E2 against placental alkaline phosphatase for radioimmunoscintigraphy in 15 patients with suspected or known germ cell carcinoma of the testis, or carcinoma of the ovary or cervix. Most patients with active disease showed good tumor images. In one patient with testicular teratoma and elevated hCG, the antibody located nodal disease missed by CT. No false positives occurred in PLAP-negative tumors or inflammation. The authors suggest utility for diagnosis, staging, and monitoring.

pmid-2863211.summary_ja: 縦隔奇形腫に含まれた膵組織の詳細な免疫蛍光解析を報告した病理学的研究である。インスリン・グルカゴン・ソマトスタチン・膵ポリペプチド陽性の内分泌細胞が、正常膵島に似た配置を示していた。膵の発生起源を反映した非ランダムな分布も認められた。低血糖症状がない理由として、膵島の構築が保たれていた点が示唆されている。
pmid-2863211.summary_en: This 1985 pathology study examines a mediastinal teratoma containing pancreatic tissue rich in islet cells. Immunofluorescence showed well-differentiated endocrine cells, including insulin, glucagon, somatostatin, and pancreatic polypeptide-positive cells, arranged in the topography seen in normal islets. The authors also found a nonrandom distribution of PP-rich and PP-poor areas, reflecting the embryologic origin of the pancreatic regions. The preserved islet architecture is suggested as a reason for the absence of hypoglycemia.

pmid-2863887.summary_ja: 持続性ミュラー管症候群の若年成人で、腹腔内精巣に生じた両側病期III純粋セミノーマの症例報告である。両側精巣摘除術、放射線療法、脊椎転移に対する椎弓切除、化学療法が施行された。本症候群に関する稀な文献もレビューしている。性分化疾患を背景とする異所性精巣の胚細胞腫瘍管理の難しさを示す症例である。
pmid-2863887.summary_en: This urology report describes a young adult with persistent müllerian duct syndrome who presented with bilateral stage III pure seminomas arising in intra-abdominal testes. Management included bilateral orchiectomy, radiotherapy, laminectomy for spinal metastases, and chemotherapy. The authors review the rare literature on this condition. The case illustrates the challenges of managing germ cell tumors in ectopic intra-abdominal testes associated with a disorder of sexual development.

pmid-2864495.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者の治療（放射線療法または化学療法）後に生まれた子どもの先天奇形の頻度を、対照群や病期Iの精巣がん患者と比較した研究である。治療群の奇形率は対照群や一般集団と差がなかった。症例数が少ないため、小さな相対危険度は除外できないと留保されている。精巣がんの治療を理由に妊娠中絶を勧めるべきではないと結論している。
pmid-2864495.summary_en: This 1985 Lancet study examined congenital malformations in children fathered by testicular cancer patients treated with radiotherapy or chemotherapy, compared with community controls and stage I patients. Malformation rates in the children of treated fathers did not differ from controls or population rates. The authors conclude that treatment for testicular cancer should not prompt advice to terminate pregnancy, while noting that the sample was too small to exclude modest relative risks and that more observations are needed.

pmid-2865841.summary_ja: 持続性ミュラー管症候群を有する患者の腹腔内精巣に生じた卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。性分化疾患に伴う異所性性腺での腫瘍型を示した。持続性ミュラー管症候群と精巣の胚細胞腫瘍との関連を示す、限られた文献の一つとなる。報告は簡潔で、組織学的所見や治療の詳細は限られている。
pmid-2865841.summary_en: This 1985 urology case report describes a yolk sac tumor arising in an intra-abdominal testis in a patient with persistent müllerian duct syndrome. The brief report documents the tumor type associated with an ectopic gonad in this disorder of sexual development. It adds to the limited literature linking persistent müllerian duct syndrome with testicular germ cell neoplasia, particularly yolk sac histology, which is rarely described in such intra-abdominal testes. Detailed histologic and treatment information is limited.

pmid-2934429.summary_ja: 27歳男性の重症筋無力症症例。CTで胸腺の腫大を認め、病理学的検査で胸腺嚢胞内壁結節として発生した胸腺セミノーマ(ジャーミノーマ)とリンパ濾胞過形成が確認された。胸腺セミノーマ、リンパ濾胞過形成、重症筋無力症の併存は初の報告である。本症例は縦隔胚細胞腫瘍が自己免疫症状を伴いうることを示す。
pmid-2934429.summary_en: A 27-year-old man with recent-onset myasthenia gravis had an enlarged thymus on CT. Pathology showed lymphoid hyperplasia and a thymic seminoma, which was described as a germinoma and arose as an intramural nodule in a thymic cyst. The authors report the first association of thymic seminoma, lymphoid hyperplasia, and myasthenia gravis. The case highlights that mediastinal germ cell tumors can present with autoimmune manifestations.

pmid-2937259.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoを中心に、ヘマトポルフィリン誘導体(HPD)の光照射による細胞毒性をin vitroで検討した。光照射下のHPDはhCG分泌と細胞数を減少させ、BeWoは正常羊水細胞より感受性が高かった。速溶出分画に活性があり、遅溶出分画は無効だった。この結果は絨毛癌に対する光感受性療法の可能性を示唆する。
pmid-2937259.summary_en: This in vitro study examined the phototoxicity of hematoporphyrin derivative (HPD) and its chromatographic fractions in hCG-secreting malignant trophoblast cells, mainly the BeWo choriocarcinoma line. Light-activated HPD reduced cell number and hCG output, and BeWo cells were more sensitive than the CaSki cervical carcinoma line and amniotic fluid controls. The fast-eluting fraction was active, while the slow-eluting fraction had no effect. The results suggest a potential role for photosensitizer-based approaches in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2981174.summary_ja: レチノイン酸(RA)処理によりF9胎児性癌細胞の足場非依存性増殖は48時間で最大98%抑制された。この悪性度の消失は、壁側内胚葉マーカーの変化より早期に起こる。一方、形質転換特異的p53タンパク質の量は並行して変化せず、p53の上昇だけでは悪性増殖を維持できないことが示唆された。
pmid-2981174.summary_en: Retinoic acid (RA) treatment of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells reduced anchorage-independent growth by up to 98% within 48 hours. This loss of malignancy preceded changes in parietal endoderm markers and other transformation-related properties. Levels of transformation-specific p53 protein did not parallel the loss of growth in suspension, suggesting that elevated p53 alone is insufficient to maintain malignant growth. The findings clarify early events in RA-induced differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-2981190.summary_ja: 50歳以上の妊娠性絨毛性疾患20例を検討した。内訳は胞状奇胎7例、侵入奇胎8例、絨毛癌5例。胞状奇胎と侵入奇胎では死亡例はなく、絨毛癌では5例中4例が死亡した。内容除去後の悪性続発症が56.3%にみられるため、高齢者の胞状奇胎には初回治療として子宮摘出術が推奨されている。
pmid-2981190.summary_en: Twenty women aged 50 or older with gestational trophoblastic disease were reviewed: 7 hydatidiform moles, 8 invasive moles, and 5 choriocarcinomas. Abnormal vaginal bleeding was the most common presenting symptom. No patients with mole died, whereas 4 of 5 choriocarcinoma patients died. Because malignant sequelae followed molar evacuation in 56.3% of cases, the authors recommend primary hysterectomy for hydatidiform mole in this age group.

pmid-2981192.summary_ja: 治療後1年以上hCGが正常化していた妊娠性絨毛性疾患の2例が、18か月および21か月後に再発した。初発時の転移は1例が肺、もう1例は肺と脳。再治療後の長期無病生存を確認し、長期的な経過観察の重要性を強調している。潜伏期間後の再活性化機序も考察している。
pmid-2981192.summary_en: Two patients with gestational trophoblastic disease had normal hCG levels for at least one year after treatment, then developed recurrence after 18 and 21 months of remission. One had lung metastases at initial presentation; the other had lung and brain tumor. Both achieved long-term disease-free status after retreatment. The authors emphasize long-term surveillance and discuss mechanisms for reactivation after a prolonged latency period.

pmid-2981374.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の悪性胚細胞腫瘍56例の検討。若年男性に多く、セミノーマが最も多い組織型だった。胎児性癌、絨毛癌、奇形腫が続く。予後は不良で、セミノーマの予後因子は非セミノーマ性腫瘍には当てはまらなかった。後年は併用化学療法が行われたが、治療法に関する結論は得られていない。
pmid-2981374.summary_en: This review covers 56 patients with primary malignant germ cell tumors of the mediastinum, mostly young men. Seminoma was the most frequent histology, followed by embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, and teratoma. Most patients were symptomatic at presentation, and the prognosis was poor. Prognostic factors for seminoma did not predict outcome in non-seminomatous tumors. Combination chemotherapy was used in later years, but no treatment-specific conclusions could be drawn.

pmid-2981622.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の手術患者にエトポシドを投与し、血漿・尿・組織中濃度を測定した。血漿中の終末半減期は約4.1時間。肺転移巣の濃度は血漿の19〜43%、子宮筋層の癌では約40〜50%であった。皮下組織では濃度が低く、約半量が尿中に排泄された。
pmid-2981622.summary_en: Etoposide (VP16) pharmacokinetics were measured in patients with choriocarcinoma undergoing surgery after a 100 or 200 mg/m2 infusion. The plasma terminal half-life was about 4.1 hours. Concentrations in lung metastases reached 19-43% of plasma, and in tumor myometrium about 40-50%, while subcutaneous tissue levels were low. About half of the drug was excreted in the urine, partly unchanged.

pmid-2982043.summary_ja: 本研究は1965～1982年に精巣胚細胞腫瘍で治療された患者77例の連続剖検例を検討したものである。剖検例の多くは単一の組織型を示し、原発巣より単一パターンが多かった。標準的3剤併用化学療法導入後は、非セミノーマ剖検例29例中6例で卵黄嚢腫瘍が唯一の成分であり、1976年以前の32例中1例とは対照的であった。
pmid-2982043.summary_en: This 1985 study reviewed 77 consecutive autopsies of patients treated for testicular germ cell tumors between 1965 and 1982. Identifiable germ cell tumor was found in 64 cases. Single histological patterns were more common at autopsy than in primary tumors. Yolk sac tumor was the sole element in 6 of 29 nonseminomatous autopsy specimens after standard three-drug chemotherapy was introduced, compared with once in 32 before 1976. The authors suggest yolk sac elements were previously obscured by faster-growing tumor but are less responsive to chemotherapy.

pmid-2982061.summary_ja: 本研究は絨毛癌6例、胞状奇胎17例、正常妊娠初期女性20例、非妊娠女性20例で細胞性免疫と血清免疫グロブリンを定量評価した。絨毛癌では胞状奇胎に比べ細胞性免疫の抑制が著明であった。胞状奇胎では血清IgGが有意に低下し、液性免疫の低下が示唆された。手術と化学療法による3か月の治療後、絨毛癌の細胞性免疫は著明に改善した。
pmid-2982061.summary_en: This 1985 study measured cell-mediated immunity and serum immunoglobulins in six choriocarcinoma patients, 17 vesicular mole patients, and normal pregnant and nonpregnant control women. Cell-mediated immunity was markedly suppressed in choriocarcinoma compared with vesicular mole. Serum IgG was significantly reduced in vesicular mole, indicating diminished humoral immunity. After three months of surgery and chemotherapy, cell-mediated immunity in choriocarcinoma improved markedly.

pmid-2982618.summary_ja: 1972～1976年のイスラエルにおける20歳未満の卵巣癌の疫学研究である。新規22例のうち胚細胞腫瘍が63.6%、上皮性腫瘍が23%を占めた。この集団は卵巣悪性腫瘍全体の2.2%で、5年生存率は54.5%であった。ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が最も悪性度の低い腫瘍であった。民族間で発生率に差は認められなかった。
pmid-2982618.summary_en: This 1985 Israeli epidemiological study examined ovarian cancer in patients under 20 years of age from 1972 to 1976. Of 22 new cases, germ cell tumors accounted for 63.6% and epithelial tumors for 23%. The group represented 2.2% of all ovarian malignancies, with a five-year survival of 54.5%. Dysgerminoma was the least malignant tumor. No difference in incidence was found across ethnic groups.

pmid-2982716.summary_ja: 1928～1982年に頭頸部の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍で治療または相談を受けた小児16例の検討である。これらの腫瘍は胚細胞腫瘍全体の5%に過ぎなかった。14例は新生児で診断され、大半は成熟または未熟な奇形腫であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍は3例で、生後6～11か月の乳児に発生した。乳児期の奇形腫の予後は良好だが、卵黄嚢腫瘍は早期診断と積極的な補助療法に依存し、予後は慎重を要する。
pmid-2982716.summary_en: This 1985 review describes 16 children treated or consulted for extragonadal germ cell tumors of the head and neck between 1928 and 1982. These tumors made up only 5% of all benign and malignant germ cell tumors. Fourteen were diagnosed in newborns, mostly pure mature or immature teratomas, while three were endodermal sinus tumors occurring in older infants. Infantile teratomas had an excellent prognosis, but endodermal sinus tumors remained guarded, depending on early diagnosis and aggressive adjuvant therapy.

pmid-2982720.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍の患者2例で血管肉腫が異なる機序により発生した報告である。1例は放射線療法の合併症と考えられ、胚細胞成分は認められなかった。もう1例は奇形腫巣内の悪性化により生じたと考えられ、両成分が混在していた。有効な化学療法の時代において奇形腫成分の悪性転化の重要性が増しており、精巣癌に血管肉腫が発生した報告は従来なかったとしている。
pmid-2982720.summary_en: This 1985 report describes two patients with malignant germ cell tumors who developed angiosarcoma by different mechanisms. In one, angiosarcoma likely arose as a complication of therapeutic radiation, with no germ cell elements present. In the other, it probably arose from malignant change within teratomatous foci, with angiosarcomatous and teratomatous elements intermingled. The authors note that malignant change within teratomatous components is increasingly important in the era of effective chemotherapy, and that angiosarcoma had not previously been reported in testicular carcinoma.

pmid-2983125.summary_ja: 1971～1981年に治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍の根治的精巣摘除術標本111例を検討し、隣接精巣組織内の精細管内悪性胚細胞（上皮内癌）を評価した。純粋セミノーマの82%、混合型または非セミノーマ性腫瘍の75%で認められた。認められなかった22例のうち10例は重度の異型を示し、早期病変が示唆された。胚細胞腫瘍は精細管内の腫瘍性病変から発生するという説を支持する結果である。
pmid-2983125.summary_en: This 1985 J Urol study examined 111 radical orchiectomy specimens from patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated between 1971 and 1981, looking for intratubular malignant germ cells (carcinoma in situ) in adjacent tissue. Such cells were found in 82% of pure seminomas and 75% of mixed or nonseminomatous tumors. Among the 22 cases lacking them, 10 showed severe atypia suggesting an early or borderline stage. The findings support the view that germ cell tumors arise from intratubular neoplasia in the seminiferous tubules.

pmid-2983472.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍627例の治療経験と最近の文献に基づく総説である。年齢分布、早期発見、腫瘍マーカー・超音波検査・X線検査の感度と特異度を扱う。N0M0期のセミノーマは放射線療法でほぼ全例治癒し、進行例には化学療法が必要とされる。N0M0期の非セミノーマでは、フォローアップ方針（ウォッチ・ポリシー）とリンパ節郭清を比較検討し、救援手術と救援化学療法による進行例の回復率を示す。
pmid-2983472.summary_en: This 1985 Urol Int review draws on 627 patients with germinal testicular tumors and recent literature. It covers age distribution, early detection, and the sensitivity and specificity of tumor markers, ultrasonography, and X-ray. Radiotherapy cures nearly all stage N0M0 seminomas, and primary polychemotherapy is needed for advanced disease. It compares watch policy with lymphadenectomy for stage N0M0 nonseminomas, and describes salvage treatment for advanced nonseminomas, with recovery in 70-80% depending on organ involvement.

pmid-2983474.summary_ja: 小児泌尿器腫瘍学の総説で、ウィルムス腫瘍、骨盤部横紋筋肉腫とともに卵黄嚢腫瘍を扱う。限局例では後腹膜リンパ節郭清や補助化学療法を省略しうるとし、進行例は新しい併用化学療法で救済可能と述べる。
pmid-2983474.summary_en: A review of pediatric genitourinary oncology covering Wilms tumor, pelvic rhabdomyosarcoma, and yolk-sac tumor. For localized yolk-sac tumor, the authors argue that retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy and adjuvant chemotherapy may be avoided, while advanced disease can be salvaged with newer combination chemotherapy regimens. Germ cell tumor management is one component of the broader pediatric urologic oncology discussion.

pmid-2983547.summary_ja: 標準的導入療法後の転移性胚細胞腫瘍49例に、エトポシドとシスプラチンのサルベージ化学療法を施行した。有効性は既往に完全寛解を得た患者に限られ、完全寛解歴のない患者では完全奏効は得られなかった。難治例には新たな治療法の検討が必要と結論している。
pmid-2983547.summary_en: Forty-nine patients with metastatic germ cell tumors received etoposide and cisplatin as salvage chemotherapy after standard induction. Response was largely confined to patients who had achieved a prior complete remission, while those without prior complete remission showed no complete responses. The authors conclude that etoposide-cisplatin combinations are effective mainly in patients who responded to earlier cisplatin, and that refractory disease needs investigational approaches.

pmid-2983872.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍を発症した兄弟4名（セミノーマ4例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍1例）の家系を遺伝学的に検討した。染色体と姉妹染色分体交換の解析、遺伝マーカー解析を行った。遺伝的素因を支持する結果は得られなかったが、出生順による時間的な環境因子の関与を示唆した。
pmid-2983872.summary_en: Four brothers with testicular neoplasms, four seminomas and one mixed germ cell tumor, were investigated for genetic predisposition. Chromosomal and sister chromatid exchange studies and genetic marker analyses were performed within the family. The findings did not support a genetic etiology, though a birth-order effect suggested time-limited environmental factors. The authors suggest further testing of JK, MNSs, and GPT in future familial testicular cancer studies.

pmid-2984822.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの転移により右上腕軟部組織に生じた腕神経叢障害の症例である。亜全摘の外科的切除と放射線療法により神経障害が治癒し、長期生存が得られた。転移は精巣摘除術の6年後に出現し、治療後6年間無病であった。
pmid-2984822.summary_en: A patient with brachial plexus neuropathy from metastatic testicular seminoma involving the right upper arm soft tissues. Subtotal surgical removal and radiation therapy led to prolonged survival and cure of the neuropathy. The metastasis appeared six years after orchiectomy, and the patient remained disease-free six years after treatment.

pmid-2984900.summary_ja: 本総説は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療の進歩をまとめたものである。シスプラチンを基軸とした化学療法により、適切な治療後の長期生存は非セミノーマで約85%、セミノーマで約95%が期待できるとされる。自然経過、症状、診断手順、病期分類、手術・放射線療法・化学療法などの治療法を論じている。
pmid-2984900.summary_en: This review article summarizes the progress in managing testicular germ cell tumours. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy markedly improved outcomes, with long-term survival of about 85% in non-seminomas and 95% in seminomas after adequate treatment. It covers natural history, symptoms, diagnostic procedures, staging, and treatment modalities including surgery, radiation therapy, chemotherapy, and combined approaches.

pmid-2984971.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の男性3例が、その後汎血球減少と芽球による骨髄浸潤を伴う悪性血液疾患を発症した。2例は急性巨核芽球性白血病、1例は巨核球成分を伴う骨髄異形成症候群と分類された。文献的検討から、この関連は化学療法の結果ではなく、全能性の胚細胞に由来する腫瘍が血液学的表現型を獲得した結果と考察している。
pmid-2984971.summary_en: This report describes three men with primary mediastinal germ-cell tumors who later developed a malignant hematologic disorder with pancytopenia and marrow infiltration by blast cells. Two were classified as acute megakaryocytic leukemia and one as myelodysplastic syndrome with a megakaryocytic component. The authors review the literature and argue the association is not due to chemotherapy but reflects evolution of a neoplasm originating from a totipotent germ cell that acquires hematologic phenotypes.

pmid-2985166.summary_ja: 腹痛で発症し胚細胞腫瘍と診断された男性23例を検討した。全生存期間は精巣腫脹で発症した患者と差がなかった。腹腔内の胚細胞腫瘍は男性の腹痛における重要な鑑別診断であると結論している。発症部位が予後を必ずしも規定しないため、原因不明の腹部症状を呈する男性では本腫瘍を念頭に置くべきと指摘している。
pmid-2985166.summary_en: This series reviews 23 men who presented with abdominal pain and were diagnosed with germ cell tumours. Their overall survival was comparable to patients who presented with testicular swelling. The authors conclude that intra-abdominal germ cell tumour should remain an important differential diagnosis for abdominal pain in men. The study highlights that presentation site does not necessarily predict prognosis, and clinicians should consider germ cell tumour when evaluating unexplained abdominal symptoms in male patients.

pmid-2985662.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患患者に対する造影ダイナミックCTの所見を報告する。奇胎除去後に持続病変を有した5例では、増強された子宮筋層に囲まれた低吸収域がみられた。絨毛癌の1例では、周辺増強を伴う中心部の非増強病変を認めた。増強病変内の欠損像は筋層へ侵入する水疱状絨毛を示唆し、侵入奇胎を疑う所見と結論づけている。
pmid-2985662.summary_en: This report describes dynamic contrast-enhanced CT findings in patients with trophoblastic disease. Five cases with persistent disease after molar evacuation showed hypodense foci surrounded by enhancing myometrium, not seen in two cases of successfully evacuated hydatidiform mole. One choriocarcinoma showed a central nonenhancing lesion with peripheral enhancement. Filling defects in enhancing lesions likely represent hydatids penetrating the myometrium, suggesting invasive mole.

pmid-2985718.summary_ja: 妊娠、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌患者の血清と尿中hCGのピーナッツ凝集素(PNA)への結合を検討した。絨毛癌では6例中4例でPNA結合分画が上昇し、その実体はアシアロhCGであった。PNA親和性クロマトグラフィーは不完全にシアル化されたhCGを検出でき、絨毛癌の診断指標となりうると提案している。
pmid-2985718.summary_en: This study examined binding of hCG in sera and urine to peanut agglutinin (PNA) in pregnancy, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma. Standard hCG and hCG-beta bound PNA only after neuraminidase treatment. The PNA-binding fraction was elevated in choriocarcinoma patients in 4 of 6 cases and consisted of asialo-hCG. The authors suggest PNA affinity chromatography could detect incompletely sialylated hCG and serve as a diagnostic index for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2986471.summary_ja: 17歳女性の卵巣に生じ、悪性網膜原基成分が主体の未熟奇形腫を報告する。核型解析で単為発生由来であり、染色体不安定性と異数性を示した。色素細胞は上衣細胞様の超微細構造を示し、未熟神経膠組織はGFAP陽性であった。神経堤ではなく神経溝由来と考えられる。
pmid-2986471.summary_en: This report describes an immature ovarian teratoma with a predominant malignant retinal anlage component in a 17-year-old woman. Karyotyping showed the tumour was parthenogenetically derived, with chromosome instability and aneuploidy. Electron microscopy of pigmented cells showed ependymal features, and glial fibrillary acidic protein was present in immature neuroglia, suggesting neural groove origin rather than neural crest.

pmid-2986664.summary_ja: H17E2モノクローナル抗体アッセイを用い、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の血清マーカーとして胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ様活性(PLAP)を評価した。転移性疾患の未治療50例では、セミノーマの88%、混合型の54%、悪性奇形腫の33%でPLAPが基準値を超えた。治療により初期値は53〜97%低下した。特にセミノーマの管理に有用と結論している。
pmid-2986664.summary_en: This study evaluated placental-like alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) as a serum marker in testicular germ cell tumours using the H17E2 monoclonal antibody assay. Of 50 patients with metastatic disease before treatment, PLAP exceeded the threshold in 88% of seminomas, 54% of mixed tumours and 33% of malignant teratomas. Among 22 successfully treated patients, 15 had elevated pre-treatment levels, which fell by 53-97% with therapy. The authors suggest PLAP is useful for managing germ cell tumours, particularly seminoma.

pmid-2986949.summary_ja: 本研究はヒト絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞を用いて、上皮成長因子(EGF)と腫瘍プロモーターのPMAがhCG分泌を400%増加させることを示した。アラキドン酸はEGFの作用を増強し、インドメタシンも同様の作用を示した。一方、ノルジヒドログアイアレチン酸はhCG分泌を強く抑制した。この結果から、リポキシゲナーゼ系を含むアラキドン酸代謝経路が、絨毛癌細胞におけるhCG生合成を調節することが示唆された。
pmid-2986949.summary_en: This study examines JEG-3 human choriocarcinoma cells, showing that epidermal growth factor (EGF) and the tumor promoter PMA bind specific receptors and markedly increase hCG secretion. Arachidonic acid potentiates the EGF effect, and cyclooxygenase inhibition by indomethacin mimics this response, while nordihydroguaiaretic acid strongly suppresses hCG output. The findings suggest that the arachidonic acid pathway, including a lipoxygenase intermediary, modulates EGF- and PMA-driven hCG biosynthesis in choriocarcinoma cells.
