pmid-3971823.summary_ja: 家族性大腸腺腫症を合併した精巣胎児性癌の症例報告である。家族性大腸腺腫症は、大腸・直腸に限らない全身性の腫瘍形成性疾患である可能性が示唆された。全大腸切除と回腸瘻造設を行っても、治療が必ずしも完全とはならないことも示された。単一症例のため一般化には限界がある。
pmid-3971823.summary_en: This case report describes embryonal carcinoma of the testis in a patient with familial adenomatosis coli. The authors propose that this hereditary syndrome may be systemic and tumorigenic beyond the colon and rectum. The case also suggests that total colectomy with ileostomy is not always curative. The report supports broader surveillance in patients with familial adenomatous polyposis. As a single-patient report, its generalizability is limited.

pmid-3971995.summary_ja: 1971年から1983年に治療した、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）純型5例の解析である。患者は15歳6か月から28歳で、全例が初経を迎えていた。臨床所見、症状、病期、治療、再発時の治療、最終的な生存について検討された。症例数が少なく、結論の一般化には限界がある。
pmid-3971995.summary_en: This study analyzes five cases of pure dysgerminoma treated with a uniform schedule between 1971 and 1983. Patients were aged 15 years 6 months to 28 years, and all had reached menarche. The authors reviewed clinical findings, symptoms, disease stage, type of treatment, treatment for recurrence, and final survival. Dysgerminoma is a germ cell tumor, and this series documents its clinical course in young patients. The small sample limits broader conclusions.

pmid-3972179.summary_ja: 本研究は、奇形癌細胞株OTT6050を培養下で分化させた細胞の膜興奮性を電気生理学的に検討したものである。レチノイン酸処理細胞はCa2+依存性の活動電位を示し、レチノイン酸と神経成長因子の併用処理細胞ではNa+とCa2+が関与する活動電位が認められた。薬剤が胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞の分化過程における機能を制御しうることを示した基礎研究である。
pmid-3972179.summary_en: This basic study examined the membrane excitability of cells differentiated in culture from the teratocarcinoma line OTT6050. Retinoic acid-treated cells generated calcium-dependent action potentials, whereas cells treated with both retinoic acid and nerve growth factor showed sodium- and calcium-dependent spikes. The findings indicate that pharmacological agents can induce distinct electrophysiological phenotypes and regulate cellular function during differentiation of germ cell tumor-derived cells.

pmid-3972298.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の治療を受けた患者に、機械的腸閉塞に似た結腸偽性閉塞が発症した症例報告である。適切な評価により非手術的治療で管理できた。結腸偽性閉塞の原因、診断、治療について考察しており、絨毛癌患者が閉塞様症状を呈した際には非機械的原因を念頭に置く必要性を示している。
pmid-3972298.summary_en: A patient treated for choriocarcinoma developed colonic pseudoobstruction, a condition that mimics mechanical bowel obstruction and can lead to spontaneous cecal perforation. Appropriate evaluation allowed nonsurgical management. The report reviews the etiology, diagnosis, and management of colonic pseudoobstruction in this setting, highlighting that non-mechanical causes should be considered when a patient with choriocarcinoma presents with apparent obstruction.

pmid-3973427.summary_ja: 幼児の未熟成分を伴う良性縦隔奇形腫を、ヒト腫瘍クローン形成アッセイで検討した研究である。軟寒天培地で形成されたコロニーは周囲から分離し、繊毛の協調運動により急速に回転した。形態学的、超微細構造的、免疫学的解析の結果、コロニーは繊毛を有する呼吸上皮のみから構成されていた。
pmid-3973427.summary_en: Researchers used the human tumor clonogenic assay to study a benign mediastinal teratoma with immature elements from a young child. Tumor colonies formed in soft agar, detached from the surrounding agar, and rotated rapidly due to coordinated beating of their cilia. Morphologic, ultrastructural, and immunologic analyses showed the colonies were composed exclusively of ciliated respiratory epithelium, illustrating an unusual behavior of a benign teratoma in culture.

pmid-3973780.summary_ja: 45,X/46,XY性腺異形成症で男性表現型または両性具有の外性器を有する小児4例の性腺を検討した。全例で胚細胞の上皮内癌(CIS)が認められ、異数性DNAから悪性の可能性が示された。CIS所見があれば性腺摘出術を考慮すべきであり、診断時に性腺生検を行うことを推奨している。
pmid-3973780.summary_en: The authors examined gonadal tissue from four children with 45,X/46,XY gonadal dysgenesis and male or ambiguous genitalia. Carcinoma in situ germ cells were found in specimens from all four patients, with aneuploid DNA content confirming malignant potential, and ultrastructure resembling seminoma cells in one case. They recommend gonadal biopsy at diagnosis and conclude that CIS findings warrant gonadectomy, given the high risk of testicular germ cell tumor development.

pmid-3978556.summary_ja: 1971年から1978年にオランダ精巣腫瘍委員会に登録された764例を解析した。転移の検出には胸部X線と両側性リンパ管造影が有用だった。精巣外への局所浸潤は予後と関連しなかった。混合型腫瘍と悪性奇形腫は挙動と治療が同様で、単一の疾患として扱いうる。セミノーマの21%、非セミノーマの4%で2年以降に再発したため、最低5年のフォローアップが望ましいと結論づけた。
pmid-3978556.summary_en: This 1985 Dutch analysis of 764 men with testicular tumors (1971 to 1978) found outcomes comparable to the best published series. Chest radiography and bipedal lymphangiography were most useful for detecting metastases. Local extratesticular invasion did not affect prognosis. Combined tumors and malignant teratomas showed similar behavior and treatment, supporting their classification as a single entity. Recurrence occurred after two years in 21% of seminoma and 4% of nonseminoma patients, so a minimum five-year follow-up is recommended.

pmid-3978564.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後の12例のセミノーマを、血管灌流と標識チミジンを用いて解析した。直径約2cmを超える結節では増殖細胞が辺縁に集中し、中心部の大部分は静止状態だった。標識指数は血管近傍で高かった。増殖様式は組織学的構造より腫瘍の形状と大きさに依存すると結論づけた。
pmid-3978564.summary_en: Vascular organ perfusion with thymidine labeling was used after orchiectomy to study growth patterns and cell kinetics in 12 human seminomas. Proliferating cells concentrated at the periphery of nodules larger than about 2 cm, while the central tumor remained quiescent. Labeling indices averaged 11.6%, highest near vessels, and reached 41.9% in an anaplastic seminoma. Growth patterns depended more on tumor geometry and size than on histologic structure.

pmid-3981225.summary_ja: 心臓領域への放射線照射を5年以上前に受け、寛解状態にあるホジキン病またはセミノーマの患者41例が心エコー検査を受けた。心膜肥厚(70%)、右室異常(39%)、左室機能障害(39%)が多く認められた。遮蔽を伴う上部マントル技術で治療された患者では、右室異常と弁肥厚が有意に少なかった。これらの所見に起因する症状は認められなかったが、より長期の追跡が必要とされた。
pmid-3981225.summary_en: Forty-one patients with Hodgkin's disease or seminoma in remission, at least five years after cardiac-field radiation, underwent echocardiography. Pericardial thickening (70%), right ventricular abnormalities (39%), and left ventricular dysfunction (39%) were common. Patients treated with an upper mantle technique with shielding had significantly fewer right ventricular abnormalities and valvular thickening. No symptoms were attributed to these findings, but longer follow-up was needed.

pmid-3981723.summary_ja: 原発性の両側同時性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の2例を報告し、文献を検討した。最も多い組織型はセミノーマで、両側ともセミノーマの組み合わせが最多だった。停留精巣の頻度は増加せず、初診時の病期は片側例と比べて悪くないと考えられた。高齢の傾向も指摘された。
pmid-3981723.summary_en: The authors describe two patients with primary bilateral synchronous testicular germ cell tumors and review the literature. Seminoma was the most common histology, and bilateral seminoma was the most frequent combination. Cryptorchidism incidence was not increased, and tumor stage at presentation appeared no worse than in unilateral disease. Patients tended to be older. This report adds two cases to the limited literature.

pmid-3983017.summary_ja: 小児の未熟奇形腫21例を病理・臨床的に検討した。発生部位は卵巣、仙尾部、精巣、縦隔が多かった。悪性度3の腫瘍は乳幼児の三胚葉性例と年長児の単胚葉性例に多く見られた。6例が死亡した。7歳以上の小児で卵巣発生例や悪性度3の症例では悪性を想定すべきと結論づけた。
pmid-3983017.summary_en: Twenty-one childhood immature teratomas, including two monodermal malignant teratomas, were reviewed. Sites included ovary, sacrococcygeal region, testis, and mediastinum. Immature neuroectodermal components were the main immature tissue. Grade 3 malignancy occurred mostly in young children with tridermal tumors and older children with monodermal tumors. Six patients died. When fully excised, early-childhood behavior resembled mature teratomas; malignancy should be assumed in older children with ovarian or grade 3 tumors.

pmid-3984523.summary_ja: 後縦隔奇形腫の4例目を報告し、前腸嚢胞との臨床的類似性と組織学的特徴について考察している。前腸重複症を模倣する本病変は診断が難しい点が主題である。本抄録は概要のみで、詳細な臨床経過や治療内容の記載はない。
pmid-3984523.summary_en: The authors describe a fourth reported example of posterior mediastinal teratoma, emphasizing that it can mimic foregut duplication. Clinical similarity to foregut cyst and the histologic features of these lesions are discussed. Because only the abstract is available, treatment details, follow-up, and patient age are not reported here, limiting assessment of outcomes.

pmid-3986457.summary_ja: 進行転移性悪性奇形腫19例の検討で、外科的生検に関連する重篤な合併症が5件あり、うち3件は死亡につながった。穿刺細胞診は信頼できる代替法と示唆された。化学療法後には手術による病期分類を省略できる可能性がある一方、陰性でも残存腫瘍を除外できない点が限界とされている。
pmid-3986457.summary_en: This 1985 review of 19 patients with advanced metastatic malignant teratomas reports five serious complications possibly related to surgical biopsy, three of which were fatal. A small series diagnosed by fine needle aspiration cytology suggested this approach is a reliable alternative. After chemotherapy, aspiration may spare patients with residual malignancy from post-treatment surgical staging. However, a negative aspirate cannot exclude malignancy, because residual tumour is focally distributed in these masses.

pmid-3987236.summary_ja: 頸部原発卵黄嚢腫瘍が脊椎に転移した初めての症例として報告された。CTで脊椎転移が描出され、部分的な閉塞を生じていた。性腺外に発生した胚細胞腫瘍の稀な例であり、CTによる脊椎病変の評価が示されている。治療経過は抄録に記載がない。
pmid-3987236.summary_en: This case report describes what the authors present as the first primary yolk sac tumor of the neck metastasizing to the spine. Computed tomography demonstrated the spinal metastasis, which caused a partial block. The report highlights an unusual extragonadal origin for this germ cell tumor and the value of CT in defining spinal involvement. The abstract is brief and does not describe the treatment given or the clinical outcome of the patient.

pmid-3987948.summary_ja: 帝王切開時に偶然発見された卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）2例を報告した。両例とも片側卵管卵巣摘出術が行われ、3年間再発はなかった。純粋型では早期診断と治療で予後が良好であり、選択された症例では妊孕性を温存できると結論づけている。
pmid-3987948.summary_en: Two cases of ovarian dysgerminoma were found incidentally during cesarean section, one an elective repeat operation and one performed for fetal distress. Both underwent unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and both patients remained free of recurrence for three years. One later delivered a healthy baby. The authors note that dysgerminoma's predominance in young women makes coexistence with pregnancy plausible. They conclude that early diagnosis and treatment of pure dysgerminoma give a good prognosis and that fertility can be preserved in selected cases.

pmid-3988122.summary_ja: 37歳未経産婦に生じた子宮原発未熟奇形腫（Norris分類Grade II）の初の症例報告である。子宮内膜腺癌の合併と、両卵巣・大網の成熟グリア組織による腹膜神経膠腫症を認めた。骨盤内放射線療法後に再発なく経過している。原発性子宮未熟奇形腫の初めての報告例と位置づけられている。
pmid-3988122.summary_en: A 37-year-old nulliparous woman presented with severe vaginal bleeding from a primary immature teratoma of the uterus, Grade II on the Norris scale. Hysterectomy also revealed well-differentiated endometrial adenocarcinoma, and mature glial implants on both ovaries and the omentum indicated gliomatosis peritonei. After an uneventful recovery she received one course of pelvic radiotherapy and has remained free of recurrence. The authors describe this as the first reported case of primary immature uterine teratoma.

pmid-3988140.summary_ja: 17歳女性に生じた硬化性間質性腫瘍と左卵巣の成熟奇形腫の併存、18か月後に対側卵巣に未熟奇形腫が出現した症例である。病期分類のための開腹術で卵巣外への微小な進展が確認された。成熟奇形腫と未熟奇形腫が対側卵巣に生じる例は少なく、奇形腫の性腺間質分化も確実ではないと述べられている。硬化性間質性腫瘍と他の卵巣腫瘍の併存は独特とされる。
pmid-3988140.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old with a large sclerosing stromal tumor and a smaller mature teratoma in the left ovary. Eighteen months later, an immature teratoma was found in the contralateral ovary, and staging laparotomy documented microscopic spread outside the ovary. The authors note that mature and immature teratomas in opposite ovaries have been reported only rarely, and that sclerosing stromal tumor has not previously been associated with other ovarian neoplasms. They conclude the combination is unique and that gonadal stromal differentiation has not been convincingly shown in teratomas.

pmid-3993670.summary_ja: 乳児型と成人型の精巣胎児性癌が家系内に生じた家族性症例を報告した。保因者と推定される母親は無がんであったが、祖母に悪性黒色腫と膀胱癌があった。遺伝症候群の特定はできず、このような家系での生体マーカー研究の重要性を論じている。
pmid-3993670.summary_en: This report describes a family with an unusual cancer spectrum in which an infant son had embryonal carcinoma of the testis, and his maternal half-brother developed the adult form. The mother, a putative obligate gene carrier, was cancer-free, while the grandmother had melanoma and bladder carcinoma. The authors could not define a hereditary syndrome. They argue that biomarker research in families like this is a priority for understanding cause and enabling control.

pmid-3994789.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株P10とP19をマウス胚盤胞と栄養外胚葉小胞に注入した基礎研究。P10は胚による増殖制御を受けたが、P19は受けなかった。栄養外胚葉だけでは制御を説明できず、キメラ発生の異常と関連した。
pmid-3994789.summary_en: This experimental study injected two embryonal carcinoma cell lines, P10 and P19, into mouse blastocysts and trophectoderm vesicles. P19 cells grew from 62 of 72 injected blastocysts, while P10 cells grew from only 7 of 73, showing that the embryo partly controls P10 proliferation. Both lines grew from trophectoderm vesicles, indicating the trophectoderm alone does not explain this control. Vesicles transferred to foster mothers did not develop normally, so the trophectoderm did not normalize the cells in vivo.

pmid-3994907.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者62例で、H17E2モノクローナル抗体によるPLAPを腫瘍マーカーとして評価した。活動性病変の15/16例で上昇し、寛解例の35%で偽陽性だった。喫煙者を除くと偽陽性は1例のみで、経時的測定は治療反応を反映した。
pmid-3994907.summary_en: This study tested placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) as a serum tumor marker for seminoma using the H17 E2 monoclonal antibody assay in 62 patients. Fifteen of 16 patients with active disease had elevated PLAP, while 16 of 46 patients in remission also had elevated levels, a 35% false-positive rate. Excluding smokers reduced false positives to one case. Sequential PLAP measurements reflected treatment response in all seven patients assessed.

pmid-3994908.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者148例の血清257検体でPLAPを測定した。活動性セミノーマでは高値、寛解では低値で、経時的変化は病勢と相関した。寛解中の�喫煙者は非喫煙者より高値だった。治療反応のモニタリングに有用と結論づけた。
pmid-3994908.summary_en: This study measured serum placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) with the H17E2 monoclonal antibody immunoassay in 257 samples from 148 patients with testicular germ cell neoplasms. PLAP was high in active seminoma and low in remission, and changing levels tracked disease course in 33 patients with seminoma. Smokers in remission had higher PLAP than nonsmokers. The authors conclude that PLAP measurement is an important adjunct for monitoring treatment response in seminoma.

pmid-3995602.summary_ja: 奇形癌幹細胞PCC3/A/1を無血清培地とフィーダー層で培養し、軟骨細胞と脂肪細胞へ分化させた基礎研究。分化は2段階で進み、線維芽様細胞が軟骨・脂肪への分化に重要な役割を果たすと示唆された。
pmid-3995602.summary_en: This study established clonal culture of PCC3/A/1 teratocarcinoma stem cells in serum-free medium on feeder layers. The stem cells differentiated into many somatic cell types, predominantly chondrocytes and adipocytes, with rare myotubes and neuron-like cells. Differentiation occurred in two stages, with fibroblastic cells appearing first and chondrocytes and adipocytes predominating later. The authors suggest fibroblastic cells play a key role in chondro-adipocyte differentiation, making this a useful model for studying cell lineage.

pmid-3997794.summary_ja: 本研究は、F9胎児性癌細胞および奇形癌OTT6050由来の糖タンパク質結合大型糖鎖（胚糖鎖）を解析したものです。レクチン結合およびアフィニティクロマトグラフィーにより、N-アセチルガラクトサミンやガラクトースを認識する複数のレクチンに対する受容体が糖鎖上に存在することを示しました。GS-IおよびSJAの受容体を持つ高分子糖タンパク質も単離されました。
pmid-3997794.summary_en: This study examined glycoprotein-bound large carbohydrates (embryoglycan) from F9 embryonal carcinoma cells and teratocarcinoma OTT6050 cells. Using lectin binding and affinity chromatography, the authors showed that these glycans carry receptors for multiple lectins recognizing N-acetylgalactosamine and galactose, including HPA, SBA, SJA, RCA-1, GS-I, DBA and PNA. Intact glycoproteins with GS-I and SJA receptors were isolated and shown to be high-molecular-weight glycoproteins similar to DBA receptors.

pmid-3997842.summary_ja: ヒトPA1胎児性癌細胞から、ラクトサミノグリカンを単離し、その構造を解析しました。分子量の異なる3つの画分に分かれ、それぞれ分岐構造やラクトサミン単位数が異なることがわかりました。長い側鎖末端には、新規のジシアロシル構造（シアル酸α2-9シアル酸）が見出されました。これらの糖鎖は、分子量8万～12万の細胞表面糖タンパク質に担われています。
pmid-3997842.summary_en: Lactosaminoglycans were isolated from human PA1 embryonal carcinoma cells and structurally characterized using endo-beta-galactosidase digestion, methylation analysis, mass spectrometry and HPLC. Three molecular-weight fractions were found, differing in antennary structure and lactosaminyl unit number. A novel disialosyl terminal structure, NeuNAc alpha2-9NeuNAc, was identified at the ends of longer polylactosaminyl side chains. These glycans are carried on cell-surface glycoproteins of 80 to 120 kDa.

pmid-3998550.summary_ja: 妊娠から発症までの潜伏期間が2年を超えた妊娠性絨毛癌8例を検討し、2年以内の98例と比較しました。長期潜伏例の8例中7例は先行妊娠が胞状奇胎でした。潜伏期間が長くなるほど胞状奇胎の割合が増加する傾向がみられました。組織学的には、長期潜伏例の多くがP型またはV型に分類され、悪性度が高い傾向が認められました。
pmid-3998550.summary_en: This study analyzed eight gestational choriocarcinoma cases with a latent period exceeding two years between antecedent pregnancy and disease onset, comparing them with 98 cases with shorter latency. Seven of the eight long-latency cases followed a hydatidiform mole, and the proportion of mole antecedents rose as latency lengthened. Histologically, most long-latency cases were P or V type under the authors' CPV classification, indicating higher malignancy compared with shorter-latency cases.

pmid-3999073.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、2つの嚢胞性奇形腫を有した1症例を報告したものです。1つは左卵巣に発生し、もう1つは寄生性で右上腹部の大網に付着していました。タイトルでは両病変とも良性奇形腫とされています。抄録が短いため、治療や経過の詳細は不明です。卵巣と大網に奇形腫が併存する稀な例として、本症例は意義があります。
pmid-3999073.summary_en: This case report describes a single patient with two cystic teratomas. One involved the left ovary, while the other was parasitic and attached to the omentum in the right upper quadrant of the abdomen. The title identifies both lesions as benign. Because the abstract is brief, further details on management, pathology, or follow-up are not available in the source text. The report is relevant as an uncommon example of coexistent ovarian and omental teratomas.

pmid-4005788.summary_ja: 小児の卵黄嚢腫瘍8例で血清LDHアイソザイム-1（LDH-1）を測定しました。早期の1例を除く7例でLDH-1の上昇が認められました。治療中の連続測定と腫瘍組織のアイソザイムパターンから、上昇は腫瘍由来と考えられました。LDH-1は卵黄嚢腫瘍に特異的ではないものの、胚細胞腫瘍全体に関連し、経過観察に有用な腫瘍マーカーとされています。
pmid-4005788.summary_en: This study measured serum lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme-1 (LDH-1) in eight children with yolk sac tumor, a common childhood germ cell tumor. Seven of the eight patients, excluding one early-stage case, showed elevated LDH-1. Serial measurements during treatment and tumor tissue isoenzyme patterns suggested the increase derived from tumor tissue. The authors conclude that LDH-1 is useful for monitoring YST, although it is not specific to this tumor and is associated with the whole GCT spectrum.

pmid-4007176.summary_ja: 男性2例が左鎖骨上窩の腫瘤を主訴に受診した。精査を尽くしたが他部位に病変は認められなかった。生検では1例がセミノーマ、もう1例が奇形腫と診断された。精密検査後に孤立性の鎖骨上窩胚細胞腫瘍として報告された例はこれまでなく、胚細胞腫瘍が稀な部位に出現しうることを示している。
pmid-4007176.summary_en: Two male patients presented with a left supraclavicular mass, with no evidence of disease at other sites despite intensive investigations. Biopsy showed seminoma in one case and teratoma in the other. The authors report that a supraclavicular germ cell tumour occurring as an isolated finding after comprehensive evaluation had not previously been described, highlighting that extragonadal germ cell tumours can present in unusual locations.

pmid-4012467.summary_ja: 16歳の未経妊女性に発症した卵巣未熟奇形腫の稀な合併症、腹膜神経膠腫症の症例報告。転移性卵巣癌との鑑別が重要である。神経膠腫性病変の組織学的悪性度（グレード）に応じて治療方針が決まり、グレード0以外は補助化学療法の適応となる。繰り返す開腹手術による腫瘍摘出と13コースの併用化学療法により、治癒したとみられた。
pmid-4012467.summary_en: A 16-year-old woman presented with gliomatosis peritonei, a rare complication of ovarian immature teratoma that can mimic metastatic ovarian carcinoma. Treatment depended on histologic grading of the gliomatous lesions, and all grades except grade 0 warranted adjuvant chemotherapy. Repeated laparotomies for tumour removal and cytological sampling were required. After five laparotomies and 13 courses of combination chemotherapy, she was apparently cured.

pmid-4012910.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍9検体について、エストロゲン、プロゲスチン、アンドロゲン、グルココルチコイドの細胞質受容体を測定した。ほとんどの腫瘍で性ホルモン受容体は陽性とならず、9検体中8検体でグルココルチコイド受容体が検出された。性ホルモンが精巣腫瘍の自然経過に大きく関与する可能性は低く、グルココルチコイドを介したホルモン療法の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-4012910.summary_en: Nine testicular tumours were assayed for cytoplasmic receptors for oestrogens, progestins, androgens and glucocorticoids. Using a 10 fmol/mg threshold, only one tumour was oestrogen-receptor positive and one was progesterone-receptor positive, and no androgen receptors were detected. Eight of nine contained glucocorticoid receptors sedimenting at 8S. The authors conclude that sex steroids are unlikely to drive testicular tumour behaviour, though glucocorticoid receptors may offer a route for endocrine manipulation.

pmid-4012952.summary_ja: 不妊男性の両側精巣生検で、異型胚細胞を伴う異常な精細管上皮が認められ、精巣上皮内癌と診断された。既報の2例では生検後約4年半で胎児性癌が発症していた。本例では右精巣摘除術と左精索静脈瘤手術が行われた。異常細胞と正常精子形成が共存する点が特徴である。
pmid-4012952.summary_en: A man with infertility underwent bilateral testicular biopsy showing abnormal seminiferous epithelium with atypical germ cells, consistent with carcinoma in situ. Embryonal carcinoma had developed in two previously reported patients within about four and a half years of biopsy. This case showed enlarged germ cells with dense chromatin, and normal spermatogenesis in other tubules. He underwent right orchiectomy and left varicocelectomy, highlighting the need for surveillance.

pmid-4012973.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫の男性が、片側精巣摘除後、化学療法で無精子症となる前に精液を凍結保存した。解凍後の運動率が著しく低下したため人工授精は繰り返し失敗した。体外受精を用いて胚を得て移植したところ、初回は自然流産したが、その後の治療で双胎妊娠が継続した。精巣腫瘍患者の凍結精液の質低下を体外受精で克服しうることを示す。
pmid-4012973.summary_en: A man with testicular teratoma had semen cryopreserved after unilateral orchidectomy but before chemotherapy rendered him azoospermic. Artificial insemination failed repeatedly due to poor post-thaw motility. Using in vitro fertilization with the stored semen, embryos were produced; a pregnancy aborted spontaneously after transfer, and a later treatment cycle resulted in an ongoing twin pregnancy. The report highlights IVF as a means of overcoming post-cryopreservation semen quality loss in men with testicular neoplasms.

pmid-4012976.summary_ja: 悪性精巣腫瘍の術後血管造影を、セミノーマ4例と非セミノーマ12例で比較した。セミノーマは低血管性で境界明瞭、新生血管はみられなかった。非セミノーマは等血管性または低血管性であったが、局所的な過血管・新生血管領域を有し、これは細胞動態研究における高増殖部位に一致した。これらの領域は化学療法薬の効率的な利用に寄与する可能性がある。
pmid-4012976.summary_en: Postoperative angiographies of malignant testicular tumours were compared between 4 seminomas and 12 nonseminomas. Seminomas were hypovascular, well-defined and not neovascular. Nonseminomas showed isovascularity or hypovascularity but contained focal hypervascular, neovascular areas, which corresponded to high-growth centres in cell kinetic studies. The authors suggest that these growth centres may favour efficient delivery of chemotherapeutic agents, potentially in metastases as well.

pmid-4012986.summary_ja: 13歳女児が強い排尿困難と急性尿閉で受診した。骨盤内診で膀胱後部の腫瘍が認められ、両側の水尿管・水腎症を伴っていた。手術で右卵巣腫瘤が左尿管と膀胱頸部を圧迫していることが判明し、重量815gの腫瘍を切除した。病理診断は卵巣未分化胚細胞腫。術後は排尿が正常化し、2年半の経過は順調であった。
pmid-4012986.summary_en: A 13-year-old girl presented with severe urinary hesitancy and acute urinary retention. Pelvic examination revealed a retrovesical tumour, and imaging showed bilateral hydroureteronephrosis. Surgical exploration found a right ovarian mass compressing the left ureter and bladder neck. Excision was performed, and the 815 g tumour was diagnosed as dysgerminoma. Voiding normalised after surgery, and the patient had an uneventful course over 2.5 years of follow-up.

pmid-4013949.summary_ja: 1970～1979年に日本の14施設で治療された精巣腫瘍511例の統計解析。年齢分布、セミノーマと非セミノーマの割合、病期別の5年生存率を検討。セミノーマは病期Iで100%、非セミノーマは93%。発熱や腹部腫瘤の触知は予後不良因子とされた。小児例では生存率が高かった。
pmid-4013949.summary_en: This Japanese multicenter analysis covers 511 testicular tumor cases treated at 14 facilities between 1970 and 1979. It describes age distribution with peaks under 3 years and at 25 to 34 years, the seminoma and non-seminoma proportions by age and stage, and histologic subtypes. Five-year survival was 96% in patients under 9 years and 70% in those over 15. By stage, seminoma survival was 100%, 65%, and 0% for stages I to III. Fever and palpable abdominal masses were associated with markedly lower survival. The study provides a historical benchmark for testicular germ cell tumor epidemiology and outcomes in Japan.

pmid-4015378.summary_ja: フロリダ大学の7例の報告。先天性肛門直腸奇形の乳児に仙尾部奇形腫が合併していたことを示す。両疾患の発生頻度から偶然の合併とは考えにくい。直腸狭窄のため仙骨前腫瘍の診断が遅れた。奇形腫は年齢とともに悪性化する頻度が上がるため、早期診断と切除が重要とされる。肛門直腸奇形の乳児では本症を疑うべきと結論している。
pmid-4015378.summary_en: This University of Florida series describes seven infants with congenital anorectal malformations who were also found to have sacrococcygeal teratomas. The authors judge the co-occurrence too frequent to be random, given the respective incidences of the two conditions. Anorectal strictures delayed diagnosis of the presacral tumors. Because malignant change in sacrococcygeal teratomas increases with age, the authors emphasize early diagnosis and excision. They recommend heightened suspicion for sacrococcygeal teratoma in any infant born with an anorectal malformation.

pmid-4016716.summary_ja: セミノーマ3例の染色体を直接標本と短期培養で解析した研究。全例で1番と12番染色体に構造異常を認めた。2例では7番染色体の過剰（7p）が加わり、1例は15番由来の二動原体染色体を有し予後不良であった。全例にXXY性染色体がみられた。特定の核型異常と腫瘍の生物学的特徴・予後との関連を示唆する初期の遺伝学的知見である。
pmid-4016716.summary_en: This cytogenetic study examined three seminomas using direct preparations and short-term cultures. All three showed structural changes in chromosomes 1 and 12, including 1q duplication, 1p loss, and a short-arm isochromosome of 12. Two tumors also involved chromosome 7 with extra 7p copies, and one showed a dicentric chromosome derived from two chromosome 15s, which was associated with an unfavorable prognosis. All tumors had XXY sex chromosomes. The findings link specific karyotypic abnormalities to seminoma biology and outcome, providing early genetic insight into testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-4018662.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍74例で血清LDHとアイソザイムを評価し、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫5例では術前LDHが全例で著明に上昇していた。良性の充実性腫瘍は正常であった。未分化胚細胞腫では速い泳動の2分画が高値を示し、他の悪性卵巣腫瘍では遅い分画が上昇していた。症例数が少ない点に留意が必要である。
pmid-4018662.summary_en: This 1985 gynecologic oncology study evaluated serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) and its isoenzymes as tumor markers in 74 patients with ovarian tumors, including five with dysgerminoma. All dysgerminoma patients had markedly elevated preoperative LDH, while all benign solid tumors were normal. Common epithelial adenocarcinomas showed elevated LDH in about 40 percent of cases. Dysgerminomas had high levels of the two fast isoenzyme fractions, whereas other malignant ovarian tumors had elevated slow fractions. The authors conclude that LDH and isoenzyme electrophoresis may be valuable in ovarian dysgerminoma, though five cases is a small sample.

pmid-4019486.summary_ja: 胎児性癌(EC)細胞株におけるレチノイドの代謝を検討した基礎研究。レチノールは酸性レチノイドへ変換されず、レチノイン酸は24時間以内にほぼ完全に代謝された。分化欠陥株では代謝が不良であった。レチノールがレチノイン酸を介してEC細胞の分化を誘導するという仮説は否定的である。
pmid-4019486.summary_en: This study examined how embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines metabolize retinol, retinyl acetate, and all-trans-retinoic acid in culture. EC cells did not convert retinol to acidic retinoids, and retinyl acetate did not yield retinoic acid. In contrast, retinoic acid at micromolar levels was almost completely modified within 24 hours, with products mostly secreted into the medium. Some lines metabolized it constitutively while others had inducible enzymes. A differentiation-defective line metabolized it poorly. The authors conclude that retinol does not induce EC differentiation through retinoic acid conversion in vitro.

pmid-4019565.summary_ja: セミノーマの気管・気管支内転移により急性呼吸不全を来した症例報告。右上葉・中葉の虚脱があり、気管支鏡で原因を診断した。放射線療法により無気肺は著明に改善した。転移性セミノーマが急性の気道閉塞として発症しうること、および放射線療法が速やかな改善をもたらしうることを示している。
pmid-4019565.summary_en: This report describes a patient with tracheal and endobronchial metastases from seminoma who presented with acute respiratory failure. Right upper and middle lobe collapse was found, and fiberoptic bronchoscopy identified the endobronchial lesion as the cause of the atelectasis. Radiation therapy produced a marked reversal of the collapse. The case highlights that metastatic seminoma can present as acute airway obstruction, and that radiotherapy can rapidly relieve the resulting lobar atelectasis. Bronchoscopy was key to establishing the etiology.

pmid-4022488.summary_ja: 一卵性双生児がともに右卵巣に成熟奇形腫を発症し、いずれも急性捻転で発症した。手術と病理組織学的検査で診断された。家族内発生から遺伝的素因の関与が示唆される。また、腫瘍の起源は第一減数分裂後の胚細胞による単為生殖と関連するとの考えが提示されている。
pmid-4022488.summary_en: This report describes identical twins who each developed a right ovarian mature teratoma, both presenting with acute torsion. The diagnosis was confirmed at laparotomy and histopathology. The authors suggest that genetic predisposition may contribute to ovarian teratoma development, since familial occurrence supports this view. They propose that the origin of these tumors is linked to parthenogenesis involving a germ cell after its first meiotic division. The report is brief but relevant to understanding the pathogenesis of mature ovarian teratomas.

pmid-4024417.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの後腹膜リンパ節評価において、腹部骨盤CTとリンパ管造影を比較した。両検査を受けた34例中21例で結果が一致した。リンパ管造影陽性・CT陰性は11例、CT陽性・リンパ管造影陰性は2例であった。精巣セミノーマ患者には腹部骨盤CTを行い、陰性の場合はリンパ管造影を行うことが推奨されている。
pmid-4024417.summary_en: This study compared abdominal pelvic CT and bipedal lymphangiography for evaluating retroperitoneal lymph nodes in testicular seminoma. Among 34 patients who had both tests, results agreed in 21. Eleven patients had positive lymphangiography but negative CT, while only two had positive CT with negative lymphangiography. The authors recommend routine abdominal pelvic CT in testicular seminoma patients. Lymphangiography should be performed if the CT findings are negative. The findings support a combined imaging approach for accurate staging.

pmid-4025086.summary_ja: 1歳7か月の男児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍(病期I)の症例報告。初回は精巣摘除術のみを行った。13か月後に大きな後腹膜転移腫瘍が見つかった。腫瘍切除と複数の化学療法の後、AFPは正常化し、3年以上完全寛解を維持している。病期I乳児精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍では、高位精巣摘除術後の経過観察が最善と結論づけている。
pmid-4025086.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 1-year-7-month-old boy with stage I yolk sac tumor of the testis. He initially underwent high orchiectomy alone. Thirteen months later, a bulky retroperitoneal metastatic tumor was found. After tumor resection and two courses of combination chemotherapy with CDDP, ACD, VBL, PLM, and CTX, elevated serum AFP normalized. He remained in complete remission for over three years. The authors conclude that watchful waiting after high orchiectomy alone is the best approach for stage I infantile testicular yolk sac tumor.

pmid-4027160.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍のアーカイブ組織を、c-myc遺伝子産物に対するモノクローナル抗体で検討した。正常精巣ではp62c-mycの発現はわずかであった。セミノーマでは核および細胞質の染色が増強していた。未分化奇形腫では活性は低く、分化上皮構造や卵黄嚢、胚様体では豊富に発現した。後に病死した5例の腫瘍ではわずかな発現にとどまった。
pmid-4027160.summary_en: This study used a monoclonal antibody against the c-myc oncogene product to examine archival testicular tumor tissue. Normal testes showed little p62c-myc expression. Seminomas displayed increased nuclear and cytoplasmic staining. Undifferentiated teratoma had low activity, whereas differentiating epithelial structures, yolk sacs, and embryoid bodies showed abundant expression. Tumors from five patients who later died of disease had only small amounts of p62c-myc. The findings suggest that p62c-myc expression varies with histologic differentiation in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-4027793.summary_ja: 本研究は、組織学的に確認された良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の患者118例を6年間にわたり後方視的に検討したものである。患者の85.6%は40歳未満であった。再発は3.4%にのみ確認された。骨盤X線で石灰化が64.1%に認められたが、骨盤超音波検査では19.4%で診断に至らなかった。多くの患者はPfannenstiel切開で卵巣摘出術を受けた。
pmid-4027793.summary_en: This six-year single-center review of 118 women with histologically confirmed benign cystic ovarian teratoma examined age distribution, symptoms, diagnostic imaging, and surgical management. Most patients were under 40. Recurrence was documented in only 3.4%, and pelvic radiography detected calcification in 64.1%. Pelvic ultrasonography missed the diagnosis in 19.4%. Most patients underwent oophorectomy via Pfannenstiel incision.

pmid-4027957.summary_ja: 精巣がん20例の原発巣をDNAフローサイトメトリーで解析し、19例で異数性の腫瘍幹細胞系が認められた。セミノーマと非セミノーマで倍数性に有意差はなかった。S期の割合は22～51%で、精巣がんが増殖の速い腫瘍であることを支持する。転移性成熟奇形腫では6%であった。異数性は診断に有用となる可能性があると述べている。
pmid-4027957.summary_en: DNA flow cytometry of 20 primary testicular cancers found aneuploid tumor stemlines in 19 cases, with no significant ploidy difference between seminomas and nonseminomas. In analyzable histograms, the S-phase fraction ranged from 22% to 51%, supporting rapid growth. A metastatic mature teratoma showed 6% of cells in S phase. The authors suggest that aneuploidy may be clinically useful for diagnosis.

pmid-4028163.summary_ja: Tera 1膜画分に対する3種のモノクローナル抗体は、未分化な胎児性癌細胞株（Tera 2クローン13など）に発現する腫瘍胎児性抗原を認識した。これらの抗原は正常成人組織には存在しない。抗原75.12は胎児性癌の分化マーカーであるが、一部の成人組織にも発現する。SSEA-1や75.12の発現にフコシルトランスフェラーゼは関与しなかった。
pmid-4028163.summary_en: Three monoclonal antibodies raised against Tera 1 membrane fractions recognized distinct onco-fetal antigens expressed on undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma cell lines such as Tera 2 clone 13 and on cystic structures resembling fetal intestine. These antigens were absent from normal adult tissues. Antigen 75.12 is an EC differentiation marker but is also expressed in some adult tissues. Fucosyltransferases were not implicated in regulating SSEA-1 or 75.12 expression on EC cells.

pmid-4031736.summary_ja: 自然発生したマウス卵巣奇形癌由来の腫瘍幹細胞をクローニングして解析した。腹水中では大部分が未分化で、5～15%が栄養膜細胞や卵黄嚢細胞へ分化した。固形腫瘍では栄養膜、壁側・臓側卵黄嚢の要素が混在していた。著者らはこの腫瘍を栄養外胚葉癌と命名した。
pmid-4031736.summary_en: Tumor stem cells from a spontaneous murine ovarian teratocarcinoma were cloned and characterized. In ascites, the tumor consisted mainly of undifferentiated stem cells, with 5% to 15% differentiating into trophoblastic and yolk sac elements. Solid tumors showed variegated trophoblastic, parietal, and visceral yolk sac differentiation. The authors designated the tumor trophectodermal carcinoma and proposed it as a malignant equivalent of the common trophoblast-yolk sac precursor.

pmid-4032867.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群(47,XXY)の患者で、前縦隔に腫瘤を認めた。女性化乳房、萎縮精巣、hCG高値から悪性胚細胞腫瘍が疑われたが、正中開胸術で胸腺右葉由来の良性奇形腫と判明した。術後経過は良好で、2年間のフォローアップでも問題はなかった。性腺機能異常を伴う場合、縦隔奇形腫が悪性胚細胞腫瘍と類似しうることを示す症例報告である。
pmid-4032867.summary_en: A patient with Klinefelter syndrome (47,XXY) presented with an anterior mediastinal mass, initially suspected to be a malignant germ cell tumor because of gynecomastia, atrophic testis, and elevated hCG. Median sternotomy revealed a benign teratoma originating from the right thymic lobe. Chromosomal analysis confirmed 47,XXY. The postoperative course and two-year follow-up were uneventful. The report highlights that mediastinal teratomas can mimic malignant germ cell tumors when hormonal abnormalities are present, so histopathology is essential for accurate diagnosis.

pmid-4033887.summary_ja: 腰仙部奇形腫の内部に脊髄髄膜瘤が完全に包含された、極めてまれな症例の報告である。臨床像、画像所見、手術治療、組織学的特徴を提示している。神経組織が奇形腫性の腫瘤に包まれているため、術前の構成成分の鑑別や切除計画は困難である。腰仙部の先天性奇形腫と神経管欠損の関連を示す症例として意義がある。
pmid-4033887.summary_en: This case report describes a myelomeningocele completely embedded within a lumbosacral teratoma, an extremely rare finding. The authors report the clinical presentation, radiological appearance, surgical management, and histological features of the lesion. Because neural tissue is enclosed within a teratomatous mass, preoperative differentiation of its components and planning of surgical resection are challenging. The report adds to the limited literature on congenital lumbosacral teratomas and their association with neural tube defects.

pmid-4034530.summary_ja: 奇形癌細胞(402AX)をマウス胎仔の支持細胞層上で培養し、in vitroでの観察とsyngeneic宿主への移植を行った。共培養により腫瘍細胞の遊走が24時間で促進された。胎仔由来基質とともに移植すると、肉眼で確認可能なリンパ節転移が生じた。胎仔組織由来の可溶性因子が増殖と遊走を促し、宿主由来因子が浸潤・転移を刺激しうることを示唆する。
pmid-4034530.summary_en: Teratocarcinoma cells (402AX) were cultured on mouse embryonic feeder layers and then examined in vitro or transplanted into syngeneic hosts. Coculture accelerated tumor cell migration within 24 hours. Transplantation with embryonic substrates produced grossly detectable lymph node metastases. The authors propose that soluble factors from embryonic tissue enhance tumor proliferation and migration, suggesting that host-derived factors may stimulate tumor invasion and metastasis. The study models the metastatic behavior of germ cell-derived teratocarcinoma.

pmid-4035002.summary_ja: 病期II精巣セミノーマの患者73例を後方視的に解析し、予後因子と予防的縦隔照射・化学療法の有用性を検討した。IIa、IIb、IIc間で生存率に差はみられたが有意ではなかった。hCG産生セミノーマは16%であったが、生存率と再発率に差はなかった。予防的縦隔照射は生存・再発に影響せず、照射前化学療法も有意な改善は認められなかった。
pmid-4035002.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 73 patients with stage II testicular seminoma examined prognostic factors and the value of prophylactic mediastinal irradiation and chemotherapy. Survival differed among IIa, IIb, and IIc subgroups, but not significantly. Tumor size above or below 10 cm did not significantly affect outcomes in IIc. HCG-producing seminomas comprised 16% of cases but showed no difference in survival or relapse. Prophylactic mediastinal irradiation did not influence survival or relapse, and pre-irradiation chemotherapy showed no significant benefit, though the sample was small.

pmid-4035518.summary_ja: 23歳女性の帝王切開時に発見された、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の非定型的な形態変異の症例報告である。病変は薄い壁をもち透明な液体を含む嚢胞として認められた。組織学的には上衣細胞に覆われ、グリア組織からなる壁に扁平上皮、脂肪組織、骨を含む小隆起があった。卵巣奇形腫が他の嚢胞性病変と類似しうることを示す。
pmid-4035518.summary_en: This case report describes an unusual morphological variant of mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, discovered during cesarean section in a 23-year-old woman. The lesion appeared as a thin-walled cyst containing clear fluid. Microscopically, the cyst was lined by ependyma, with a glial wall and a small protuberance containing squamous epithelium, adipose tissue, and bone. The case shows that ovarian teratomas can have atypical features, such as ependymal lining, that may mimic other cystic lesions.

pmid-4035845.summary_ja: 未分化セミノーマと縦隔サルコイドーシスが同時に認められた、極めてまれな症例報告である。両疾患が同時に現れることは非常にまれである。著者らは、根治的治療の開始前に丁寧な病期分類が必要であると強調している。精巣胚細胞腫瘍で縦隔異常を伴う患者では、正確な組織診断と十分な画像評価が重要であることを示している。
pmid-4035845.summary_en: This case report describes the concurrent presentation of anaplastic seminoma and mediastinal sarcoidosis, an exceedingly rare synchronous occurrence of both conditions. The authors stress that meticulous staging is required before definitive therapy given this unusual combination. The report highlights the importance of accurate histological diagnosis and thorough imaging evaluation in patients with testicular germ cell tumors who present with mediastinal abnormalities.

pmid-4036599.summary_ja: 精巣・卵巣・縦隔・頭蓋内のジャーミノーマ24例を電子顕微鏡で検討した研究である。17例に核内膜様構造が認められ、セミノーマでは非セミノーマ性より高頻度であった。これらの構造は核ポケットの変異型と考えられ、精原細胞にも類似構造がみられた。
pmid-4036599.summary_en: This electron microscopy study examined 24 germinomas, including seminomas, dysgerminomas, a mediastinal germinoma and intracranial germinomas. Intranuclear membranous profiles were found in 17 tumors, more often in seminomas (11 of 12) than non-seminomatous germinomas (6 of 12). Their morphology suggested they are variants of nuclear pockets and intranuclear annulate lamellae connected to nuclear envelope clefts. Similar structures were seen in spermatogonia of adolescents and adults, so the authors propose they may be continuations of spermatogonial features.

pmid-4036603.summary_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた青色母斑様の色素細胞2例を超微細構造で検討した報告である。色素細胞はメラノサイトではなく、メラニン合成能を持つSchwann細胞の特徴を示した。青色母斑の神経起源を支持する所見であり、症例数は少ないが奇形腫内の色素成分の由来を考える上で示唆に富む。
pmid-4036603.summary_en: This ultrastructural study examined two cases of blue nevus-like pigmented cells arising within ovarian benign cystic teratomas. The bipolar or dendritic pigmented cells showed features of Schwann cells that synthesized melanin, rather than ordinary melanocytes. The findings support a neural origin for blue nevus in this setting. The study is brief, with only two cases, but it suggests that the pigmented component of ovarian mature teratoma may derive from neural rather than melanocytic lineage.

pmid-4037010.summary_ja: 絨毛癌関連の絨毛性疾患の治療から5年後に生じた骨盤動静脈瘻の症例報告である。手術を行わず内腸骨動脈塞栓術で瘻を閉塞させた。その1年後に妊娠し、健康な児が出生した。血管造影による治療のみで分娩に至った初めての報告であり、妊孕性を保ちたい患者にとって非手術的な選択肢となりうる。報告者らはこの手法の有用性を示した。
pmid-4037010.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with a pelvic arteriovenous fistula that developed after treatment of choriocarcinoma-related trophoblastic disease five years earlier. Instead of surgery, the fistula was occluded by hypogastric artery embolization. Pregnancy occurred one year later, and a healthy infant was delivered. The authors state this is the first reported delivery achieved after angiographic management alone, suggesting that embolization can be an effective nonsurgical option for women who wish to conceive.

pmid-4037200.summary_ja: 1941年から1983年に治療された仙尾部奇形腫の小児66例を後方視的に検討した研究である。女児が多く、半数は新生児であった。若年ほど予後が良好で、悪性例の予後は極めて不良であった。成熟組織または非悪性の胎児性組織を含む腫瘍は予後良好であった。本シリーズでは悪性例19例中、生存は1例のみであった。
pmid-4037200.summary_en: This retrospective series reviewed 66 infants and children with sacrococcygeal teratoma treated from 1941 to 1983. Females predominated, and about half were neonates. Nearly half were benign, while 29% had frankly malignant tumors and 23% contained only embryonic tissue. Younger patients had significantly better outcomes, and tumors with mature or embryonic (non-malignant) elements had a good prognosis. Malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma carried a bleak prognosis, with only one of 19 patients surviving.

pmid-4038215.summary_ja: オーストラリアの小児仙尾部奇形腫8例の症例集積報告である。7例は出生時に診断され、1例は生後3か月半で尿閉を契機に発見された。全例で尾骨を含めて速やかに摘出され、再発例はなかった。合併奇形や家族歴を有する症例も含まれていた。小規模シリーズながら、尾骨を含む完全摘出の重要性が示唆される。
pmid-4038215.summary_en: This Australian case series describes eight infants and children with sacrococcygeal teratoma. Seven were diagnosed at birth, and one presented at 3.5 months with urinary retention. Two had associated congenital anomalies, and one had a family history of the tumor. In all cases, the tumor was removed together with the coccyx soon after diagnosis. None of the patients had recurrence, indicating that complete primary excision including the coccyx was effective in this small series.

pmid-4038447.summary_ja: 初回治療から7年半後に多発肺転移で再発した卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の1例である。シスプラチン、アドリアマイシン、シクロホスファミドによる併用化学療法3コースで完全寛解が得られた。本腫瘍は抗がん薬に高感受性であり、進行例や再発例の一部で同レジメンを検討する価値があると論じている。
pmid-4038447.summary_en: This report describes a patient with ovarian dysgerminoma who relapsed with multiple pulmonary metastases 7.5 years after initial therapy. Complete remission was achieved after three courses of combined chemotherapy with cisplatin, adriamycin and cyclophosphamide. The authors discuss diagnostic, therapeutic and drug-administration issues, noting that this tumor type is highly sensitive to cytotoxic agents. They suggest this regimen is worth considering in selected advanced or recurrent cases.

pmid-4038467.summary_ja: 子宮絨毛癌の悪性度を評価するための新たな組織学的基準を提案した研究である。70例の組織所見を予後との関連で解析し、4項目を選択して得点化した。低悪性度群の死亡率は7%、高悪性度群は69%であった。予後評価に用いうる実用的な方法として提案されている。
pmid-4038467.summary_en: This study proposes new histopathologic criteria for grading malignancy in uterine choriocarcinoma. Seventy patients were evaluated, and 13 histologic features were examined for prognostic relevance. Four were selected: island formation, massive proliferation of intermediate-type trophoblasts, rectangular infiltration into myometrium, and atypia at the invasive front. A scoring system based on these items separated low-grade tumors (mortality 7%) from high-grade tumors (mortality 69%), offering a practical prognostic tool.

pmid-4038722.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoを対象に、抗代謝薬MTXと温熱療法の併用効果を検討した研究である。MTX除去後5時間以内に加温した場合に増殖抑制とhCG産生抑制が最も強かった。この時期は細胞がS期に同調している時期に一致した。抗代謝薬によるS期同調は、絨毛癌に対する温熱療法の効果を高める上で重要と結論づけている。
pmid-4038722.summary_en: This study examined how methotrexate (MTX), an antimetabolite, affects the heat sensitivity of the choriocarcinoma cell line BeWo. Cells were treated with MTX, then heated to 43°C at various times after drug removal. Growth and hCG production were most affected when heat was applied within five hours of MTX removal, when the labeling index was highest. Heat sensitivity declined as cells left S phase. The authors conclude that synchronizing choriocarcinoma cells in S phase with antimetabolites is important for hyperthermia.

pmid-4038869.summary_ja: 絨毛癌および悪性奇胎の女性806例に対し、間欠的大量化学療法(主に5-FU)を行った。化学療法抵抗性の肺転移を有する43例が1962〜1982年に肺切除を受け、5年生存率は50%であった。単発病変で他臓器転移がない例や、化学療法後に被包化・壊死した例で成績が良かった。
pmid-4038869.summary_en: This study reviewed 806 women with choriocarcinoma and malignant mole treated with intermittent intensive 5-fluorouracil-based chemotherapy. Among them, 43 patients with pulmonary metastases resistant to chemotherapy underwent lung resection between 1962 and 1982. Surgery caused no postoperative deaths, and 5-year survival was 50%. Better outcomes were seen in patients with a solitary lung lesion and no other major organ metastases, and in those whose lesions were encapsulated and necrotic after chemotherapy. Serum and urine hCG levels and radiographic changes guided candidate selection.

pmid-4038913.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、病期IIIまたは巨大な病期IIの後腹膜転移を有する66例を対象に、併用化学療法と外科治療の効果を評価した。化学療法単独で38%の患者が完全寛解に至り、化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清の追加により、進行転移を有する患者の完全奏効率は24%から67%に上昇した。最小限の転移を有する患者は通常、化学療法単独で反応した。転移病巣の大きさは原発腫瘍の組織型よりも予後的に重要であった。最小限の病変に対する定期的な郭清は不要とされた。
pmid-4038913.summary_en: This study evaluated combination chemotherapy and surgery for retroperitoneal metastases in 66 patients with Stage III or bulky Stage II nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Chemotherapy alone achieved complete remission in 38% of patients, and adding postchemotherapy RPLND raised complete response from 24% to 67% in patients with advanced metastases. Patients with minimal metastases usually responded to chemotherapy alone. Bulk of metastatic disease was more prognostically important than primary histology, and teratomatous differentiation reduced chemotherapy response, which surgery offset. Routine RPLND is not needed for minimal disease.

pmid-4038916.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWo、Jar、ElFa、DoSmiの核型と染色体多型による遺伝的ヘテロ接合性を解析した。BeWoとJarは正期産後、ElFaとDoSmiは奇胎妊娠後の腫瘍に由来する。全株に染色体再構成が見られたが共通のものはなく、由来にかかわらず4株とも遺伝的にヘテロ接合性であった。
pmid-4038916.summary_en: Four choriocarcinoma cell lines, BeWo, Jar, ElFa, and DoSmi, were karyotyped and assessed for genetic homozygosity or heterozygosity using chromosomal polymorphisms. BeWo and Jar were derived from tumors after term pregnancies, while ElFa and DoSmi came from molar pregnancies. Three lines had hypertriploid modal chromosome numbers, and DoSmi was hypotetraploid. All lines had multiple rearrangements, but none was shared. All four lines were genetically heterozygous regardless of origin, which is relevant to their use as in vitro models.

pmid-4039287.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株HCCM-5を漸増濃度のメトトレキサートで約36週間培養し、耐性株HCCM-5MTXrを樹立した。耐性株は取り込みが約10分の1に減少し、DHFR活性は約5倍に上昇していた。薬剤除去後も輸送障害は持続し、耐性は主に輸送障害によることが示された。
pmid-4039287.summary_en: Human choriocarcinoma cell line HCCM-5 was exposed to increasing methotrexate concentrations for about 36 weeks until it resisted 5 x 10^-7 M, a dose that completely inhibited the parent line. The resistant subline HCCM-5MTXr had similar doubling time, morphology, and hCG secretion. Resistance was associated with 10-fold reduced methotrexate uptake and 5-fold higher DHFR activity. Impaired transport persisted after drug withdrawal, while DHFR activity normalized, indicating that resistance mainly involves impaired methotrexate transport.

pmid-4039984.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌と悪性奇形腫の患者にエトポシドを投与し、薬物動態と毒性を検討した。投与5分後は高値で、24時間後は患者間変動が大きかった。白血球最低値は併用療法例でのみ24時間後濃度と相関した。投与スケジュールによる有効性や毒性の差はなく、高用量では血中濃度が上がっても効果は増さなかった。
pmid-4039984.summary_en: In patients with gestational choriocarcinoma and malignant teratoma, etoposide serum levels were measured after 100 mg/m2 dosing. Early levels were high, while 24-hour levels showed greater interpatient variability. The WBC nadir correlated with 24-hour etoposide levels only in patients given combination therapy. Schedules of 500 mg/m2 given as 5-day or day 1 and 3 regimens showed similar efficacy, toxicity, and AUC. High-dose etoposide raised serum levels without improving response, and CSF levels were low.

pmid-4040179.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の患者2例が、シスプラチンを含む併用化学療法後に肉腫様変化を来した。転移巣では胎児型横紋筋肉腫、軟骨肉腫、紡錘細胞肉腫が認められた。化学療法後の非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍は、従来考えられていたより多い可能性があると述べられている。
pmid-4040179.summary_en: Two patients with testicular mixed germ cell tumors developed sarcomatous transformation after cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy. Metastatic sites showed embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma, chondrosarcoma, and spindle cell sarcoma. The authors suggest that nongerm cell malignancies following chemotherapy in mixed germ cell tumors may be more common than previously recognized.

pmid-4040229.summary_ja: 原発性卵巣絨毛癌の6症例を検討し、そのうち5例は少なくとも5年の追跡が行われた。全生存率は80%であった。妊娠性と非妊娠性の腫瘍、原発と転移の区別の難しさについて論じている。積極的な化学療法の判断には、腫瘍の起源を判定するよりも外科的病期分類の方が有用である可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-4040229.summary_en: Six cases of primary ovarian choriocarcinoma were reviewed, and five had at least five years of follow-up. Overall survival was 80%. The authors discuss difficulties in distinguishing gestational from nongestational neoplasia and primary from metastatic disease. Surgical staging may be more useful than determining the tumor's gestational or nongestational origin for deciding on aggressive chemotherapy.

pmid-4040701.summary_ja: 43歳男性の左鎖骨上窩腫瘤と上腹部腫瘤の症例。鎖骨上窩の生検でセミノーマに胎児性癌と絨毛癌の成分を認めた。右精巣摘除術により約1cmのセミノーマが見つかり、潜在性精巣腫瘍と診断された。性腺外に胚細胞腫瘍を認めた場合は、精巣の病理組織学的検査が性腺外胚細胞腫瘍との鑑別に不可欠と述べられている。
pmid-4040701.summary_en: This 1985 Japanese case report describes a 43-year-old man with a left supraclavicular mass and an upper abdominal mass. Supraclavicular biopsy showed seminoma with embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma components. Physical examination suggested a slightly atrophic right testis, and right orchiectomy revealed a roughly 1 cm seminoma, identifying an occult testicular primary. The authors emphasize that when germ cell tumor is found outside the gonads, careful histological examination of the testes is essential to distinguish occult testicular tumor from primary extragonadal germ cell tumor.

pmid-4040885.summary_ja: 65歳男性の胃腫瘍の症例。絨毛癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分に少量の腺癌成分を伴っていた。剖検で性腺や他の原発巣は認めず、胃原発と考えられた。胚細胞腫瘍で見られる胎児性や栄養膜成分の胃での出現は初報告である。性腺腫瘍の前方分化と異なり、胃では粘膜上皮の逆分化による発生の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-4040885.summary_en: This report describes a 65-year-old man with a gastric tumor containing choriocarcinoma and yolk sac tumor components, plus a small adenocarcinoma component. Autopsy found no gonadal or other primary tumor, supporting a gastric origin. The authors note that embryonal and trophoblastic elements are common in gonadal tumors, but this is the first clear demonstration of such an association in the stomach. They propose that gastric tumors may develop differently from gonadal ones, through retrodifferentiation of mucosal epithelium rather than forward differentiation of germ cells.

pmid-4040960.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の転移による脳内出血の症例。非定型的な中大脳動脈遠位部の動脈瘤から出血し、血腫除去術が行われた。病理組織学的検査で血管壁を浸潤する絨毛癌が確認された。妊娠可能年齢の女性の脳内出血では、転移性絨毛癌を鑑別診断に挙げるべきと述べられている。
pmid-4040960.summary_en: A case of metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma presenting as intracerebral hemorrhage from an atypical distal middle cerebral artery aneurysm. Surgical evacuation of the hematoma was performed, and histopathology showed choriocarcinoma invading the vessel wall. The authors note that neoplastic aneurysms are unusual, and that metastatic choriocarcinoma should be included in the differential diagnosis of intracerebral hemorrhage in women of childbearing age. They also state that advances in treatment had achieved a 75% cure rate for metastatic choriocarcinoma.

pmid-4041040.summary_ja: 16歳女性が排尿時痛と頻尿を主訴に受診した。卵巣原発の純粋な非妊娠性絨毛癌が破裂し、致死的な血腹症を来した。胚細胞に由来すると推定される極めてまれな疾患である。妊娠歴のない卵巣絨毛癌が急性の腹腔内出血で発症しうることを示す症例報告である。
pmid-4041040.summary_en: A 16-year-old girl with dysuria and frequent urination developed fatal hemoperitoneum after rupture of a pure primary nongestational choriocarcinoma of the ovary. The authors describe this as an extremely rare entity, presumably arising from a germ cell. The report highlights that ovarian choriocarcinoma can occur without any gestational history and can present acutely with life-threatening intraperitoneal bleeding.

pmid-4041108.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌が急性腸閉塞と脾出血として発症した症例報告。絨毛癌が小腸の腸重積を引き起こした報告は文献上初めてとされる。絨毛癌は出血を主体とし、時に急性腹症の原因となることが考察されている。急性腹症を呈する腫瘍として注意が必要である。
pmid-4041108.summary_en: A patient with metastatic choriocarcinoma presented with acute abdominal symptoms, including acute intestinal obstruction and splenic hemorrhage. The authors describe this as the first reported case of choriocarcinoma causing invagination of the small intestine. The paper briefly discusses the abdominal manifestations of this neoplasm, which typically cause hemorrhage and occasionally produce acute abdominal symptoms.

pmid-4042075.summary_ja: 進行精巣がん81例で女性化乳房を評価した研究。診断時の女性化乳房はHCG値と相関し、初診時HCG値より強い独立した予後不良因子であった。化学療法後の一過性女性化乳房は予後と関連せず、該当する12例は全員無病生存であった。治療判断には発症時期と腫瘍マーカーの評価が重要である。
pmid-4042075.summary_en: This study evaluated 81 patients with advanced testicular cancer for gynecomastia at diagnosis and after platinum-based chemotherapy. Gynecomastia at presentation, which became more likely with rising HCG, independently predicted poor survival, more strongly than initial HCG. Transient gynecomastia after chemotherapy, with normal HCG and elevated gonadotropins, was not associated with poor outcome; all 12 affected patients were alive without disease. Therapy decisions should consider timing of onset and clinical markers.

pmid-4042318.summary_ja: 病理学的に確定した精巣セミノーマの7例に、胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼ(CPAP)の免疫酵素法を適用した予備的研究。治療前に4例でCPAPが上昇し、うち2例はhCGも上昇していた。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は全例正常であった。セミノーマの治療モニタリングにおける腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性は、さらなる検討に値すると結論づけられている。
pmid-4042318.summary_en: This preliminary study applied a new immunoenzymatic assay for carcino-placental alkaline phosphatase (CPAP) to seven patients with histologically proven testicular seminoma. CPAP was elevated in four patients before treatment, including two who also had raised chorionic gonadotrophin. Alpha-fetoprotein was normal in all cases. The authors conclude that CPAP merits further evaluation as a tumor marker for monitoring treatment of testicular seminoma, since established markers were lacking.

pmid-4044339.summary_ja: 1960〜1981年に根治的精巣摘除術と放射線療法を受けた精巣セミノーマ188例を後方視的に解析した。病期Iの5年生存率は98%で、放射線単独で治癒可能であった。病期IIBは予後不良で、病期IIIには化学療法が必要と結論された。予防的縦隔照射は病期IおよびIIAでは不要とされた。
pmid-4044339.summary_en: This 1985 retrospective analysis reviewed 188 patients with testicular seminoma treated by radical orchiectomy and radiation therapy at the Cross Cancer Institute between 1960 and 1981. Most patients had Stage I disease and were cured with radiation alone, with five-year survival of 98% for Stage I and 82% for Stage IIA. Stage IIB and Stage III had poorer outcomes. Prophylactic mediastinal radiation was not indicated for Stage I or IIA. Radiation caused no long-term toxicity. The authors concluded that Stage IIB treatment and primary chemotherapy for Stage III warrant further study.

pmid-4044595.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で誘導したF9胎児性癌細胞の分化過程における細胞外マトリックス成分の変化を解析した。フィブロネクチンは減少し、IV型コラーゲンとラミニンは増加した。ラミニンは凝集体に蓄積し、フィブロネクチンは凝集に、ラミニンは分化に関与すると考察された。基礎研究である。
pmid-4044595.summary_en: This study analyzed how extracellular matrix components change during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells into visceral endoderm-like aggregates. Fibronectin synthesis fell to about 10% of baseline, whereas type IV collagen rose about threefold and laminin rose at least twofold. Laminin accumulated in the aggregates. The authors suggest fibronectin contributes to aggregation, while laminin is important for the differentiation process. The work uses embryonal carcinoma cells as a model of early embryonic differentiation rather than clinical tumor behavior.

pmid-4044654.summary_ja: 胎児性癌由来の内胚葉様細胞(Dif 5、PSA-5E)が、IGF-IIのラット相同体であるMSAを分泌することを示した。未分化胎児性癌株の分泌は少なかった。内胚葉由来のIGF-IIが初期胚発生の成長因子として働く可能性を提唱している。基礎研究であり、臨床的なGCT患者の検討は含まれない。
pmid-4044654.summary_en: This study found that endoderm-like cells derived from F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, including Dif 5 and visceral endoderm-like PSA-5E cells, secrete substantial amounts of multiplication-stimulating activity, the rat homologue of IGF-II. Undifferentiated EC lines produced little. Two activity peaks were identified: a high-molecular-weight IGF-binding protein and a low-molecular-weight biologically active fraction. The authors propose that IGF-II from visceral endoderm may act as an early embryonic growth factor. The study is laboratory-based and does not include clinical germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-4044668.summary_ja: 2本の活性X染色体を持つ雌性胎児性癌細胞株P10を用いた研究である。レチノイン酸による分化に伴いX染色体の不活性化が生じることを示した。父由来X染色体の優先的な不活性化は見られず、正常の胚外内胚葉とは異なり、胚性組織に類似していた。基礎研究である。
pmid-4044668.summary_en: This paper examines X chromosome inactivation in P10, a female embryonal carcinoma cell line with two genetically active X chromosomes. Treatment with retinoic acid induces rapid differentiation into an extraembryonic endoderm-like cell type. Differentiation was accompanied by X inactivation, shown by a late-replicating X chromosome. Analysis of X-linked variant alleles showed the endoderm did not preferentially inactivate paternal X chromosomes, unlike normal extraembryonic endoderm, suggesting the process resembles that of normal embryonic tissue. The study is laboratory-based.

pmid-4045525.summary_ja: 1971〜1982年に腫瘤径の大きい病期II精巣セミノーマ16例に初回放射線療法を行った。全例が完全寛解に至り、中央値60か月の観察で全例無病生存であった。再発した2例は追加照射で救済された。毒性は軽度であった。初回放射線療法が選択すべき治療と結論された。
pmid-4045525.summary_en: This study reports 16 patients with bulky stage II testicular seminoma treated with primary radiotherapy between 1971 and 1982. Bulky disease was defined as UICC stage IIC or IID without visceral or supradiaphragmatic involvement. All patients achieved complete remission, and median follow-up was 60 months. Two patients relapsed and were salvaged with further radiation. Toxicity was mild. The authors conclude that primary radiotherapy is the treatment of choice for bulky stage II seminoma, given modern imaging and radiation techniques.

pmid-4046212.summary_ja: ピーナッツ凝集素(PNA)アフィニティクロマトグラフィーを用い、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の糖鎖を解析した。正常妊娠および胞状奇胎のhCGはカラムに結合せず、絨毛癌のhCGは有意に結合した。脱シアル化hCGの検出が絨毛癌の診断に有用となる可能性が示された。
pmid-4046212.summary_en: This 1985 study used peanut agglutinin-Sepharose affinity chromatography to examine hCG from patients. hCG from normal pregnancy and hydatidiform mole did not bind to the column, whereas a significant fraction of hCG from choriocarcinoma did. The results indicate that choriocarcinoma hCG contains desialylated forms detectable by this method. The authors suggest the approach may be a useful tool for diagnosing choriocarcinoma. The work is a short laboratory-based report.

pmid-4046714.summary_ja: 舌に生じた奇形腫の症例報告であり、文献上これまでに5例しか報告のない極めて稀な病変である。症例を追加し、既報をレビューしている。奇形腫は通常、精巣・卵巣や仙尾部に生じるため、頭頸部発生の稀な症例として意義がある。
pmid-4046714.summary_en: This case report describes a teratoma of the tongue, an extremely rare extragonadal germ cell neoplasm with only five prior cases in the literature. The authors present an additional patient and review the published reports of this entity. The paper documents the clinical features of this uncommon location for teratomas, which are typically found in gonadal or sacrococcygeal sites. It provides a literature-based overview of a rare head and neck presentation.

pmid-4046978.summary_ja: 播種性悪性奇形腫と肺転移をもつ3歳女児が緩和的放射線療法を受けた。痙攣の後に脳機能が消失し、36時間以内に死亡した。死亡前の頭部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)は陰性だったが、剖検で壊死した腫瘍による頸動脈および脳動脈の閉塞が確認された。肺転移例における脳腫瘍塞栓がまれな終末像となりうることを示した症例である。
pmid-4046978.summary_en: A 3-year-old girl with disseminated malignant presacral teratoma and pulmonary metastases received palliative radiotherapy. She developed seizures, lost cerebral function, and died within 36 hours. A pre-mortem brain CT scan was negative, but autopsy showed necrotic tumour occluding the carotid and cerebral arteries. The authors suggest that widespread cerebral tumour embolization can be an unusual terminal event in cancer patients with pulmonary metastases.

pmid-4048775.summary_ja: 移植したヒト奇形癌の界面活性剤抽出物から、糖結合性タンパク質を分画・精製した基礎研究である。Ca2+非依存的に赤血球を凝集させる2種のレクチンを同定し、D-マンノースやD-ガラクトースで細胞凝集が阻害された。マンナン特異的レクチンは哺乳類の組織では未報告で、胎児性癌の診断・治療への応用が期待される。
pmid-4048775.summary_en: Detergent extracts of transplanted human teratocarcinoma tumours were fractionated by affinity chromatography, yielding several carbohydrate-binding proteins. Two proteins agglutinated rabbit erythrocytes independently of calcium and were defined as endogenous human teratocarcinoma lectins. Mannose and galactose inhibited aggregation of teratocarcinoma cells, suggesting these lectins mediate cell aggregation. The mannan-specific lectin had not previously been found in mammalian tissue and may have diagnostic and therapeutic potential for embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-4052967.summary_ja: 病期I精巣がんに放射線療法を受けた4例で、1〜8年後に両側肺門リンパ節腫大が出現し、全例で生検によりサルコイド反応が確認された。精巣がん患者ではサルコイド反応の頻度が高い可能性がある。再発と誤認しないよう注意し、無病の患者で縦隔リンパ節が腫大した場合は生検が必要と述べている。
pmid-4052967.summary_en: Four patients developed bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy 1 to 8 years after radiotherapy for stage I testicular cancer, and two also had paratracheal nodes. Biopsy showed sarcoid reaction in all cases. The authors suggest an increased frequency of sarcoid reaction in patients treated for testicular cancer. Such findings should not be mistaken for recurrent malignancy, and mediastinal lymph node enlargement in disease-free patients warrants biopsy.

pmid-4053660.summary_ja: 左半胸郭の広範な不透明化と散在する石灰化を示し、縦隔の奇形癌を疑わせた若年患者2例の報告。生検で1例は奇形癌、1例はホジキン病と確定した。ホジキン病でも治療前に腫瘍性石灰化が稀に生じうることが後方視的に示された。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)は後縦隔浸潤と均一な濃度の描出により両者の鑑別に有用である。
pmid-4053660.summary_en: This report describes two young patients with massive left hemithorax opacification and scattered calcification that mimicked mediastinal teratocarcinoma on imaging. Biopsy confirmed teratocarcinoma in one and Hodgkin's disease in the other. A retrospective review suggests that spontaneous neoplastic calcification can occur in Hodgkin's disease before treatment, though rarely. The authors conclude that computed tomography can help distinguish these entities by showing posterior mediastinal involvement and homogeneous density, which matters because the two diseases require different management.

pmid-4057017.summary_ja: 後縦隔奇形腫の報告で、世界文献上の良性例は8例のみと記載されている。本症例を含む4例は大動脈、胸壁、食道などの周囲主要構造と密接に関係し、しばしば部分切除を要した。そのため術前にバリウム嚥下検査や大動脈造影を行い、局所浸潤の有無を評価すべきだと提言している。
pmid-4057017.summary_en: This report reviews posterior mediastinal teratomas, noting that only eight benign cases had been described worldwide. The authors add their own case and find that four of these teratomas were intimately involved with major surrounding structures, including the aorta, chest wall and esophagus, often requiring partial resection of those structures. They recommend that preoperative evaluation include a barium swallow and/or aortography to exclude significant local involvement before surgery, as this affects operative planning.

pmid-4057386.summary_ja: 精巣内嚢胞性病変4例の報告。3例は類表皮嚢胞、1例は当初類表皮嚢胞と診断された嚢胞性成熟奇形腫であった。精巣嚢胞性病変は術前に誤診されうることを示し、成熟奇形腫は胚細胞腫瘍として異なる管理が必要なため、鑑別が重要である。全例で鼠径部アプローチにより精巣を探索した。
pmid-4057386.summary_en: This short report describes four intratesticular cystic lesions. Three were epidermoid cysts, while the fourth was a cystic mature teratoma that had initially been diagnosed as an epidermoid cyst. All cases were explored through an inguinal approach. The report highlights that cystic testicular lesions may be misdiagnosed preoperatively, and that mature teratoma can mimic epidermoid cyst, which matters because teratoma is a germ cell tumor requiring different management.

pmid-4059127.summary_ja: 46,XYの女性に、ディスジャーミノーマと性腺芽腫が併存した症例報告。顕微鏡的には、ディスジャーミノーマ・性腺芽腫の組合せと胚細胞-性索間質混合組織の両方が認められた。通常は別個とされる両腫瘍の間に移行像が存在することを示す症例である。これは性腺腫瘍の分類を考えるうえで示唆に富む。
pmid-4059127.summary_en: The authors describe a 46,XY woman with coexisting dysgerminoma and gonadoblastoma. Microscopic examination showed both dysgerminoma-gonadoblastoma and mixed germ cell-sex cord stromal tissue. The case illustrates a transitional spectrum between these two tumors, which are usually considered distinct entities. It is a single-case pathology report that informs how such gonadal tumors are classified.

pmid-4061213.summary_ja: 進行精巣がん（病期IIまたはIII）15例で、後腹膜をコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)上3領域に分けてリンパ節腫大を評価した。腎門下73%、腎門上47%、横隔膜脚後方40%に腫大を認めた。横隔膜脚後方のリンパ節腫大が予後を必ず悪化させるわけではなく、後腹膜進展の見張りリンパ節となりうると示唆された。
pmid-4061213.summary_en: This Japanese study divides the retroperitoneum on computed tomography into infrahilar, suprahilar and retrocrural areas in 15 patients with stage II or III testicular cancer. Lymph node enlargement was most common infrahilar (73%), followed by suprahilar (47%) and retrocrural (40%). Retrocrural or suprahilar nodes always occurred with infrahilar or suprahilar enlargement. Retrocrural involvement did not necessarily worsen prognosis. The authors suggest the retrocrural node may act as a sentinel node for retroperitoneal spread, not only in testicular cancer but in other urogenital malignancies.

pmid-4063737.summary_ja: 1970～1981年にエジンバラで治療された精巣の早期非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍91例の解析である。全例が精巣摘除術と傍大動脈リンパ節への放射線療法で治療された。臨床病期Iの5年生存率は全体で83%、リンパ管造影で病期診断した群では94%であった。病期IIAの再発率は50%で、T1を超える原発腫瘍は再発しやすかった。
pmid-4063737.summary_en: This Edinburgh series reviews 91 patients with early-stage non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis treated from 1970 to 1981. All were managed with orchiectomy and para-aortic radiotherapy. Clinical Stage I patients had a 5-year survival of 83% overall, rising to 94% in those staged with lymphography. Relapse occurred in 29.7% overall and in 50% of Stage IIA patients. Tumours extending beyond T1 relapsed more often, while histology did not significantly affect relapse.

pmid-4063956.summary_ja: 正常妊娠と絨毛癌患者のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)変異体を等電点電気泳動で解析した。絨毛癌の血清と腫瘍組織にのみ、pI 3.2・3.5・3.7の酸性変異体が見つかった。ラット・ライディッヒ細胞のテストステロン産生を指標にすると、胎盤型のpI 4.1が最も活性が高かった。腫瘍由来変異体ではpI 3.7が最も強い活性を示した。
pmid-4063956.summary_en: This study characterised hCG variants in normal pregnancy and choriocarcinoma using isoelectric focusing and radioimmunoassay. Three additional acidic variants (pI 3.2, 3.5 and 3.7) were found only in the sera and tumour tissue of choriocarcinoma patients. Biological activity, measured as testosterone production by rat Leydig cells, was highest for placental-type hCG at pI 4.1. Among the tumour variants, the fraction at pI 3.7 showed the greatest potency.

pmid-4065222.summary_ja: マウス胚性カルシノーマ由来のF9細胞と、分化した壁側内胚葉様のPYS-2細胞でシアル酸リアーゼ(NAN-リアーゼ)の活性を比較した。活性はPYS-2細胞で高く、F9細胞はレチノイン酸による分化誘導で上昇した。酵素は365倍に精製され、一部は核に局在していた。増殖と分化における役割を考察している。
pmid-4065222.summary_en: This study examined sialic acid lyase (NAN-lyase) in murine teratocarcinoma cell lines, comparing undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma F9 cells with differentiated parietal endodermal PYS-2 cells. Enzyme activity was much higher in PYS-2 cells and rose in F9 cells after retinoic acid induction. The enzyme was purified 365-fold and partly characterised, with a fraction associated with the nucleus. Its role in growth and differentiation is discussed.

pmid-4070109.summary_ja: 満期まで継続した妊娠と併存した、肺転移を伴う絨毛癌の症例報告である。母親と児はともに生存し、出産から3年後も疾患の所見は認められなかった。進行した絨毛癌と生存可能な満期妊娠が併存する点が稀である。
pmid-4070109.summary_en: This case report describes metastatic choriocarcinoma involving the lungs in a woman whose full-term pregnancy continued alongside the disease. The lung metastases were present during the pregnancy, and both mother and child survived. Three years after delivery there was no evidence of disease. The case highlights the rare coexistence of an advanced gestational tumour with a viable term pregnancy.

pmid-4070461.summary_ja: 上顎と下顎の両方に付着した口腔内奇形腫の1例を報告している。この付着所見から、口咽頭膜と口腔内奇形腫の発生との関連が示唆された。ただし、同様の付着例は少なく、確定的な結論を導くには症例数が不足していると著者らは述べている。頭頸部に発生した奇形腫の局在を示す初期の報告である。
pmid-4070461.summary_en: This case report describes an intraoral teratoma that was attached to both the maxillary and mandibular regions. The attachment suggests a possible relationship between the buccopharyngeal membrane and the development of intraoral teratomas. The authors note, however, that so few similar cases have been documented that a definite conclusion cannot yet be drawn. The paper is a brief 1985 plastic surgery report providing an early observation on extragonadal teratoma localization in the head and neck region.

pmid-4071851.summary_ja: 萎縮精巣に発生した稀なセミノーマの症例を報告し、精巣萎縮が腫瘍発生に関与する可能性を考察している。セミノーマは成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍の代表的な組織型であり、萎縮を背景とする発生は注目に値する。萎縮と胚細胞腫瘍の併存という臨床像を示す症例報告である。
pmid-4071851.summary_en: This report describes a rare case of seminoma that developed in an atrophic testis. The authors discuss the possible role of testicular atrophy in tumorigenesis, considering whether long-standing atrophy might predispose the gonad to malignant germ cell transformation. Because seminoma is the most common testicular germ cell tumor in adults, a seminoma arising in an atrophic testis is noteworthy. The brief case report from 1985 highlights a clinical scenario in which atrophy and germ cell neoplasia coexist.

pmid-4075393.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌細胞株とマウス胚におけるホメオボックス遺伝子の発現を比較した研究である。ヒト第17染色体上のHu1領域とマウス第11染色体のMu1領域は高い相同性を示した。ヒト細胞ではレチノイン酸による分化誘導後にHu1 mRNAが発現した一方、マウス奇形癌細胞では発現が認められなかった。マウス胚では発生期に発現が確認された。
pmid-4075393.summary_en: This study examines homeobox gene expression in a human teratocarcinoma cell line and in mouse embryos. The authors identified a homeobox region on human chromosome 17 that shows high sequence similarity to a mouse region on chromosome 11. The human cell line expressed the Hu1 transcript only after retinoic acid-induced differentiation, whereas mouse teratocarcinoma cells did not express the corresponding mouse transcript at any stage. Expression was detected in mouse embryos, suggesting developmental regulation of these genes.

pmid-4075712.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが骨に転移した3例を報告している。いずれも放射線療法で治療され、診断後6年から16年にわたり生存し無病であった。著者らは、セミノーマの骨転移に対する放射線療法の有用性を強調している。セミノーマは放射線感受性が高いとされ、長期的な良好な経過は、この臨床場面での放射線療法の検討を支持する。
pmid-4075712.summary_en: This report describes three patients with testicular seminoma that metastasized to bone and were treated with radiotherapy. All three patients remained alive and disease-free six to sixteen years after diagnosis. The authors emphasize the value of radiotherapy in this clinical situation. Because seminoma is generally radiosensitive, this favorable long-term outcome supports considering radiotherapy for seminoma bone metastases. The brief series is a 1985 clinical report from a radiology journal.

pmid-4076643.summary_ja: フィーダー細胞上で分化する多能性PSA1胎児性癌細胞から、非分化クローンを単離した。その中から分化能が安定して低いサブラインT2H9を選択した。長期培養により未分化クローンの割合が大きく増加することも示された。得られた変異株は、幹細胞の多能性を解析するための細胞資源として提示されている。
pmid-4076643.summary_en: The authors isolated nondifferentiating clones from multipotential PSA1 embryonal carcinoma cells, which normally differentiate when grown on feeder cells. From these, they selected T2H9, a stable differentiation-deficient subline in which less than 3 percent of clones showed differentiation. They also found that the frequency of undifferentiated clones increased markedly with prolonged in vitro culture. The resulting variant lines are presented as resources for somatic-cell genetic analysis of stem-cell pluripotency.

pmid-4077147.summary_ja: H-2クラスI抗原が奇形癌の移植抗原として機能しうることを示した研究である。導入遺伝子を発現するL細胞で同系免疫したマウスは、胎児性癌細胞の同種移植に対して抵抗性を獲得した。Kb、Db、Dd、および一部の受容マウスではLd抗原も有効であった。マウス実験による免疫遺伝学の研究であり、標的腫瘍として胎児性癌細胞が用いられている。
pmid-4077147.summary_en: The authors show that H-2 class I antigens can function as teratocarcinoma transplantation antigens. Coisogenic immunization against class I molecules expressed on transfected L cells induced resistance to embryonal carcinoma cell allografts. The Kb, Db, Dd, and, in some recipients, Ld antigens were all effective. The authors suggest the approach may help identify other histocompatibility genes encoding transplantation antigens. The study is experimental immunogenetics in mice using embryonal carcinoma cells as the tumor target.

pmid-4077148.summary_ja: PCC3およびOC15Sを含むマウス奇形癌細胞株におけるH-2クラスI抗原の発現を解析した。クラスI抗原を発現するL細胞で免疫したマウスはPCC3細胞を拒絶し、照射されたマウスでは腫瘍の増殖が変化した。胎児性癌マーカーECMA-7を有するOC15S細胞はKb、Db特異的抗血清と反応した。クラスI抗原発現は胎児性癌細胞の多能性の要件でも結果でもないと結論している。
pmid-4077148.summary_en: This study examines H-2 class I antigen expression on mouse teratocarcinoma cell lines, including PCC3 and OC15S. Allogeneic mice immunized with class I-expressing L cells rejected PCC3 cells, and sublethally irradiated mutant mice showed altered growth of these tumor cells. OC15S cells bearing the embryonic carcinoma marker ECMA-7 reacted with Kb- and Db-specific antisera. The authors conclude that class I antigen expression is neither a requirement for nor a consequence of pluripotentiality in embryonic carcinoma cells.

pmid-4077385.summary_ja: 甲状腺に生じた良性の発生異常性腫瘍を認めた乳児2例を報告し、いずれも手術で切除された。1例は内胚葉由来の単胚葉性発生異常腫瘍(ディスエンブリオーマ)であった。もう1例は奇形腫で、腫瘍内の胎児性肝組織に由来して血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が高値を示した。甲状腺と頸部奇形腫の鑑別基準や、術前後の甲状腺機能検査の必要性が論じられている。
pmid-4077385.summary_en: This report presents two infants with benign dysontogenetic neoplasms of the thyroid gland, both successfully operated on. One was a monodermic dysembryoma derived from entoderm. The other was a teratoma with markedly elevated serum AFP, attributed to embryonal hepatic tissue within the lesion. The authors discuss criteria for distinguishing thyroid from cervical teratomas and stress prompt surgical removal with pre- and postoperative thyroid function studies. It is a 1985 pediatric otorhinolaryngology report.

pmid-4078405.summary_ja: 新潟県の地域データに基づき、胞状奇胎後に発症した中断性絨毛癌8例を検討した研究。先行妊娠は多くが胞状奇胎の既往を伴う正期分娩であった。胞状奇胎の既往がある分娩では絨毛癌のリスクが約290倍と算出された。既往のある妊婦では胎盤の肉眼的・組織学的精査が重要と結論づけている。
pmid-4078405.summary_en: This Japanese study of 8 interrupted postmolar choriocarcinoma cases in Niigata Prefecture analyzed the antecedent pregnancies. Most followed term delivery in women with a prior hydatidiform mole. The calculated risk of choriocarcinoma after a molar history was 290 times that without. The authors recommend careful gross and microscopic placental examination in parturients with a prior molar pregnancy, since intraplacental choriocarcinoma may be found incidentally.

pmid-4079397.summary_ja: 女性に生じた原発性縦隔ジャーミノーマの症例を報告し、文献をレビューした論文。初発時の進展度により長期生存率は50〜81%とされる。腫瘍は胸腔内と所属リンパ節に広がり、後期に血行性転移をきたす。外科治療、放射線療法、化学療法のそれぞれの役割について考察している。
pmid-4079397.summary_en: This report describes a female patient with primary mediastinal germinoma and reviews the literature on such tumors. Long-term survival ranges from 50 to 81%, depending on the extent of disease at presentation. Spread typically occurs intrathoracically and to regional lymph nodes, with late hematogenous dissemination. The authors discuss the respective roles of surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy in management.

pmid-4083220.summary_ja: 難治性または再発性の精巣胚細胞がん患者4例に、VM-26とシスプラチンの併用療法（うち2例は放射線療法を併用）を行った報告。完全奏効2例、部分奏効2例が得られ、その後3例は16〜22か月無病生存した。毒性は許容範囲で、VM-26は救援療法において有効な薬剤と結論づけている。
pmid-4083220.summary_en: Four patients with refractory or recurrent germ cell testicular cancer were treated with VM-26 and cisplatin, two also receiving radiotherapy. Two patients had complete responses and two partial responses; one partial response became disease-free after sequential radiotherapy. Three patients remained disease-free for 16 to 22 months. Toxicity was tolerable, and the authors conclude that VM-26 is an active salvage agent.

pmid-4083701.summary_ja: 出生直後の新生児に生じた口腔内奇形腫様腫瘍の症例報告。腫瘍は線維組織、骨、歯芽から構成されていた。外科的切除により良好に治療された。組織像は成熟奇形腫の成分に類似している。新生児期の口腔内奇形腫の一例を示す報告である。
pmid-4083701.summary_en: This report presents a newborn with a teratoid tumor of the oral cavity composed of fibrous tissue, bone, and tooth buds. The lesion was successfully treated with surgical resection. The histologic components resemble mature teratomatous elements. As a single-case report, the paper focuses on the tumor's presentation and surgical management in the neonatal period.

pmid-4083805.summary_ja: 排尿障害、便秘、下肢脱力という典型的三徴候で晩期に発見された仙尾部奇形腫の非典型例を報告。出生時に毛束と小結節が認められ、手術時には小さな髄膜瘤が確認された。病因、臨床像、鑑別診断、悪性転化、治療について文献をもとに考察している。
pmid-4083805.summary_en: This paper reports an unusual late-presenting sacrococcygeal teratoma in a patient with urinary retention, constipation, and leg weakness. A tuft of hair and a small lump had been noted at birth, and a small meningocele was found at operation. The authors review the pathogenesis, clinical features, differential diagnosis, malignant change, and treatment of this tumor based on the literature.

pmid-4084242.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫からアミノペプチダーゼを精製し性状を解析した研究。本酵素は泳動度が妊婦血清のオキシトシナーゼに類似し、オキシトシンやバソプレシンにより阻害された。分子量は約8万と推定された。胎盤特異的なオキシトシナーゼ様酵素であり、胚細胞腫瘍における胎盤型タンパク質の発現が示唆されている。
pmid-4084242.summary_en: This study purified and characterized an aminopeptidase from an ovarian dysgerminoma. The enzyme resembled placental oxytocinase in electrophoretic mobility and was inhibited by oxytocin and vasopressin. Its molecular weight was estimated at about 80,000. The authors conclude that the dysgerminoma enzyme is an oxytocinase-like, placenta-specific protein, suggesting expression of a placental-type protein in this germ cell tumor.

pmid-4084740.summary_ja: 1985年の報告で、精巣奇形腫の大きな後腹膜転移に対し、リンパ節郭清術前に行うコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)の正確性を検討した。108例中106例で手術により存在が確認され、部位は95%で正確に予測された。CT上の腫瘍断面積は病理標本の計測値と良好に相関し、術前評価における有用性が示された。
pmid-4084740.summary_en: This 1985 study evaluated whether preoperative CT accurately predicts the location and size of bulky retroperitoneal metastases from testicular teratoma before para-aortic lymphadenectomy. Among 108 patients, CT correctly identified the tumour's presence in 106 cases confirmed surgically, and predicted the site accurately in 95%. Mean tumour cross-sectional area on CT correlated well with pathological measurements. The findings support CT as a reliable tool for surgical planning in advanced testicular teratoma.

pmid-4085535.summary_ja: 両側の精巣に同時に生じたセミノーマの2例を報告した。精巣腫瘍のおよそ1%がこの両側性病変に相当すると推定されている。著者らは既報の89例をまとめ、この稀な病態の特徴を整理した。両側同時性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍は稀ではあるが、両側精巣の慎重な評価が重要であることを示している。
pmid-4085535.summary_en: This report describes two new cases of simultaneous bilateral testicular germ cell tumours, both presenting as bilateral seminoma. The authors estimate that such bilateral involvement occurs in roughly 1% of testicular tumours. They also provide a synopsis of 89 previously published cases to characterise this rare clinicopathologic entity. The review underscores that simultaneous bilateral testicular germ cell tumour is uncommon but clinically important, requiring careful assessment of both testes.

pmid-4085661.summary_ja: 1985年の研究で、早期胎盤と絨毛癌の組織外植片培養を用い、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の産生に対するプロゲステロンの影響を検討した。正常胎盤ではプロゲステロンがhCGの分泌とmRNA蓄積を抑制したが、絨毛癌では抑制が認められなかった。絨毛癌におけるhCG調節は正常胎盤とは異なるとされ、hCG産生腫瘍の生物学を理解する上で示唆に富む。
pmid-4085661.summary_en: This 1985 Japanese study examined how progesterone regulates human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) production using tissue explant cultures from early placenta and choriocarcinoma. In normal placenta, progesterone suppressed hCG and hCG-alpha secretion and reduced hCG-alpha and hCG-beta mRNA accumulation, while hPL was unaffected. In choriocarcinoma explants, progesterone did not inhibit hCG synthesis or secretion. The authors conclude that hCG regulation in choriocarcinoma differs from that in normal placenta, a finding relevant to hCG-secreting tumour biology.

pmid-4086902.summary_ja: 13年間に管理した全胞状奇胎518例の成績を報告し、尿中hCGの経時的測定を中心とした新潟方式の追跡法を検討した。5週と8週の2つの基準値により、多くの症例が化学療法を要さない経過と判断された。侵入奇胎や転移性胞状奇胎などの合併症は約25%に認められ、胞状奇胎後絨毛癌は主に転移を伴う症例で発生した。
pmid-4086902.summary_en: This Japanese study reports outcomes of 518 total hydatidiform mole cases managed over 13 years using the Niigata postmole follow-up method, centred on serial urinary hCG measurements. Using two critical thresholds at weeks 5 and 8, most patients showed a regression pattern that required no chemotherapy. Complicated moles such as invasive and metastatic moles occurred in about a quarter of patients, and postmolar choriocarcinoma developed rarely, almost exclusively in patients with confirmed metastatic disease. The paper also notes that chest radiographic lung shadows typically appear around 40 days after evacuation.

pmid-4087240.summary_ja: 陸軍兵士23例の後方視的研究で、精巣腫瘍の治療が遅れた要因を検討した。現代の薬物療法により約90%が治癒するが、治療失敗は診断遅延による大きな腫瘍塊をもつ症例に多い。遅延の責任は患者本人、かかりつけ医、専門医のいずれにもあると結論し、早期発見と紹介の改善策を提言している。
pmid-4087240.summary_en: This military study examined why treatment of testicular tumours was delayed in 23 servicemen treated at the QEMH Woolwich.
