Modern drug therapy, combined with surgery and radiotherapy, now cures nearly 90% of patients, but treatment failures mainly occur in those with large tumour masses resulting from delayed diagnosis. The authors found that responsibility for delay was shared among the patient, the general practitioner, and the hospital specialist. They offer recommendations for earlier recognition and referral to improve outcomes.

pmid-4091131.summary_ja: 右陰嚢内容の腫脹を主訴とした22歳男性の症例報告である。術前診断は右精巣腫瘍と左停留精巣であった。右精巣にセミノーマ(pT1)を認め、左側ではtransverse testicular ectopiaとミュラー管遺残が偶然確認された。国内の報告例を概説し、腫瘍を伴った10例を含めて病態と治療について考察している。
pmid-4091131.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 22-year-old man with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome who presented with a right scrotal swelling. Preoperative diagnosis was a right testicular tumour and left undescended testis. High orchiectomy revealed a right seminoma (pT1), and incidental left transverse testicular ectopia with a remnant Müllerian duct. The authors review 67 reported Japanese cases of transverse testicular ectopia, of which 10 were associated with tumours, and discuss the pathogenesis and management of this syndrome.

pmid-4091133.summary_ja: 右陰嚢の不快感と右精巣上体尾部の硬く無痛性の腫瘤を主訴とした36歳男性の症例報告である。術中迅速凍結切片診断では精巣上体のセミノーマが疑われた。高位鼠径精巣摘除術の結果、腫瘍細胞は主に精巣内に存在しており、精巣上体腫脹を臨床症状とするセミノーマと診断された。精巣上体原発と誤認されうるため、精巣の慎重な評価が重要である。
pmid-4091133.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 36-year-old man with right scrotal discomfort and a firm, painless mass in the right epididymal tail. Frozen-section examination of an exploratory excision suggested epididymal seminoma. High inguinal orchiectomy revealed that tumour cells predominantly occupied the testis, and the final diagnosis was seminoma presenting with epididymal swelling. The case illustrates that seminoma may mimic an epididymal primary tumour, so careful intraoperative and pathological assessment of the testis is important.

pmid-4091834.summary_ja: 本論文は、マウス奇形癌株OTT6050の胚様体から樹立された多能性細胞株TCEを報告している。フィーダー非依存性で増殖し、核型、分化能、発生制御遺伝子産物、細胞表面マーカー、中間径フィラメントタンパクにより特性を解析した。胎児性癌細胞は奇形癌の幹細胞であり、発生と細胞分化の研究モデルとして有用である。
pmid-4091834.summary_en: This paper reports the establishment of TCE, a feeder-independent, pluripotent mouse teratocarcinoma cell line derived from embryoid bodies of the OTT6050 strain. The authors characterized the line by karyotype, differentiation capacity, developmentally regulated gene products such as alkaline and acid phosphatase, cell surface markers, and intermediate filament proteins. Because embryonal carcinoma cells are the stem cells of teratocarcinomas, the line serves as a model for embryonic development and cell differentiation research. The findings are discussed in terms of the developmental potency of TCE.

pmid-4092410.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の転移により前頭葉内出血を発症した症例を報告している。患者は2年前に良性疾患のため子宮と付属器を摘出されており、腫瘍は予想されていなかった。著者らは、血腫除去時の血性液の細胞診が悪性腫瘍の診断につながると強調する。骨盤内手術の既往がある患者の脳出血では、転移性絨毛癌も鑑別に挙げるべきである。
pmid-4092410.summary_en: This case report describes a patient who developed a frontal intracerebral hemorrhage caused by metastasis of a choriocarcinoma. The patient had undergone hysterectomy and adnexal removal two years earlier for a non-malignant condition, so the tumor was unsuspected. The authors emphasize that cytological examination of fluid obtained when evacuating a hematoma can reveal the underlying malignancy. The case shows that hemorrhagic brain lesions in patients with prior pelvic surgery should prompt consideration of metastatic choriocarcinoma.

pmid-4094075.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の肝転移により死亡した48歳男性の剖検例を報告している。純粋セミノーマが肝に単発の大きな結節を形成し、CTでは説明しにくい低吸収域を示した。剖検との対比により、低吸収域は凝固壊死に一致し、血管内腫瘍塞栓による転移巣周囲の虚血が所見を説明できることが示された。
pmid-4094075.summary_en: This Japanese report describes a 48-year-old man who died of liver metastases from a left testicular tumor. The pure seminoma formed a large solitary hepatic nodule that was difficult to explain on plain and enhanced CT. Autopsy correlation showed that the low-density area corresponded to coagulative necrosis, with tumor thrombi in vessels causing ischemia around the metastatic foci. This ischemic mechanism reasonably accounts for the atypical imaging findings. The study highlights how histopathological correlation can clarify discordant CT appearances of metastatic germ cell tumors.

pmid-4095025.summary_ja: 出生時から存在した巨大な舌の先天性奇形腫を、生後32時間で摘出した症例を報告している。組織学的に未熟な神経組織を含んだが悪性所見はなかった。生後8日には血清のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が検出されたが、7か月時点では陰性で、1年後も再発を認めなかった。既知の5例はいずれも悪性の経過をとらず、先天性舌奇形腫は悪性化しにくいと結論づけている。
pmid-4095025.summary_en: This report describes a large congenital teratoma of the tongue, present at birth and removed at 32 hours of age. Histology showed immature neural tissue without malignant features. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was present at 8 days of age but absent at 7 months, and no recurrence was seen at one year. The literature review identified four other glossal tumors, all present at birth. The authors conclude that congenital teratomas of the tongue appear not to behave malignantly.

pmid-4095117.summary_ja: 病期IIC・III期の非セミノーマ性精巣がん30例で、導入化学療法後の残存腫瘍に対する手術成績を検討している。手術関連死はなく、縦隔・肺・後腹膜病変の多くで完全寛解が得られた。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値は完全寛解の不達成や長期生存の低下と関連し、残存組織の病理所見も重要な予後因子であると結論づけている。
pmid-4095117.summary_en: This study evaluated surgery for residual tumor after induction chemotherapy in 30 patients with stage IIC or III nonseminomatous testicular cancer. Surgery caused no operative deaths, and complete remission was achieved in many patients with mediastinal, pulmonary, or retroperitoneal disease. Persistently elevated AFP at diagnosis or before surgery predicted failure of complete remission and poorer long-term survival. Among disease-free survivors, most had no tumor or mature teratoma on residual histology. The authors conclude that AFP levels, complete remission, and residual histology are key prognostic factors.

pmid-2411427.summary_ja: 胚発生研究のモデルとして用いられる胎児性癌細胞について、パッチクランプ法で単一チャネル電流を解析した。発現するイオンチャネルは限られ、主なものは電位・カルシウム依存性カリウムチャネルであった。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍ではなく細胞生物学の研究で、GCT診療との関連は間接的である。
pmid-2411427.summary_en: This electrophysiology study applied patch-clamp techniques to embryonal multipotential carcinoma cells, widely used as a model for early mammalian embryogenesis. The cells expressed a restricted set of ion channels, most commonly a voltage- and calcium-activated potassium channel resembling that of differentiated cells. The paper addresses membrane biology rather than clinical germ cell tumors, so its relevance to GCT management is indirect.

pmid-2426574.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株C86S1A1を用い、DNA脱メチル化剤5-アザシチジンによる不活性X染色体上の遺伝子の再活性化を検討した基礎研究である。一過性と一部細胞での安定的な再活性化が示され、X染色体不活性化は段階的な過程であると考察されている。
pmid-2426574.summary_en: This basic research study examines X chromosome reactivation in the mouse embryonal carcinoma cell line C86S1A1. The authors show that the DNA-demethylating agent 5-azacytidine transiently reactivates X-linked genes such as HPRT in almost all cells and stably in a subset. Stable reactivation occurred mainly in cells retaining two X chromosomes and was absent when cells were differentiated before treatment. The findings suggest X inactivation proceeds in sequential steps, with DNA methylation as an early event followed by other transcriptional repression mechanisms. Embryonal carcinoma cells serve as a model system rather than a clinical tumor study.

pmid-2578957.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株を用い、分化とインターフェロン処理によるppp(A2'p)nA依存性RNaseの発現調節を解析した基礎研究である。未分化の胎児性癌細胞では発現が低く、分化した細胞やレチノイン酸・ジブチリルcAMPによる分化誘導で上昇した。
pmid-2578957.summary_en: This basic study measures ppp(A2'p)nA-dependent RNase levels in murine embryonal carcinoma cell lines during differentiation and interferon treatment. Interferon induced the enzyme in differentiated lines (F9 clone 9, PYS, PSA 5E) but not in undifferentiated EC lines (F9, PC13 clone 5, Nulli 2A). Differentiation of PC13 clone 5 with retinoic acid and dibutyryl-cAMP gradually induced the RNase. The double-stranded-RNA-dependent protein kinase was interferon-inducible regardless of differentiation state. The work uses embryonal carcinoma cells as a differentiation model for interferon-regulated RNA degradation.

pmid-2579001.summary_ja: F9奇形癌細胞から得たマウスIV型コラーゲン関連cDNAを用い、レチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPによるmRNA発現の二段階的調節を解析した基礎研究である。レチノイン酸処理で上昇し、さらにcAMP誘導体で増加するが、事前のレチノイン酸処理がなければcAMPは効果を示さなかった。
pmid-2579001.summary_en: This study isolates a cDNA related to mouse type IV collagen from F9 teratocarcinoma cells and uses it to examine mRNA regulation during differentiation. Type IV collagen mRNA is very low in untreated F9 cells, rises after retinoic acid, and is further increased by dibutyryl-cAMP. Dibutyryl-cAMP has no effect unless cells were first exposed to retinoic acid, indicating sequential regulation by these two compounds. The authors propose the cDNA as a tool for studying how retinoids and cAMP regulate collagen expression. The teratocarcinoma cells serve as a developmental differentiation model.

pmid-2581941.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞から単離したマウス胚抗原ECMA 2およびECMA 3の性状を解析した生化学研究です。両者は高分子糖鎖を持つ糖タンパク質で、ECMA 2の抗原決定基はαガラクトシル残基に依存します。血清学的検査で、血液型B抗原やP1抗原、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の血清が認識する抗原とは異なることが示されました。主に基礎的な糖鎖生物学の研究です。
pmid-2581941.summary_en: This biochemical study characterises two mouse embryonic antigens, ECMA 2 and ECMA 3, isolated from F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Both are glycoproteins carrying a high-molecular-weight glycan, and the ECMA 2 epitope depends on an alpha-galactosyl residue. Serological tests distinguish ECMA 2 from blood group B and P1 antigens and from an antigen recognised by sera of patients with ovarian germ cell tumours. The work is mainly basic glycobiology.

pmid-2856907.summary_ja: アブリンに耐性を示すF9およびPSA-1胎児性癌細胞の変異株を分離し解析しました。全変異株はSSEA-1とForsmann抗原を欠いていましたが、多分化能は保持していました。相補性実験から、SSEA-1発現には別々の2つの遺伝子が必要と示されました。F9変異株はレチノイン酸により内臓型または壁側型内胚葉へ分化し、PSA-1変異株は三胚葉成分を含む奇形癌を形成しました。
pmid-2856907.summary_en: This developmental biology study isolated abrin-resistant variants of F9 and PSA-1 embryonal carcinoma cell lines. All variants lacked SSEA-1 and Forsmann antigen, and complementation experiments showed two separate genes are required for SSEA-1 expression. F9 variants differentiated into visceral or parietal endoderm with retinoic acid, while PSA-1 variants formed teratocarcinomas containing all three germ layers. The findings indicate these antigens are not required for pluripotency or broad differentiation.

pmid-2982999.summary_ja: 1985年の論文で、培養ヒト胎児性癌細胞へのヒトサイトメガロウイルス（HCMV）感染を検討している。未分化EC細胞ではHCMVは複製しなかったが、レチノイン酸で分化させた細胞の一部では複製した。感受性は薬剤の直接作用ではなく分化によるものとされた。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床的内容は扱われていない。
pmid-2982999.summary_en: This 1985 J Gen Virol study examines human cytomegalovirus infection of human embryonal carcinoma cells in culture. HCMV did not replicate in undifferentiated EC cells but replicated in some cells differentiated with retinoic acid. Susceptibility resulted from differentiation rather than a direct drug effect on viral replication. Viral DNA entered the nucleus within an hour, and infection increased anchorage-independent growth. Herpes simplex virus type 1 replicated well, indicating no general block to viral replication.

pmid-2986010.summary_ja: 胎児性癌幹細胞で発現する新規のマウスホメオボックス含有遺伝子を同定した。ホメオボックス隣接配列の転写産物は分化誘導の前後で存在したが、ホメオボックス配列を含むと思われる転写産物は分化後にのみ出現した。胎児性癌細胞は幹細胞分化のモデルとして用いられており、臨床腫瘍学ではなく基礎発生学の研究である。
pmid-2986010.summary_en: This study identifies a novel murine homeobox-containing gene expressed in embryonal carcinoma stem cells. Transcripts flanking the homeobox were present both before and after induced differentiation, while a transcript likely containing the homeobox sequence appeared only after differentiation. Embryonal carcinoma cells are used here as a model of stem-cell differentiation, so the work is basic developmental biology rather than clinical tumour research.

pmid-2986619.summary_ja: 未分化で悪性の奇形癌細胞株PCC4と分化した非悪性株PCD1で、4種の細胞性プロトがん遺伝子の発現を比較した。PCC4ではc-Ki-ras、c-myc、c-fosの転写産物が高値で、c-Ha-rasは変化がなかった。c-Ki-rasは10〜20倍に増幅していたが、c-mycとc-fosに構造変化は認められなかった。胎児性癌細胞株は悪性度の実験モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-2986619.summary_en: This study compares expression of four cellular proto-oncogenes in an undifferentiated malignant teratocarcinoma line (PCC4) and a differentiated non-malignant line (PCD1). Transcripts of c-Ki-ras, c-myc and c-fos were higher in PCC4 cells, while c-Ha-ras was unchanged. Southern blotting showed no structural change in c-myc or c-fos, whereas c-Ki-ras was amplified 10- to 20-fold in PCC4 cells. Embryonal carcinoma lines serve here as experimental models of malignancy.

pmid-2987069.summary_ja: レチノイン酸処理で分化させたマウスP19胎児性癌細胞から、クローン化した分化株を樹立して解析した。両株は形態、増殖速度、プラスミノーゲンアクチベーター産生、インスリンへの分裂促進反応が異なるが、継代可能で細胞外マトリックスを産生する。両株はEGFに分裂促進反応を示し、EGF受容体などのリン酸化を誘導する。分化株の膜画分はEGF依存的なチロシンキナーゼ活性を示したが、未分化P19細胞はEGFに応答しなかった。
pmid-2987069.summary_en: Clonal differentiated lines derived from P19 murine embryonal carcinoma cells after retinoic acid treatment are characterized. The lines differ in morphology, proliferation, plasminogen activator production, and insulin mitogenic response, yet both can be serially passaged and produce extracellular matrix. Both respond mitogenically to EGF, with EGF inducing phosphorylation of the EGF receptor and a 38-kDa protein. Membranes from differentiated cells show EGF-dependent tyrosine kinase activity, whereas undifferentiated P19 cells do not respond to EGF.

pmid-2988940.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞株2種と、その分化誘導細胞株のマイナー組織適合性(Hm)抗原発現を、細胞傷害性Tリンパ球応答を用いて比較した研究である。未分化EC細胞は分化誘導細胞とHm発現が大きく異なり、分化誘導細胞は成体脾細胞に近いパターンを示した。F9とPCC3の間にも生体内・試験管内で差異が認められた。EC細胞は刺激能を欠くにもかかわらず、特異的な競合効果を示した。
pmid-2988940.summary_en: This murine immunology study compares expression of minor histocompatibility (Hm) alloantigens on two embryonal carcinoma cell lines (F9, PCC3) and their differentiated derivatives (PYS-2, T.D.M.-1). Using cytolytic T-lymphocyte responses across strain combinations and recombinant inbred mice, the authors found major Hm expression differences between undifferentiated EC cells and differentiated derivatives, which resembled adult splenocytes. Both EC lines showed reduced immunogenicity, with differences between F9 and PCC3 detected in vivo and in vitro. EC cells also showed specific competition effects despite lacking stimulatory capacity.

pmid-2989042.summary_ja: マウスのF9およびPC-13胎児性癌(EC)細胞はPDGFを結合しないが、受容体への結合でPDGFと競合するPDGF様因子を放出する。EC細胞由来の内胚葉様分化細胞はPDGFを結合し、受容体数は細胞株により異なる。F9細胞が分化してPDGF結合細胞になると、PDGF様因子の産生は90%以上低下した。EC細胞が分泌する因子は分化した子孫細胞に作用し、初期胚細胞の増殖に影響する可能性がある。
pmid-2989042.summary_en: This study shows that mouse F9 and PC-13 embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells do not bind platelet-derived growth factor (PDGF) but release a PDGF-like factor that competes with PDGF for receptor binding. Endoderm-like cells derived from EC cells, including PYS-2 and PSA-5E, bind PDGF with varying receptor numbers. Production of the PDGF-like factor fell by more than 90% when F9 cells differentiated into PDGF-binding cells. The findings suggest that EC cells secrete a factor acting on their differentiated progeny, possibly influencing early embryonic cell behavior.

pmid-2991056.summary_ja: 奇形癌由来の均一な上皮型細胞株1H5を、原始内胚葉のモデルとして評価した。レチノイン酸存在下や胎児性癌細胞との共培養で嚢胞状構造を形成し、臓側内胚葉のマーカーであるα-フェトプロテインを発現した。一部の臓側内胚葉の性質は発現せず、壁側内胚葉様の分化は腫瘍形態でのみ認められた。体外での臓側内胚葉分化研究に有用な系と提案されている。
pmid-2991056.summary_en: This study characterizes 1H5, a homogeneous epithelial cell line derived from a teratocarcinoma, as a model of primitive endoderm. When cultured with retinoic acid or co-cultured with embryonal carcinoma cells, 1H5 cells form cystic structures and express alpha-fetoprotein, a marker of visceral endoderm. Some visceral endoderm properties were not expressed, and parietal-like differentiation was noted only in tumor form. The authors propose 1H5 as a useful system for studying visceral endoderm differentiation in vitro.

pmid-2995166.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌由来細胞株のα-L-フコシダーゼ等電点型を、乳癌株や正常組織と比較した。胎児性癌および卵黄嚢癌細胞は、塩基性型が優位な胎児型パターンを示した。一方、乳癌は酸性型優位の成人型パターンであった。奇形癌内に生じた体細胞性悪性腫瘍は多様なパターンを示した。
pmid-2995166.summary_en: This 1985 study compared alpha-L-fucosidase isoelectric forms in mouse teratocarcinoma-derived cell lines with a mammary carcinoma line and with normal fetal and adult tissues. Embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac carcinoma cells expressed an embryonic pattern dominated by basic enzyme forms, similar to early fetal and placental tissue. The mammary carcinoma showed an adult pattern with acidic forms. Somatic malignancies arising within teratocarcinomas showed variable patterns.

pmid-2995417.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌由来のF9細胞を用い、カルシトニンのオートクリン系を検討した基礎研究である。F9細胞はカルシトニン受容体を発現し、無血清培地へ免疫反応性カルシトニンを分泌した。外因性カルシトニンは受容体と分泌を抑制し、レチノイン酸は受容体数と合成を漸減させた。両者の相互調節が示唆される。
pmid-2995417.summary_en: This basic research study examines the calcitonin autocrine system in F9 mouse embryonal carcinoma cells, a model of early embryogenesis. The authors show that F9 cells express calcitonin receptors and secrete immunoreactive calcitonin into serum-free medium. Receptor binding and secretion both fell during the first hours of serum-free culture and then recovered. Exogenous calcitonin suppressed both receptors and secretion, and retinoic acid progressively decreased receptor number and calcitonin synthesis. The findings suggest reciprocal regulation of calcitonin receptors and secretion in embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-2997185.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で分化誘導したマウス奇形癌幹細胞株F9およびP19を用いた基礎研究である。コラーゲン修飾に必要な酵素であるプロリン4-ヒドロキシラーゼの活性が、分化の過程で40倍以上に増加することを示した。増加はレチノイン酸添加後42時間から72時間の間に起こり、酵素蛋白量の増加と一致していた。著者らは、この酵素が分化細胞の有用なマーカーになりうると提案している。
pmid-2997185.summary_en: This basic study examines F9 and P19 mouse teratocarcinoma stem cell lines, which differentiate into endoderm-like and fibroblast-like cells after retinoic acid treatment. The authors found that prolyl-4-hydroxylase activity, an enzyme needed for collagen modification, rises more than 40-fold during differentiation. The increase occurs between 42 and 72 hours after retinoic acid addition and parallels increased amounts of immunoprecipitable enzyme protein. The authors propose this enzyme as a useful marker for certain cell types arising during teratocarcinoma stem cell differentiation.

pmid-2997239.summary_ja: レチノイン酸処理したF9胎児性癌細胞を用い、ジブチリルcAMPがラミニンおよびIV型コラーゲンの分泌に及ぼす影響を検討した基礎研究である。ジブチリルcAMPはラミニン分泌を誘導し、大多数の細胞をラミニン分泌細胞へ変換した。この効果は除去後2日以内に可逆的に消失した。ラミニンmRNAのレベルも可逆的に変化していた。
pmid-2997239.summary_en: This cell biology study used retinoic acid-treated F9 embryonal carcinoma cells to test how dibutyryl cAMP affects secretion of laminin and type IV collagen. Dibutyryl cAMP stimulated laminin secretion in addition to type IV collagen, mainly within 16 hours, and converted most cells to laminin-secreting cells. Unlike the irreversible effect of retinoic acid, the cAMP effect reversed within two days of removing dibutyryl cAMP. The reversal did not reflect changes in cell number, and cAMP also altered laminin mRNA levels reversibly.

pmid-3007248.summary_ja: 1985年の報告で、奇形腫6050由来の胎児性癌細胞株3種（F9、PCC4、PC13）において、レチノイン酸による分化時のcAMP依存性プロテインキナーゼの活性と細胞内分布を検討した。F9とPCC4では壁側内胚葉様への分化に伴い活性と制御サブユニットが増加した。PC13は臓側内胚葉へ分化し、異なる変化を示した。臨床腫瘍ではなく細胞分化の基礎研究である。
pmid-3007248.summary_en: This 1985 study examined cAMP-dependent protein kinase activity and subcellular distribution in three embryonal carcinoma cell lines (F9, PCC4 and PC13) derived from teratoma 6050 during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Retinoic acid increased kinase activity and regulatory subunit levels in F9 and PCC4 cells, which differentiated toward parietal endoderm. PC13 cells, which differentiated toward visceral endoderm, showed a different pattern. The work addresses the differentiation biology of EC cells rather than clinical tumors.

pmid-3838957.summary_ja: 成体マウス小腸、マウス初期胚、奇形癌および胎児性癌細胞株からDolichos biflorus agglutinin (DBA)受容体を単離し比較した。未分化な奇形癌および胎児性癌細胞は、高分子量の糖鎖を多く含んでいた。糖鎖の大きさは細胞の分化状態を反映すると考えられる。主題は発生生物学で、臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍研究ではない。
pmid-3838957.summary_en: This 1985 Differentiation study compares Dolichos biflorus agglutinin receptors isolated from adult mouse small intestine, early mouse embryos, and teratocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma cell lines. Receptors from teratocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma cells contained large amounts of high-molecular-weight carbohydrate, similar to early embryos, whereas receptors from endoderm cells and intestine did not. The findings suggest that receptor carbohydrate structure reflects differentiation status. The work is mainly developmental biology using mouse teratocarcinoma lines as reference material.

pmid-3838958.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌F9およびPCC4細胞を免疫原としてラット-マウス・ハイブリドーマ抗体を作製し、4クローンを得た。F11およびF20抗体は未分化な奇形癌細胞に特異的に反応した。P2抗体は未分化型および胚性内胚葉型の奇形癌細胞と反応した。これらを用いて初期胚の新規分化抗原P2およびF2を同定した。
pmid-3838958.summary_en: Rat-mouse hybridoma antibodies were raised against mouse teratocarcinoma F9 or PCC4 cells, and four clones were established. Antibodies F11 and F20 reacted only with undifferentiated teratocarcinoma cells and recognized the Forssman antigen, while P2 reacted with undifferentiated and embryonal endoderm-type teratocarcinoma cells. Using these antibodies, the authors mapped differentiation antigens across preimplantation, early postimplantation, and later embryos and adult tissues. The P2 and F2 antigens may be novel markers of early embryonic differentiation. The focus is embryology, with teratocarcinoma cells used as immunogens and reference material.

pmid-3840574.summary_ja: マウスおよびヒトの奇形癌幹細胞でN-mycが高発現することを示し、胎児性癌様の胚細胞腫瘍モデルとしての位置づけを示した研究です。マウス胚では妊娠中期に高発現し、成体の脳・精巣・腎臓では低いことが報告されています。N-mycが哺乳類の胚発生に関与する可能性が示唆されています。腫瘍そのものよりも発生学的な発現解析が中心です。
pmid-3840574.summary_en: This 1985 Nature study reports high N-myc expression in mouse and human teratocarcinoma stem cells, a model of embryonal carcinoma-type germ cell tumor. N-myc is also abundant in mid-gestation mouse embryos, declining toward term, and is lower in adult brain, testis, and kidney. The authors suggest N-myc may contribute to mammalian embryogenesis. The paper centers on developmental expression rather than germ cell tumor clinical features.

pmid-3851695.summary_ja: マウスおよびヒトの奇形癌由来細胞株を用い、寒天とアガロースの半固形培地での腫瘍幹細胞コロニー形成を比較しました。低融点アガロースは寒天より広い濃度域でコロニーを形成し、ゲル化が遅く、コロニーの移し替え効率にも優れていました。足場非依存性増殖を調べる培養法の改良を示す研究です。
pmid-3851695.summary_en: The authors compared agar and low-melting-point agarose for forming tumor stem cell colonies in semi-solid media. Three mouse teratocarcinoma-derived cell lines and one human line were grown at various concentrations. Agarose supported colony formation over a broader concentration range than agar, gelled more slowly, and allowed more efficient transfer of colonies to culture dishes. The authors conclude that low-melting-point agarose offers practical advantages for anchorage-independent tumor cell growth assays.

pmid-3857593.summary_ja: 3種の胎児性癌細胞株に、ネオマイシン耐性遺伝子を組み込んだレトロウイルスベクターを感染させ、安定に発現する形質導入クローンを多数単離しました。クローンは未分化な胎児性癌細胞の性質を保持し、遺伝子発現はシス作用性の機構によると考えられました。
pmid-3857593.summary_en: The authors infected three embryonal carcinoma cell lines with a recombinant Moloney murine leukemia virus carrying a neomycin-resistance gene and isolated many clones that stably express the transgene. The clones retained undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma morphology, tumorigenicity in 129/Sv mice, and cell-surface markers. Some clones had single and others multiple integrated copies, and helper virus expression was undetected. Expression appeared to depend on a cis-acting mechanism linked to the viral long terminal repeat.

pmid-3859819.summary_ja: 口腔内でまれに報告される舌下部の類皮嚢腫5例を報告し、文献を概説した論文である。類皮嚢腫は全身に生じるが、口腔内では舌下部に多い。抄録では組織学的所見や治療、転帰の詳細は限られている。奇形腫と関連付けられる発生性病変であり、胚細胞腫瘍としての位置づけは不確かである。
pmid-3859819.summary_en: This report describes five cases of sublingual dermoid cyst, a rare oral-cavity lesion, drawn from several London-area dental and hospital diagnostic records. The article reviews the clinical presentations and summarizes the literature on dermoid cysts, which occur throughout the body but only rarely in the oral cavity, most commonly in the sublingual region. The abstract gives limited detail on histopathology, treatment, and outcomes. Its relevance to germ cell tumors is uncertain, because dermoid cysts are developmental lesions often classified alongside teratomas.

pmid-3878273.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞をモデルに、着床後初期胚の増殖調節因子を検討したシンポジウム論文である。EC細胞は分化に伴い特定の増殖因子への依存性を獲得し、必要因子が定義培地で同定された。EC細胞が分泌する胎児性癌由来増殖因子(ECDGF)は、in vivoで胚の増殖因子として働く可能性がある。
pmid-3878273.summary_en: This symposium paper uses murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells as a model to characterize growth regulatory molecules in the early postimplantation mouse embryo. EC cell differentiation alters proliferation control, including acquired dependence on specific growth factors. Defined media identified factors required for EC cell proliferation. EC cells secrete a growth factor, ECDGF, which may act as an embryonic growth factor in vivo. Proliferation may be regulated by reciprocal interactions between primitive ectoderm and differentiated derivatives.

pmid-3894113.summary_ja: レチノイン酸処理による胎児性癌細胞の分化過程を追跡した1985年の発生生物学的研究である。神経、内胚葉、筋系の前駆細胞への分化と、細胞表面のレクチン受容体や胚性糖鎖の変化を6日間観察した。細胞運命の決定に重要な時期が示唆された。臨床腫瘍ではなく胚発生の試験系として胎児性癌細胞を用いている点が特徴である。
pmid-3894113.summary_en: This 1985 developmental biology study examines how pluripotent HM-1 embryonal carcinoma cells differentiate into nerve, endoderm and muscle precursors after retinoic acid exposure. Cell-surface lectin receptor changes and embryoglycan synthesis were tracked over six days. Most surface changes occurred between days two and four, a window considered critical for determining cell fate. The work uses EC cells as an in vitro model of embryonic differentiation rather than studying clinical tumour behaviour.

pmid-3896777.summary_ja: c-fos遺伝子を胎児性癌細胞株に導入した際の分化促進作用を検討した1985年の研究である。F9細胞では分化細胞のコロニーが得られたが、P19細胞では効果が弱く、PC13細胞では認められなかった。c-fosは他の自然発生的な事象と協調して分化を促すと結論された。臨床腫瘍ではなく細胞株を分化モデルとして用いている。
pmid-3896777.summary_en: This 1985 EMBO study tests whether inducible c-fos expression promotes differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells. Metallothionein-promoter c-fos constructs were transfected into F9 and other EC lines. c-fos induced differentiated colonies in F9 cells, but effects were weaker in P19 and absent in PC13 cells. The authors conclude c-fos cooperates with spontaneous events to promote differentiation in certain EC lines. The study uses EC cell lines as a model of differentiation, not as clinical tumour material.

pmid-3917147.summary_ja: 129/Svマウスをヒト唾液の血液型物質で免疫したところ、精子形成の抑制と、精子形成細胞およびF9奇形癌細胞に共通する膜抗原に対する抗体が得られた。吸収実験から、これらの抗原は発生段階で調節される糖鎖抗原と考えられた。F9の癌胎児性抗原は精子分化抗原と類似した糖鎖構造をもつと提唱されている。
pmid-3917147.summary_en: Mice of the 129/Sv strain were immunized with human salivary blood group substances, producing both reduced spermatogenesis and antibodies against membrane antigens shared by spermatogenic cells and F9 teratocarcinoma cells. Antibody absorption experiments suggested these antigens are developmentally regulated carbohydrates, and SSEA-1 was found in the immunizing substances. The authors propose that oncofetal F9 antigens resemble spermatogenic differentiation antigens.

pmid-3968192.summary_ja: 本研究は、多能性胎児性癌細胞株OC15におけるアミノ酸輸送を解析した基礎研究である。中性アミノ酸輸送系A・L・ASCの関与を示し、系Aと系Lの動態を定量した。プロリンとフェニルアラニンの輸送は他の細胞と異なり、Na+依存性が強いことが明らかになった。臨床的な腫瘍研究ではなく、細胞代謝の基礎研究である。
pmid-3968192.summary_en: This 1985 study characterizes neutral amino acid transport in the pluripotent embryonal carcinoma cell line OC15, using it as a cell model. Most amino acids are carried by systems A, L, and ASC, and the authors quantify the kinetics of systems A and L. Proline and phenylalanine transport differ from other cell types and show strong sodium dependence. The findings are compared with the F9 embryonal carcinoma line and mouse embryos. This is basic cell biology rather than clinical tumor research.

pmid-3982434.summary_ja: 未分化および分化したマウス奇形癌細胞の放射線感受性を比較した。未分化細胞はUVに対して分化細胞やBALB/3T3細胞より約3倍感受性が高く、X線感受性はBALB/3T3細胞と同等だった。照射後のカフェイン処理で未分化細胞の一部が感作され、二相性の生存曲線を示した。この高感受性は分化により失われた。
pmid-3982434.summary_en: Radiosensitivity of undifferentiated and differentiated murine teratocarcinoma cells was examined. Undifferentiated cells were about three times more sensitive to UV than differentiated cells and BALB/3T3 fibroblasts, while X-ray sensitivity matched BALB/3T3 cells. Caffeine given after irradiation sensitized a fraction of undifferentiated cells, producing biphasic survival curves. This high sensitivity was lost upon differentiation. The study concerns cell biology rather than patient tumors.

pmid-3996476.summary_ja: 奇形癌OTT6050の糖タンパク質に対する抗血清は、奇形癌、胎児性癌、内胚葉細胞、栄養膜細胞の基質への接着を阻害した。活性成分は約125kDaの糖タンパク質GP-125で、F9およびPYS-2細胞にも存在した。細胞と基質の接着を阻害したが細胞同士の接着は阻害しなかった。
pmid-3996476.summary_en: This study raised an antiserum against glycoproteins from teratocarcinoma OTT6050 that blocked attachment and spreading of teratocarcinoma, embryonal carcinoma, parietal endoderm, and trophoblast cells to plastic and to several extracellular matrix proteins. The active component was a glycoprotein of about 125 kDa, named GP-125, which was also found in F9 and PYS-2 cells. The antibody inhibited cell-substratum adhesion but not cell-cell adhesion. The study points to an intrinsic component of cell-substratum adhesion rather than a specific matrix receptor.

pmid-4018458.summary_ja: マウスの初期胚と奇形癌細胞を用い、N-アセチルガラクトサミン認識レクチン5種の結合性を比較した発生学的研究。内胚葉形成や胚発生初期の分化解析に有用なレクチンを示す。奇形癌細胞は比較対象であり、ヒトの胚細胞腫瘍の診療に直接関わる研究ではない。
pmid-4018458.summary_en: This developmental biology study compares binding of five N-acetylgalactosamine-recognizing lectins across mouse preimplantation embryos, early postimplantation embryos, and teratocarcinoma cells. Lectin reactivity differed among cell populations. SJA marked visceral endoderm, DBA marked the inner cell mass of early blastocysts, and primary endoderm changed reactivity during differentiation. The authors propose these lectins as tools to study endoderm formation and early embryonic differentiation. Teratocarcinoma cells serve as a comparison model rather than being studied clinically, so the paper has limited direct relevance to human germ cell tumor management.

pmid-4018461.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株H6を用いた細胞接着研究。凝集能が欠損した変異株を分離し、ピーナッツ凝集素（PNA）の結合が低下していることを示した。原因は分子量94kDaの糖タンパクの減少と推定される。臨床的な患者や治療を扱う研究ではなく、胚細胞腫瘍の基礎研究としての位置づけである。
pmid-4018461.summary_en: This basic cell biology study uses the mouse embryonal carcinoma line H6 to investigate cell adhesion. Three aggregation-defective variants were isolated, each showing reduced binding of peanut agglutinin. Quantification revealed roughly half to one-quarter as many PNA receptors, specifically a 94-kilodalton glycoprotein. Binding of concanavalin A and soybean agglutinin was unchanged, suggesting no general glycoprotein defect. The authors propose the 94-kDa protein may mediate H6 cell-cell adhesion. The work is experimental and does not address patients, treatment, or clinical markers.

pmid-4043090.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌の神経分化に伴うタンパク質合成パターンを二次元電気泳動で解析した研究。約1000種のポリペプチドのうち、約12%が消失・減少し、約7%が新たに合成された。脳組織と共通する神経特異的タンパク質4種が候補として挙げられた。奇形癌を疾患ではなく発生モデルとして用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-4043090.summary_en: This study analyzed protein synthesis patterns by two-dimensional gel electrophoresis during neural differentiation of mouse teratocarcinomas. Roughly 1000 polypeptides were resolved, with about 12% absent or reduced and 7% newly synthesized in neurogenic tumors. Four nerve-specific proteins shared with brain tissue were identified as candidates for further analysis of differentiation. The work uses teratocarcinoma as a developmental model rather than examining germ cell tumor as a disease.

pmid-4043091.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌由来の筋様細胞に分化する腫瘍と、胎児肢芽の筋分化を二次元電気泳動で比較した研究。筋分化に伴い約12%のポリペプチドが減少し、83種類のタンパク質が増加した。筋特異的タンパク質5種が腫瘍と胎児肢芽の両方に出現した。発生初期の分化を分子レベルで解析する手段として有用と考えられる。
pmid-4043091.summary_en: This study compared newly synthesized proteins in mouse teratocarcinoma-derived tumors restricted to muscle-like cells with developing fetal limbs using two-dimensional gel electrophoresis. About 12% of polypeptides decreased and 83 proteins increased during muscle differentiation. Five muscle-specific proteins appeared in both myogenic tumors and developing limbs but not in brain. The authors propose these proteins as tools for analyzing early developmental differentiation at the molecular level.

pmid-4044017.summary_ja: 非活性化マウスマクロファージがH-2抗原を欠くF9奇形癌細胞を溶解できるかを検討した。チオグリコレート誘導および骨髄由来のいずれのマクロファージもF9を効率よく殺傷したが、線維肉腫標的は溶解しなかった。H-2発現の欠如が「非自己」認識のシグナルとなる可能性を示した。臨床的GCT研究ではなく、胎児性癌由来株を標的とした免疫学的研究である。
pmid-4044017.summary_en: This study examined whether non-activated murine macrophages can lyse F9 teratocarcinoma cells lacking H-2 antigens. Both thioglycollate-elicited and bone marrow-derived non-activated macrophages killed F9 cells efficiently but did not lyse fibrosarcoma targets. LPS activation enabled fibrosarcoma lysis without substantially increasing lysis of F9 cells. The authors propose that absence of H-2 expression on target cells may act as a signal for macrophage recognition of foreign cells. F9 is an embryonal carcinoma-derived line used here as a target, so the study is immunological rather than clinical.

pmid-4068117.summary_ja: 耳管に生じた先天性類皮嚢腫の症例報告で、文献上の同種症例は7例のみであった。発生学と典型的な発症様式を考察している。後耳介切開と鼓室前経路を組み合わせた新しい手術アプローチを提示している。
pmid-4068117.summary_en: This case report describes a congenital dermoid cyst arising in the Eustachian tube, a rare site with only seven similar cases found in the literature. The authors discuss the embryology and typical clinical presentation of these cysts. They present a new surgical approach combining a retroauricular incision with a protympanic route to access and excise the lesion. This approach is offered as a practical option for similar cases.

pmid-21278951.summary_ja: 52歳女性医師の症例報告である。重度の呼吸困難と大量胸水で入院し、当初は悪性疾患を伴う心不全が疑われた。精査の結果、腹水・胸水を伴う良性嚢胞性奇形腫の卵巣腫瘍、すなわちメイグス症候群と診断された。患者が癌を否認し化学療法を拒んだ点も治療上の課題として挙げられている。
pmid-21278951.summary_en: This 1984 case report describes a 52-year-old female physician admitted with severe dyspnea and massive pleural effusion. She was initially suspected of heart failure with malignancy, but she denied cancer and refused chemotherapy. The workup revealed a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary with ascites and hydrothorax, consistent with Meigs' syndrome. The case highlights the diagnostic challenge of patient denial and the need to consider ovarian teratoma in pleural effusion.

pmid-37281510.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞を用いた基礎研究である。スクシニルコンカナバリンAおよびツニカマイシンは細胞の伸展を阻害し、細胞は丸い凝集塊を形成した。ツニカマイシンはエンブリグリカンの合成も部分的に抑制した。マンノシル糖タンパク質が細胞と基質との接着に関与することが示唆され、胚細胞腫瘍の細胞生物学の理解に資する。
pmid-37281510.summary_en: This 1984 basic study examined F9 embryonal carcinoma cells treated with succinyl concanavalin A or tunicamycin. Succinyl concanavalin A at 50 μg/ml blocked cell spreading while only partially inhibiting growth, forming rounded aggregates. Tunicamycin at 1 μg/ml produced a similar effect and partially inhibited embryoglycan biosynthesis. The findings suggest a mannosyl glycoprotein mediates cell-substratum adhesion in embryonal carcinoma cells, offering insight into germ cell tumor cell biology.

pmid-37281787.summary_ja: マウス初期胚を免疫学的特権部位に移植し、腫瘍形成能を検討した実験研究である。6日半胚全体で腫瘍形成率が最も高く、三胚葉由来組織を含む奇形腫と卵黄嚢癌様の領域が認められた。外胚葉性円錐のみでは腫瘍を形成しなかった。胚細胞腫瘍の発生を考える実験モデルとして意義がある。
pmid-37281787.summary_en: This 1984 experimental study transplanted mouse early embryos into an immunologically privileged glass cylinder site in allogeneic adults to test tumor-forming potential. Whole 6.5-day embryos gave the highest tumor yield, producing teratomas with derivatives of all three germ layers and yolk sac carcinoma-like areas. Genital ridge grafts also produced teratomas. The ectoplacental cone alone gave no tumors, and trophoblastic giant cells persisted longer within the cylinder. The model is relevant to germ cell tumor origin.

pmid-6083720.summary_ja: 本報告は、測定可能な転移を有する病期III精巣胚細胞腫瘍の7例に対する化学療法の成績である。シスプラチン単剤またはPVB療法を施行し、奏効率は71.4%、手術による残存結節切除を加えると85.7%であった。切除された肺転移結節は成熟奇形腫であった。進行例では強力な化学療法と残存腫瘤の摘出が重要であると述べている。
pmid-6083720.summary_en: This 1984 Japanese report describes chemotherapy in seven patients with stage III disseminated germ cell testicular tumors with measurable metastases. Patients received single-agent cisplatin (CDDP) or PVB (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin) for up to three courses. Three had complete response and two partial response, giving an overall response of 71.4%, rising to 85.7% with surgical resection of residual nodules. Histology of one resected pulmonary nodule showed mature teratoma. The authors emphasize intensive chemotherapy and removal of residual masses.

pmid-6083721.summary_ja: 42歳男性の病期IIBセミノーマ症例の報告である。右根治的精巣摘除術で純粋セミノーマと診断され、傍大動脈リンパ節の巨大転移を認めた。PVB療法を4コース施行後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行い、生存腫瘍細胞は認めず完全奏効と判断された。進行セミノーマの初回治療としてPVB療法を推奨している。
pmid-6083721.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 42-year-old man with stage IIB seminomatous germ cell tumor of the right testis. After radical orchiectomy confirmed pure seminoma with bulky paraaortic metastases, he received four courses of PVB chemotherapy. Retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy afterward found no viable tumor, indicating complete response. The authors argue that PVB should be the initial treatment for advanced seminoma, given poor survival and high relapse rates with radiotherapy alone.

pmid-6083892.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株Nulli-SCC1を用い、レチノイン酸による分化誘導時の遺伝子発現を解析した研究である。形態変化の前に二次元電気泳動でタンパク質パターンが変化していた。α-アマニチンや無細胞翻訳系を用いた実験から、遺伝子発現は転写と転写後の両方で制御されていることが示唆された。初期胚との類似性を示し、胚細胞腫瘍の分化研究の基盤となる知見である。
pmid-6083892.summary_en: This 1984 basic research study examined the murine embryonal carcinoma cell line Nulli-SCC1 during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Two-dimensional gel electrophoresis showed protein profile changes well before morphological differentiation. Experiments with alpha-amanitin and cell-free translation suggested that gene expression is regulated both transcriptionally and post-transcriptionally, resembling early embryonic cells. The work provides insight into embryonal carcinoma as a model for germ cell differentiation.

pmid-6084421.summary_ja: 進行泌尿生殖器癌18例に対するシスプラチン(CDDP)療法の報告である。精巣腫瘍6例を含み、うち5例で客観的奏効を認めた。骨髄抑制や悪心・嘔吐が主な副作用で、BVP化学療法レジメンでは腎機能障害もみられた。非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍に対するCDDP併用化学療法の有効性が示唆されている。
pmid-6084421.summary_en: This 1984 Japanese study treated 18 patients with advanced genitourinary carcinoma with cisplatin (CDDP), including six with testicular tumors. Four testicular patients received CDDP, bleomycin and vinblastine, and five of the six testicular patients responded objectively. Bone marrow suppression and nausea were common toxicities, and renal dysfunction occurred with the BVP regimen. The authors conclude that CDDP combination chemotherapy is effective for nonseminomatous testicular tumor, while other genitourinary cancers need further study.

pmid-6085330.summary_ja: ヒト奇形腫由来株Tera-2の単一細胞クローンを解析した。レチノイン酸処理により扁平な細胞へ分化し、凝集後には神経マーカーと反応する神経様細胞が生じた。増殖性クローンは少なくとも2種類の細胞型を形成する能力を持ち、従来の分離株とは異なっていた。
pmid-6085330.summary_en: Single-cell clones of the human teratoma line Tera-2 were characterized for surface markers and tumorigenicity. Retinoic acid induced differentiation into flat, G1-arrested cells, and aggregation followed by retinoic acid treatment produced neuron-like cells that reacted with neuronal markers. Fibronectin secretion changed upon differentiation. The progressively growing clones could form at least two cell types and were distinct from previously isolated Tera-2 subpopulations.

pmid-6085541.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の患者12例の尿中で、hCGβサブユニットのC末端断片と脱シアル化hCGという特異なhCG分子形態を検出した。検出率はそれぞれ83%と50%で、健常妊婦ではわずかであった。これらは妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の診断や正常妊娠との鑑別に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-6085541.summary_en: Urinary analysis of 12 patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia detected unusual hCG forms, namely carboxyterminal fragments of the beta-subunit and desialylated hCG. These were found in 83% and 50% of patients, respectively, but only negligibly in healthy pregnant women. Such forms were not detected in normal controls given an hCG infusion. The authors suggest these molecules may aid diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and its differentiation from normal pregnancy.

pmid-6085562.summary_ja: 抗体を用いて、ヒト胎児性癌細胞株、そこから作製したヌードマウス腫瘍、および精巣胚細胞腫瘍の中間径フィラメント蛋白を解析した。細胞株は低分子ケラチン3種を発現し、NTera-2ではレチノイン酸処理で40Kケラチン陽性細胞が増加した。臨床の充実性胚細胞腫瘍でもケラチンが検出された。
pmid-6085562.summary_en: Monoclonal antibodies were used to study intermediate filament proteins in human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines, nude mouse tumors derived from them, and surgically removed testicular germ cell tumors. The EC lines expressed three low-molecular-weight keratins, while clone NTera-2 expressed the 40K keratin in only a fraction of cells until retinoic acid induction. Xenografts contained cells positive for keratin, vimentin, neurofilament and desmin. Keratin was also detected in embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac carcinoma and trophoblastic components of solid germ cell tumors.

pmid-6086260.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(胞状奇胎、絨毛腺腫、絨毛癌)の定義、病因、疫学、分類、予後と治療選択肢を概説した総説である。血清hCG、超音波検査などで診断し、非転移例や低リスク転移例にはメトトレキサートとロイコボリンのレスキュー療法を、高リスク転移例には多剤併用療法を用いる。放射線療法や手術も併用される。
pmid-6086260.summary_en: This review summarizes the definition, etiology, epidemiology, classification, and prognosis of gestational trophoblastic tumors, which include hydatidiform mole, chorioadenoma destruens, and choriocarcinoma. It describes diagnosis based on clinical findings, imaging, and serum hCG, and outlines therapy: evacuation for molar pregnancy, methotrexate-leucovorin or actinomycin D for nonmetastatic and low-risk disease, and multiagent regimens such as methotrexate, actinomycin D, and chlorambucil, VBC, and etoposide-containing protocols for high-risk metastatic disease, along with radiation and surgery.

pmid-6086489.summary_ja: 後腹膜に発生した性腺外成熟奇形腫の一例報告である。奇形腫の扁平上皮性嚢胞壁にパジェット病が認められ、腺癌を伴っていた。この部位の成熟奇形腫は稀で、良性成分からの悪性転化は少ないとされる。パジェット病と腺癌が同一奇形腫内に併存した点が特徴である。
pmid-6086489.summary_en: A case report describing Paget's disease arising in the squamous cyst lining of an extragonadal mature teratoma of the retroperitoneum that harbored an adenocarcinoma. The authors note that extragonadal mature retroperitoneal teratomas are rare, with fewer than 100 reported cases, and that malignant transformation from benign elements at this site appears uncommon. The case is notable because Paget's disease coexisted with the adenocarcinoma within the teratoma.

pmid-6088708.summary_ja: 原発巣の精巣が未摘除のまま、シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた播種性胚細胞腫瘍の患者20例を対象とした研究である。化学療法後の精巣摘除術で、残存癌3例、奇形腫6例が確認された。精巣は全身治療中に胚細胞系の悪性腫瘍の避難部位となりうるため、化学療法後の摘除が推奨される。
pmid-6088708.summary_en: This study reviewed 20 patients with disseminated germ cell tumors who underwent orchiectomy after cisplatin-based chemotherapy, despite the testis not having been resected at diagnosis. Residual carcinoma was found in three testes and teratoma in six. The authors recommend performing orchiectomy after chemotherapy in patients whose primary testicular tumor was not removed initially, because the testis may serve as a sanctuary site for germ cell malignancies during systemic treatment.

pmid-6088832.summary_ja: 絨毛癌182例を26年間にわたり治療した施設の解析で、41例(2.3%)に脳転移が認められた。1972年以降は転移巣の開頭摘出術が行われ、手術群は非手術群より生存期間が有意に長かった。子宮病変の未熟型組織像、子宮病変の欠如、肺転移が脳転移のリスク因子であった。
pmid-6088832.summary_en: This Japanese report reviewed 182 choriocarcinoma patients treated over 26 years, of whom 41 (2.3%) developed cerebral metastases. Craniotomy for metastatic lesions was adopted from 1972, and surgically treated patients survived significantly longer. Immature histology of the uterine lesion, absence of a uterine lesion, and pulmonary metastasis were identified as risk factors for brain metastasis.

pmid-6088880.summary_ja: イタリア・ロンバルディア州で、胞状奇胎または絨毛癌の女性132例と正常分娩の対照304例を比較した症例対照研究である。母体年齢40歳以上や父親年齢45歳以上でリスクが上昇し、両親とも高齢の場合に最も高かった。父親年齢は母体年齢とは独立した効果を示し、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の雄核発生起源を支持する。
pmid-6088880.summary_en: A case-control study in Lombardy, Italy, compared 132 women with hydatidiform mole or choriocarcinoma with 304 control women who delivered normally. Maternal age over 40 and paternal age over 45 were associated with increased GTD risk, with the highest estimates when both parents were older. Paternal age showed an effect independent of maternal age, supporting cytogenetic evidence for an androgenetic origin of GTD.

pmid-6089532.summary_ja: 本研究は成人非セミノーマ型精巣腫瘍45例のうち、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)陰性の28例を臨床的に検討した。胎児性癌が半数を占め、病期I・II・IIIの5年生存率は94%、40%、16.6%であった。病期IIでは後腹膜リンパ節郭清が選択され、放射線療法は効果が限定的であった。肺転移例の一部は化学療法で治癒した。
pmid-6089532.summary_en: This clinical study from a Japanese institution reviews 45 adult nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, 28 of which were hCG-negative and lacked chorionic elements. Histology included embryonal carcinoma (50%), teratoma, and teratomatous mixed tumors. Five-year survival was 94% for stage I, 40% for stage II, and 16.6% for stage III. Prophylactic irradiation in stage I did not prevent vascular dissemination in some patients. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was preferred for stage II. Some patients with lung metastases were cured with chemotherapy in the pre-VAB era.

pmid-6089533.summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍110例のうち、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値は19例(17.3%)であった。非セミノーマの37.8%、セミノーマの3.1%でhCGが陽性であった。陽性例の52.6%では絨毛成分が確認された。hCG陽性例は進行病期で受診することが多く、予後不良であった。
pmid-6089533.summary_en: This companion study examines 110 adult testicular germ cell tumor patients, 19 (17.3%) of whom had elevated hCG. Positive hCG occurred in 3.1% of seminomas and 37.8% of nonseminomas. Chorionic elements were confirmed in 52.6% of hCG-positive patients. High hCG levels (over 3,000 mIU/ml) corresponded to chorionic elements, while low levels were seen without them. hCG-positive patients were mostly advanced at presentation and had a poorer prognosis, regardless of hCG level or chorionic component.

pmid-6089563.summary_ja: 1965年から1975年に治療された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対し、5-フルオロウラシルを単剤で用いた成績を再評価した。侵入奇胎173例、絨毛癌139例のうち、初回治療での完全寛解は各々84.9%、59.3%であった。再発率は3.2%で、生存者の大部分は10年以上フォローアップされた。毒性はメトトレキサートより軽度であった。
pmid-6089563.summary_en: This review re-evaluates high-dose 5-fluorouracil given as a single agent for gestational trophoblastic neoplasms treated from 1965 to 1975. Among 173 invasive mole and 139 choriocarcinoma cases, complete remission occurred in 84.9% and 59.3%, respectively, when used as initial therapy. The recurrence rate was 3.2%, with a recurrence death rate of 1.4%. Long-term survivors were followed for over five years, most for over ten. Toxicity was milder than with methotrexate or 6-mercaptopurine, with diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis as specific complications.

pmid-6090001.summary_ja: 精巣・縦隔・後腹膜の胚細胞腫瘍11例で、非胚細胞性の悪性腫瘍成分が発生していた。多くは奇形腫内で悪性転化したと考えられた。シスプラチン治療後に非胚細胞成分が顕在化することがあった。胎児性横紋筋肉腫例の予後が最も不良であった。可能な場合は完全切除が推奨される。
pmid-6090001.summary_en: This clinicopathologic study of eleven male patients describes non-germ cell malignancies arising within germ cell tumors of the testis, mediastinum, or retroperitoneum. Malignant non-germ cell elements were present in five primary specimens and in ten of eleven patients overall. Most cases had teratoma in the primary tumor, suggesting origin within teratomatous foci. Cisplatin often unmasked these elements. Embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma carried the worst prognosis, and total surgical excision was recommended when feasible.

pmid-6091460.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の疫学を概説した。胞状奇胎は約1000妊娠に1例とされ、発生率の明らかな時間的傾向は認められていない。胞状奇胎の危険因子は年齢、人種、既往の胞状奇胎であり、絨毛癌ではこれに加え胎児喪失歴やABO血液型が関連するとされる。今後はそのメカニズムと、絨毛組織の悪性転化の解明が必要とされる。
pmid-6091460.summary_en: This review examines the epidemiology of gestational trophoblastic disease. Hydatidiform mole occurs in about one per 1,000 pregnancies, with no consistent temporal trends in mole or choriocarcinoma rates. Mole is associated with abnormal gametogenesis and fertilization, and with age, ethnicity, and prior mole. Choriocarcinoma risk additionally relates to fetal wastage and ABO blood group interactions. The authors call for research on the mechanisms behind these risks and on malignant transformation of trophoblastic tissue.

pmid-6092290.summary_ja: 29歳女性の左卵巣に発生した重さ4.5kgの稀な悪性卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。主成分は膵島細胞を伴う未熟な膵組織で、インスリン、グルカゴン、ソマトスタチン陽性細胞が確認された。少量成分としてディスジャーミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫などを含んでいた。手術と化学療法後、患者は妊娠し健康な女児を出産した。
pmid-6092290.summary_en: A rare malignant ovarian mixed germ cell tumor weighing 4.5 kg was described in a 29-year-old woman. Its predominant component was immature pancreatic tissue with islet cells, which stained for insulin, glucagon, and somatostatin. Minor components included dysgerminoma, endodermal sinus tumor, immature teratoma, and mucinous adenocarcinoma. After surgery and chemotherapy with vincristine, actinomycin D, and cyclophosphamide, the patient later conceived and delivered a healthy infant.

pmid-6092549.summary_ja: 本研究は、ある施設で30年間に胚細胞腫瘍の治療を受けた男性における白血病の発生を検討した。急性非リンパ性白血病4例と慢性骨髄単球性白血病1例が認められ、相対危険度は全体で13.7、細胞障害性薬剤のみで治療された群では50.1と著明に高かった。文献的検討で14例が追加された。治療に関連した白血病の増加が示唆され、積極的な抗白血病療法が推奨されている。
pmid-6092549.summary_en: This study assessed leukemia risk after treatment of germ cell tumors in men at one institution over 30 years. Four patients developed acute nonlymphocytic leukemia and one chronic myelomonocytic leukemia. Relative risk ranged from 13.7 in the total population to 50.1 in patients treated with cytotoxic agents alone. A literature review added 14 cases. The authors conclude that leukemia after germ cell tumors is increased, likely treatment-induced, and that aggressive antileukemic therapy is warranted because complete responses and long-term survival are achievable.

pmid-6093273.summary_ja: 南アフリカで報告された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（トロホブラスト偽腫瘍）の症例報告である。妊娠性絨毛性疾患は胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍などを含む。この腫瘍は従来は良性と考えられていたが、近年では致死的となりうるとの報告がある。本論文は、南アフリカで初めて報告された稀な症例を提示し、その希少性と予後への注意を喚起している。
pmid-6093273.summary_en: This is a case report of placental site trophoblastic tumour, also called trophoblastic pseudotumour, from South Africa. The authors review gestational trophoblastic disease, which includes hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumour. Although the condition was originally considered benign, recent reports suggest it can be fatal. The paper presents the first South African patient with this uncommon tumour, highlighting its rarity and potential for a lethal outcome.

pmid-6093440.summary_ja: 1976年から1980年に診断されたデンマークの連続した精巣胚細胞腫瘍1,058例を、組織学的にセミノーマと非セミノーマに分類して検討した。胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫、絨毛癌の成分が記録された。壊死、出血、核分裂像、切除断端陽性は非セミノーマで多かった。2.5 cm未満の腫瘍でも、セミノーマの16%、非セミノーマの29%に転移がみられた。病期Iはセミノーマに多く、純粋な胎児性癌は病期IIIと最も関連が強かった。
pmid-6093440.summary_en: This pathology review of 1,058 consecutive Danish testicular germ cell tumours diagnosed from 1976 to 1980 classified seminomas and non-seminomas by histology. Embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumour, teratoma, and choriocarcinoma components were recorded. Necrosis, bleeding, mitoses, and positive resection margins were more common in non-seminomas. Tumours under 2.5 cm already metastasised in 16% of seminomas and 29% of non-seminomas. Stage I was more frequent in seminomas, while pure embryonal carcinoma was most often associated with stage III disease.

pmid-6093441.summary_ja: 1976～1980年にデンマークで登録された精巣胚細胞腫瘍1,058例の組織型と病期を報告。発生率は男性10万人あたり年8～9人と高値であった。研究期間中に原発腫瘍のサイズは縮小し、セミノーマでは転移の減少がみられたが、非セミノーマでは変化がなかった。全国登録によるデンマークの疫学データとして価値がある。
pmid-6093441.summary_en: This Danish cohort study describes 1,058 consecutive testicular germ cell tumour patients diagnosed from 1976 to 1980 through a national registry. The incidence was high, about 8 to 9 per 100,000 males annually. Primary tumour size decreased during the study period. Metastatic spread declined for seminoma but did not change for non-seminomatous tumours. Histology and stage at diagnosis are presented, providing epidemiological and clinical information on testicular cancer in Denmark during that era.

pmid-6093442.summary_ja: デンマークの成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍1,058例を対象に、組織型と病期別に予後因子を解析した。病期IIのセミノーマでは術後hCG高値と後腹膜転移の大きさが不良因子であった。非セミノーマでは病期ごとに、術後hCG、局所浸潤、核分裂数、肝・肺転移、絨毛癌または卵黄嚢腫瘍成分、年齢などが予後に影響した。再発無生存率と生存率で評価された。
pmid-6093442.summary_en: This study examined prognostic factors in 1,058 adult Danish testicular germ cell tumour patients, analysed separately by histology (seminoma, non-seminoma) and clinicoradiologic stage. For seminoma stage II, elevated hCG and larger retroperitoneal metastases were adverse. For non-seminoma, postoperative hCG, local invasion, mitotic count, tumour size, metastasis size, liver or lung metastasis, choriocarcinoma or yolk sac components, and age influenced outcome by stage. Relapse-free survival and overall survival were used as endpoints.

pmid-6093462.summary_ja: 1980～1981年にラゴス大学病院で扱われた妊娠性絨毛性疾患の症例を検討した疫学研究。胞状奇胎は約184分娩に1例、絨毛癌は約299分娩に1例と、以前より増加していた。胞状奇胎では27%に偽子癇前症状があり、絨毛癌の死亡率は31%と高かった。診断の遅れが主因とされ、紹介体制と啓発の必要性が提言された。
pmid-6093462.summary_en: A review of trophoblast neoplasm cases at Lagos University Teaching Hospital in 1980 to 1981 reported an apparent rise in incidence: about 1 in 184 deliveries for hydatidiform mole and 1 in 299 for choriocarcinoma. Hydatidiform mole was associated with age and parity, and 27% of patients had pseudotoxemia, one progressing to eclampsia. Choriocarcinoma mortality was 31%, linked to delayed diagnosis and higher parity. The authors call for better referral systems and greater public awareness of symptoms.

pmid-6093468.summary_ja: 1964～1975年に単剤の5-FUで治療された妊娠性悪性トロホブラスト腫瘍の大規模研究。初回治療群では侵入奇胎98.4%、絨毛癌93.0%の寛解率を示した。他の抗代謝薬に耐性となった群でも有効性が認められた。再発率は1.4%で、多くが5年以上生存した。5-FUは有効性が高く毒性が低いため、第一選択の化学療法として推奨されている。
pmid-6093468.summary_en: This study re-evaluates 5-fluorouracil as single-agent therapy for gestational malignant trophoblastic neoplasms treated from 1964 to 1975. Among 173 invasive mole and 139 choriocarcinoma cases, first-line 5-FU achieved remission rates of 98.4% and 93.0%. In patients resistant to 6-mercaptopurine or methotrexate, remission rates were 93.6% and 71.7%. Recurrence was 1.4%, and most patients survived more than five years. The authors conclude that 5-FU remains the first-choice chemotherapy because it is more effective and less toxic than other antimetabolites.

pmid-6093473.summary_ja: 1971～1980年にポルトガルで観察・治療されたトロホブラスト腫瘍220例の検討。年齢、既往妊娠、子宮の病理所見、転移部位で分類された。胞状奇胎は完全治癒が期待できた一方、絨毛癌では診断の遅れが治療失敗につながった。妊娠性絨毛性疾患において早期診断の重要性が示された。
pmid-6093473.summary_en: This Portuguese report describes 220 patients with trophoblastic tumours observed and treated between 1971 and 1980. Patients were classified by age, previous pregnancies, uterine pathology, and sites of metastasis. The authors found that complete cure was achievable in hydatidiform mole, whereas in choriocarcinoma, late diagnosis led to treatment failure. The study highlights the importance of early diagnosis for improving outcomes in gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-6093838.summary_ja: 1976〜1983年に進行非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対して化学療法を施行した307例のうち、73例で化学療法後に腫瘤を切除した。残存悪性腫瘍を有する群は無病生存率が44%と低く、線維化・壊死群および成熟奇形腫群はいずれも84%であった。血清マーカー高値と不完全切除が予後不良因子であり、残存腫瘤は組織型にかかわらず完全切除すべきと結論している。
pmid-6093838.summary_en: Among 307 patients with advanced non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours treated with chemotherapy (1976–1983), 73 underwent post-chemotherapy resection. Residual malignancy was found in 22%, fibrosis or necrosis in 34%, and mature teratoma in 44%. Patients with residual tumour had markedly lower disease-free survival (44%) than those with fibrosis/necrosis or mature teratoma (both 84%). Elevated markers and incomplete resection were adverse features. The authors argue that residual masses should be completely excised even when prior resection showed mature teratoma, as the surgery has both diagnostic and therapeutic value.

pmid-6094687.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoとHCCM-5を用い、性ステロイド、LH-RH、サイクリックAMPなどがhCG分泌と増殖に与える影響をin vitroで検討した。LH-RHとサイクリックAMPはhCG分泌を強く増強し、酪酸ナトリウムは両者を抑制した。hCG分泌修飾因子を3群に分類した。
pmid-6094687.summary_en: This in vitro study examined how sex steroids, LH-RH, cyclic AMP, retinoic acid, and sodium butyrate affect proliferation and hCG secretion in two choriocarcinoma cell lines, BeWo and HCCM-5. Estradiol and progesterone inhibited growth and hCG output only at pharmacological concentrations. LH-RH and cyclic AMP slightly suppressed proliferation while markedly enhancing hCG secretion per cell. Sodium butyrate inhibited both processes, and retinoic acid had no effect. The authors classify modifiers into three groups according to their effects on proliferation and hCG secretion.

pmid-6095759.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の病理を概説した総説。ディスジャーミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌、奇形腫などを含む。ディスジャーミノーマは最も頻度が高く、成熟奇形腫を除けば予後が最も良好であった。
pmid-6095759.summary_en: This review covers the pathology of ovarian germ cell tumours, including dysgerminoma, endodermal sinus tumour, embryonal carcinoma, polyembryoma, choriocarcinoma, teratomas, and mixed germ cell tumours. For each type it summarises prognosis, gross and microscopic features, differential diagnosis, and immunoenzyme histochemistry. Dysgerminoma was the most common type, comprising about half of reported cases. Excluding mature teratomas, dysgerminoma had the best prognosis.

pmid-6095777.summary_ja: 原発性悪性縦隔腫瘍38例の総説で、胚細胞腫瘍11例(セミノーマ、悪性奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍を含む)を含む。胚細胞腫瘍の平均生存期間は3.3年であった。外科的切除、化学療法、縦隔照射を組み合わせた多職種治療を推奨し、多くが治癒可能と強調している。
pmid-6095777.summary_en: This review of 38 patients with primary malignant mediastinal tumours includes 11 germ cell tumours: five seminomas, two malignant teratomas, and two endodermal sinus tumours. Mean survival for germ cell tumour patients was 3.3 years. Other groups included mediastinal neuroblastomas, lymphoproliferative disorders, carcinomas, and thymomas. The authors describe their multimodal approach, combining aggressive surgical resection, combination chemotherapy, and often mediastinal irradiation, and emphasise that many mediastinal malignancies are curable.

pmid-6096463.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、胞状奇胎の栄養膜細胞および絨毛癌細胞株におけるトランスフェリン受容体の動態を検討した。受容体は妊娠週数とともに増加し、絨毛癌細胞株では正常栄養膜の5～10倍に達した。トランスフェリン-鉄の添加によりチミジン取り込みと天然型hCG分泌が増加した一方、受容体は減少した。鉄取り込みが栄養膜細胞の増殖やホルモン産生と関連することを示唆する。
pmid-6096463.summary_en: This study examines transferrin receptor dynamics on the cell membranes of trophoblastic cells, including normal placenta, molar trophoblasts, and choriocarcinoma cell lines (GCH-1, GCH-2, ENAMI). Receptor density rises with gestational age, is roughly comparable or modestly altered in molar trophoblasts, and is five to ten times higher on choriocarcinoma lines. Transferrin-iron addition increased thymidine uptake and native hCG secretion in choriocarcinoma cells, while receptor levels decreased. The findings link iron uptake to trophoblastic growth and hormone production.

pmid-6097485.summary_ja: 脱シアル化したhCGのO型糖鎖を認識する抗血清R141を作製し、特異的放射免疫測定系を構築した。栄養膜疾患29例の尿中hCGを測定したところ、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、持続性栄養膜症ではasialo-hCGは有意に検出されなかった。一方、絨毛癌6例中2例で検出された。asialo-hCGの存在は病勢の進行と関連する可能性があり、絨毛癌における悪性転化の指標となりうることを示唆する。
pmid-6097485.summary_en: This study developed an antiserum (R141) that recognizes desialylated O-glycan units on the hCG beta COOH-terminal peptide and used it in a specific radioimmunoassay. Among 29 patients with trophoblastic disease, asialo-hCG was not significantly detected in hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, or persistent trophoblastic disease, but was found in 2 of 6 choriocarcinoma cases. The authors suggest that asialo-hCG may relate to disease advancement and could serve as a marker of malignant change in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6097683.summary_ja: 完全奇胎は全染色体が父親由来であるため同種移植片とみなされ、母体に強い免疫応答を誘導すると論じている。正常胎盤、奇胎、絨毛癌の関係を明らかにすることは、催奇形形成と発がんの機序の解明に資すると述べる。抄録は簡潔で、臨床管理よりも免疫生物学に焦点を当てている。
pmid-6097683.summary_en: This short paper argues that complete hydatidiform moles, whose chromosomes are all paternal in origin, behave as complete allografts and should elicit a vigorous maternal immune response. The authors suggest that clarifying the relationships among normal placenta, mole, and choriocarcinoma could provide insight into the basic mechanisms of teratogenesis and carcinogenesis. The abstract is brief and focuses on immunobiology rather than on clinical management or outcomes.

pmid-6097684.summary_ja: 栄養膜疾患のモニタリングにおける二点法モノクローナル抗体IRMAの信頼性を、絨毛癌、胞状奇胎、流産後の患者およびコントロールの血清で評価した。検出限界は3～4 mIU/mlであった。追加化学療法を要する患者の同定に最も信頼性が高く、疾患のない患者で持続性の低値陽性を示さなかった。不要な化学療法の回避に役立つと結論づけている。
pmid-6097684.summary_en: This study evaluates a two-site monoclonal immunoradiometric assay (IRMA) for hCG in monitoring trophoblastic disease. Tested on sera from choriocarcinoma patients, hydatidiform mole patients, patients after spontaneous or missed abortion, and controls, the IRMA detects as little as 3-4 mIU/ml. It was the most reliable method for identifying patients needing additional chemotherapy and did not yield persistent low positive values in patients without disease. The authors recommend it for distinguishing clinically relevant low hCG levels from undetectable ones.

pmid-6097685.summary_ja: 高リスク絨毛癌の管理を総説し、初診時の生命を脅かす進行や臓器病変に応じた対応の必要性を述べる。胎盤部栄養膜性疾患は異なる治療を要するとされる。主要な長期リスクは薬剤耐性であり、治療失敗の多くは初期の不適切な治療に由来する。予後スコアリングにより耐性の傾向を予測し、治療を初めから計画することが推奨されている。
pmid-6097685.summary_en: This article reviews the management of high-risk choriocarcinoma, emphasizing that risk arises at presentation, when disease may already be life-threatening and organ involvement shapes management, and also during long-term treatment. The authors note that placental-site trophoblastic disease requires distinct management. Drug resistance is the major long-term risk, and many late treatment failures trace back to inappropriate early therapy. Prognostic scoring is presented as a way to identify resistance propensity and plan treatment from the outset.

pmid-6098178.summary_ja: 両側精巣に原発した胚細胞腫瘍の2症例を報告した。いずれも両側根治的精巣摘除術を受け、組織学的にセミノーマと診断された。症例1は骨盤・傍大動脈への放射線照射後15年生存、症例2は後腹膜リンパ節郭清で転移なく、術後の放射線照射後1年再発を認めなかった。両側性腫瘍の発生頻度、組織型、予後、治療について文献的に考察する。
pmid-6098178.summary_en: This report describes two patients with bilateral primary testicular germ cell tumors, both treated with bilateral radical orchiectomy. In the first, both tumors were seminoma and the patient received pelvic and para-aortic irradiation, surviving 15 years. In the second, pure seminoma was found bilaterally, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection showed no metastasis, and the patient received retroperitoneal irradiation with no recurrence at one year. The authors review prior cases and discuss incidence, histology, interval, and prognosis.

pmid-6098182.summary_ja: 両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の3例を報告し、うち1例は両側ともセミノーマ、2例は胎児性癌と奇形腫、または胎児性癌とセミノーマという異なる組織型を示した。国内文献78例のレビューでは、組織型が類似していたのは54例であった。両側性ではセミノーマが最も多く、組織型が異なる例は発生間隔が長かった。セミノーマは成人のみに発生していた。
pmid-6098182.summary_en: This paper reports three cases of bilateral testicular germ cell tumor: one with seminoma in both testes, and two with mixed histology, namely embryonal carcinoma with teratoma and embryonal carcinoma with seminoma. It also reviews 78 Japanese cases from the literature. Bilateral tumors with similar histology were more common, seminoma was the most frequent type in bilateral disease, and tumors with different histology occurred at longer intervals. Seminoma occurred only in adults.

pmid-6100170.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPで処理し、神経分化を誘導した研究です。神経成長因子を加えると神経様形態が強まり、チロシン水酸化酵素などが発現しました。ラミニンの産生も増加しました。臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の検討ではなく、発生研究のモデルとしての細胞株研究です。
pmid-6100170.summary_en: This study examined neuronal differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells induced by retinoic acid and dibutyryl cyclic AMP. Nerve growth factor further enhanced neuron-like morphology and induced tyrosine hydroxylase and enkephalin-like immunoreactivity, along with serotonin-like staining and synaptic-like vesicles. Neuronally differentiated cells showed increased laminin production, while endodermally differentiated cultures expressed fibronectin, laminin and type IV collagen. The work uses embryonal carcinoma cells as a developmental model rather than examining patient tumors or clinical management.

pmid-6100171.summary_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍から17株の胎児性癌細胞株を、3種類の体外培養法で樹立しました。低密度播種で広く分化したのは3株と、そのうち2株由来のクローンのみでした。樹立・維持に用いた3つの方法を比較し、多能性を持つ3株の性質をまとめています。
pmid-6100171.summary_en: The authors established 17 embryonal carcinoma cell lines from human testicular germ cell tumors using three in vitro cultivation methods. Only three lines, and clones derived from two of them, differentiated extensively when seeded at low density. The paper compares the three culture methods used to establish and maintain these lines and summarizes the properties of the three pluripotential EC lines. It provides foundational cell-line resources for studying germ cell tumor biology and differentiation potential.

pmid-6100361.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍13例を免疫染色で検討しました。胎児性癌と絨毛癌の合胞体様巨細胞はβ-hCGとSP1が陽性でした。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分はAFPなどが陽性でした。性腺原発の腫瘍と類似したマーカー所見から、共通の起源が示唆されています。
pmid-6100361.summary_en: Thirteen extragonadal germ cell tumors were screened by immunoperoxidase staining for seven antigens, including beta-hCG, SP1, hPL, CEA, AFP, alpha-1-antitrypsin and ferritin. Syncytial giant cells in embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma stained for beta-hCG and SP1. Yolk sac tumor components expressed AFP, alpha-AT and ferritin. Seminomas showed little ferritin positivity, and teratomas were largely negative. The extragonadal tumors displayed marker patterns similar to their gonadal counterparts, supporting a common cell origin.

pmid-6140076.summary_ja: 二卵性双生児2組の男性3名全員が停留精巣であり、うち2名がセミノーマを発症した家系の報告です。甥に萎縮精巣がみられました。双生児、停留精巣、精巣がんの関連には、ホルモン因子が関与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-6140076.summary_en: This report describes a sibship in which all three male members of two dizygotic twin pairs had cryptorchidism. Two of these brothers developed seminomas at ages 31 and 33. A nephew with an atrophic testicle was identified, but no further twinning, cryptorchidism or testis cancer was found. The authors review prior reports linking twinning, cryptorchidism and testis cancer, and suggest hormonal factors may contribute to the association in this family. The study highlights a possible familial and hormonal link between cryptorchidism and testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-6141173.summary_ja: 酪酸ナトリウムがマウス胎児性癌細胞に組蛋白質の過アセチル化を起こし、分化を誘導することを示した研究です。レチノイン酸を効きにくい細胞では、酪酸が細胞性レチノイン酸結合蛋白質の発現を回復させ、レチノイン酸との併用で広範な分化が起こりました。
pmid-6141173.summary_en: This study shows that sodium butyrate induces differentiation of murine embryonal carcinoma cells, including the 6050AJ and PCC4 lines, by causing histone hyperacetylation. Unlike retinoic acid and HMBA, butyrate altered histone H2a and H2b forms in 6050AJ cells. In PCC4(RA)-1 cells, which respond poorly to retinoic acid, butyrate reactivated cellular retinoic acid binding protein expression, and combining butyrate with retinoic acid produced extensive differentiation. The findings suggest butyrate acts through a mechanism distinct from other inducers.

pmid-6141346.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍347例と対照347例を比較した症例対照研究です。現在の農業従事がオッズ比6.27と有意に関連しました。石油・天然ガス採掘業も、オッズ比2.29で過剰リスクと関連していました。職業的曝露が精巣がんのリスクに関与する可能性が示されています。
pmid-6141346.summary_en: This hospital-based case-control study reviewed records of 347 patients with histologically confirmed testicular germ cell tumors and 347 controls with other disorders. Present farming occupation was significantly associated with testicular cancer, with an odds ratio of 6.27. Employment in crude petroleum and natural gas extraction also conferred excess risk, with an odds ratio of 2.29. The findings suggest occupational exposures in agriculture and oil and gas work may contribute to the risk of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-6143856.summary_ja: 1959年から1978年に治療された精巣セミノーマ74例のうち、停留精巣の既往がある6例を検討しました。停留精巣の悪性腫瘍リスクは正常精巣の約20〜48倍とされ、発がんの機序と定期的なフォローアップの重要性が論じられています。
pmid-6143856.summary_en: The authors reviewed 74 patients treated for testicular seminoma at the University of Louisville between 1959 and 1978, identifying six with a history of cryptorchidism. They reviewed these cases alongside the literature, discussed etiologic factors for tumorigenesis in undescended testes, and emphasized the importance of periodic follow-up. The paper notes that malignancy risk in an undescended testicle is roughly 20 to 48 times that of a normally descended testicle, highlighting cryptorchidism as a significant risk factor for seminoma.

pmid-6144603.summary_ja: Tera-2由来のヒト胎児性癌クローン株NT2/D1とNT2/B9をレチノイン酸で処理すると、体外で広範に分化しました。神経細胞を含む複数の形態の細胞が生じ、SSEA-3の発現は消失しました。クローン性ヒト胎児性癌細胞株の広範な体細胞分化の初の報告です。
pmid-6144603.summary_en: Two clonal human embryonal carcinoma lines, NT2/D1 and NT2/B9, derived from Tera-2, were treated with retinoic acid and differentiated extensively in vitro. Differentiation produced several morphologically distinct cell types, including neurons forming clustered networks with axon bundles. Differentiated cells expressed neurofilament proteins and tetanus toxin receptors, and lost SSEA-3 expression. The authors describe this as the first extensive somatic differentiation of a clonal human EC cell line in vitro, a finding relevant to embryonal carcinoma biology.

pmid-6144604.summary_ja: レチノイン酸およびHMBAに対して分化しない胎児性癌(EC)細胞変異株を融合し、相補性を解析した1984年の研究。レチノイン酸結合蛋白(cRABP)の有無により分化能が異なることを示し、変異株どうしの融合では部分的な相補性が認められた。腫瘍形成した雑種細胞株の分化パターンも検討され、胚細胞腫瘍の分化障害の機序理解に寄与する知見である。
pmid-6144604.summary_en: This 1984 study fused embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell mutants that fail to differentiate in response to retinoic acid and HMBA, analyzing their genetic complementation. Hybrids between an RA-unresponsive line lacking cellular RA-binding protein and responsive lines differentiated normally, and hybrids between two RA-refractory mutants showed partial complementation with low cRABP. Tumors from hybrids differentiated variably, suggesting EC lines may differentiate poorly in tumor form for different reasons. These findings inform understanding of differentiation defects in germ cell tumor-derived stem-like cells.
